We encourage you to keep an eye on our careers site to stay informed about future opportunities where we are able to offer visa sponsorship.

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today's challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future. Leveraging Data, AI, and real-time decision-making we turn energy complexity into growth opportunities for our partners.

By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable and affordable.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

What will I be doing?

As a Senior Pre-Sales Engineer
, you are a "developer-plus" technical contributor. You are responsible for building high-quality mock backends, APIs, and demo infrastructure, but with a unique twist: you leverage LLMs and Generative AI
to prototype at high velocity.

This role sits at the critical boundary between Product Engineering and Go-to-Market. While you won't build production systems, you will build "production-shaped" assets: reusable, well-structured, and documented services that enable credible technical storytelling and high-fidelity client validation.

Your core responsibilities will include:

AI-Accelerated Prototyping: Leverage LLMs (e.g., Claude and Gemini) to rapidly scaffold, build, and iterate on proof-of-concept apps and mock services. You move faster than a traditional sprint by using AI to handle the "heavy lifting" of boilerplate and logic generation.
Technical Asset Development: Design, build, and maintain reusable mock services in Node.js / TypeScript. You’ll implement contract-first APIs (REST/GraphQL), manage AWS deployments (API Gateway, Containers), and handle persistence using PostgreSQL or DynamoDB
Infrastructure as Code: Manage demo environments using Terraform, ensuring environments are reproducible and secure using existing OIDC authentication patterns.
Frontend Collaboration: Work closely with frontend engineers to ensure UI components point cleanly to your mock services, debugging integration issues and supporting end-to-end demo flows.
Strategic Pre-Sales Support: Partner with Pre-Sales consultants to translate client "win themes" into working technical artefacts. You will occasionally demo directly to clients, showcasing how Kaluza solves their specific retail challenges.
Product & UX Influence: Collaborate with Design and Product teams for UI direction while developing your own design ideas to make Kaluza’s capabilities shine.
Mentorship & Standards: Set informal engineering standards for the pre-sales team, mentoring others on API design and architecture.
AI Evangelism: Act as the resident expert in GenAI workflows for the Commercial team, mentoring others on how to use AI to bridge the gap between "slide-ware" and "software."

What this role is NOT:

A pure presentation-led role (you will be writing code regularly).
Shipping production code (your value comes from building things that work for a demo, not maintaining production SLOs).

About You

You are a software engineer by trade but a prototyper by heart. You understand the rigour of clean code but know when to lean into AI to accelerate delivery. You are motivated by the immediate impact of winning new clients and validating Kaluza’s value proposition in real-time.

Ideally you’ll have/be:

Software Engineering Foundation: Strong hands-on experience in Node.js / TypeScript and React. You know how to write code from scratch, which is why you’re so good at prompting AI to do it for you.
GenAI Power User: Deep experience leveraging LLMs and Generative AI to build apps, debug complex issues, and accelerate the development lifecycle. You aren't just using an AI assistant; you are "vibe coding" complete PoCs.
API Design Expert: Experience designing clean, well-documented APIs (REST and/or GraphQL) and using Git/Github workflows effectively.
Cloud & Infrastructure Knowledge: Familiarity with AWS primitives and a proven ability to deploy infrastructure using Terraform.
Pragmatic & Autonomous: Comfortable operating with ambiguity, translating vague client requirements into working systems through a high degree of initiative.

What Will Set You Apart

The "Prototyper" Portfolio: A track record of building internal tools, sales demos, or high-fidelity PoCs using AI-first workflows.
Energy Sector Insight: Understanding the specific challenges facing energy retailers globally.
Auth & Security Savvy: Practical knowledge of OIDC-based authentication flows.
Design Thinking: A talent for sharing UX/UI design thinking with wider product teams.

Where you'll work

We offer flexible working, with an expectation of 3 days a week in the office. This gives us the best of both: real time together to collaborate and build relationships, with the flexibility to work in the way that suits you best the rest of the week.

Kaluza Values

Here at Kaluza we have five core values that guide us as a business:

Play to win, Solve the real problem, Build trust every day, Own the outcome, Go further together

From us you’ll get

Pension Scheme
Discretionary Bonus Scheme
Private Medical Insurance + Virtual GP
Life Assurance
Access to Furthr - a Climate Action app
Free Mortgage Advice and Eye Tests
Perks at Work - access to thousands of retail discounts
5% Flex Fund to spend on the benefits you want most
26 days holiday
Flexible bank holidays, giving you an additional 8 days which you can choose to take whenever you like
With no qualifying service periods, including up to 26 weeks full pay for primary caregivers and 4 weeks full pay for secondary caregivers when welcoming a new addition to your family
Dedicated personal learning and home office budgets
And more…

We want the best people

We’re keen to meet people from all walks of life — our view is that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We want to build teams which represent a variety of experiences, perspectives and skills, and we recognise talent on the basis of merit and potential.

We understand some people may not apply for jobs unless they tick every box. But if you're excited about joining us and think you have some of what we're looking for, even if you're not 100% sure, we'd still love to hear from you.

Find out more about working at Kaluza on our careers page and LinkedIn.

You can also find our Applicant Data Protection Policy here.

As a Software Developer, you will build the future of identity verification, creating AI-driven solutions that power our global platform.

Exciting Opportunity for a Solutions Architect at Entelect

Elevate your career at Entelect, where we prioritise people and nurture a culture of growth, collaboration, and innovation.

Join a dynamic, multidisciplinary environment that encourages versatility, and provides individual attention to career development, including intentional and regular one-on-ones with leadership.

Tackle complex challenges and make a meaningful impact alongside passionate professionals who inspire and support each other.

What You'll Be Doing:

Delivery
:

Leveraging your expertise to develop complex, enterprise applications for leading organisations globally.
Leaning on your deep understanding of technology frameworks; when they should be used, which are beneficial and what their pitfalls are.
Engaging in various stages of the SDLC, from system design to analysis, scoping, and estimation.
Researching innovative technologies and implementing them in projects to drive innovation.
Navigating complexity in enterprise environments and effective at collaborating with a technical audience to define the direction of a project.
Delivering premium, high-quality code, documentation, diagrams and presentations.
Not only relying on experience but having a broad awareness of tools and technology being used in industry. Have to be comfortable shaping solutions from the entire toolkit, suspending personal preferences in favour of a balanced outcome.
Experience working with Cloud solutions and using Cloud Native services in solutions.

People
:

Demonstrating maturity, motivation, and leadership in the workplace.
Championing change within the team and fostering a collaborative culture.
Collaborating with cross-functional teams to tackle complex business challenges, driving continuous improvement.
Leading and driving technical decision-making within your team.
Mentoring and guiding the people around you towards successful delivery and technical excellence.
Engaging with Entelect’s broader management team on relevant industry trends and setting the benchmark through work done at customers.

Customer:

Building strong relationships and understanding customer needs to deliver impactful solutions.
Managing customer expectations and identifying opportunities for service improvements.
Ensuring compliance with data security and industry regulations
Driving technical discussions, best practices as well as improving the technical landscapes across your customer’s projects.
Providing trusted advice and making use of your ability to gain buy-in and negotiate with customers.
Understanding how the business and the technology can combine to add true value to your customers.
Building on Entelect’s reputation within the customer environment.
Engaging with executives and senior technical audiences at customers. Incredibly selective and articulate in communicating concepts, choices and recommendations to senior audiences.

What We Need from You:

A bachelor’s degree in IT, Engineering, or related fields.
Minimum 10 years’ experience as a software engineer in an enterprise environment.
A solid understanding of software engineering fundamentals and commitment to clean code and best practices.
Broad and deep technical knowledge in your craft.
Cloud experience in Azure, AWS or GCP. Understanding of cloud native architectures as well as on premise and how they differ.
Ability to build, architect and design applications within an enterprise environment.
Mastery of various technologies with the agility to adapt to new frameworks.
Flexibility to work across a variety of different environments and tooling.
Strong collaboration and communication skills with a drive for continual improvement.
Ability to communicate with both technical and non-technical audiences.
Passion for delivering well-crafted solutions, systems, and services.
Hunger to continually improve those around you through mentorship and guidance.
Pro hybrid working model working from the office on average 2 – 3 times per week.

What You'll Get from Us:

A competitive compensation package with annual salary increases and guaranteed bonuses.
Tenure-based loyalty leave.
Access to employee wellness programs and rewards for professional development.
Commission incentives for successful business development leads and employee referrals.
Hands-on support from leadership through regular one on ones and quarterly reviews.
Continuous development programs offering training in leadership and technical skills.
Exposure to enterprise projects across multiple domains and problem spaces for South Africa’s most esteemed organisations.

Tech Stacks We Use:

*Popular but not limited to
Backend: Java Spring, C# .Net
Frontend techs: Angular, React, Vue, Blazor, Native and Cross platform mobile
Databases: Relational and No SQL
Cloud environments: Azure, AWS, GCP

What To Expect from the Recruitment Process:

Our aim is to make the recruitment process as efficient as possible, keeping you informed every step of the way.

The first step is an initial conversation with our talent team to get to know you better and introduce you to Entelect and all that we have to offer.
The next step will be a 1.5-hour in-person technical interview at one of our offices where you will meet some of our leadership team.
Following the technical interview, we will invite you back for an in-person case study presentation where we will give you the opportunity to showcase your leadership skills.
Finally, if we are both aligned, we wrap up the process with salary discussions and present you with an offer of employment.

Not quite ready but eager to learn more? Head to the Culture Site and complete the form to set up an exploratory chat. Our team understands that good things take time and are happy to wait until that time is right for you.

jobs.description:

With a team of over 900 professionals, we work to make things flow smoothly, whether it's for large organisations or individual employees. As businesses face rapid changes in the world of work, our team is here to help them adapt and thrive.

With over 40 years of experience behind us, MHR’s track record as a high-performance organisation is built on clear goals, a shared vision, and strong communication - all of which we pass on to our customers.

MHR is more than just a place to work; it’s a platform for empowerment. Joining us means bringing innovation, technology, and teamwork seamlessly removes obstacles, enhances your skills, and allow you to focus on what’s most important to you- work that matters.

With us, you’ll grow, find your flow, and make a lasting difference in your career, your team, and your impact.

Your Career

As a Software Engineering Manager at MHR, you'll lead a cross-functional team of Software Engineers and Test Engineers, helping build the next generation of our cloud-based HR and Payroll platform. Lead, coach and develop a cross-functional engineering team.
Drive a culture of quality, test-driven development and continuous improvement.
Support the delivery of scalable, maintainable software and architecture.
Partner with Product teams to deliver against product roadmaps.
Remove delivery obstacles and improve team effectiveness.
Support recruitment, talent development and succession planning.
Champion AI-assisted development practices to improve productivity and quality.

Experience leading or mentoring software engineers within Agile teams.
Strong software engineering background

Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
Interest in modern engineering practices, cloud technologies and AI-assisted development.

jobs.description:
What Makes Cloudbeds Unique

At Cloudbeds, we're not just building software, we’re transforming hospitality. Our intelligently designed platform powers properties across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From independent properties to hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've become the World's Best Hotel PMS Solutions Provider and landed on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again in 2024, but we're just getting started.

Location:

Remote (Europe)

How You'll Make an Impact:

As a Staff Software Engineer
in Revenue Intelligence, you will shape the technical direction of systems that help hospitality businesses understand demand, identify revenue opportunities, and make better pricing and commercial decisions. You will work across customer-facing applications, backend services, data pipelines, analytical stores, recommendation workflows, and cloud infrastructure. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will solve complex engineering problems directly while establishing architecture, improving reliability and security, reducing systemic technical debt, and aligning multiple teams around durable technical decisions. Your impact will extend beyond individual features to the quality, scalability, operability, and long-term evolution of the Revenue Intelligence platform.

Our Revenue Intelligence Team:

The Revenue Intelligence team builds products and platforms that turn hospitality data into practical decisions for hoteliers, including pricing recommendations, demand insights, reporting, automation, and commercial opportunities. Our systems span frontend experiences, APIs, distributed services, data processing, machine-learning workflows, and production infrastructure. We value pragmatic engineering, strong ownership, evidence-based decisions, and technical leaders who raise the effectiveness of the people and systems around them.

What You Bring to the Team:

Set and evolve the technical strategy for Revenue Intelligence, translating product and business goals into coherent architecture and executable engineering plans
Lead the design and delivery of complex capabilities across customer-facing web applications, backend APIs, event-driven services, data pipelines, analytical storage, and recommendation workflows
Identify and resolve systemic risks in scalability, reliability, security, data quality, observability, and operability before they become recurring customer or engineering problems
Drive modernization of legacy systems and infrastructure through incremental, well-reasoned migrations that preserve delivery momentum and production stability
Partner with Product, Data Science, Infrastructure, Security, and engineering leaders to define boundaries, contracts, ownership, and long-term platform direction
Remain hands-on in the codebase through implementation, technical spikes, design reviews, debugging, incident response, and the most consequential or ambiguous engineering work
Raise the technical effectiveness of the wider organization through mentoring, architecture guidance, engineering standards, documentation, and constructive challenge

What Sets You Up for Success:

10+ years of software engineering experience, including significant technical leadership across complex production systems
Deep hands-on expertise in Python, with the ability to work effectively across both ecosystems and guide engineering decisions beyond a single language
Strong architecture and distributed-systems fundamentals, including API design, event-driven workflows, consistency, failure handling, scalability, and service boundaries
Experience with data-intensive systems such as PostgreSQL, Redshift, or similar analytical platforms, batch and streaming pipelines, and large-scale data processing
Experience designing or operating recommendation systems, machine-learning platforms, pricing systems, experimentation workflows, or other decision-support products
Strong cloud and platform engineering experience across AWS, containers, Kubernetes, Terraform, Helm, Argo CD, CI/CD, observability, and secure production operations
A demonstrated ability to lead through influence, create alignment across teams, communicate complex tradeoffs clearly, and drive decisions from ambiguity to execution
A strong record of improving engineering quality through testing strategy, operational readiness, incident learning, security, documentation, and sustainable technical standards
Product judgment and customer empathy, with the ability to connect technical investments to measurable outcomes for hoteliers and the business
Business-level English fluency and experience collaborating effectively in a remote, globally distributed organization

Bonus Skills to Stand Out:

Investment Operations is a product area within SimCorp’s Product Division, which delivers functionality enabling the operations users to be highly efficient. It also offers full STP and automation capability for the workflows and processes seamlessly across the product areas and the financial institutions workflows.

As part of our Investment Operations Product Area, you will contribute to the development of enterprise products within this product area. You will collaborate with colleagues from Ukraine, Poland, Denmark and Germany, while gaining deep expertise in applied finance and modern software engineering practices.

What You Will Be Responsible For

Collaborate closely with Product Owners, Technical Leads, and teammates during analysis, refinement, and development.

Drive improvements in automation, CI/CD pipelines, and development tools.
Ensure adherence to engineering best practices (XP, TDD, clean code).
Engage in Sprint Reviews/Demos and continuous process improvements

We are looking for an experienced engineer with well-developed technical and collaborative skills

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field.
3+ years of professional experience with C# (.NET or .NET Framework).
Extensive experience in designing and developing enterprise applications in .NET / C#.
Demonstrated expertise in automation frameworks and CI/CD

Experience with relational databases (SQL).
Proficient English communication skills (Upper-Intermediate or higher), written and spoken
Ability to mentor, guide, and inspire other developers.

Background in FinTech or capital markets.

Possibility to join Deutsche Börse Group Share Plan (eligible after 1 year)

At Netwrix, our mission is to revolutionize data security by placing identity at the core - providing unparalleled visibility and control. Engineered and supported by over 900 highly talented, motivated employees and hundreds of trusted partners in nearly every geography, Netwrix solutions are relied upon daily by security professionals across more than 13,500 organizations in over 100 countries around the world.

Over the past two decades, Netwrix has expanded its market presence through innovation, organic growth, and strategic acquisitions, and are proud to be backed by renowned private equity firms, TA Associates and Centerbridge Partners. Netwrix maintains a global presence, fostering a remote-first work environment while encouraging and facilitating frequent face-to-face interaction with colleagues, customers, and partners.

Position Overview

Netwrix is on a mission to help customers protect and secure their identity and data landscape through market-leading on-prem and SaaS products and integrated solutions. Netwrix Identity products provide leading identity security solutions to thousands of enterprise customers worldwide.

We are seeking a highly skilled Staff Software Engineer who will develop new features and capabilities for Netwrix Identity Recovery, our enterprise solution for backup and recovery of Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, and Okta environments. The Staff Software Engineer will ensure scalable, secure, high-quality experiences for enterprise customers in both on-prem and SaaS environments.

This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced technical leader to help shape the future of identity recovery. You will contribute to the advancement of Netwrix Identity Recovery and key technologies across the platform, with opportunities to integrate AI capabilities into our products and development process. Working closely with engineers and product leaders, you'll influence architectural direction, mentor engineers, and help deliver solutions that protect organizations worldwide against identity-based threats.

Your home base is the Netwrix Identity Recovery team. You will work within a shared engineering platform and technology stack, with opportunities to contribute to other products across the Netwrix ITDR portfolio — such as PingCastle, Threat Prevention, and Threat Manager.

Write high-quality code and design scalable backend services for on-prem and SaaS environments, setting examples of technical excellence for the team and supporting key decisions on architecture, scalability, and integration

Familiarity with Windows systems programming and enterprise deployment patterns
Understanding of DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and monitoring/observability

Technical Skills

Strong proficiency in C# and the .NET ecosystem (.NET Core/.NET) — the primary managed language in this stack
Proficiency in maintaining and extending C++ code – the primary language of the core Windows services in the Recovery product
Experience with Windows systems programming: services, IPC, and Windows security APIs
Solid understanding of Active Directory, Entra ID, Okta, or similar identity and directory systems
Strong knowledge of distributed systems, modular architectures, and service-oriented design
Experience with SQL Server or comparable relational databases
Proficiency in designing RESTful APIs and asynchronous communication patterns
Familiarity with cloud platforms (Azure preferred), containerization, and infrastructure as code

Leadership & Soft Skills

Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams
Proven ability to balance technical quality with business priorities and timelines
Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to tackle complex, ambiguous challenges
Experience mentoring or guiding engineers in technical growth

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with C++ on Windows, including COM, RPC, and Windows service development

Experience with Azure services: Azure Identity, Azure Key Vault, Azure Blob Storage, Azure Container Instances

Understanding of disaster recovery, BCDR product categories, or identity security (ITDR)
Familiarity with threat detection methodologies, SIEM concepts, and security frameworks
Contributions to open-source projects or involvement in technical communities

jobs.description:
Get to Know Us

Since being founded in 2001, BlackLine has become a leading provider of cloud software that automates and controls the entire financial close process. Our vision is to modernize the finance and accounting function to enable greater operational effectiveness and agility, and we are committed to delivering innovative solutions and services to empower accounting and finance leaders around the world to achieve Modern Finance.
Being a best-in-class SaaS company, we understand that bringing in new ideas and innovative technology is mission critical. At BlackLine we are always working with new, cutting-edge technology that encourages our teams to learn something new and expand their creativity and technical skillset that will accelerate their careers.
This role is specifically for our AI-powered Invoice-to-Cash (I2C) solution, a market-leading platform that uses intelligent automation to help companies collect cash faster, unlock working capital, and supercharge efficiency in their accounts receivable processes.
Work, Play and Grow at BlackLine!

Make Your Mark

As the founding Manager, Software Engineering for our new Business Intelligence & Analytics Engineering team
in Krakow, you have one of the most consequential roles in this new chapter of BlackLine's growth. This is a genuinely multi-disciplinary team - spanning data engineering, cloud data platforms, BI and analytics, and applied AI - and you will be the architect of the team itself: hiring and developing a world-class group of engineers across those disciplines, and shaping the culture, practices, and career trajectories of everyone in it.
You will lead the team through an ambitious delivery arc. You will start by standing up modern data pipelines - using Fabric database mirroring to move data from our Azure-hosted tenant databases into a canonical data model in Snowflake
- then build the modelling layer and surface insight to customers through Power BI
dashboards. From there, the team will develop true agentic AI experiences for risk analysis, credit management, cash allocation, and Disputes & Deductions (D&D), blending Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) and Human-on-the-Loop (HOTL) patterns on BlackLine's BL 3.0 Agentic framework.
You will partner closely with your senior engineers and cross-functional product leadership to ensure the team operates with clarity, urgency, and a high engineering bar. You will champion a culture of AI-accelerated development, where tools like Claude and Cursor are woven into the everyday fabric of how we build. This is not just a management role - it is a founding leadership role with an enduring impact on our mission to deliver autonomous finance and expand BlackLine's office-of-the-CFO footprint.

You'll Get To

Build and Scale the Krakow BI & Analytics Engineering Team:
Lead the hiring, onboarding, and ongoing development of a high-performing, multi-disciplinary team spanning data engineering, BI/analytics, and AI. Be an ambassador for BlackLine's engineering culture in the Krakow hub from day one.
Deliver the Snowflake Analytics Platform:
Own delivery of our modern data platform - Fabric database mirroring from Azure-hosted tenant databases into a canonical Snowflake data model, the Snowflake modelling and semantic layers, and customer-facing Power BI dashboards that turn that data into insight.
Lead the Agentic Experience Roadmap:
Guide the team from analytics into applied AI - building true agentic agents for risk analysis, credit management, cash allocation, and Disputes & Deductions management, delivering a mix of Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) and Human-on-the-Loop (HOTL) experiences on BlackLine's BL 3.0 Agentic framework, integrated with our existing web applications.
Lead, Coach, and Grow Your Team:
Own the career development, performance, and wellbeing of your direct reports across a varied set of specialisms. Conduct regular 1:1s, provide meaningful feedback, and create growth paths that retain and attract top talent in a competitive Krakow market.
Drive Delivery and Execution:
Partner with Product Management to align on priorities, manage engineering capacity, and ensure the team consistently delivers high-quality software and data products on time. Remove blockers, manage risk, and keep commitments.
Champion AI-Accelerated Development:
Cultivate a team mindset and workflow that embraces modern agentic development tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude) as force multipliers for velocity and quality - and hold the bar high for what great engineering looks like in this era.
Shape Engineering Culture and Standards:
Establish and uphold best practices across the full stack of the team's work - data pipeline reliability and observability, data quality and lineage, dimensional and semantic modelling standards, code quality, CI/CD, testing, and security. Set the tone for a culture of ownership, craft, and continuous improvement.
Collaborate Cross-Functionally:
Serve as the primary engineering leadership voice in conversations with Product, Design, and senior stakeholders, and with the analytics and office-of-the-CFO consumers of the team's output. Translate business goals into actionable engineering plans and communicate engineering realities clearly to non-technical partners.
Contribute to Strategic Roadmap Planning:
Participate in quarterly and annual planning cycles, providing technical and capacity input that shapes the product roadmap, the data platform architecture, and long-term agentic-AI direction.
Sustain Enterprise-Grade Quality:
Ensure the team's output - data pipelines, analytics, and AI agents alike - meets the reliability, performance, accuracy, and security standards required by a global SaaS platform serving finance and accounting professionals worldwide.

Technical / Specialized Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

Proven experience leading and growing engineering teams
in a SaaS product environment, with a track record of hiring, developing, and retaining engineers at multiple seniority levels.
Strong technical foundation in data engineering and analytics
- hands-on experience with cloud data platforms and pipelines, ideally including Snowflake
, Microsoft Fabric
, and Power BI / DAX
, and dimensional or semantic data modelling - sufficient to earn trust with your engineers and make sound architectural trade-offs.
Solid grounding in application engineering
- production-grade, scalable, secure services, ideally in C# / .NET
- and comfort leading integration with modern web applications (React / C# / SQL Server / PostgreSQL).
Awareness of, or genuine enthusiasm for, building agentic AI / LLM-based experiences
(including HITL and HOTL patterns) and integrating them into enterprise products.
Experience managing in an AI-augmented engineering environment,
or a genuine enthusiasm and aptitude for adopting AI-driven development tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude) to raise team velocity and quality.
Demonstrated ability to drive cross-functional delivery,
aligning engineering, product, and design stakeholders around shared goals and managing execution with clarity and accountability.
Strong people management skills,
including structured performance management, career development frameworks, and the ability to have direct, compassionate conversations.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills;
comfortable representing the team to senior leadership and working effectively across time zones and cultures.
A high engineering bar:
you understand what great looks like in data quality, pipeline reliability, code quality, CI/CD, testing, and observability, and you hold the team to that standard.

We're Even More Excited If You Have

Experience standing up a new engineering team or office, especially in a greenfield or hub-expansion context where you shaped culture from scratch.
Experience delivering a cloud data-warehouse migration or modernisation (e.g., to Snowflake) and building customer-facing embedded analytics.
Hands-on exposure to agentic AI, LLM orchestration, or ML-driven decisioning in a production enterprise setting.
Background in regulated industries such as finance, accounting, or fintech, giving you sensitivity to the compliance and reliability requirements our customers depend on - and to the office-of-the-CFO analytics use cases this team serves.
Familiarity with cloud-native architectures and experience guiding teams building on Azure (and comfort across AWS or Google Cloud).
Knowledge of Responsible AI principles and how to guide a team in applying them responsibly when leveraging AI-generated code and autonomous agents in production.
A history of strong cross-timezone collaboration with engineering and product leadership in distributed organizations.

is the team that builds and supports the world's leading marketplace for travel experiences
. We believe that making memories is what travel is all about. And with 400,000+ travel experiences to explore—everything from simple tours to extreme adventures (and everything in between) —making memories that will last a lifetime has never been easier.

About The Role

We’re looking for a product-focused Software Engineer II
to join our fast-growing Experiences Engineering team. This is a full-stack role, leveraging Java, SQL, React, AWS and AI tools
. It’s ideal for mid-level engineers who enjoy solving complex problems, shipping frequently, and working in a modern cloud environment. You’ll play a key role in building high-impact features that power millions of traveler experiences globally.

We embrace flexibility in where and how work gets done and also value meaningful in-person moments to connect and collaborate. You can expect a remote-first working model
with periodic in-person gatherings at your closest office for team connection, planning, or other key moments. This position is open to candidates based within a commutable distance (generally up to 1.5 hours) of one of our office hubs in London, Oxford, Krakow or Lisbon.

What You’ll Do

Drive Impact: Connect your engineering work directly to traveler value by owning features from design to deployment.
Shape the Product: Partner with product, design, and data teams to influence what we build, helping to define specifications and find the most efficient path to success.
Collaborate & Mentor: Review code, provide thoughtful feedback, and coach less experienced engineers to maintain a high bar for quality.
Innovate with AI: Use agentic AI as a daily partner to plan approaches, automate routine tasks, and focus your energy on solving more complex technical challenges.
Champion Operational Health: Take hands-on ownership of system reliability by building monitoring dashboards, managing alerts and support cases, and fixing underlying bugs to continuously improve service resilience and eliminate operational toil.
Build for Quality: Design and implement clean, maintainable solutions with a focus on performance, security, and automated testing.

Skills & Experience

We typically look for a minimum of 2-3 years’ experience, following a Bachelor’s degree or above in Comp Science or a related field.

Full-Stack Mindset: Experience developing web apps, including proficiency in a modern backend language (e.g., Java, C#, Go, Python) and familiarity with relational databases.
Problem Solving: A strong grasp of computer science fundamentals (data structures, algorithms) and the ability to apply them to real-world distributed systems.
Data-Driven: A habit of using operational data and experiment results to validate that your changes had the intended effect.
AI Coding: you are fluent coding with either Cursor or Codex/Claude/Open Code.
Global Mindset: Ability to operate effectively within a global team, communicating clearly about progress and blockers.

We don’t expect you to know everything on day one. However, we’re especially interested if you’ve had exposure to AWS, React, or NoSQL databases. More than any specific tool, we value curiosity and the ability to solve problems creatively.

We value engineers from different technical backgrounds. You can complete our coding interview exercises
in any language of your choice, but need to be open to working within the Java ecosystem when you join!

What We Offer

Competitive compensation packages, including base salary, annual bonus, and more.
“Work your way” with flexibility to suit your lifestyle. We take a remote-friendly approach to collaboration, with the option to join on-site as often as you’d like in select locations.
Flexible schedule. Work-life balance is ingrained in our culture by design. Trust and accountability make it work.
Donation matching. Give back? Give more! We match qualifying charitable donations annually.
Tuition assistance. Want to level up your career? We love to hear it! Receive annual support for qualified programs.
Lifestyle benefit. An annual benefit to spend on yourself. Use it on travel, wellness, or whatever suits you.
Travel perks. We believe that travel is employee development, so we provide discounts and more.
Employee assistance program. We’re here for you with resources and programs to help you through life’s challenges.
Health benefits. We offer great coverage and competitive premiums.
Generous referral scheme. Help us grow and be rewarded with generous awards for referring successful candidates.

Our Cultural Pillars

Traveller first: We exist to create value for our customer, the traveler. We enable our suppliers and partners to unlock this value. Their collective behaviors and insights are what drives us.
Execution is our edge: We act fast, experiment, learn from failure, iterate, and improve the solutions of tomorrow across every aspect of our business. Our execution is agile, data-driven, prioritised, and built to scale. We assume no problem is someone else’s problem and finish what can be done today, knowing tomorrow will bring fresh challenges.
We succeed together: The best outcomes are driven by empathic, humble, and diverse subject matter experts working toward shared goals. We collaborate relentlessly, challenge assumptions, give actionable feedback, and set each other up for success through empowered teams with a clear charter. We transparently take ownership of our growth, individually and as a team. We celebrate the quality of our effort, our learnings, and our collective achievements.

Discover more in our Tech Blog, for an inside look into some of our exciting and ground-breaking technical projects here at Tripadvisor Group.

Tripadvisor Group champions the unique identities, abilities, and experiences of all our people – employees, customers, and partners. This stems from our belief in the transformative power of travel, dining, and experiences to connect us and open doors to worlds very different from our own. Our ED&I strategy shapes how we approach our people, culture, business, and reputation. Tripadvisor Group strives to embed inclusion and belonging across all our brands.

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please make sure to reach out to your individual recruiter or our team at AccessibleRecruiting@tripadvisor.com
.

If you have any additional questions about careers at Tripadvisor you can email us at recruitment@tripadvisor.com
. We have all the answers!

jobs.title: Software Engineer 5— Platform Modernization Engineering
jobs.description:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

About The Team

The Platform Modernization Engineering (PME) — Migrations team exists to accelerate Netflix's ability to evolve its infrastructure by driving safe, scalable migrations across the stack. We reduce engineering toil, eliminate technical debt, and enable teams to move forward with confidence as Netflix's technology continues to evolve at pace.

We are not a feature delivery team. We are a revenue protector and accelerator — through our work we enable faster feature delivery, innovation, and security protection across the entire engineering organization.

Netflix operates one of the most sophisticated and high-scale engineering platforms in the world. Keeping that platform on the leading edge requires continuous, intentional modernization. The Paved Path — our curated set of recommended, well-supported infrastructure standards — is constantly advancing as Netflix pushes into new technical territory. Our team exists to bring the fleet along with it: setting clear baselines, accelerating adoption across thousands of services, and protecting that progress from erosion over time. We affect both engineering culture and engineering quality at scale.

We operate in pods (3–6 month cycles), partnering closely with the most strategically critical initiatives across Infrastructure Engineering. We build the automation and tooling that lets us execute these at a scale and speed no manual effort could match, including AI-assisted code modification pipelines and fleet-wide orchestration systems.

About The Role

We are looking for an experienced L5 Software Engineer who thrives at the intersection of large-scale systems, automation, and cross-functional influence. You will design and build the tooling and automation that powers fleet-wide migration campaigns, partner directly with platform and product teams to de-risk complex infrastructure changes, and help define what excellent Paved Path adoption looks like in practice at Netflix.

This is a high-autonomy, high-impact role. You will own migration projects end-to-end — from scoping and technical design through automated execution, quality validation, and completion. You'll also build durable tooling that outlasts any single campaign.

Key Responsibilities

Migration Engineering

Design and execute large-scale code and infrastructure migration campaigns across Netflix's fleet of thousands of repositories and services. Own the full lifecycle: scoping, campaign design, automated execution, validation, and completion.

Automation & Tooling

Build and extend PME's internal automation platforms — leveraging AI-assisted code modification, rule-based transformations, and batch orchestration — to scale the team's impact across the fleet with speed and reliability.

Technical Design

Write clear, well-researched design documents. Identify and communicate tradeoffs between migration approaches and drive decisions with data and stakeholder input.

Cross-Functional Partnership

Embed with partner teams driving the most crucial infrastructure-level strategic initiatives to deeply understand migration needs, de-risk project execution, and ensure campaigns land successfully with minimal customer toil.

Paved Path Advocacy

Proactively identify opportunities to improve Paved Path adoption and adherence. Surface patterns and systemic opportunities — then act on them. Influence product strategy and roadmaps of platform teams through direct engagement and data.

Operational Excellence

Instrument migrations with telemetry and dashboards. Monitor fleet health, track adoption rates, and build the feedback loops that continuously improve campaign design and execution.

Who You Are

A strong generalist engineer energized by scope and ambiguity — comfortable working across the full stack (backend services, automation pipelines, data models, dashboards) while building depth in the areas that matter most.

A systems thinker who understands that successful migrations are as much about people and process as they are about code — and designs solutions accordingly.

A self-directed owner who can take a high-priority, ambiguous challenge and drive it to completion across teams, time zones, and organizational boundaries.

Someone who builds customer trust through repeated, low-drama delivery. You communicate proactively, course-correct quickly, and leave things better than you found them.

A pragmatic builder who defaults to automation and reuse, builds tools that generalize beyond a single use case, and knows when to ship fast vs. when to invest in durability.

jobs.description:
About Us

At Plentific, we’re redefining property management in real time. Our mission, is to lead real estate through the transformative journey into “The World of Now,” enabling us to empower property professionals through our innovative, cloud-based platform.
We harness cutting-edge technology and data-driven insights to streamline operations for landlords, letting agents, and property managers—enabling them to optimize maintenance, manage repairs, and make informed decisions instantly. Our platform is designed to create seamless, real-time workflows that transform traditional property management into a dynamic, digital experience.
Backed by a world-class group of investors—including Noa, Highland Europe, Brookfields, Mubadala, RXR Digital Ventures, and Target Global—Plentific is at the forefront of the proptech revolution. Headquartered in London with a global outlook, we’re continually expanding our reach and impact.
We’re looking for forward-thinking, passionate professionals who are ready to contribute to our mission and drive industry innovation. If you’re excited about making an immediate impact and shaping the future of property management, explore career opportunities with us at Plentific.
The Role

We're looking for a Software Architect

to join our engineering team and play a pivotal role in shaping the technical direction of our platform. This is not just a hands-on engineering role, it's a leadership position where you'll be expected to bridge the gap between product vision and technical execution.
You'll work closely with Product Managers to translate business requirements into robust technical strategies, produce detailed technical analyses, and guide a team of engineers toward successful, on-time delivery. At the same time, you'll remain deeply hands-on, contributing directly to our codebase and setting the bar for engineering excellence across the team.
Our engineering team sits at the centre of everything we do at Plentific and is constantly tackling challenging problems, such as online payments, quoting, invoicing, booking, search and scoring algorithms, ETL, data pipelines, in-app messaging, real-time notifications, and fraud prevention. Our backend engineers mostly work with Python and Django on a service-oriented architecture deployed at scale on Kubernetes. jobs.description:
Posting Type

Remote

Job Overview

WHO WE ARE

Relativity is a leading legal data intelligence company building technology that helps users organize data, discover the truth, and act on it with confidence. Our AI-powered, cloud platform, RelativityOne, transforms massive volumes of complex information into actionable insights for litigation, investigations, regulatory inquiries, data breach responses, and other high-stakes legal work where accuracy and trust are crucial.

The world’s largest law firms, corporations, and government agencies rely on Relativity’s legal AI software to securely surface and manage the most relevant and impactful information in their matters. Beyond our commercial impact, we are committed to expanding access to technology and supporting pro bono legal work.

What We Do

At Relativity, engineers do more than write code - they build systems that enable users to uncover insights from complex data at scale using cloud-native architecture, AI, and modern tools.

About The Role

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Engineering Platform team, where you will help build the cloud-native backbone that powers Relativity’s development ecosystem. You will work on high-impact initiatives that shape how our engineers build, test, deploy, and scale software—driving technical excellence across the company.

As part of a growing and financially stable organization, you will contribute in a dynamic, fast-moving environment that values autonomy, ownership, and practical action over excessive process. Platform engineers are trusted to solve complex problems at scale and empowered to make decisions that improve the day-to-day experience of developers.

Job Description And Requirements

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Design, build, and operate scalable, secure, and reliable platform services and developer tooling using .NET and Microsoft Azure
Lead the development of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) components to automate and standardize cloud infrastructure
Drive adoption of DevOps practices and CI/CD automation across engineering teams
Collaborate with internal stakeholders to build reusable capabilities that improve development speed and consistency
Integrate observability, performance monitoring, and self-service tooling into the platform ecosystem
Mentor and support engineers through code reviews, technical discussions, and knowledge sharing
Proactively identify improvement areas, experiment with solutions, and deliver results with a bias toward action
Contribute to initiatives that embed AI/ML into platform services and developer workflows

Required

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

5+ years of software development experience with strong expertise in C# and the .NET ecosystem
Deep hands-on experience with Azure services and cloud-native application patterns
Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates
Experience building or supporting CI/CD systems and modern DevOps pipelines
Familiarity with containers and orchestration tools such as Docker, Kubernetes, or AKS
Demonstrated success working in Agile teams and collaborating cross-functionally
Strong problem-solving, communication, and mentorship skills

Preferred

Exposure to AI/ML tools or interest in applying AI to platform and engineering challenges

WHY WE COULD BE A GREAT FIT

Impactful Mission

Build systems that help customers organize data, discover the truth, and act on it in high-stakes legal matters.

Engineering at Scale

Work on distributed, cloud-native systems that process large volumes of data.

Cutting-Edge Technology

Build with AI, cloud platforms, and scalable architectures shaping legal tech.

Growth and Ownership

Gain experience owning systems end-to-end across cloud and distributed environments.

Collaborative Culture

Work in a team focused on knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.

Inclusive Environment

Diverse perspectives create stronger teams and better outcomes.

Compensation And Benefits

Competitive salary, benefits, DTO, parental leave, and equity program.

Relativity is committed to competitive, fair, and equitable compensation practices.

This position is eligible for total compensation which includes a competitive base salary, an annual performance bonus, and long-term incentives.

The expected salary range for this role is between following values:

208 000 and 312 000PLN

The final offered salary will be based on several factors, including but not limited to the candidate's depth of experience, skill set, qualifications, and internal pay equity. Hiring at the top end of the range would not be typical, to allow for future meaningful salary growth in this position.

Required Skills

Automation, Data Analysis, Database Management, Network Architecture, Performance Optimizations, Problem Solving, Project Management, Software Development, System Designs, Technical Leadership

jobs.description:
Project Description:

The project is part of the Credit, Asset-backed & Securitized Products (CASP) division of an investment bank, focusing on platforms that support securitization and structured finance products. The current primary objective is migrating existing on-premise systems to a modern Microsoft Azure cloud environment, transforming legacy architecture into scalable, cloud-native solutions. It involves rebuilding and adapting systems used for structuring, processing, and distributing securities such as ABS, MBS, and CLOs. The platform integrates with trading, risk, and regulatory systems to support both real-time and batch data processing. The target architecture follows a microservices-based approach with containerized services deployed on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS). Infrastructure provisioning and configuration are managed using Terraform as Infrastructure as Code. The system leverages REST APIs and event-driven communication to ensure scalability and flexibility during and after migration. Special focus is placed on maintaining data consistency, performance, and regulatory compliance throughout the transition. The project emphasizes high availability, resilience, and observability in a complex financial ecosystem. AI-assisted development tools like GitHub Copilot are integrated to enhance engineering productivity. The environment promotes modern engineering practices, automation, and continuous improvement.

Responsibilities:

Design, develop, and maintain backend services using Java 11+ and Spring Boot within a microservices architecture.
Build and enhance RESTful APIs and message-driven services supporting securitization and credit workflows.
Develop and deploy cloud-native applications on Microsoft Azure, including AKS-based container orchestration.
Use Terraform to define and manage infrastructure as code.
Work with containerization technologies (Docker) and contribute to CI/CD pipelines using GitLab or GitHub.
Implement integrations using messaging systems such as Kafka, IBM MQ, or Tibco EMS.
Collaborate on system design, ensuring scalability, resilience, and alignment with distributed architecture principles.
Develop and optimize database interactions using Azure SQL, Oracle, or Sybase.
Write and maintain unit, integration, and end-to-end tests to ensure code quality and reliability.
Implement monitoring, logging, and observability practices to support production systems.
Utilize Linux/Unix skills for troubleshooting and scripting.
Leverage AI-assisted development tools to improve efficiency while maintaining high coding standards.

Mandatory Skills Description:

Strong object-oriented programming skills with Java 11+
Extensive experience with Spring Boot / Spring ecosystem
Hands-on development of Web and/or REST APIs and message-driven services
Experience building and running containerized applications
Strong experience with Azure cloud, including:
Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform
Kubernetes (AKS) and container orchestration
Compute (VMs) and storage solutions (e.g., Azure Files)
Solid Linux/Unix skills (shell scripting, system understanding)
Experience with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot) integrated into development workflows
Experience with GitLab / GitHub, IntelliJ / VSCode

🏠 Hybrid work (3 days/week from the office)

🌐 Fully remote recruitment process
🖋 Stable employment based on an employment contract

Aristocrat jest spółką notowaną na giełdzie ASX, z siedzibą główną w Sydney w Australii. W centrum naszego działania są współpraca i integralność. Dbamy o dobrostan naszych pracowników i zapewniamy im narzędzia, które wspierają rozwój, inspirują do działania i pomagają w pełni wykorzystywać swoje możliwości. jobs.title: Mjukvaruingenjör - C#.NET
jobs.description:
Vi tror att framsteg och möjligheter skapas bäst tillsammans. Välkommen till en plats där samarbete gör skillnad.

Din roll

Ta chansen att bli en del av vårt engagerade team inom delprojektet Digital Map Generating System (DMGS) / Geodata inom JAS Gripen i rollen som mjukvaruutvecklare.

Vi är en central resurs som har expertis inom GIS, geodata och aeronautisk information. Geodata är en viktig del av de flesta av Saabs produkter och tjänster inom flyg, försvar och säkerhet. DMGS är ett egenutvecklat verktyg baserat på ESRI ArcMap för att behandla, kvalitetssäkra och producera Geodata till Gripen samt dess stöd- och träningssystem.

I rollen som mjukvaruutvecklare ingår t.ex. uppgifter som att arbeta fram kreativa lösningar kring överenskommen kravbild tillsammans med angränsande system. Planering, testning och möjligheten att kommunicera utvecklad funktion till intressenter kan också vara en del av arbetet.

Under funktionsutvecklingen kommer du samtidigt att få lära dig om hur vårt data och system kravställs, utvecklas, testas och distribueras; både i form av geografiska data till flygplan, till 3D-omvärldar för Gripens simulatorer samt till andra intressanta system.

Teamet består idag av roller som uppdragsledare, systemingenjörer och mjukvaruutvecklare och kännetecknas av en trevlig stämning och en god kultur av att hjälpa och lära av varandra.

Det finns en stor möjlighet till att anpassa dagarna med varierade arbetsuppgifter och även möjligheter att få delta på konferenser som sker utomlands.

Din närmsta chef är utbildad coach och om du brinner för personlig utveckling finns det stora möjligheter. Du erbjuds möjligheten att genomföra både interna och externa utbildningar.

Din profil

Kunskap inom C#.NET; gärna även inom WPF, Async Await och TPL.
Du har erfarenhet kring AI i kombination med programmering
Kunskap att se helheten och förstå hur olika delar av ett system interagerar. Detta är kritiskt för att designa skalbara och underhållbara system.
Förmågan att identifiera, analysera och lösa komplexa problem.
Förmågan att kommunicera tekniska koncept på ett sätt som är förståeligt för både tekniska och icke-tekniska teammedlemmar. Detta inkluderar dokumentation och presentationer.
Förmågan att säkerställa att mjukvaran uppfyller högsta kvalitetsstandarder. Inkluderar även testning, säkerhet och prestandaoptimering.
Förmågan att arbeta effektivt i ett team och har en bra kommunikativ approach
Applikationer: MS Visual Studio, ESRI ArcMap, ESRI ArcGIS Pro

Befattningen kräver att du genomgår och godkänns enligt vid var tid gällande bestämmelser för säkerhetsskydd. För befattningar där Saab har krav på säkerhetsklassinplacering kan, i förekommande fall, medföra krav på visst medborgarskap.

Vad blir du en del av

Upptäck oändliga möjligheter. Anta utmaningar, skapa smarta innovationer och uppgradera dina förmågor. Det här är en plats för kluriga tänkare, modiga pionjärer och alla däremellan. Tillsammans uppnår vi det extraordinära, var och en tar med sitt unika perspektiv. Varje bidrag räknas.

Saab är ett ledande försvars- och säkerhetsföretag med syfte att hjälpa nationer att skydda sin befolkning och bidra till trygghet för människor och samhällen. Med 28 000 talangfulla medarbetare utvecklar Saab teknik och lösningar för en säkrare och mer hållbar värld.

Saab utvecklar, tillverkar och underhåller avancerade system inom flygteknik, vapen, ledningssystem, sensorer och undervattenssystem. Saab har sitt huvudkontor i Sverige men en global verksamhet där Saab är en del av många nationers försvarsförmåga. Läs mer om oss här

You will work across a suite of applications built primarily with .NET, running in Docker-based environments. That means taking features from start to finish, contributing to architectural decisions, and helping improve how the team works.

Day to day, that means building and maintaining backend services in C#, developing front-end components in TypeScript, designing REST APIs, and operating services with Docker and Docker Compose. You will also contribute to infrastructure automation and internal tooling as the need arises.

We are AI-first in practice, not just in name. We actively use AI-assisted development workflows and expect that to deepen over time. The landscape shifts fast, and we are not waiting to see where it lands. We are building with it now. That means we want someone who is genuinely curious about these tools, experiments with them, and develops their own judgment about when and how to use them well.

Why Maranics

Most people spend years executing other people's decisions. At Maranics, you own the outcome. We are a small team building a tool that changes how businesses run in practice. Not prototypes, not internal tools that get quietly abandoned. When something ships here, you feel it.

Because we are small, your work is visible and the people who depend on it are not three teams away. We are genuinely AI-first, and we are building the kind of team that develops real judgment on real problems. Growth here is not rationed. When you are ready for more, you take it.

What We Are Looking For

You have 2–4 years of professional software development experience, solid .NET backend skills, and practical front-end experience. You are comfortable with Docker, Git-based workflows, and taking full ownership of a feature. A good grasp of software architecture fundamentals is important, as is strong written and spoken English.

Experience with CI/CD, infrastructure automation, or AI-assisted development tools is a plus. So is having worked in a small, distributed team before. You will know what that feels like.

Who This Is For

This role suits someone who wants more than ticket execution, who notices things, communicates openly, and cares about the outcome. If you want to build real things in a small remote team where your work has visible impact and your name is attached to it, this role will fit.

Practical Information

Location: Maranics is based in Gothenburg and the role works well hybrid, with flexibility on how often you are in the office.
Work permit within EU is required.
Start: As soon as possible, with consideration for your notice period.

About Maranics

Maranics builds a platform that digitalises operational workflows in complex, regulated industries. Where data was previously lost, scattered across silos, or trapped in manual processes, Maranics creates a single connected layer capturing what matters, routing it in real time, and delivering accurate, contextual data directly to the systems that need it.

At the same time, there is room to make your own mark. We value developers who ask questions, suggest improvements and take responsibility for moving things forward. As your knowledge of the product grows, so does your opportunity to influence it.
Appgate is growing, with major customer contracts driving expansion across our engineering teams. We're also developing new capabilities in areas such as operational technology (OT), helping secure access to industrial systems. Joining now means contributing as those capabilities take shape.

Requirements

Your role in the Core team

The Core team develops the client and controller at the heart of Appgate SDP.
The client is the software users interact with to connect securely. The controller manages the policies and access decisions that determine what they can reach.
This is a fullstack role:
your work will span the client, its C# logic and React/TypeScript interface, and the Java REST backend that powers it. You'll move across this boundary regularly, understanding how a feature connects from backend logic through to what the user sees. 1 Appgate | Core Team We use agentic AI tools as part of our development workflow and continue to explore where they can help us build, test and improve software. • Develop features for the Appgate client, using C#, React/TypeScript and Electron.
• Develop features for the Java REST backend.
• Investigate and resolve problems across applications, operating systems and networks.
• Improve automated testing, developer tooling and build and release workflows.
• Shape technical solutions through design discussions, code reviews and collaboration across teams.
What you bring

You enjoy building software, understanding how things work, and seeing a solution through. You're comfortable taking initiative, while knowing when to involve others and work through a problem together.
We're looking for:

• Strong professional experience with C#. • Backend development experience, ideally with Java.
• Experience with, or working knowledge of, React, TypeScript and Electron. • Confidence supporting and debugging software across Windows, macOS and Linux.
• A working understanding of Unix systems. • An interest in writing maintainable code and improving how it is tested and delivered.
• Good communication skills in English.

Benefits

Build something, you can put your name to If you're looking for room to grow, experienced colleagues to learn from, and the opportunity to take meaningful ownership of a security product, we'd like to hear from you.
Join Appgate's Core team and help shape what comes next.

Do you want to turn digital designs into real-world manufacturing solutions and help shape the future of production? At Sandvik Coromant in Gimo, you’re part of building smarter, more automated and data-driven manufacturing environments.

Why Sandvik?

At Sandvik Coromant, you join a market-leading company where innovation, sustainability and development are at the core of everything we do. Here, you get to:

Work with cutting-edge technology in a highly automated production environment
Collaborate globally in a diverse and inclusive organization
Contribute to solutions that shape the future of manufacturing

About The Job

You develop innovative and scalable software solutions that bridge digital design and physical manufacturing. Working closely with global teams, you enable smarter and more efficient production through automation and advanced data-driven approaches.

Job Responsibilities

Develop automation solutions that support the journey toward lights-out production
Translate product requirements into actionable shop floor solutions
Contribute to methodologies for robust and state-of-the-art software solutions
Support CAD automation using internal domain-specific languages
Create seamless automation flows from design to production
Participate in local and global projects related to new technologies and products

Location

This position is based on-site in Gimo, Sweden.

Your profile

You have a strong foundation in engineering and programming, combined with an interest in manufacturing and industrial processes. Working in a global environment, you communicate effectively in both English and Swedish and enjoy collaborating across teams and disciplines.

Your background includes:

Experience in programming (e.g. Python, Java, C#)
Knowledge of engineering, manufacturing or industrial processes
Familiarity with areas such as CAD/CAM, product development or automation
Understanding of modern development practices, such as agile methodologies
Experience working with systems, architecture or data-driven solutions
K8s and Microservices architecture and development practices

You’re curious and analytical, with a problem-solving mindset that drives continuous improvement. Collaboration comes naturally, and you enjoy working across teams and cultures to turn complex ideas into practical solutions. With a proactive approach, you adapt quickly to new technologies and contribute to a fast-moving, innovative environment.

Curious about Sandvik Coromant in Gimo?

Sandvik Coromant in Gimo is a great place to work, just a short trip from cities like Uppsala, Stockholm and Gävle. Our production site is awarded for its high grade of automation, digitalization and sustainability. We’re also a market-leading manufacturer of products for metal cutting, and in Gimo, we employ around 1200 brilliant minds. Development is in our DNA and we’re proud to create solutions that truly shape the future of manufacturing.

We believe that diversity of experience, perspective, and background leads to a better environment for our employees, our business, and our customers. Lösa komplexa tekniska problem på riktigt (inte bara flytta buggar mellan backloggar).
Ta tekniskt ansvar i uppdrag med hög komplexitet.
Växla naturligt mellan kod, arkitektur och dialog med kund i ditt uppdrag.

Ha roligt, utvecklas och bygga starka samarbeten med kollegor och kunder.

Du är en trygg, erfaren och vass utvecklare som:
Är ingenjör med 8+ års erfarenhet.
Pratar flytande svenska och engelska.
God kommunikationsförmåga, initiativtagande, självständig men samarbetsorienterad.
Är van att jobba nära både teknik och verksamhet.

Vi är kräsna med teknikval och uppdrag.
Vi tror på frihet under ansvar.
Du är ingen “resurs”. Du är vår kollega.

Ett bolag där det är helt okej att vara nördig, nyfiken och rak.
Fokus på långsiktighet, kvalitet och rimliga förväntningar.

Perfekt. Hör av dig så tar vi en kaffe eller ett första samtal.

Fanatics Betting and Gaming is headquartered in New York with offices in Denver, Leeds and Dublin.

At Fanatics Betting & Gaming (FBG), a core division of Fanatics' mission to establish the ultimate end-to-end digital sports platform, we're crafting a world where every aspect of a sports fan's passion is catered to. In this dynamic and supportive environment, your work will directly impact the development of sophisticated systems, driving innovation in how sports fans engage with the Fanatics ecosystem and deliver FBG product. You'll tackle unique technical challenges within our real-time decision-making systems, ensuring our platform remains at the forefront of the industry. Here, your professional growth is as vital as our platform's evolution, ensuring you develop alongside our mission to revolutionize the sports experience for fans worldwide.

Responsibilities

Write efficient, modular, and testable code that adheres to our commitment to innovation and quality standards.

Experience And Skills

8+ years of experience with C# and cloud platforms (Azure a plus).
Effective communication skills, capable of demystifying complex technical topics for diverse audiences.

Together, you’ll ensure that our solutions are aligned with If’s architectural principles. You will also have the opportunity to guide and mentor a team of skilled developers.

This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of the applications that support the core systems, contribute to modernizing legacy platforms, and make a lasting impact on how we deliver value to our customers.

Key Responsibilities

Lead the technical delivery within the Yggdrasil squad, ensuring design, development, and maintenance of stable and secure solutions.
Translate business requirements into efficient technical solutions.
Act as a bridge between business experts, technical developers in Norway and India, and architectural teams.
Ensure consistent coding standards, version control, security and documentation practices.
Drive adoption of modern engineering practices, including CI/CD, automated testing and monitoring.
Drive modernization activities such as API enablement for integration between cloud-based and mainframe systems and data replication using Change Data Capture (CDC).
Ensure optimal usage and cost management of Azure resources.

We offer

Benefits

In the same way that we place high demands on you as an employee, we also expect you to place high demands on us as an employer. Here are some of the benefits of working at If:

An including work environment where everyone is welcome
Career and development opportunities in the biggest insurance company in the Nordics
Social activities, as well as highly skilled professional environment
Possibility of hybrid workplace
Health promoting workplace with e.g., wellness allowance and various sports activities
Great insurance benefits
Weekly workout hour
High pension savings

About The Team

The Core Tribe is responsible for maintaining and evolving our business-critical insurance and claims systems. The Tribe operates cross-functionally across Finland and Norway, organized into smaller squads combining business domain experts with IT professionals.

Our IT development teams include colleagues from If’s internal IT units as well as strategic partners such as Tata Consultancy Services, ensuring seamless collaboration across Norway and India.

Yggdrasil squad is one of the squads in the Core Tribe. The mission of this squad is to ensure the ecosystems of applications supporting the Policy and Claims systems within the Norwegian scope is viable, healthy and stable. As the Senior Developer for this squad, you’ll be responsible for maintaining and developing this ecosystem and strengthening our squad technical capabilities.

Who are you?

You are a technically strong and forward-thinking developer with a passion for quality and long-term solutions. You bring deep technical expertise and strong communication skills that enable you to develop effective, maintainable solutions and you collaborate well across roles.

You also take ownership of your work and continuously look for ways to improve. You understand the bigger picture, think with a long-term and solution-oriented mindset, and bring an architectural perspective when designing and evaluating solutions. In addition, you work in a collaborative, transparent, and pragmatic way when solving problems.

In Terms Of Technical Experience, You Have

Solid experience with C#, .NET, and Azure application development and maintenance.
Familiarity with enterprise solutions, REST APIs, and message-based architecture.
Good knowledge and practical use of Infrastructure as Code (for example Terraform or Bicep).
Hands-on experience with tools such as Azure DevOps and CI/CD pipelines.
Experience with static code and security analysis tools such as SonarQube and Snyk.
Experience applying OWASP Top 10 in design, development, and risk assessment of applications.
Experience with authentication and authorization solutions including OAuth2, Curity and Identity Providers.

It´s a Plus If You Have

Experience working in an Agile setup, collaborating closely with product owners and business stakeholders.
Python and Databricks competence.
Familiarity with integration patterns between distributed systems and IBM z Mainframe.
Experience with monitoring and observability using Dynatrace, Application Insights, Splunk or similar tools.
Understanding of basic networking concepts including firewall rules and ability to use Wireshark for troubleshooting when needed.

Additional Facts And The Recruitment Process
