jobs.title: PhD Candidate in Empirical Software Engineering
jobs.description:
About The Position

As agile development scales to larger, more complex organizations, software engineering is being transformed by a set of intertwined changes. Continuous software engineering is converging development and operations to enable frequent releases, while AI is touching every stage of the software lifecycle, bringing agents that work alongside developers. Together, these changes are reshaping team composition and dynamics, as well as enabling shorter feedback loops, while introducing new roles and requiring new skillsets.

The purpose of empirical software engineering research is to study these shifts as they unfold, examining real-world practice to generate knowledge that can guide how teams and organisations build quality software. As a PhD Candidate, you will carry out this work within the Software Engineering group at the Department of Computer Science, one of Norway's leading software engineering environments. The group works closely with industry and publishes at leading international venues.

Your immediate leader will be the head of unit.

Duties of the position

Develop research-based knowledge on continuous software development, grounded in empirical studies.
Carry out empirical studies in Norwegian software companies, with the aim of publishing in recognised journals and conferences.
Responsible for conducting your own studies and for taking part in project teams together with master's students.
Contribute to teaching activities, including lab sessions and supervision
Other career-promoting work agreed with the department, such as work on smaller related research projects or collaboration with organisations in the public and private sectors. Applicants who hold a position outside the university may, by agreement, retain part of that position as career-promoting work.

Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment.

Required Selection Criteria

You must meet the requirements for admission to the faculty's Doctoral Programme, see Section 6-1 of the PhD regulations for more information.
You must have a relevant Master’s degree in computer science or equivalent. Your degree must include a major independent project (minimum 30 ECTS) equivalent to a master’s thesis.
You must have a strong and relevant academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your Master's degree study, or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker academic background, you may be considered if you can document that you are exceptionally suited for a PhD education, for example through relevant work experience and/or peer-reviewed academic works.
You must master English as a professional language, both written and orally.
You must attach a project outline (1500 words) to your application. It should set out your theoretical and methodological approach to the research topic, together with proposed research questions.

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.

Preferred Selection Criteria

Academically relevant background within software engineering or information systems

Experience from the software industry
Experience with empirical studies and scientific publishing
Good oral and written presentation skills in Norwegian or another Scandinavian language

Personal characteristics

To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), it is important that you are able to:

A good team player
A good communicator
Eager to learn
Results-oriented
Work independently

Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities.

We offer

An exciting job with an important mission in society
Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
Career guidance and follow-up during the PhD period
Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
Working capital that can be used to implement the project
Mentor programme as a new employee at NTNU
Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)
Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)

As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.

Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals.

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education.

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality.

Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 580 000,-per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary.

The employment period is 4 years for the doctoral work in addition to 1 year of career promotion work. (A minimum of three work years of the total term period must be dedicated to doctoral work.

For employment as a PhD Candidate, it is a prerequisite that you gain admission to the PhD programme in Computer Science within three months of your employment contract start date, and that you participate in an organized doctoral programme throughout the period of employment.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to be in conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.

About The Application

The attachments (including a description of your scientific work) must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. The documents must be in Norwegian/a Scandinavian language or English.

Please note:
the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

The Application Must Include

Transcripts and diplomas for Bachelor's and Master's degrees
CV
Copy of Master's thesis. If you have recently submitted your Master's thesis, you can attach a draft of the thesis. Documentation of a completed Master's degree must be presented before taking up the position.
Project outline containing proposals for an overall description of research questions, theoretical perspectives, methodological design for the project and progress plan (maximum 1500 words/4 pages)
Short letter of motivation (400 words/1 page)
Possibly publications etc. other relevant research work
Possibly certificates
Names and contact information of three relevant referees

If all, or parts, of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both Bachelor's and Master's education, in addition to other higher education. If your institution uses “diploma supplement” (normal for most European institutions), you must attach this. A description of the documentation required can also be found here. If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.

Joint work will be considered. If it is difficult to identify your contribution to joint work, you must attach a brief description of your participation.

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. Motivation for the position, ambitions, and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates.

NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and has committed itself to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment and CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).

General information

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

If you think this position looks interesting and in line with your qualifications, you are welcome to apply.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Joakim Klemets (Associate Professor), phone +47 413 51 921, email: joakim.klemets@ntnu.no.

If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact HR at hr@idi.ntnu.no.

Application deadline: 08.10..2026

For practical information about working at NTNU, please visit this webpage.

The city of Trondheim
is a modern European city with a rich cultural scene. Trondheim is the tech capital of Norway with a population of 200,000. The Norwegian welfare state, including healthcare, schools, kindergartens and overall equality, is probably the best of its kind in the world. Professional subsidized day-care for children is easily available. Furthermore, Trondheim offers great opportunities for education (including international schools) and possibilities to enjoy nature, culture and family life and has low crime rates and clean air quality.

NTNU - knowledge for a better world

NTNU - knowledge for a better world

The Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU) creates knowledge for a better world and solutions that can change everyday life.

Department of Computer Science

We are the leading academic IT environment in Norway, and offer a wide range of theoretical and applied IT programmes of study at all levels. Our subject areas include hardware, algorithms, visual computing, AI, databases, software engineering, information systems, learning technology, HCI, CSCW, IT operations and applied data processing. The Department has groups in both Trondheim and Gjøvik. The Department of Computer Science is one of seven departments in the Faculty of Information Technology and Electrical Engineering .

First, let us tell you more about Forge Digital

We are Forge Digital – a technology agency with cutting-edge solutions and strong domain knowledge in digitalization across manufacturing, retail & logistics, and energy. Our mission is to improve our clients' performance. We guide companies in assessing their current digital maturity, identifying digital challenges and opportunities, and designing a customized digitalization roadmap. We leverage cutting-edge technologies to enhance operational efficiency. Our expertise in analytics, machine learning, edge computing, and sensor-machine integrations enables us to create a sustainable competitive edge.

What we look for

As a Senior Developer or Architect at Forge, you will design and build robust, scalable systems – from operational and business applications to industrial operator interfaces and real-time situational awareness solutions. You will take technical ownership of complex projects, collaborate closely with clients, and help shape how we work.

Here are a few examples of what you could be working on at Forge:
Development of AI-powered solutions: applied AI for decisioning, optimization, and predictive systems, as well as agentic and generative AI capabilities embedded directly into business applications
Development of operational work-enhancing solutions and real-time situational awareness systems
Development of integrations connecting production, business, and automation systems (IT/OT)
Development of data pipelines, data platforms, and event-driven architectures
Business-critical and high-availability system development
Legacy system modernization for AI-assisted development practices

Our main technology stack includes .NET, C#, Node.js, NestJS, and TypeScript – though we are technology-agnostic and always select the best tools considering the entire solution lifecycle. We work with Azure and AWS cloud platforms, hybrid cloud environments, and on-premises solutions.

Fluency in both written and spoken Finnish and English is required.

How to forge success in this role

To succeed in this role, you bring solid hands-on experience in software development and a genuine interest in building industrial-grade solutions. The following are what we consider essential:
AI-assisted development
: You are comfortable working in AI-assisted development workflows – using AI tooling to accelerate delivery, improve code quality, and maintain high standards of human oversight.
Software architecture
: You can design and own the technical architecture of complex, distributed systems – making sound decisions that consider the full solution lifecycle.
Core technologies
: Strong knowledge of most of our main technologies (.NET/C#, Node.js/TypeScript) and databases such as MS SQL, PostgreSQL, and/or document databases.
Container environments
: Comfortable working with containerized applications and deploying to Kubernetes or similar environments.
Event-driven architectures
: Solid experience designing and building event-driven systems and messaging patterns, using tools such as RabbitMQ or Azure Service Bus.
Domain knowledge
: Background in manufacturing, logistics, or energy sectors.
Cloud and infrastructure mindset
: Solid understanding of Azure and/or AWS services, cloud-native architectures, and hybrid environments.
Communication & client interaction
: As a senior member in a consultancy setting, you are comfortable engaging with clients, facilitating technical discussions, and translating business needs into technical solutions.

The following experience is considered an advantage:
Experience building and integrating LLM-based solutions, including agentic workflows and MCP-based systems
Experience with industrial data exchange standards such as OPC UA or similar IT/OT integration patterns
Frontend development experience (React or similar)
Python and data engineering or analytics background

More than anything, we value a learning-oriented mindset and genuine willingness to keep developing your skills.

What we offer

At Forge, senior developers and architects have real influence over how systems are designed and delivered – you will shape technical direction, define standards, and solve problems that directly affect project outcomes. Our clients operate in sectors where the systems you build genuinely matter.

You will join a highly motivated and experienced team, with whom to build the story of Forge Digital. As a newly established company, we provide a real opportunity to put your mark on how we work, operate, and innovate with clients.

This position is full-time, and the start date is agreed with the chosen candidate. We offer a competitive salary based on your experience level. Our comfy offices in the GO21-building in Tampere and Helsinki city center offer a great atmosphere to work in. We work in a flexible hybrid model and put a lot of focus on building a strong team culture and cohesion. In addition, we offer:
A competitive salary, which within the framework of this role is approximately 5000-6000€/month, depending on your experience level
Lunch benefit
ePassi Flex budget of 1 000 €/year
Mobile phone benefit
Home internet
Health and accident insurance
Daily refreshments at the office

Your supervisor will be there to spar on personal learning, career development, and possible training needs.

Our recruitment process

If Forge's approach resonates with you, send us your application and join our skilled team! Our application form is easy and quick: simply add your contact information, CV, and cover letter to the form below. You can also share your LinkedIn profile or attach any other relevant documents you wish. Apply soon, as we will process applications during the application period. In our recruitment process, you can expect to have a couple of interviews, including technical interview.

jobs.description:
Are you an experienced software professional looking for interesting customer projects where your expertise makes a real impact? At Wave Company, we believe the best technical outcomes happen when experts talk to experts.

Who we are

We are an independent tech consulting company that has experienced rapid growth and proudly collaborates with Fortune 500 companies.
Our mission is to reshape the tech consulting industry by introducing a new way of connecting talent (Dev2Dev). In just a few years, Wave has grown into a team of around 50 highly skilled professionals.

Read more about Wave here, and you're also welcome to join the Wave Company project channel on Slack.

What you'll do

You'll work on technically demanding customer projects where your expertise has a real impact. Depending on the assignment, you'll either join as an individual specialist or as part of a cross-functional Wave team.

Our customers span multiple industries, including weather and environmental intelligence, clean energy, mobile gaming, deep tech, retail and logistics. What they have in common is a need for experienced engineers who enjoy solving challenging technical problems.

Depending on your background, your work may focus on:

Software Engineering –
Full Stack, Frontend and Backend development
AI & Data Science –
Building AI-powered solutions and data-driven architectures
DevOps & Cloud –
Designing scalable, secure and automated cloud environments
Cyber Security –
Strengthening resilience in business-critical systems
Quality Assurance –
Test automation and quality engineering

Work model:
Depending on the project, you can work remotely, in a hybrid setup or at the customer's office. We respect your autonomy and always aim to find a setup that works well for both you and the customer.

What we expect from you

As a Senior professional at Wave, you're more than a software developer. You're a consultant, problem-solver and trusted technical expert.

We're looking for someone who has:

Strong experience in modern software development, cloud engineering or software architecture
The ability to communicate technical topics clearly with customers and stakeholders
A high standard for software quality and long-term maintainability
Curiosity about AI-assisted software development and modern engineering practices

Most importantly, you're someone who enjoys solving meaningful technical challenges together with other experienced professionals.

Why Wave Company?

Technical matching.
Our technical leads participate in the project matching process, helping ensure you won't end up in a project that doesn't fit your skills and interests.
Transparent business.
We believe in radical transparency. You'll always know the customer's billing rate—no hidden margins.
A community of senior professionals.
Around 50 experienced colleagues who genuinely support each other. The threshold for asking for help is zero, and every voice is heard.
People-first culture.
Forget unnecessary hierarchy and office politics. Leadership and sales work for you, not the other way around.
Flexibility and well-being.
We offer comprehensive occupational healthcare, high-quality home and work connectivity, and leadership that understands the realities of senior consulting.

Sound like your next move?

If you value technical excellence, transparency and working with other experienced professionals, we'd love to hear from you.

Send us your CV or LinkedIn profile together with your contact information.

We'll review your profile and get in touch as soon as we see a project opportunity that matches your skills, experience and preferences.

Job Description

Tule mukaan Tieto Tech Consulting -tiimiin ja kasva rooliasi laajemmaksi! Tarjoamme mahdollisuuden työskennellä monipuolisissa ja yhteiskunnallisesti merkityksellisissä projekteissa. Kehitämme palveluita, joita todennäköisesti käytät itsekin.

Etsimme AI kehittäjää tiimiimme. Kehitä uraasi ympäristössä, jossa yhdistyvät huipputeknologia, kannustavat kollegat sekä mahdollisuus liikkua joustavasti eri roolien, tiimien ja toimialojen välillä.

Mikä on Tech Consulting?

Tech Consulting on digitaalisen suunnittelun ja ohjelmistokehityksen yksikkö, jossa autamme asiakkaitamme kasvamaan yhdistämällä liiketoimintamuotoilun, teknologisen asiantuntemuksen ja modernin ohjelmistokehityksen.

Uskomme yhteistyöhön, avoimuuteen ja siihen, että parhaat ratkaisut syntyvät, kun erilaiset ihmiset ja ideat kohtaavat.

Asiakkainamme on yli 130 organisaatiota eri toimialoilta, kuten julkishallinnosta sekä finanssi-, eläke-, energia-, logistiikka- ja valmistavasta teollisuudesta. Kehitämme digitaalisia palveluja, joilla on todellista vaikutusta ihmisten arkeen ja yhteiskuntaan.

Millaiset tehtävät sinua odottavat?

Etsimme AI kehittäjää, jolla on vahva tekninen osaaminen ja konsultoiva työote. Tässä roolissa osallistut asiakasprojekteihin yhdessä arkkitehtien ja kehittäjien kanssa, suunnittelet AI- ja GenAI-ratkaisuja sekä perustelemaan selkeästi, miksi valitut ratkaisut tukevat parhaiten asiakkaan tavoitteita.

Teknisten keskustelujen vetäminen ja ratkaisujen määrittely asiakkaiden kanssa
Liiketoimintatarpeiden kääntäminen AI käyttötapauksiksi ja selkeiksi ratkaisusuunnitelmiksi
Modernien ja ylläpidettävien sovellusten suunnittelu ja toteutus
AI- / LLM- / GenAI-ratkaisujen rakentaminen ja tuotantoon vieminen (RAG, agentit, työkalukutsut, evaluointiputket)

Turvallisten, vaatimustenmukaisten ja vastuullisten AI-ratkaisujen varmistaminen
AI-agenttien ja avustajien hyödyntäminen omassa työssä sekä niiden käyttöönoton tukeminen
Kehittäjien mentorointi sekä uudelleenkäytettävien ratkaisujen ja arkkitehtuurien kehittäminen

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

Vahvat konsultointi- ja viestintätaidot; kyky perustella valintoja ja ohjata päätöksentekoa
Ohjelmistokehityskokemusta (esim. Python), backend- / API-kehitystä sekä pilvinatiivien arkkitehtuurien tuntemusta (Docker, Kubernetes)
Kokemusta modernien yritystason sovellusten suunnittelusta ja toteutuksesta
Käytännön kokemusta AI/ML-kehyksistä ja LLM-alustoista (esim. Azure AI / Azure OpenAI), mukaan lukien mallien käyttöönotto ja optimointi
Ymmärrystä vektorihakutekniikoista, RAG-malleista, evaluointimenetelmistä, prompt engineeringistä ja guardraileista
Kokemusta CI/CD:stä, Infrastructure as Code -ratkaisuista (Terraform / Bicep), havainnoitavuudesta sekä data engineeringin perusteista
Tietämystä turvallisista kehityskäytännöistä, GDPR:stä ja vastuullisesta tekoälystä
Sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa

Kokemuksen agenttipohjaisista työnkuluista, vektoritietokannoista, Databricksista tai Snowflakesta sekä AI- tai pilvisertifikaateista
Kokemuksen työskentelystä säädellyillä toimialoilla (julkinen sektori, finanssi, terveydenhuolto) tai korkean tietoturvan ympäristöissä

Merkityksellistä työtä yhteiskunnallisesti tärkeiden digitaalisten ratkaisujen parissa
Pohjoismaisen, vastuullisen ja luottamukseen perustuvan työyhteisön
Mahdollisuuksia kehittää osaamistasi eri toimialoilla, teknologioissa ja rooleissa
Joustavat työskentelymallit, hyvinvointiedut ja aidosti ihmislähtöisen kulttuurin

Miksi liittyä kasvavaan tiimiimme?

Tieto rakentaa teknologiaa, joka toimii ihmisten hyväksi. Tieto Tech Consultingilla työskentelet teknologian, innovaation ja yhteiskunnallisen vaikuttavuuden rajapinnassa. Saat käyttöösi laajan IT-osaajaverkoston sekä kulttuurin, joka kannustaa yhteistyöhön, uteliaisuuteen ja jatkuvaan oppimiseen. Meillä kasvu ei pysähdy.

Vil du være med til at holde vores kunders data-, AI- og platformmiljøer kørende – og lære af nogle af branchens dygtigste undervejs?

Vi søger en nysgerrig og struktureret Associate til vores Service Delivery-team. Du får en fod inden for drift af moderne dataplatforme fra dag ét, med erfarne kolleger tæt på og en klar oplæring i vores runbooks og processer.

Service Delivery holder kundernes data-, AI- og platformmiljøer kørende – pålideligt, kontinuerligt og i stor skala. Teamet håndterer incidents, driver problemløsning frem mod systemiske fixes frem for gentagne workarounds, automatiserer driftsopgaver og bruger AI-agenter til at forbedre svartid og servicekvalitet.

Som Associate bliver du en del af den daglige drift af kundernes dataplatforme og indgår i vores supportvagt kl. 07:00-17:00, hvor du håndterer standardincidents efter godkendte runbooks under vejledning fra erfarne kolleger.

Din rolle hos Inspari

Som Associate Operations Engineer er du med til at sikre, at kundernes dataplatforme kører stabilt og forudsigeligt. Du arbejder tæt sammen med erfarne kolleger og tager gradvist mere ansvar, efterhånden som du bliver tryg i rollen.

Du kommer blandt andet til at:
Overvåge alerts og håndtere standardincidents inden for scope ved hjælp af godkendte runbooks.
Udføre restarts, re-runs og validering af data loads og refreshes.
Bruge AI til at opsummere incidents, give forslag til runbook-opdateringer og fremskynde log-analyse – altid med validering, før noget output bruges aktivt.
Dokumentere fund og bidrage til løbende forbedring af runbooks og known-issues.
Eskalere korrekt med tydelig kontekst og evidens, når en sag ligger uden for scope.
Give klare skriftlige opdateringer i tickets, Teams og mail efter en simpel struktur (Hvad er der sket / Status nu / Næste skridt / Ansvarlig) og sikre gode overdragelser, så den næste kollega kan fortsætte uden at miste kontekst.
Deltage aktivt i supportvagten kl. 07:00-17:00

Sådan bliver du en succes i rollen

Du håndterer standardincidents og service requests konsekvent og korrekt ved hjælp af etablerede runbooks.
Du leverer klar dokumentation og gode overdragelser, som gør det nemt for kolleger at tage over.
Du bruger AI-værktøjer ansvarligt – med fokus på korrekthed, ingen misbrug af følsomme data og altid validering før handling.
Du deltager pålideligt i supportvagten med forudsigelig udførelse og tydelige overdragelser.

Din profil

Denne rolle er skabt til dig, der er tidligt i din karriere. Du behøver ikke have en lang erfaring i bagagen – bare en solid teknisk grundforståelse og lyst til at lære. Rollen giver dig et bredt indblik i drift af moderne dataplatforme og kan være et naturligt afsæt til videre specialisering inden for fx AI, data platform eller platform engineering.

Vi lægger vægt på, at du:
Har en grundlæggende forståelse af dataplatforme, databaser og cloud-teknologier – gerne med kendskab til Microsoft Azure, SQL, Power BI, Fabric, Databricks eller lignende.
Har stærke analytiske evner og kan fejlfinde struktureret.
Kommunikerer klart med både kunder og tekniske kolleger.
Arbejder struktureret med incidents, opgaver og dokumentation.
Tager ejerskab for mindre tekniske opgaver og følger dem til dørs.
Har gode engelsk- og tyskkundskaber, både skriftligt og mundtligt.

Derudover er du nysgerrig, proaktiv og har lyst til at lære. Du har en stærk ansvarsfølelse, er serviceminded og trives med direkte kundekontakt. Du kan holde hovedet koldt, når flere sager kører samtidig, og du er ikke bange for at spørge og lære af erfarne kolleger, mens du gradvist tager mere ansvar.

Hvad vi tilbyder

Hos Inspari bliver du en del af et ambitiøst konsulenthus med stærk specialisering inden for data og AI og komplekse opgaver hos enterprise-kunder.

Du får blandt andet:
En struktureret oplæring i vores runbooks, processer og vidensystemer
Tæt sparring med erfarne kolleger i Service Delivery og på tværs af Platform Engineering og Data Platform-teams
Mulighed for at arbejde med AI-værktøjer som en naturlig del af driften
En klar vej til mere ansvar og faglig udvikling, efterhånden som du vokser i rollen
Certificeringsforløb, der klæder dig på fagligt
En kultur præget af høj faglighed, ansvar, samarbejde og Heartwork

Lokation

Du vil være tilknyttet vores kontor i Kgs. Lyngby (København) eller Lystrup (Aarhus), hvor arbejdet foregår i en hybrid model mellem kontoret og hjemmearbejde.

Rejseaktivitet

Rollen indebærer en vis rejseaktivitet, som planlægges løbende i samarbejde med dig.

Ansøg nu

Hvis rollen matcher din erfaring, faglige profil og det ansvar, du ønsker fremover, glæder vi os til at modtage dit CV og din ansøgning.
Vi afholder samtaler løbende, så send din ansøgning hurtigst muligt.

jobs.description:
Job description:

BUILD MARKETS. SHAPE ECONOMIES.
At SGX Group, we create markets. We turn ideas into products and expand access to new opportunities. We are building the future of the exchange in-house: from architecture and platforms to the critical systems that power markets. The biggest decisions are still open to people who join us now.

The opportunity
The Executive Director, Software Engineering is a seasoned technology leader responsible for shaping SGX’s enterprise software engineering vision, platform strategy, and technical operating model. This role holds broad accountability for engineering excellence across architecture, platform resilience, governance, and leadership capability, ensuring SGX’s technology estate remains secure, scalable, and future-ready. Working across multiple teams and domains, the role translates strategic priorities into modern engineering practices, drives critical technology decisions, raises technical standards, and enables senior engineering leaders to deliver high-performing platforms that strengthen SGX’s long-term competitiveness, innovation, and operational resilience.
This role offers the opportunity to shape the future of software engineering at SGX by influencing enterprise architecture, platform strategy, and the engineering practices that underpin critical market infrastructure. It is suited for a leader who is motivated by building long-term capability, modernising engineering at scale, and leaving a lasting impact on how technology enables business growth, resilience, and innovation.
Beyond immediate leadership accountability, the role provides a compelling career path into broader enterprise technology leadership, with opportunities to deepen influence across strategy, engineering transformation, architecture governance, and organisational capability building. It is an ideal platform for a senior leader seeking to expand enterprise impact, develop the next generation of engineering leadership, and play a defining role in SGX’s technology evolution.

The Software Engineering team
Software Engineering builds, runs and evolves the applications and platforms behind SGX Group's business and market infrastructure.
The team works closely with product, architecture, platform, security and delivery colleagues to turn business priorities into secure, resilient and scalable services. Its remit spans the full engineering lifecycle, from technical design and delivery through to production ownership and continuous improvement.
Our next phase is about strengthening engineering ownership, modernising platforms and practices and building consistency across teams without flattening the different needs of each business domain.

What you will do
Software Development: Define the enterprise engineering vision and drive transformation of the software delivery process across SGX Tech.
Software Design: Shape enterprise-wide software architecture strategy and technology evolution.
Secure Software Development: Define Tech org-wide application security and engineering risk strategy.
Testing & Quality Engineering: Drive Tech org-wide quality transformation and delivery assurance strategy.
System Integration: Define Tech org-wide integration and interoperability strategy.
SDLC & Delivery Excellence: Drive Tech org-wide operational resilience and service reliability direction.
Observability & Production Support: Define organisational service ownership and operational excellence strategy.
Automation & Productivity: Lead organisational productivity strategy and investment priorities, driving productivity transformation through automation and AI.
Leadership & Mentoring: Define engineering culture, workforce strategy and long-term capability development.
Agentic AI Engineering: Reimagine software delivery around AI-native operating models and ecosystem capabilities.
Act as a senior technology leader and trusted partner to business and technology stakeholders, influencing strategic decisions and positioning engineering as a driver of resilience, innovation, and competitive advantage.

What we are looking for
Experience: Extensive experience in senior software engineering, platform engineering or technology leadership roles, with accountability for multiple engineering teams, senior leaders or enterprise platforms in complex, high-availability environments.
Track record: Strong track record of defining enterprise engineering direction and translating strategy into scalable operating models, governance frameworks and long-term platform evolution.
Technical stack: Deep expertise in modern distributed systems including microservices, service mesh and observability platforms, with strong cloud platform knowledge across AWS EKS, Azure AKS and GCP GKE, and advanced knowledge of Site Reliability Engineering practices such as incident management, chaos engineering and capacity planning.
Standards & environment: Track record of improving operational resilience and service maturity across mission-critical, regulated enterprise platforms.
Communication & leadership: Proven ability to lead leaders and scale engineering organisations through mentoring, upskilling strategies and performance frameworks, with strong executive presence and the ability to influence major technology decisions and align engineering outcomes with enterprise priorities.
Education & certifications: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information and Communications Technology, or a related discipline; postgraduate qualifications are advantageous.
Domain Knowledge: Exposure to financial market infrastructure, including securities and derivatives trading, clearing, settlement, market operations, or exchange-related systems.

Why this role matters
You will work on technology that underpins critical market infrastructure, where engineering decisions have direct consequences for the business, its customers and the markets it serves. Not many engineering roles carry that weight.
The mandate is real. You will shape how platforms are engineered, owned and evolved, and what software engineering becomes at SGX Group. The work is demanding and the organisation is still changing, which is exactly where the opportunity sits. There are not many chances in a career to build something that outlasts you.

About SGX Group
SGX Group is one of the world's most trusted international marketplaces, known for its stability and openness. Anchored in Singapore, we enable price discovery, capital formation and risk management across asset classes, supported by resilient infrastructure and robust clearing. We convene issuers, investors and intermediaries to create and grow markets that stand the test of time. Find out more at www.SGX Group.com.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer, Site Reliability
jobs.description:
Life at UiPath

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.

To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.

Could that be you?

Your mission

At UiPath’s Site Reliability team, we build the platforms and systems that the entire company depends on to deliver on our compliance and SLA promises to customers. This spans monitoring, alerting, cloud infrastructure, access management, standardized synthetics, performance and test validation, incident detection and status reporting, incident management, automated remediation, structured post-mortems, customer communications, repair item tracking, and assertion of engineering best practices across UiPath. We are scaling each of these pillars - and building the next generation of capabilities on each, increasingly powered by AI.

This is a software engineering role.

You will not be the person who identifies a reliability gap and files a ticket for another team to fix. You are the engineer who identifies the gap, designs the system that closes it, builds it, ships it, and drives its adoption - often by doing the integration work yourself rather than asking other teams to come to you. You build platforms that other engineers depend on in their critical path, and you hold yourself accountable to outcomes, not outputs.

You treat every system you ship as a product: you put it in front of users early, seek feedback, and iterate until it delivers real results. If adoption is slow, you don’t blame the docs - you sit with the team, understand the friction, and remove it.

What You'll Do At UiPath

Design, engineer, and build SRE platform systems and capabilities with cutting-edge AI, treating them as products that other engineering teams depend on in their critical path.
Participate in livesite monitoring rotations, handle escalations, and drive effective mitigations - reducing customer impact through broad, detailed, and effective post-mortems.
Drive availability, scalability, and performance improvements based on livesite learnings. Generate (or codify existing) best practices and ensure they are followed widely across UiPath - not by publishing guidance, but by embedding them into the systems you build.
Ensure technical deliverables meet or exceed expectations on reliability, scalability, quality, and performance. Identify and drive architectural changes that significantly move the needle on these dimensions.
Onboard other teams onto your platforms by driving outcomes yourself - writing the integrations, pairing with their engineers, removing friction - rather than handing off documentation and waiting.
Ship early, seek feedback relentlessly, and iterate fast. Treat every user complaint as a design input, not a support ticket.
Drive task planning, estimation, scheduling, and staffing.
Mentor Software Engineers to develop their skills and knowledge through hands-on coaching, advice, and training opportunities.
Participate in and influence process improvements and best practices across the engineering organization.

What You'll Bring To The Team

Proven track record (10+ years) of architecting and engineering world-class, large-scale, distributed commercial applications and services, and ensuring customer success.
Experience building large-scale, complex internal platforms adopted by 10+ teams in their critical path at a large company — systems that have stood the test of time, not prototypes that were handed off or abandoned.
Demonstrated ability to drive adoption of your systems by doing the hard work yourself: writing integrations, removing friction for other teams, and measuring success by outcomes delivered - not features shipped.
Experience building and maintaining complex AI-powered applications in production.
Proficiency in one or more object-oriented languages (such as C#, C++, Java, or Python), backed by solid computer science fundamentals.
Deep understanding of data structures, algorithms, multithreading, synchronization, asynchronous patterns, and cloud programming.
Experience with service-oriented and microservice-based architectures, HTTP applications, and web services development.
Familiarity with modern engineering practices including agile development, CI/CD, and DevOps. Ability to work with globally distributed teams.
Experience working with or managing production Kubernetes infrastructure is a plus.
Experience with cloud providers (Azure, AWS, GCP) and managed services (AKS, GKE, etc.) is a plus.
Experience with database backends (e.g., Azure SQL, CosmosDB, Azure Data Lake, Power BI, MongoDB, MySQL, DynamoDB, etc.).

Maybe you don’t tick all the boxes above—but still think you’d be great for the job? Go ahead, apply anyway. Please. Because we know that experience comes in all shapes and sizes—and passion can’t be learned.

Many of our roles allow for flexibility in when and where work gets done. Depending on the needs of the business and the role, the number of hybrid, office-based, and remote workers will vary from team to team. Applications are assessed on a rolling basis and there is no fixed deadline for this requisition. The application window may change depending on the volume of applications received or may close immediately if a qualified candidate is selected.

We value a range of diverse backgrounds, experiences and ideas. We pride ourselves on our diversity and inclusive workplace that provides equal opportunities to all persons regardless of age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, and expression, national origin, disability, neurodiversity, military and/or veteran status, or any other protected classes. Additionally, UiPath provides reasonable accommodations for candidates on request and respects applicants' privacy rights. To review these and other legal disclosures, visit our privacy policy.

• Strong skills in web frontend development (JavaScript, HTML, CSS). Experience with modern JavaScript frameworks (e.g., React, Angular, Node.js) is a plus.
• Solid understanding of relational databases and proficiency in SQL.
• Familiarity with software development best practices, including version control (Git), automated testing, and Agile methodologies.
• English proficiency.
• Proactivity, genuine enthusiasm and curiosity, teamwork attitude.

Bonus Qualifications

• Cloud Computing fundamentals.
• Experience with CRM systems or enterprise software solutions.
• Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
• System Integrations and Communication Protocols such as HTTP, JSON, API, WS, SOAP, REST, XML.

The profile is rounded up by excellent analytical skills, precision, self-management capacities and a strong goal-oriented inclination.

Individuals who have a strong will
to expand their knowledge of new technologies, a passion to grow within the company and aspirations
for career growth. At Deloitte we foster a consultative culture because the best decisions are made in collaboration with others. These are not aspirations, but principles that we all commit to today and every day.

🌍 Engagement within international large-scale teams and projects, with opportunities to travel for training or client purposes.

🚀 Challenging and innovating environment where personal development and growth are encouraged, always with transparency and trust
🌈 Diverse culture and active communities that enable you to bring yourself to work

jobs.title: AI Principal Engineer
jobs.description:
Company Description

Are you ready to shape the future technological landscape in Europe?

We are dedicated to responsible digitalisation, building innovative, inclusive solutions that drive meaningful impact. With over 8,900 professionals across Europe, we help EU institutions, public and private organisations thrive in a rapidly evolving digital world. Are you ready to shape the future through technology? Your journey starts here. Take a look at some of our impactful projects here: https://netcompany.com/cases/

Job Description

So, what are the main responsibilities of the AI Principal Engineer
in Netcompany’s Enterprise Solutions?

Joining us as an AI Principal Engineer
, you will lead the design, delivery, and scaling of advanced GenAI, LLM, and Machine Learning (ML) solutions for enterprise clients across both public and private sectors. In this role, you will operate at the intersection of technical leadership, people management, and client engagement, driving impactful AI initiatives from concept to production.

You will act as a trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders, translating complex AI capabilities into clear business value, while leading and mentoring a high-performing team of AI/ML engineers. As a Principal (Manager-level role), you will be accountable not only for technical excellence but also for team growth, delivery quality, and client success.

This is a highly client-facing leadership role. Your ability to navigate complex stakeholder landscapes, align business and technology priorities, and communicate effectively with both technical teams and executive leadership will be key to success. You will represent the AI function in strategic discussions, lead workshops, and shape enterprise AI adoption roadmaps.

You will focus on the architecture and delivery of scalable, production-grade AI systems, ensuring solutions are reusable, extensible, and aligned with best practices, while pushing the boundaries of innovation beyond off-the-shelf tools.

As The AI Principal Engineer, You Will

Serve as the primary AI and ML advisor to enterprise clients, translating business challenges into scalable AI-driven solutions with measurable impact.
Lead, mentor, and grow a team of AI/ML engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence, innovation, and continuous learning.
Drive the end-to-end architecture and delivery of ML and GenAI pipelines, from ideation and prototyping to production deployment.
Collaborate closely with MLOps, DevOps, and data engineering teams to ensure robust, scalable, and maintainable solutions.
Manage stakeholder relationships across multiple projects, including executive communication, reporting, and risk management.
Lead client workshops, discovery sessions, and technical presentations to define AI strategies and accelerate adoption.
Oversee delivery quality, ensuring solutions meet performance, scalability, security, and governance standards.
Contribute to practice development, including methodology, tooling, reusable assets, and pre-sales activities.

Qualifications

What would make you a fit for the role:

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in AI, Data Science, Machine Learning, Computer Science, Engineering, Operational Research, or a related field (PhD is a plus).
8+ years of experience in AI/ML engineering, with a strong track record of delivering enterprise-grade AI solutions from concept to production.
Proven experience in a leadership or management role, including team leadership, mentoring, and performance management.
Strong experience in client-facing environments, including leading workshops and presenting to senior stakeholders (C-level, board members).
Deep expertise in Machine Learning and GenAI, including LLMs (e.g., GPT, Claude, Gemini), RAG architectures and prompt engineering, Agentic AI systems and orchestration frameworks.
Solid understanding of MLOps practices, model lifecycle management, and production deployment patterns.
Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
Hands-on experience with modern AI/ML frameworks and tooling, including open-source ecosystems.

It would also be a plus if you match some of the following:

Experience in consulting, systems integration, or professional services environments.
Familiarity with AI governance, responsible AI, and LLM monitoring frameworks.
Experience with advanced GenAI frameworks (e.g., LlamaIndex, LangGraph) and evaluation tools.
Exposure to AIOps practices and production AI observability.
Experience supporting pre-sales, proposals, or business development in AI/data domains.

Additional Information

Being a part of the Netcompany team, you will be provided with:

The opportunity to work in a modern environment & in a hybrid working model
A seamless onboarding experience and a buddy to support you on your first steps
A competitive compensation & benefits package
Health and life insurance program
Meal and commuting allowance
Well-being activities (on premises)
Continuous learning opportunities using the most modern methods (unlimited access to Udemy for Business, ad-hoc trainings)
A personalized development plan for targeted career growth

If you are looking forward to be part of a diverse environment, and have the opportunity to work alongside well-experienced professionals, on challenging, large-scale projects that directly impact millions of citizens around the globe, then this is the place to be!

By joining Netcompany in Athens, you will be part of a vivid team of 2,300+ tech professionals. When at the office, you'll have the flexibility to work from our three modern, sustainable, and state-of-the-art offices!

Please upload your CV in English
via the Apply button. All applications will be treated as strictly confidential.

We ensure equal opportunities, treatment, and consideration to all candidates. Discrimination based on sex, racial or ethnic origin, religion or belief, disability, age, sexual orientation or marital status, physical or mental disability, or any other factor protected by applicable laws and regulations is prohibited. As part of the Netcompany culture, we respect human rights and focus on creating a positive workplace, where all employees are valued, and where diversity and inclusion are a vital part of our everyday working experience.

In the following link you may find our CV Submission privacy notice: https://netcompany.com/cv-submission-privacy-notice/

, opgedaan via opleiding, stage of werkervaring

jobs.title: Solution Architect
jobs.description:
The Architecture team supports a broad range of strategic initiatives within the Life Insurance domain, covering operational excellence, legacy platform modernization, and technological innovation. The environment combines critical customer, intermediary, and operational platforms, as well as integrations with key external partners.
The organization is looking for a Solution Architect capable of designing end-to-end solutions aligned with business needs and architectural principles, while supporting their implementation from project inception through production deployment. The role requires close collaboration between Business and IT stakeholders in a hybrid technology landscape that combines legacy COBOL Microfocus systems with modern .NET and Angular solutions built according to Domain Driven Design (DDD) principles.

Your missions:

Design end-to-end solution architectures aligned with business objectives and enterprise architectural standards.
Analyze business requirements and propose pragmatic, sustainable, and future-oriented solution options.
Bridge the gap between Business and IT by translating complex business needs into robust technical solutions.
Guide projects from architecture definition through implementation and production rollout.
Ensure alignment and collaboration among all stakeholders throughout project lifecycles.
Define short-, medium-, and long-term visions for the evolution of IT systems.
Validate and challenge proposed solutions together with technical architecture teams.
Support modernization initiatives while ensuring continuity of legacy platforms.
Contribute to innovation initiatives and technology evolution within the Life Insurance domain.

Your activities:

Gather and analyze business requirements and strategic objectives.
Design target solution architectures and define implementation roadmaps.
Work closely with business stakeholders to identify real business needs.
Collaborate with IS teams, Application Technology teams, Architecture & Strategy teams, and Infrastructure & Operations teams.
Ensure smooth transition from architecture phase to delivery and implementation.
Facilitate consensus-building between Business and IT stakeholders.
Present architectural solutions to the Architecture Board.
Produce and maintain architecture documentation.
Ensure compliance with architectural standards and governance principles.
Assess implementation, operational, maintenance, and run costs of proposed solutions.
Review and validate technical architecture proposals.
Promote collaboration across multidisciplinary teams.
Challenge existing approaches and introduce innovative ideas when relevant.
Ensure quality, maintainability, scalability, and long-term sustainability of solutions.
Support integration initiatives involving strategic external partners.

You have the following skills:

Functional & Business
Solution Architecture (mandatory, 2-5 years minimum)
Functional Design (mandatory, 2-5 years minimum)
Ability to translate complex business requirements into technical solutions
Stakeholder management and business-IT alignment
Architecture governance and documentation
Life Insurance domain knowledge

Domain Driven Design (DDD) concepts (mandatory)

Strong interest in technological innovation (mandatory)

Innovation. Sustainability. Productivity. This is how we are Breaking New Ground in our mission to sustainably advance the noble work of farmers and builders everywhere. With a growing global population and increased demands on resources, our products are instrumental to feeding and sheltering the world.

From developing products that run on alternative power to productivity-enhancing precision tech, we are delivering solutions that benefit people – and they are possible thanks to people like you. Grow a Career. Build a Future!

Be part of this company at the forefront of agriculture and construction, that passionately innovates to drive customer efficiency and success. And we know innovation can’t happen without collaboration. So, everything we do at CNH Industrial is about reaching new heights as one team, always delivering for the good of our customers.

Job Purpose

As an H&F embedded Software Engineer
, you will be responsible for the timely development of application software for our Self Propelled Forage Harvester products. The successful applicant will be specifying, designing, and testing vehicle application and control software per CNH coding standards .

As part of the H&F Integration team you are crucial in delivering new mechatronic features on Multi ECU, Multi CAN vehicle network architectures for this high performance agricultural equipment.

Key Responsibilities

Define the control system software requirements, software specification and software structure for vehicle applications
Maintain, archive, and control application source code, manage SW releases
Implement the software architecture and strategies, requirements for closed loop control algorithms, User Interface and related software control logic dealing with complex product offering
Perform unit testing and system integration testing with the hardware and software, via simulation and on-board executions.
Define & Execute test scenarios to verify the implemented control / monitoring strategy
Support Product Validation and Verification Engineers as they conduct Functional and Performance testing
Analyse and interpret field data to improve feature development and troubleshooting. (i.e. CAN traces)
Produce documentation in support of design, implementation, and test activities

Experience Required

Bachelor or Master degree in Electrical, Computer or similar engineering discipline
Experience/knowledge of using C & C# Programming language
Experience with industry coding standards for software development such as MISRA-C
Experience with CAN and/or LIN protocols and diagnostic tools such as Vector CANalyzer®
Demonstrated problem-solving capabilities and experience
Ability to interpret & implement vehicle networking protocols
Proficient in English, both written and verbal

Preferred Qualifications

Experience using MATLAB® Simulink/Stateflow and Automatic code generation
Experience with code debuggers, code analysis, and memory management
Experience with automated testing (Phyton, CAPL, etc)
Experience with SAE J1939, CAN, UDS
Experience with Electro-Hydraulic or vehicle control systems for on/off-highway vehicle systems
Demonstrated knowledge SW engineering systems tools such as SVN, Polarion, Azure, GIT
Demonstrated technical leadership and organization/control skills
Experience with network client/server architecture
Experience with agricultural equipment and/or machines
Experience working in a team-oriented, collaborative environment.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills

What We Offer

At CNH we offer dynamic career opportunities across an international landscape. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to delivering value for all our employees and fostering a culture of respect.

Working at CNH means working in an environment where, thanks in part to its international character, numerous development opportunities are available. More than 2,500 people work at CNH Belgium’s site in Zedelgem. This single location houses various departments, ranging from design—with an R&D center employing around 400 people—to production, service, dealer training, and all support departments.

CNH Belgium in Zedelgem is also located in a traffic-free area and is easily accessible.

We offer a very attractive salary package with numerous fringe benefits such as insurance, eco vouchers, meal vouchers, a cafeteria plan (Flex Ben), and no less than 20.5 working time reduction days on top of the statutory vacation days (in a full-time system).

Are you as passionate as our people? Would you like to be part of a great team and help build the most innovative and largest agricultural machines on the market? Apply now!

integration.

What Makes Cloudbeds Unique

At Cloudbeds, we're not just building software, we’re transforming hospitality. Our intelligently designed platform powers properties across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From independent properties to hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. Remote (Europe)

How You'll Make an Impact:

As a Staff Software Engineer
in Revenue Intelligence, you will shape the technical direction of systems that help hospitality businesses understand demand, identify revenue opportunities, and make better pricing and commercial decisions. You will work across customer-facing applications, backend services, data pipelines, analytical stores, recommendation workflows, and cloud infrastructure. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will solve complex engineering problems directly while establishing architecture, improving reliability and security, reducing systemic technical debt, and aligning multiple teams around durable technical decisions. Your impact will extend beyond individual features to the quality, scalability, operability, and long-term evolution of the Revenue Intelligence platform.

Our Revenue Intelligence Team:

The Revenue Intelligence team builds products and platforms that turn hospitality data into practical decisions for hoteliers, including pricing recommendations, demand insights, reporting, automation, and commercial opportunities. Our systems span frontend experiences, APIs, distributed services, data processing, machine-learning workflows, and production infrastructure. We value pragmatic engineering, strong ownership, evidence-based decisions, and technical leaders who raise the effectiveness of the people and systems around them.

What You Bring to the Team:

Set and evolve the technical strategy for Revenue Intelligence, translating product and business goals into coherent architecture and executable engineering plans
Lead the design and delivery of complex capabilities across customer-facing web applications, backend APIs, event-driven services, data pipelines, analytical storage, and recommendation workflows
Identify and resolve systemic risks in scalability, reliability, security, data quality, observability, and operability before they become recurring customer or engineering problems
Drive modernization of legacy systems and infrastructure through incremental, well-reasoned migrations that preserve delivery momentum and production stability
Partner with Product, Data Science, Infrastructure, Security, and engineering leaders to define boundaries, contracts, ownership, and long-term platform direction
Remain hands-on in the codebase through implementation, technical spikes, design reviews, debugging, incident response, and the most consequential or ambiguous engineering work
Raise the technical effectiveness of the wider organization through mentoring, architecture guidance, engineering standards, documentation, and constructive challenge

10+ years of software engineering experience, including significant technical leadership across complex production systems

Experience designing or operating recommendation systems, machine-learning platforms, pricing systems, experimentation workflows, or other decision-support products

Deep hands-on expertise in .NET/C#

jobs.description:
Du hast gerade dein Studium abgeschlossen und schon zehn Jahre Erfahrung als Senior Engineer? Just kidding. We hire for attitude and train for skills. Du bringst Drive, Freude am Kundenkontakt, ein Herz für Tech und den Kopf für komplexe Probleme mit - den Rest bringen wir dir bei. Wer "wir" sind? Eine Schweizer IT-Consulting-Firma mit über 270 Mitarbeitenden. Seit 1996 entwickeln wir gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden in der Deutschschweiz digitale Lösungen, die halten, was sie versprechen.

Deine Challenges

Du arbeitest in einem Projektteam beim Kunden, gemeinsam mit dessen Mitarbeitenden und weiteren ipt’lern
Du entwickelst hands-on individuelle Lösungen rund um Cloud, API Management, Fullstack Applikationen oder Datenplattformen
Dabei arbeitest du mit führenden Technologien wie Microsoft Azure, AWS, Confluent oder Databricks
Dein erstes ipt-Projekt suchen wir gemeinsam mit dir, passend zu deinen Interessen und Stärken

Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium in Informatik oder Wirtschaftsinformatik
Erste technische Praxiserfahrung ist ein Plus, sei es durch einen Job oder durch Studienprojekte
Du gehst mit Biss an Herausforderungen, die andere lieber liegen lassen
Professionelles Auftreten und sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse
Bereitschaft, 1 bis 3 Mal pro Woche vor Ort beim Kunden zu arbeiten (Zürich, Bern, Luzern, Basel)

Das sind unsere Benefits für dich

Klare Perspektive: Du willst in deiner Karriere weiterkommen? Bei ipt hast du jährlich die Chance, befördert zu werden. Unser Karrieremodell zeigt dir deine Möglichkeiten auf.
Keine Chefs: Bei ipt mögen wir es nicht nur technologisch modern. Wir haben nur eine einzige Hierarchiestufe und glauben an das Potenzial von lateraler Führung.
iEvent: Einmal im Jahr verreist die ganze ipt für fünf Tage ins Ausland, für gemeinsame Workshops und Fun-Aktivitäten.
Zeit für dich: Überstunden kannst du bei uns 1:1 kompensieren. Dazu hast du 6 Wochen Ferien.
Bring Your Own Device: Mit CHF 3000 Startguthaben holst du dir die Geräte, die zu dir passen. Danach wird dein Guthaben monatlich mit CHF 125 aufgefüllt.

CANCOM Switzerland AG, ein Unternehmen der global agierenden CANCOM, unterstützt als Digitalisierungspartner Unternehmen bei der Steigerung der Business Performance und Entwicklung neuer Geschäftsmodelle. Dabei agiert sie als Berater, Lösungs- und Systemlieferant wie auch Dienstleistungsanbieter. Das umfangreiche Portfolio umfasst Lösungen für ICT-Infrastruktur, smarte Gebäude-, Medien- und Sicherheitstechnik sowie Outsourcing-Services. Umfassendes Know-How und eine Vielzahl von erfolgreichen Use Cases machen die CANCOM Switzerland AG zum idealen Begleiter bei der digitalen Transformation.

DEINE NEUEN AUFGABEN
Du bist gerne nahe bei den Kunden, löst technische Anliegen pragmatisch und fühlst dich sowohl im Support als auch in kleineren ICT-Projekten wohl. Bei uns betreust du unterschiedliche Kundenumgebungen im Tagesgeschäft, unterstützt Anwenderinnen und Anwender und arbeitest bei Microsoft-365-, Azure- und Modern-Workplace-Projekten mit. Dich erwartet eine vielseitige Aufgabe mit breitem technischem Spektrum statt einer engen Spezialisierung.

Du betreust definierte Kunden und bist für sie eine verlässliche technische Ansprechperson im Tagesgeschäft.
Du bearbeitest Supportanfragen im 1st und 2nd Level, analysierst Störungen und sorgst remote oder vor Ort für eine nachhaltige Lösung.
Du unterstützt Anwenderinnen und Anwender bei Fragen rund um Clients, Microsoft 365, Benutzerkonten, Berechtigungen, mobile Geräte und Arbeitsplatzlösungen.
Du betreibst und pflegst Microsoft-Umgebungen mit Windows Server, Active Directory, Entra ID, Exchange Online, Intune, Teams, SharePoint und OneDrive.
Du führst wiederkehrende Betriebs-, Wartungs- und Lifecycle-Aufgaben strukturiert durch und dokumentierst deine Arbeiten nachvollziehbar.
Du arbeitest bei Microsoft-365-, Azure- und Modern-Workplace-Projekten mit, beispielsweise bei Migrationen, Rollouts, Gerätebereitstellungen, Onboardings und der Einführung neuer Services.Je nach Erfahrung übernimmst du kleinere Projekte oder klar definierte Arbeitspakete selbstständig.
Du koordinierst technische Anliegen mit internen Spezialisten, Herstellern und weiteren Partnern und hältst die Kunden transparent über den Fortschritt informiert.
Du erkennst Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten in Kundenumgebungen und bringst pragmatische Vorschläge für einen stabileren, sichereren oder effizienteren Betrieb ein.
Du entwickelst dich fachlich laufend weiter und baust dein Wissen in Microsoft 365, Azure und Modern Workplace gezielt aus.

DAS BRINGST DU MIT
Du hast eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Informatiker/in EFZ, idealerweise mit Fachrichtung Plattformentwicklung bzw. Systemtechnik, oder eine vergleichbare technische Ausbildung.
Du bringst praktische Erfahrung im ICT-Support oder System Engineering mit und kennst den direkten Umgang mit Kunden und Anwendern.
Du bringst fundierte praktische Erfahrung mit Microsoft 365 sowie Windows Server mit und kennst dich mit Windows Clients, Active Directory und gängigen Workplace-Technologien aus.
Du hast Erfahrung mit Entra ID, Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint und OneDrive.
Du arbeitest selbstständig, strukturiert und lösungsorientiert und behältst auch bei mehreren parallelen Anfragen den Überblick.
Du kommunizierst verständlich, verbindlich und auf Augenhöhe – mit Anwendern ebenso wie mit technischen Ansprechpartnern.Du bist serviceorientiert, übernimmst Verantwortung und gehst gerne aktiv auf Kunden zu.
Du bist bereit, Einsätze bei Kunden in der Schweiz wahrzunehmen; ein Führerausweis der Kategorie B ist von Vorteil.Du sprichst stilsicher Deutsch und verfügst über gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift; weitere Sprachen sind willkommen.

Nice-to-have (keine Muss-Anforderungen):

Erfahrung mit Intune und Autopilot
Erfahrung mit Azure Infrastructure ist keine Muss-Anforderung, wird jedoch ausdrücklich bevorzugt;

Formarás parte de un equipo multidisciplinar responsable de una aplicación móvil utilizada por técnicos de campo en más de 35 países para la puesta en marcha, configuración y conexión de dispositivos a servicios cloud.

Buscamos una persona con una sólida experiencia en .NET MAUI

🎯 ¿Qué harás en este rol?

Te incorporarás a un equipo autónomo y altamente técnico, donde tu principal responsabilidad será garantizar la calidad, estabilidad y evolución de una aplicación móvil multiplataforma desarrollada en .NET MAUI
.

Aproximadamente el 70% de tu tiempo
estará enfocado en el desarrollo móvil y el 30% restante
en tareas de integración backend y servicios cloud.

🛠️ Responsabilidades principales

Liderar el desarrollo, evolución y mantenimiento de aplicaciones móviles multiplataforma con .NET MAUI
.
Implementar interfaces de usuario enfocadas en la experiencia de técnicos de campo.
Resolver incidencias específicas de Android e iOS
, incluyendo ciclo de vida, permisos, compatibilidad y rendimiento.
Optimizar tiempos de carga, consumo de memoria y resiliencia de red en entornos con conectividad limitada.
Definir y mantener estrategias de testing mediante pruebas unitarias, de integración y automatizadas.
Desarrollar e integrar APIs REST y microservicios utilizando C# y .NET
.
Colaborar en la integración con servicios cloud de Microsoft Azure
.

🧑 💻 ¿Qué perfil buscamos?

Experiencia mínima de 5 años trabajando dentro del ecosistema .NET
.
Experiencia demostrable de al menos 3 años desarrollando con .NET MAUI
.
Haber participado en el desarrollo y despliegue de aplicaciones MAUI en producción para Android e iOS
.
Conocimiento profundo de arquitectura MAUI
, Dependency Injection, Shell Navigation, Handlers y desarrollo específico por plataforma.
Experiencia sólida en desarrollo backend con C#, .NET y APIs REST
.
Experiencia trabajando bajo metodologías TDD
y automatización de pruebas.
Conocimientos y experiencia con Microsoft Azure
, especialmente servicios cloud-native.
Nivel de inglés C1.

Capacidad para trabajar de forma autónoma y liderar decisiones técnicas.

⭐ Valorable

Experiencia en aplicaciones industriales o de field service.
Conocimientos de patrones offline-first
, sincronización de datos y almacenamiento local.
Experiencia con feature flags, configuración remota y despliegues progresivos.
Participación en migraciones de Xamarin.Forms a .NET MAUI
.
Experiencia en entornos DevOps y mantenimiento de pipelines CI/CD.
Interés o experiencia en soluciones basadas en IA y agentic workflows.

📍 100% Remoto

🌍 Se aceptarán únicamente perfiles Nearshore

jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer based in Spain.

This is a fully remote opportunity for a senior engineer who can take ownership of complex software projects from concept through launch. You will contribute across the full technology stack, building new product capabilities while maintaining a strong focus on quality and automated testing. The role combines hands-on development with technical ownership, architectural thinking, and continuous exploration of new technologies. You will work closely with a distributed engineering team to shape technical solutions, coding standards, and development practices. The environment values autonomy, curiosity, attention to detail, and a strong sense of ownership. You will have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on a growing SaaS product while working with a modern cloud-based technology stack.

Accountabilities

Deliver senior-level implementation of new product features across the full technology stack.
Own projects from technical conceptualization through implementation, testing, launch, and continuous improvement.
Design and implement reliable, maintainable, and scalable software solutions.
Build comprehensive test automation for new development, including unit and integration testing.
Solve complex technical challenges while balancing product requirements, engineering quality, and maintainability.
Research, evaluate, propose, test, and implement new technologies, techniques, and development approaches.
Collaborate with engineers and other stakeholders on technical design, coding standards, development practices, and best practices.
Contribute to maintaining a high-quality engineering environment with minimal technical debt.
Continuously improve development processes, tooling, and engineering practices.
Take ownership of technical decisions and proactively identify opportunities to improve the product and engineering experience.

Requirements

7+ years of full-stack software development experience, with strong expertise in C# and .NET/Core, ideally within SaaS products.
Strong experience with modern frontend JavaScript frameworks.
Strong hands-on experience developing and integrating Web APIs.
Advanced SQL skills, with SQL Server experience preferred.
Strong knowledge of Test-Driven Development and automated testing, including both unit and integration testing.
Hands-on experience with Azure Cloud.
Azure DevOps experience is a plus.
Strong ability to build intuitive, reliable, and maintainable software.
Ownership mindset with a track record of following through on commitments and taking responsibility for technical outcomes.
Comfortable working independently in a small-team environment while actively collaborating with others.
Curious and proactive approach to learning, experimentation, and adopting new technologies.
Willingness to ask questions, challenge assumptions, learn from mistakes, and continuously improve.
Strong attention to detail and a commitment to engineering excellence.
Self-driven approach with the ability to use sound judgment and seek alignment when needed.
Currently based and legally authorized to work within a European country in the CET, EET, or WET time zones.

Benefits

Annual compensation of $75,000–$85,000 USD, depending on experience and qualifications.
Fully remote work within Europe.
Flexible working schedule.
Competitive benefits package and paid time off.
Creative and collaborative working environment.
Direct exposure to leadership across different departments.
Significant ownership and the opportunity to make a visible impact on the product and customer experience.
Structured engineering onboarding designed to support rapid learning and integration.
Choice of PC or Mac hardware.
Opportunity to work with modern platforms, frameworks, development tools, and engineering standards.
Near-zero technical debt environment.
Modern technology stack including Azure, .NET 8.x, C# 12, Ember.js 5.7, Bootstrap 5.x, Selenium, Entity Framework 8.x, SQL Server 2022, and Azure DevOps.
Collaboration within an international, distributed engineering team spanning more than 20 countries.
Remote-first environment designed to support asynchronous collaboration across time zones.

to join our Playgami team in Barcelona on a hybrid basis!

Playgami is building the best SaaS gaming platform ever! The team strives to build the world’s best products for game production, operation, and insights. Powering many award-winning, loved-by-millions franchise games over mobile, web, and PC.

Always looking further to keep improving your skills
