Hi there future intern!

I am Álvaro,
the recruiter for this position (and hopefully, your future colleague!).

First, a little bit about what I like the most about working at Zurich Technology Delivery Center
: The environment here is incredibly collaborative and innovative. Our tech-driven mindset fosters continuous learning and growth, creating an atmosphere where everyone can thrive. Now, I can't wait to share this exciting journey with you at Zurich
!

Let me take a wild guess: you’ve probably sifted through countless job offers today, and they all seem to blur together. Sound familiar? Well, here’s the scoop: At Zurich, we might not have all the answers (and we’re not striving for perfection!), but we’ve got something special. Curious? Keep reading!

First of all, THANK YOU for considering our company. We understand that finding the right opportunity can be tough, but I’ll try to make it easier.

Who Are We?

Let me introduce us. You’re reading about Zurich Insurance Group
, a global leader in insurance, but this role specifically pertains to our Technology Delivery Center (TDC).
Established in Barcelona in 2006, the TDC operates as an integral part of Zurich Insurance Group, providing cutting-edge technological solutions and support to Zurich's local and global business units.

In essence, Zurich TDC is where technology meets the vast reach of a multinational company. We specialize in areas such as software development, data analytics, cybersecurity, and IT infrastructure. Our primary mission is to support Zurich's strategic goals and enhance operational efficiency through innovative technology solutions.+

We are looking for a Junior PowerApps developer intern who possesses a passion to learn about to create and improve useful applications for our users, will work with our team of talented engineers to design and build the next generation of our web & mobile applications.

If you're considering a role with us, know that you'll be joining a hub of technological excellence dedicated to driving Zurich's success on a global scale.

What Can You Expect?

And you might be thinking: This is great, what will my day-to-day be like, at TDC? I’m glad you asked – I asked myself the same question at the time.

As a Junior PowerApps developer, your main responsibilities will involve:

Development focused on Microsoft Power Platform.
Collaborating with cross-functional teams to design and ship new features.
Analyze the customer needs and design, document, test, and develop software as required to satisfy the functional and non-requirements.
Acquire technical expertise on aspects of the organization´s IT infrastructure / software applications / architecture / hardware to internal customers, advise them of appropriate actions to fulfill procedural and regulatory requirements or solve immediate problems.
Help on production issues.
Collaborate with the team, working always in Agile methodology.
Complete agreed work within established estimates and communicates status and issues promptly.

What Makes You a great Fit?

While we’re not seeking perfection or expecting you to save the world, we believe that if you meet some of these requirements, you’ll be a fantastic fit for our team. We are waiting for you!

Coursing BS/MS degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, Mathematics or any related subject
Fluent in English, Spanish or Catalan
Basic knowledge of any programming language (preferred C# .NET or Angular).

Nice to have:

Any other frameworks, programming languages or Rest API services
PowerApps/Power Platform knowledge
PowerBI knowledge
Testing experience (Unit Testing or SIT/UAT functional testing)

And… What Makes Us Special?

Paid Internship, up to 30 hours weekly with a flexible schedule.
LinkedIn and internal training opportunities.
Special discounts on various brands and products, plus great banking and insurance conditions.
A welcome pack filled with amazing gadgets.
A dynamic workspace with tasty coffee and fruit and featuring gaming, gym, and other fun areas!
Summer and Christmas events and different social clubs such as hiking, investment, beach volley and many more

Looking for a place to start or further develop your career?
This is for you! Zurich offers a comprehensive career plan providing a great opportunity to build and enhance your career from the start. You will have the chance to work on global projects, guided by experts and leveraging innovative technologies. Learn from very well-known experts in the field, ensuring you gain valuable experience and knowledge.

Where Are We Located?

Barcelona, Poblenou.

We Are Waiting for You.

It’s a match? Don’t wait any longer! Apply
by sending your CV in English
.

If not, no worries! We’ll meet again in the future. Feel free to share this amazing opportunity with anyone you think would be a great fit.

At Zurich, we are an equal opportunity employer. We attract and retain the best-qualified individuals available, regardless of race/ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, or disability.

Zurich Technology Delivery Center – Your Talent, Our Strength

You are the heart & soul of Zurich!

You are the heart & soul of Zurich!

At Zurich, we like to think outside the box and challenge the status quo. We take an optimistic approach by focusing on the positives and constantly asking What can go right?

We highly value the experience and know-how of our employees and offer a wide range of opportunities across business areas to encourage you to apply for new opportunities within Zurich when you are ready for your next career step.

Let’s continue to grow together!

Location(s): ES - Barcelona
Schedule: Full Time or Part Time
Recruiter name: Alvaro Gallego Zazo

jobs.title: Integrations & Data Migration Architect - Microsoft Dynamics CRM (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Join Liebherr, a global leader in engineering and manufacturing, as we advance our digital transformation journey. We are looking for a motivated
Integrations & Data Migration Architect - Microsoft Dynamics CRM (m/f/d)
to play a key role in our newly established IT Shared Service Center in Madrid.
In this role, you will own and shape the integration and data migration architecture for Liebherr's global CRM solution (OneCRM), supporting its deployment across our international Sales and Service Companies. You will ensure reliable and scalable data flows between Microsoft Dynamics 365, SAP S/4HANA, master data management solutions, central data platforms, customer systems, and other enterprise applications.
You will define and govern the end-to-end approach for data migration across global rollout waves, from source data analysis and mapping through cleansing, transformation, validation, reconciliation, and final migration. Combining architectural ownership with hands-on technical expertise, you will help ensure high levels of data quality, integrity, and operational reliability. You will be part of an international, cross-functional team that values innovation, methodology, and long-term thinking, making a direct impact on the way Liebherr serves its customers worldwide.
The working location for this position will be in Madrid city, where we operate a hybrid model, requiring at least 40% of working time spent on-site on a weekly basis.

Creating passion: your responsibilities

Own the end-to-end integration and data migration architecture for Liebherr's global Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM solution.
Define and govern integration patterns and data flows between Microsoft Dynamics 365, SAP S/4HANA, master data management solutions, central data platforms, customer systems, and other enterprise applications.
Define and drive the data migration approach for global CRM rollouts, including source analysis, data mapping, transformation, cleansing, enrichment, validation, reconciliation, and loading.
Establish reusable migration standards, tools, and templates to enable consistent and industrialized global deployments.
Define data synchronization and master data exchange mechanisms, ensuring reliable and maintainable data flows.
Coordinate data cleansing and migration readiness with business stakeholders, data owners, and rollout teams.
Maintain transparency of critical data flows, system dependencies, data ownership, and system responsibilities across the OneCRM landscape.
Provide technical leadership to Dynamics and integration developers, implementation partners, and other technical teams.
Maintain architecture and technical documentation for integrations, data models, mappings, and migration concepts using tools such as JIRA and Confluence.
Travel (up to 30%) to Liebherr sites worldwide to support architecture, migration, and rollout activities.

Contributing your strengths: your qualifications

7+ years of professional experience in enterprise application integration, data architecture, data migration, or related technical roles within complex IT landscapes.
Proven experience designing and executing large-scale data migrations and enterprise system integrations, ideally within international transformation or rollout programs.
Strong experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM and Dataverse, including a solid understanding of data structures and integration capabilities.
Deep understanding of data mapping, transformation, cleansing, validation, reconciliation, synchronization, and master data management principles.
Good knowledge of Microsoft Azure integration technologies, APIs, event-driven integration, and enterprise integration architecture patterns.
Experience with SQL and relevant tools and technologies for data analysis, transformation, migration, integration, and validation.
Strong architectural and analytical capabilities, with the ability to understand complex multi-system landscapes and translate them into scalable and maintainable data flows.
Ability to combine architectural thinking with hands-on implementation, troubleshooting, and technical problem-solving, with a strong focus on data quality and reliability.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience working across technical teams, business stakeholders, data owners, external partners, and international organizations.
Fluent in English (written and spoken); additional languages (e.g., German or Spanish) and relevant Microsoft Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Azure, or integration architecture certifications are considered a strong advantage.

Our commitment to you: your benefits

As an internationally successful family business, the Liebherr Group offers you a secure job, a unique variety of tasks and exciting development opportunities. Become part of our strong team today and get to know the Liebherr Group as a reliable partner. Profit from these benefits:
Competitive compensation and benefits package that recognizes your expertise
Flexible and hybrid working model
Creative freedom and responsibility to shape processes and solutions in our global transformation
Continuous learning and development with tailored training and certification opportunities
Meal vouchers
Life and accident insurance
Option to include a premium private health insurance package as part of the flexible remuneration
A safe, stable and international workplace within a trusted family business that invests in people

Please only use the online application option.
Please note that we do not accept applications via recruitment agencies for this position.

Have we awoken your interest? Then we look forward to receiving your online application. If you have any questions, please contact Marija Kostadinovic.
One Passion. Many Opportunities.

The Company

Liebherr is a family-run technology company that is not only one of the largest construction machinery manufacturers in the world, but also offers high-quality, user-oriented products and services in many other areas. The Group employs nearly 50,000 people in more than 140 companies on all continents.

jobs.description:
Our Consulting team at BearingPoint is dedicated to optimizing client business operations through Microsoft-centric business platforms and cloud technologies. With deep expertise in Microsoft Business Applications
—including Dynamics 365 (including Dynamics 365 Business Central), Power Platform, and the broader BizApps ecosystem
—we help organizations streamline finance, operations, supply chain, and customer engagement processes while enabling data-driven decision-making.

We leverage Microsoft Copilot
to enhance productivity and embed AI-driven insights directly into daily workflows, empowering users across business functions. Our strong capabilities in the Modern Workplace
—spanning Microsoft 365, Teams, and collaboration solutions—enable seamless communication, efficient work patterns, and an improved employee experience.

Data and analytics are central to our approach, with Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, and Azure data services
delivering actionable insights at scale. On the cloud side, we design and implement secure, resilient, and scalable solutions on Microsoft Azure
, embedding security by design through Microsoft Security technologies
such as Entra ID, Microsoft Defender, and Microsoft Purview.

In addition, our team develops integrated front-end and back-end applications
using the Power Platform and Azure services
, ensuring intuitive, mobile-friendly access to business applications and end-to-end process integration across the Microsoft ecosystem.

Primary Functions And Tasks

Our Microsoft team is entering an exciting phase of growth, and we’re looking for a Dynamics 365 Business Central Technical Architect / Lead Developer
to help shape the future of our Business Applications practice. In this role, you will guide a talented Business Central technical team in designing, developing, and optimizing AL extensions that enhance Business Central functionality—all while championing modern development standards and cloud‑first architecture.

Location: Portugal

As a Technical Architect, You Will

Lead, mentor, and grow a high-performing Business Central technical team.
Define, implement, and enforce technical standards and best practices.
Architect end‑to‑end Business Central solutions that support scalability and long‑term maintainability.
Oversee integrations, custom extensions, and solution performance.
Contribute to pre‑sales activities, scoping, and solution design.
Develop and maintain AL extensions for Microsoft Business Central, ensuring modularity and upgradeability.
Support legacy Dynamics NAV environments using C/AL while clients transition toward Business Central Online.
Collaborate closely with Functional Consultants, Solution Architects, and Project Managers.
Translate functional design specifications into high‑quality technical designs.
Build integrations between Business Central and third‑party systems using APIs, file-based methods, and Azure Functions (including AIS).
Maintain clean, well‑documented code and deliver technical documentation for customizations and integrations.
Support quality assurance efforts and testing activities throughout project lifecycles.
Monitor and optimize system and code performance.
Participate in code reviews, unit testing, and deployment processes to ensure delivery excellence.
Stay current with Business Central product updates, development practices, and the platform roadmap.

We are looking for: 

We’re looking for a detail‑oriented, technically strong problem‑solver with a passion for both technology and business optimization. You should bring curiosity, excellent communication skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and functional teams.

Deep experience with D365 Business Central and/or Dynamics NAV.
Strong expertise in AL development and the Business Central extension framework.
Solid understanding of Azure services and the Power Platform.
Proven experience in technical leadership and architectural design.
Hands-on development experience in C/AL and AL for NAV and Business Central.
In‑depth understanding of Business Central architecture, including object ranges, licensing, and extension management.
Extensive experience with Git, code review processes, and modern development workflows.
Knowledge of widely used Business Central apps such as Continia and Tasklet.
Understanding of core ERP processes (Finance, Supply Chain, Projects, Manufacturing).
Working knowledge of SQL Server and database management.
Experience with NAV server configuration, service tier setup, and user management.
Ideally, hands-on experience upgrading NAV versions to Business Central Online.
Excellent problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and a proactive mindset.
Strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.
A Master’s degree or relevant certifications (Microsoft or equivalent).

Join a collaborative, forward-thinking team dedicated to helping clients enhance their operations through innovative solutions and leading-edge Microsoft technologies. Here, your technical expertise and ideas will shape impactful transformations across industries.

For more information, please visit:
www.linkedin.com/company/bearingpoint

About BearingPoint

BearingPoint is an independent management and technology consultancy with European roots and a global reach. The company operates in three business units: Consulting, Products, and Capital. jobs.description:
Build your future with Sovos.

If you're seeking a career where innovation meets impact, you've come to the right place. As a global leader, Sovos is transforming tax compliance from a business requirement to a force for growth while revolutionising how businesses navigate the ever-changing regulatory landscape.

At Sovos, we're dedicated to more than just solving compliance challenges – we're committed to making a positive and lasting difference. Our teams operate on the modern edge of digital technology, working not only to solve complex business challenges but also to enrich our personal, professional, and local communities.

Our purpose-built systems provide the tools you need to thrive in a world where governments demand increased visibility, faster reporting and greater control over business processes. Excited about the possibilities? So are we!

Don’t worry if you don't check all the boxes – apply anyway. We're focused on hiring the right people, not just the "right" resume. It's not about what you've done elsewhere; it's all about what you're capable of doing here.

The Work You'll Do

At Sovos, our Core Platform and AI Platform
are the foundation that dozens of engineering teams build on. We're seeking a Fullstack Senior Engineer
who will design, build, and operate the platform services that power that foundation — services that are reliable, well-documented, and adoptable at scale.

This is a builder role at the center of the Sovos platform strategy. You'll work closely with the Platform Adoption
team to understand how teams are using what you build, close feedback loops quickly, and ensure that what ships is something the broader engineering organization can confidently rely on.

The Fullstack Senior Engineer
will own the design and delivery of platform services that span the Sovos portfolio — from identity and administration to AI capabilities and shared infrastructure
. Your work directly determines what other teams can build and how fast they can build it
.

More Specifically You Will

Building Platform Services That Scale Across the Portfolio

You'll design and deliver the Core Platform and AI Platform services that product teams depend on — things like identity, shared admin experiences, design system components, and AI infrastructure. Adoptability is a first-class requirement: services need to be well-designed, well-documented, and easy to integrate correctly.

Design and implement platform services with clear contracts, versioning strategies, and backward compatibility in mind
Build with adoption as a first-class concern — prioritize APIs, SDKs, and interfaces that are intuitive for consuming teams
Contribute to Core Platform components including identity, Sovos Admin, Mosaic design system, and Sovos Home
Build and maintain AI Platform infrastructure including tooling, integrations, and agentic service components
Establish engineering standards, patterns, and guardrails that make the right way the easy way for consuming teams

Partnering Closely with the Platform Adoption Team

You'll work together with the Senior Developers on the Platform Adoption team who are embedded with consuming teams.

Treat adoption friction as a product defect - actively seek feedback from the Adoption team and act on it
Collaborate on Skills and integration guidance to ensure what gets taught matches what's built
Participate in onboarding sessions, design reviews, and pairing with consuming teams when platform depth is needed
Provide timely support and clear escalation paths for teams hitting blockers in platform integration

Owning Quality, Reliability, and the Path to Production

Platform services are only as good as their uptime, and the confidence teams have in them. You'll lead testing strategies, participate in deployment planning, and take ownership of the operational quality of what you build — because what you ship is someone else's critical path.

Author and maintain comprehensive test plans — unit, integration, contract, and end-to-end — for platform services
Own the deployment lifecycle for platform components from development through staging to production
Establish observability practices (logging, metrics, alerting) so platform health is visible and actionable
Contribute to security and compliance reviews for platform services, particularly those touching identity and data
Participate in on-call rotations and lead incident response for platform-level issues

What We Need From You

7+ years of software engineering experience, with meaningful time building shared services, platforms, or infrastructure consumed by other engineering teams
Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and React for frontend platform components; experience with backend services in Java, .NET, or Node.js
Experience designing APIs, SDKs, or component libraries with developer experience as a primary consideration
Familiarity with identity and authentication patterns (OAuth/OIDC, SAML, SSO) is a strong plus
Experience or genuine enthusiasm for AI tooling, agentic frameworks, and integrating LLM-based capabilities into platform services
Strong instincts for testing strategy - you write tests because you care about what happens after you ship, not because someone asked you to
Excellent communication skills: you can explain platform design decisions and trade-offs to both engineering peers and non-technical stakeholders
A collaborative mindset - you view the teams building on your platform as customers, not consumers

What Does Sovos Offer You?

The tools to enhance your life – because we want you to enjoy your life outside of work and inside!

An opportunity to work with a global team
Bi-Weekly Meeting Free Days!
Mentoring Programs
Globally recognised Training and Development programs
Benefits

Sovos is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing an environment that celebrates diversity and where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and employees. We do not discriminate against race, color, religions, national origin, age, sex, marital status, national origin, disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic provided by law. At Sovos, all employees are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work.

Company Background

Sovos is a global provider of tax, compliance and trust solutions and services that enable businesses to navigate an increasingly regulated world with true confidence. Purpose-built for always-on compliance capabilities, our scalable IT-driven solutions meet the demands of an evolving and complex global regulatory landscape. Sovos’ cloud-based software platform provides an unparalleled level of integration with business applications and government compliance processes.

More than 100,000 customers in 100+ countries – including half the Fortune 500 – trust Sovos for their compliance needs. Sovos annually processes more than three billion transactions across 19,000 global tax jurisdictions. Bolstered by a robust partner program more than 400 strong, Sovos brings to bear an unrivaled global network for companies across industries and geographies. Founded in 1979, Sovos has operations across the Americas and Europe, and is owned by Hg and TA Associates. For more information visit http://www.sovos.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Twitter.

Flix is reshaping how customers get help, moving towards AI-driven resolution across every channel, language, and market. As a Process Intelligence & Automation Engineer(m/f/d)
, you turn that ambition into running systems: you design and deliver end-to-end automated processes on the Celonis platform that resolve real customer cases without human intervention, for millions of passengers.

You bring engineering rigour into a business team. You translate business requirements into data models, pipelines, and automations fast, you own what you ship in production, and you are comfortable being the most technical person in the room.

About The Role

Data integration and modelling: identify the source-system tables and fields that need to be brought into Celonis; build and maintain the extractions, transformations (ETL) and Celonis data models for each Customer Service process, spanning ticketing, order management, and payment/refund data.
Automation development: design, build, and operate production automations on the Celonis platform (Action Flows and Process Orchestrator) that execute real customer outcomes (e.g. end-to-end refund handling), including API calls into Flix backend systems and integrations with AI-driven customer contact channels (chatbot, voicebot).
Reliability and guardrails: your automations move real money; build for scalability, error handling, monitoring, auditability, and safe rollout of changes.
Insourcing and takeover: take over data models and automation logic built by an external implementation partner (reverse-engineer, document, harden, and extend them as the in-house owner).
Collaboration: work daily with business users who own rules and business logic, the Data Analyst who owns dashboards and process mining, and IT engineering who own system integrations, security, and scalability.
Documentation: document all technical and data requirements and all ETL and automation work to Centre of Excellence standards, so nothing you build depends on you being in the room.

About You

Automation platform experience: 3+ years hands-on building production automations on process orchestration or automation platforms; Celonis is a strong plus (Data Integration, PQL, Knowledge Models, Action Flows, Process Orchestrator); strong experience with platforms such as n8n, Camunda, UiPath, Power Automate, or Make is also relevant. We care about proven end-to-end delivery, not certifications.
Production ownership at scale: you have owned and shipped solutions handling transactions at scale (1M+ annually) and can talk concretely about what broke and how you fixed it.
Data fundamentals: working SQL and data modelling basics; you understand how to identify a correct case ID, control grain in joins, and validate a data model against its sources. Scripting (Python or similar) is a plus but not required (you are comfortable using AI tooling to fill gaps here).
Enterprise systems and integration literacy: solid understanding of how core operational systems work — CRM, ticketing, order management, and ERP — including their data structures, process flows, and the business logic they enforce. Equally, you are fluent in how these systems integrate: REST and SOAP APIs, authentication mechanisms, webhooks, rate limits, and data exchange formats (JSON, XML). You can independently read API documentation, navigate integration patterns, and reason about data flow across system boundaries.
Hybrid profile: you thrive in a roughly 70/30 technical-business role: you sit inside the business, gather requirements yourself, and can explain and defend technical decisions to non-technical stakeholders.
Communication: clear written documentation and communication in English; you leave behind artefacts other people can pick up.
Conversational automation experience: hands-on experience connecting automated workflows to chatbot or voicebot platforms is a plus.

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!

Travel perks: 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family.
Work from (M)Anywhere: Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year.
Hybrid work model: We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life.
Wellbeing support: Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members.
Learning & Development: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills.
Mentoring Program: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career.

At Flix, you’ll find teams that rally together to overcome challenges and spark creativity. We believe in ownership culture - giving you the freedom to take initiative, make an impact, and shape your own career path.

As we continue to expand across the globe, you can make a real difference in how we work.

Job Description

The QA Architect is the technical owner of the QA Test Center offering.

Working alongside the QA Manager, he defines and evolves the technical QA strategy (governance, test automation, AI, tooling), owns the deployment of all tooling that supports the offering, and represents the offering technically in front of clients — including presentation meetings and, where a client already runs its own setup, adapting the solution accordingly.

Key Responsibilities

Contribute to defining the offering's QA strategy (governance, test automation, AI adoption, best practices), together with the QA Manager.
Design, implement and maintain the technical architecture of the QA Test Center: tools, integrations, environments and automation pipelines.
Deploy, configure and evolve all tooling supporting the offering (test management, automation, CI/CD, reporting, dashboards, etc.).
Turn the current draft of the offering into a solid, documented and repeatable technical value proposition, ready for go-to-market.
Support the sales process: take part in client meetings, present and technically defend the proposed setup.
Assess a client's existing QA setup and adapt the solution (tools, processes, integrations) when the client already has its own stack in place.
Prepare demos, proofs of concept and technical materials to support sales activities.
Keep the offering technologically up to date, tracking trends in test automation and AI applied to QA.
Act as the technical reference point for delivery teams using the offering on client projects.

Qualifications

Solid experience (ideally 5+ years) in QA/Testing, including time spent in technical architecture or technical leadership roles.
Proven track record defining and implementing end-to-end test automation strategies.
Experience with QA governance: processes, metrics, quality and reporting.
Client-facing experience, including technical presentations and adapting solutions to different contexts.
Test automation tools (e.g. Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, Appium, or equivalents).
Test management and quality tools (e.g. Azure Test Plans, Xray, TestRail, qTest, or equivalents).
CI/CD pipeline integration (e.g. Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions).
Knowledge of and applied interest in AI for QA (test generation, defect analysis, coverage optimization, self-healing tests, etc.).
Understanding of systems architecture and integrations (APIs, cloud environments, containers).
Ability to design and document technical architecture (diagrams, specifications, setup guides).
Strong technical communication skills, including in front of business and client audiences.
Consultative mindset, able to defend and argue technical choices.
Flexibility and pragmatism to adapt solutions to a client's context without losing technical rigor.
Ownership mindset — able to work autonomously on an offering that is still maturing.
Strong collaboration skills within a small, cross-functional team, working closely with the QA Manager and the Business Manager.
Results-driven with good business acumen, even though this is not a sales role by nature.
Fluency in English (spoken and written).

Nice to Have

Relevant QA/Testing certifications (e.g. ISTQB Advanced/Expert) or automation tooling certifications.
Prior experience structuring or launching a QA offering/product (internally or at a consultancy).
Knowledge of quality governance frameworks (e.g. TMMi) or DevOps/SRE practices applied to QA.
Experience in technical pre-sales.

Additional Information

The Devoteam Group works for equal opportunities, promoting its employees based on merit and actively fights against all forms of discrimination. This position is an addition to the Omnivise Asset Management (OAM) team to provide centralized, expert-level management for current OAM projects and service contracts. The primary business aim is to offload advanced support tasks from the development team, creating a dedicated project and service function to handle Level 2 services like system upgrades for on-premise and cloud environments. To address this, the role is structured around three core areas: direct execution of OAM projects and services, advanced technical support and system maintenance, and process improvement with mentorship. This focus ensures that project delivery is streamlined, complex technical issues are resolved efficiently, and operational knowledge is effectively transferred and maintained within the service organization. Given the focus on advanced I&C systems and project oversight, the ideal candidate will be a senior professional with significant experience in Electrical or Control Systems Engineering. They must possess proven skills in managing technical projects, troubleshooting complex control systems (DCS/SCADA), and have a foundational understanding of both on-premise and cloud system administration.

How You’ll Make An Impact

Design and maintain automated deployment pipelines
Support and operate Kubernetes-based platforms and containerized workloads
Manage infrastructure provisioning and configuration using Terraform
Deploy and support Apache Kafka environments
Provide 3rd level support for complex platform and infrastructure issues
Support on-premises and hybrid cloud deployment environments
Improve platform stability, scalability, observability, and release efficiency
Drive automation, standardization, and operational process improvement
Perform system administration and maintenance tasks for customer systems, with a future focus on OES and cloud environments.
Develop and maintain technical documentation, including standard operating procedures (SOPs), maintenance guides, and knowledge base articles.
Coach and mentor junior engineers and technical staff on OAM system architecture, support processes, and best practices.
Identify and implement process improvements to streamline project delivery and service support workflows.

What You Bring

Significant professional experience (typically 3-5 years) in software development or system administration or software execution preferably in the power generation or industrial automation sector.
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or related technical field would be beneficial (not mandatory)
Strong background in on-premises and cloud-based deployment environments
Focus on standardization, scalability, observability, operational reliability and documentation
Database Knowledge (MS SQL, Postgres, Oracle, Third Party Data Bases)
Utilize AWS for infrastructure deployment and cloud operations, including AWS and/or Azure.
Manage deployment, support, and platform operations for Apache Kafka.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Nintex/K2 Certified Specialist, K2 Five Core Developer, or Nintex Automation Cloud Practitioner/Developer certifications.

jobs.location: Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
jobs.description:
Own the end-to-end solution architecture for the programme: the central integration layer, adapters to SAP and non-SAP systems, connectivity to the accredited service provider, interfaces to the reconciliation platform, and the security and deployment views. You are the technical authority who takes the design through the client’s architecture review board.

Key responsibilities

• Author the solution architecture document, solution design document (SDD) and integration/API design specifications; obtain approval from the client’s architecture/design review board and security function.
• Design the central integration layer — ingestion, orchestration, validation (PINT-AE/UBL), status tracking, ERP write-back and managed file transfer services — as cloud-native services on Kubernetes within the client’s private cloud / Azure tenant.
• Define integration patterns and standards (REST/SOAP/OData, IDoc/BAPI, events and queues, webhooks, polling, SFTP/MFT) exposed through enterprise API gateways (Azure API Management / webMethods) with mutual TLS and OAuth 2.0/OIDC.
• Lead requirements-confirmation workshops with AR, AP, tax and IT stakeholders across entity groups; own the interface catalogue and canonical data model.
• Ensure conformance with the client’s reference architecture and anti-pattern rules (no point-to-point integrations, no hard-coded credentials, no database-to-database access) and with non-functional requirements (throughput, latency, resilience, observability, performance at scale).
• Define the environment strategy (Dev/QA/UAT/Pre-prod/Prod), platform-service requirements and infrastructure-as-code approach; act as technical recovery lead in the BC/DR plan.
• Technically lead and review the SAP, non-SAP, ASP-connectivity and reconciliation-platform leads; run design and code reviews for architectural compliance.

Required experience and skills

• 12+ years in enterprise integration / solution architecture, including 5+ years as lead architect for integration platforms in SAP-centric landscapes.
• Deep expertise in API-led and event-driven integration, API management (Azure APIM, webMethods or similar), messaging/queues, MFT and cloud-native deployment (Kubernetes, containers, CI/CD, IaC).
• Strong knowledge of SAP S/4HANA integration surfaces (OData, IDoc, BAPI/RFC, SAP Integration Suite/BTP or PI/PO) and non-SAP ERP integration (Oracle Fusion REST/SOAP).
• Working knowledge of UBL/EN 16931-based eInvoicing standards and the Peppol 4/5-corner model; UAE PINT-AE and FTA eInvoicing framework knowledge strongly preferred.
• Experience with enterprise IAM (Microsoft Entra ID, SAML 2.0/OIDC, SCIM), SIEM log integration, secrets management and zero-trust integration security.
• Ability to write and defend architecture at review-board level; excellent English documentation skills.

Nice to have

• TOGAF or equivalent; Microsoft Azure Solutions Architect Expert.
• Experience with tax-clearance or B2B network integrations (Peppol, ZATCA, EDI).
• Exposure to AP automation / reconciliation platforms.

Creëer je eigen toekomst

Als Senior .NET Developer in het Nexus-team help je de basis bouwen voor toekomstige digitale oplossingen binnen onze Private Clients-activiteiten.

Het Nexus-team is verantwoordelijk voor het ontwikkelen van een Operational Data Store (ODS): een centraal dataplatfom dat informatie uit meerdere bronsystemen samenbrengt, standaardiseert en beschikbaar maakt voor applicaties binnen de hele organisatie. Door een consistente en betrouwbare datalaag te creëren, stellen we ontwikkelteams in staat om beter gebruik te maken van data. Hoewel dit een Senior .NET Developer rol is, ligt de focus vooral op backend-ontwikkeling.

Dit is een zeer autonome rol in een lean team. Je bouwt niet alleen oplossingen, maar helpt ook mee aan het vormgeven van de toekomst van het platform. Je werkt in een complexe omgeving waar bedrijfsprocessen, applicaties en datamodellen samenkomen.

Wij geloven dat de beste oplossingen ontstaan door eerst het probleem écht te begrijpen. Daarom zoeken we iemand die nieuwsgierig is, graag onderzoekt hoe dingen werken, actief het gesprek aangaat met stakeholders, aannames uitdaagt en complexe vraagstukken vertaalt naar schaalbare technische oplossingen.

Je verantwoordelijkheden:

Ontwerpen, bouwen en onderhouden van services en applicaties bovenop de Operational Data Store
Ontwikkelen van backendfunctionaliteit en integraties met C# .NET en Azure SQL
Meewerken aan het migreren van functionaliteit van bestaande API’s naar de nieuwe datalaag waar dat passend is
Integreren en standaardiseren van data uit meerdere bronsystemen
Bijdragen aan de verdere ontwikkeling van het datamodel en de platformarchitectuur
Intensief samenwerken met business stakeholders, architecten en developmentteams om requirements te begrijpen en verbeterkansen te identificeren
Onderzoeken van complexe data- en applicatielandschappen en oplossingen voorstellen die zowel business- als technische behoeften in balans brengen
Eigenaarschap nemen van analyse tot en met implementatie

Jouw talenten

Als Senior .NET Developer ben je zelfstandig, analytisch en proactief. Je vindt het prettig om te werken in een omgeving waar niet alles vooraf is vastgelegd en waar het ontdekken van de juiste oplossing onderdeel is van je werk. Je bent iemand die echt wil begrijpen hoe dingen werken. Je stelt vragen, daagt aannames uit en voelt je comfortabel bij het vormen én onderbouwen van je eigen visie op technische en functionele besluiten.

Daarnaast heb je:

Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring met C# .NET-ontwikkeling
Sterke kennis van SQL en relationele databases
Ervaring met het bouwen van integraties tussen systemen en applicaties
Ervaring met Azure-gebaseerde oplossingen
Affiniteit met datamodellering en complexe datastructuren
Sterke analytische vaardigheden en probleemoplossend vermogen
Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen samen te werken met zowel technische als niet-technische stakeholders
Ervaring met werken in Agile-teams

Samen met uiteenlopende klanten toekomstgerichter, duurzamer en datagedreven beleggen. Zowel nationaal als internationaal. Met ruim 300 jaar ervaring maken we van die ambitie realiteit bij Van Lanschot Kempen. Dat doen we met zo’n 2.100 collega’s verdeeld over verschillende expertises.

Omdat het team lean is, heeft jouw bijdrage directe impact op de richting van het platform. Je krijgt de kans om invloed uit te oefenen op technische beslissingen, oplossingen vorm te geven en te werken aan vraagstukken waarin software engineering, architectuur en data samenkomen. We bieden een omgeving waarin eigenaarschap, nieuwsgierigheid en initiatief worden gewaardeerd. Technische expertise is belangrijk, maar jouw vermogen om complexiteit te doorgronden maakt uiteindelijk het verschil.

De mate van innovatie en wendbaarheid van een organisatie is mede afhankelijk van de diversiteit van het personeelsbestand. Dankzij onze verschillen, versterken we elkaar. Our logistics services allow our customers to transport exactly what they want, when they want, in a cost effective way.

To support our continued growth and digital transformation, we are expanding our software development team with a Web Developer. In this role, you will join our software development department of 35 professionals covering analysis, development, and testing. The team is highly autonomous and works closely with Product Owners to build in house, business driven applications.

Our architecture is Angular, API first, cloud native, and centered around Microsoft Azure, with Apigee for API management and Okta for identity and access management. Knowledge of WEB design is highly valued.

To be successful as a WEB developer, you are analytical, technically strong, and comfortable translating business requirements into robust, secure, and scalable software solutions.

What will you do?

As a WEB Developer, you will:

Develop and maintain scalable web applications using modern front end (Angular) and back end (Dotnet) technologies within Azure
Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code following best practices and coding standards
Collaborate with UI/UX designers to implement responsive and intuitive user interfaces
Optimize applications for maximum speed and scalability
Implement security and data protection measures
Participate in code reviews and provide constructive feedback to team members
Write and maintain technical documentation

What do we expect from you?

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in an Informatics or IT related field
Proven experience as a WEB developer
Strong proficiency in front end technologies: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6+), and modern frameworks (Angular preferred, React or Vue.js)
Experience with Agile development methodologies
Experience with version control systems (Git)
Knowledge of web security best practices and OWASP guidelines
Good command of the English language (spoken and written)
Currently living in The Netherlands within commuting distance of Haarlem

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with cloud platforms (Azure)
Experience with CI/CD pipelines

How does the process work?

Throughout September and October, we will review and shortlist potential candidates. Shortlisted candidates will be invited for onsite interviews in October.

  Why work at Hillebrand Gori?

With great pride, we can say that Hillebrand Gori is the largest beverages logistics company in the world. Founded in 1844, we are active in over 90 countries. Within our department around 15 different nationalities work together.

jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer - Hybride
jobs.description:
Wil jij eigenaar zijn van een platform dat er echt toe doet? Van cloudinfrastructuur en releases tot een vloot slimme kasten in het veld, en van security-audits van veeleisende klanten tot de storing die niemand anders kan vinden? Dan is dit jouw kans.

Wij zoeken een Senior DevOps Engineer die de dagelijkse werking van ons platform draagt: de Azure-infrastructuur, het uitrollen van nieuwe klantomgevingen, CI/CD en releases, security en compliance, kostenbeheersing en de sleutelkasten en lockers die bij onze klanten draaien. Je bent de specialist op wie het team en onze klanten kunnen bouwen. Je adviseert onze Chief Software Officer over de technische keuzes en begeleidt junior en medior DevOps engineers in hun ontwikkeling.
Wat ga je doen?

Als Senior DevOps Engineer zorg jij dat wat het softwareteam bouwt betrouwbaar, veilig en herhaalbaar in productie komt en daar blijft draaien. Je ondersteunt de CSO bij strategische keuzes over architectuur en investeringen door te komen met onderbouwde voorstellen, die je uitvoert en bewaakt. Je werkt nauw samen met de Tech Lead en het softwareteam en bent het technische gezicht van Nauta Connect richting de IT- en securityafdelingen van onze klanten.
Platform en netwerk:
je beheert en ontwikkelt onze cloud- en on-premise infrastructuur via Infrastructure as Code (Bicep/deployment stacks/Azure Verified Modules), firewalls, loadbalancers, Front Door, Azure Container Apps, Azure App Services, ExpressRoute en VPN, DNS en certificaten.
Uitrol nieuwe klanten:
je zet de infrastructuur voor nieuwe klanten en omgevingen geautomatiseerd en volgens de standaard neer (spoke, netwerk, database, toegang en configuratie), ontwikkelt die standaard door en faseert omgevingen gecontroleerd uit.
Releases en pipelines:
je onderhoudt en verbetert onze CI/CD-pipelines in Azure DevOps (smoke- en performancetests, quality gates, security scanning, geautomatiseerde databasemigraties) en voert de releases en hotfixes van onze productsuite uit, met minimale downtime via blue/green of canary deployments.
Security en compliance:
je werkt shift-left: je signaleert en dicht kwetsbaarheden met tooling als SonarQube, GitLeaks, OWASP Dependency-Check, Trivy en OWASP ZAP, stelt securityrapportages op, beantwoordt security-vragenlijsten van klanten en ondersteunt onze ISO 27001-audits.
Databases en observability:
je beheert onze SQL Server- en PostgreSQL-databases in productie (backups, herstel, migraties, performance) en richt monitoring in met Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics en Grafana.
Kosten:
je maakt de kosten van het platform per omgeving en per klant inzichtelijk, optimaliseert zonder verlies van beschikbaarheid of veiligheid en maakt de kostenimpact van elk voorstel expliciet.
Vloot en devices:
je bouwt en onderhoudt de Linux golden image voor onze kasten en lockers en beheert de vloot in het veld: provisioning, updates en het oplossen van problemen op de devices.
Incidenten en klantomgevingen:
je bent het eindstation voor storingen die support en het softwareteam niet kunnen oplossen, ook op het grensvlak van software en infrastructuur. Je bouwt testopstellingen die klantomgevingen nabootsen en helpt klanten ons product veilig in hun netwerk te landen.
Team en kennis:
je leidt de junior en medior DevOps engineers op, reviewt infrastructuur- en securitywerk en zorgt dat kennis in het team wordt vastgelegd in plaats van in één hoofd.

Wat motiveert jou?

Eigenaarschap:
je bijdrage heeft een echte impact op ons platform.
Breedte:
cloud, netwerk, pipelines, security, databases, kosten, embedded devices en klantnetwerken; weinig DevOps-rollen zijn zo veelzijdig.
Impact:
klanten als zorginstellingen en overheden vertrouwen dagelijks op wat jij draaiende houdt.
Groei:
bij bewezen diepgang volg jij het ontwikkelpad naar DevOps Architect.
Samenwerking:
korte lijnen met de CSO en de Tech Lead, en DevOps-collega's die van jou willen leren.
Flexibiliteit:
hybride werken en werktijden die bij je passen.

Dit bieden wij jou

Een compact, divers en gedreven team waarin jouw werk direct zichtbaar is
Een marktconform salaris, afhankelijk van je ervaring, en fijne secundaire voorwaarden
Tijd en budget voor opleidingen, certificeringen en conferenties
Flexibele werktijden en de mogelijkheid om hybride te werken
Laptop en telefoon van de zaak en wat je nodig hebt om ook thuis prettig te werken
28 vakantiedagen
Korting op je sportschoolabonnement, een vitaliteitsprogramma met allerlei (sportieve) activiteiten en gezellige teamuitjes.
Een cultuur waarin experimenteren mag, fouten maken erbij hoort en successen samen gevierd worden

Wat breng jij mee?

Een hbo- of wo-opleiding in IT of informatica, of gelijkwaardige kennis opgebouwd in de praktijk.
Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in DevOps of platform engineering, met aantoonbare verantwoordelijkheid voor productieomgevingen.
Diepgaande kennis van Microsoft Azure (onder meer App Services, Container Apps, Functions, Key Vault, Front Door, Application Gateway, SignalR, Managed Redis) en van Azure-netwerken: landing zone, hub-and-spoke, VNet-peering, NSG's, private endpoints, Azure Firewall, ExpressRoute en VPN.
Ruime ervaring met Infrastructure as Code met Bicep en/of Terraform, met containers (Docker, Container Apps, AKS) en met CI/CD in Azure DevOps Pipelines.
Ervaring met het geautomatiseerd uitrollen van nieuwe klantomgevingen.
Ervaring met high-availability-ontwerpen en minimal-downtime-releases (blue/green, canary) en met incidentonderzoek op basis van logs, traces en databases.
Ervaring met DevSecOps-tooling, CVE-afhandeling en securityrapportages binnen ISO 27001, de OWASP Top 10 en de NCSC-richtlijnen.
Ervaring met SQL Server en PostgreSQL in productie, met monitoring en observability en met Linux inclusief golden images.
Scripting in Bash en PowerShell, en voldoende leesvaardigheid in .NET/C# om applicatiecode op infrastructuur- en securityaspecten te reviewen.
Het vermogen om complexe technische zaken helder uit te leggen aan klanten en collega's, in het Nederlands en Engels.
Een pré:
ervaring met ARM en Ansible, MariaDB en MySQL, fleetmanagement van embedded devices, Python en/of C#, andere cloudplatformen, of certificeringen op het gebied van Azure, Kubernetes, Terraform of security.

Wie zijn wij?

Nauta Connect ontwikkelt slimme oplossingen voor de uitgifte en het beheer van sleutels en bedrijfsmiddelen: elektronische sleutelkasten en lockers, naadloos geïntegreerd met onze eigen Connect-software. Die software is het kloppende hart van onze oplossingen en wordt volledig in huis ontwikkeld. Onze klanten zijn onder meer zorginstellingen, gemeentes, onderwijsinstellingen en organisaties met hoge eisen aan veiligheid en beschikbaarheid.

Ons softwareteam is compact, hecht en denkt actief mee. We gaan graag de uitdaging aan om complexe problemen binnen organisaties op te lossen, waarbij onze hardware en slimme software samen het verschil maken. Korte lijnen, veel eigenaarschap en de ruimte om iets écht te bouwen.

Nauta Connect is onderdeel van de Nauta Group, een (h)echt familiebedrijf met het hoofdkantoor in Barneveld. Hoe gaat het met je? En heb je nog leuke plannen voor de komende dagen? Het zijn vragen die je vaak hoort in onze wandelgangen. We houden van persoonlijk contact met elkaar en met onze klanten, en werken iedere dag met een enthousiast team van zo'n 170 medewerkers aan het succes van ons bedrijf.

Create your own future

Are you a great engineer ready to take on a new challenge, bridging native mobile development and backend API development? We are looking to extend our team with a passionate fullstack engineer who is strong in either native iOS development or backend REST API development in C#/.NET — and has working knowledge of the other side. You understand the full landscape needed to run enterprise apps reliably, including APIs, authentication, and CI/CD.

The Client AI & Analytics team is building AI-powered tools inside ClientCenter, our custom platform used by private bankers, relationship managers, and other commercial staff to manage client relationships and deliver highly personalized client service at scale. We build practical, impactful AI tools that fit naturally into how bankers and advisors actually work, always with humans firmly in the loop.

Over the past period, the team has added a growing set of AI-powered capabilities to the platform, including meeting preparation, live transcription, automated documentation, data quality improvements, and compliance support. We are now taking the next step: developing a native iOS app, backed by our C#/.NET API layer, that makes these intelligent capabilities available anytime, anywhere, on secure managed devices within our corporate environment.

As a fullstack engineer, you will help build the corporate mobile app and the backend that powers it, enabling our commercial colleagues to work faster, smarter, and more effectively, with AI-assisted ClientCenter functionality right at their fingertips.

Your talents

"Passionate about mobile and backend technology, AI, growth mindset, collaborative and hands-on" — this is how we can best describe you in this role. You use these talents to continuously improve the digital experience of our commercial colleagues.

You have strong experience in at least one
of the following, and working
knowledge of the other:

iOS development

3+ years of experience developing native iOS apps, preferably with Swift and SwiftUI
Strong understanding of REST architectural principles (resources, statelessness, idempotency, proper use of HTTP methods/status codes) and experience applying this when consuming APIs in a mobile context
NET API development
3+ years of experience developing REST APIs in C# / .NET
Track record of designing robust, maintainable, and scalable APIs — sound architectural choices that hold up as the platform and usage grow

Across both profiles, you also have:

Familiarity with design patterns, testing (unit/integration tests), continuous integration and deployment
Solid understanding of Clean Architecture and MVVM principles, and experience with dependency injection
Knowledge of and hands-on experience with Azure is a strong plus

What makes you stand out:

Experience with setting up and maintaining CI/CD pipelines in Azure (for example Azure DevOps, Azure Pipelines) for mobile apps.
Experience developing and deploying corporate mobile apps in managed environments, such as Mobile Device Management (MDM) solutions like Microsoft Intune (e.g. app protection policies, app configuration, distribution to managed devices).
Affinity with broader software engineering topics (logging, monitoring, observability, security-by-design) and collaborating with backend / platform engineers.

Move ahead at Van Lanschot Kempen

Investing in a more future-oriented, sustainable, and data-driven way with various clients. Both nationally and internationally. With nearly 300 years of experience, we make this ambition a reality at Van Lanschot Kempen. We do this with more than 1,800 colleagues in various fields of expertise.

This means a work environment which offers both; the cool and ambitious character of a start-up combined with the solid benefits of a large company.

An organisation's degree of innovation and agility also depends on the diversity of its workforce. Our differences make us stronger together. We promote an inclusive work environment where all colleagues feel at home. With us, you can be yourself. And we are proud of that.

jobs.title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer - Moonpay Enterprise
jobs.description:
MoonPay Enterprise is for builders with something to prove.

This isn't a "work on cool crypto stuff" company. It's a high-standards, high-velocity, high-accountability company building the operating system for value movement. If the internet moves information, we move value: crypto, stablecoins, tokenized assets, and whatever comes next. Four offerings make that real: fund, tokenize, trade, and spend.

MoonPay Enterprise is the fund layer built for businesses. We power how stablecoins move through real financial operations: enterprises, fintechs, PSPs, wallets, and marketplaces running their treasuries, their cross-border flows, and their stablecoin operations on us. The goal is to make moving real money at scale as predictable as any other piece of financial infrastructure, with the compliance and controls CFOs need to say yes.

AI is the default operating mode here. It's woven into every role, and we expect you to use it daily. It handles the manual work so you can deliver on what actually matters.

You'll thrive here if outcomes excite you more than process, if impact motivates you more than titles, and if you want hard problems, real ownership, and teammates who love winning, building, and doing it together.

The bar is high. The pace is real. We're building the rails that businesses run real money on, for humans and agents. MoonPay ranked #2 in Crypto Services on Fortune's inaugural Crypto 100, made Forbes' America's Best Startup Employers 2026 (Top 25 in Finance), and landed on The Sunday Times Best Places to Work two years running.

The role

We’re hiring backend engineers across several openings within MoonPay Enterprise. All roles share the same foundation of designing and operating reliable, secure, high-throughput backend services, but each opening has a distinct focus. When you apply, tell us which track (or tracks) excites you most.

Track 1: KYB / KYC & Compliance Platform

Build the systems that let enterprises onboard safely and stay compliant across dozens of jurisdictions. You’ll own services powering business (KYB) and individual (KYC) verification flows, risk scoring, sanctions and AML screening, case management, and integrations with identity and compliance vendors. The challenge is making rigorous compliance feel invisible: fast, automated, and globally scalable, without ever compromising on regulatory obligations.

Track 2: New Product Lines, starting with Custody

Join us at the ground floor of new enterprise products, beginning with Custody. You’ll design the backend for secure digital asset storage and management for institutional clients: key management workflows, policy engines, transaction authorization, ledger integrity, and audit trails. This track suits engineers who love ambiguity, greenfield architecture, and building products from zero to one with enterprise-grade security requirements.

Track 3: Blockchain, Stablecoin Issuance & On-Chain Infrastructure

Work directly with blockchain protocols to power our stablecoin issuance business and on-chain products. You’ll build and operate services for minting, burning, and managing fully reserved stablecoins across chains, develop smart contract integrations on EVM chains and Solana, and design the indexing, monitoring, and reconciliation systems that keep on-chain and off-chain state in sync. Prior Solana (Rust) or Solidity development experience is a strong plus here.

Across all tracks, experience with fiat rails, banking integrations, or payments systems is very welcome. Much of our hardest work happens where traditional finance and crypto overlap.

What you’ll do

Design, build, and operate backend services written in Rust that process high volumes of financial transactions with strong guarantees around correctness, idempotency, and auditability
Own features end to end, from shaping the product spec through technical design, implementation, testing, deployment, and production monitoring. You won’t just receive work from product: as a domain expert, you’ll help define what we build and propose the work you consider most useful
Integrate with external partners such as banks, payment processors, blockchains, and identity and compliance vendors, and build the abstractions that make those integrations reliable
Improve engineering quality across observability, incident response, security practices, and API design
Collaborate closely with product, compliance, and other engineering teams across MoonPay’s global network
(Staff level) Set technical direction for your area, mentor other engineers, and drive architectural decisions that span multiple teams

About You

5+ years of backend engineering experience (8+ for Staff), with a track record of shipping and operating production systems at scale
Strong backend experience with a statically compiled language (e.g. Rust, Go, C#, C++) is a must. Deep fundamentals matter more to us than your specific language history
Prior professional Rust experience is not required, but interest in Rust and motivation to become an expert in it are very welcome, since our services are written in Rust
Solid fundamentals in distributed systems, API design, data modeling, and asynchronous processing
Comfort working in domains where precision matters, such as financial systems, double-entry ledgers, reconciliation, or similarly correctness-critical software
A pragmatic, autonomous, ownership-driven mindset. You care about outcomes, communicate clearly, and thrive on high throughput: on this team, features ship in hours to days and products in days to weeks
Strong critical thinking, including in how you use AI tools. You know how to drive AI-assisted development productively while staying firmly in control of correctness, security, and design quality
Interest in crypto, stablecoins, and the future of payments. Prior crypto experience is a plus rather than a requirement, except for Track 3, where hands-on blockchain development experience is expected

Bonus points

Professional or hobby experience writing Rust (open-source contributions count!)
Experience in fiat payments, banking integrations, card networks, or PSPs
Familiarity with KYC/KYB, AML, sanctions screening, or regulated financial products (Track 1)
Background in custody, key management (MPC/HSM), or institutional-grade security (Track 2)
Smart contract development in Solidity (EVM) or Rust (Solana), and experience with on-chain indexing or node infrastructure (Track 3)
Experience working in regulated, multi-jurisdiction environments

How we work

MoonPay Enterprise operates like a startup inside a scale-up: small, senior, high-throughput teams with real ownership, direct access to customers and decision-makers, and the backing of MoonPay’s global licenses, banking relationships, and distribution network. We move fast and expect engineers to act as product owners for their domain, not just implementers. This role is open fully remote, or hybrid from our Berlin, Germany hub if you prefer time with the team in person.

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.

Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.

Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.

What Sets Us Apart

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.

Meet the team behind this journey

DeepL is not just a translation tool; we are building the Operating System for Global Communication
. We are the rare AI company that builds the entire stack in-house: from training next-gen LLMs on our own NVIDIA DGX SuperPODs to delivering real-time Language AI to over 300 million users and 200,000+ businesses globally.

You will join the Identity and Access Management team
. Owning DeepL's full identity stack: organisation, account and session management, SSO federation, SCIM provisioning, and the OIDC provider, for both internal and external users. It is the foundation every DeepL product relies on to authenticate and authorise users securely and at scale. When identity is unavailable, no one can log in, so reliability and performance sit at the heart of everything the team does.

We are shifting gears from "Software-First" to "Product-First." We don't hire engineers to simply maintain legacy endpoints or close Jira tickets. We hire Missionaries
— builders who obsess over the Why before the How. You will contribute across the stack, shipping features that create delightful, frictionless experiences for both external developers and internal engineering teams.

Your Responsibilities

Own the Identity Experience End-to-End: You will architect and build complex, user-facing features across our identity stack. You will own business-critical systems from the initial problem definition through to architectural design, deployment, and production reliability. You measure success by user impact, not just pull requests merged
Build for "Consumer-Grade" Enterprise: You understand that authentication and authorization systems cannot fail. You build for reliability and maintainability, while delivering a user-friendly experience. You will lead incident response, and continuously raise the bar on code quality and operational health
Collaborate to Raise the Bar: You will work closely with teammates across Identity and adjacent teams - other product teams, Product Management and Support. You will lead designs, scoping, shaping, and solving hard product and technical challenges in collaboration with your team and other engineers
Drive Technical Pragmatism: Whether using our core stack (C#/.NET Core, Kubernetes, Postgres) or exploring new tools, you choose the technology that solves the customer problem most effectively, ensuring long-term maintainability over short-term trends. You use AI for boilerplate code, test generation, and debugging, allowing you to focus your cognitive energy on high-value architectural decisions and complex problem-solving

Qualities we look for

Extreme Ownership & Operational Excellence: You own your services end-to-end (production operations, incident response, and on-call) and you're motivated by pushing reliability toward four nines. You write comprehensive tests, monitor the systems in production, and you treat each incident as an opportunity to learn
A "System Thinker" Mindset: You don't just know syntax; you understand failure modes, system boundaries, and how your code impacts the broader architecture at scale. You can design systems that deliver high availability for our millions of users.
Backend Mastery at Scale (C# / .NET): You have deep expertise designing scalable backend systems and distributed architectures, and you've worked with high-scale distributed systems in production. Strong system design is core to how you work. Roughly 80-90% of the work is backend; working on the frontend (React/Javascript) is a welcome plus, not a requirement
Enterprise Domain Curiosity: You are interested in the hard problems of B2B SaaS Identity - authentication (SSO/OIDC), authorization, and requirements such as security and auditing. You understand that these aren't "boring details"; they are the pillars of trust for enterprise clients
AI-Native Velocity: You leverage AI-powered tools (like GitHub Copilot or Claude) to accelerate your velocity and eliminate repetitive toil. You use AI for boilerplate code, test generation, and debugging, allowing you to focus your cognitive energy on high-value architectural decisions and complex problem-solving

A Note on Our Hiring Process:
DeepL hires for the Company
, not just a specific team. We operate a Unified Engineering Pipeline
. If you pass our bar, we will match you to the highest-priority role that fits your skillset—whether that is in Core Product, Platform, Voice, or Enterprise. We prioritize "Missionaries" who want to solve the biggest problems, wherever they live in the stack.

What We Offer

Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.
Open communication, regular feedback: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.
Hybrid work, flexible hours: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.
Virtual Shares: An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future.
Regular in-person team events: we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.
Monthly full-day hacking sessions: every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.
30 days of annual leave: we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.
Competitive benefits: just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.

If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!

We are an equal opportunity employer

You are welcome at DeepL for who you are - we appreciate authenticity here. Our product is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our diversity that we will find the power to break down language barriers in the world.

Who We Are

We are one of the world’s largest independent exploration and production companies, based on proved reserves and production of liquids and natural gas. With operations and activities in 13 countries, we explore for, develop, and produce crude oil and natural gas globally. We are challenged with an important job to safely find and deliver energy to the world. Our employees are critical to our success, and with them we power civilization.

We’re grounded by our SPIRIT Values – safety, people, integrity, responsibility, innovation, and teamwork. These values position us to deliver strong performance in a dynamic business – but not at all costs. We believe it’s not just what we do – it’s how we do it – that sets us apart.

Fostering an Inclusive Work Environment

To deliver superior performance, we create an environment that respects the contributions and differences of every individual. Wherever possible, we use these differences to drive competitive business advantage, personal growth and, ultimately, create business success.

The Systems Support Engineer sustains reliable non-ETRM commercial applications supporting compliance, credit risk, market risk, pricing, custom solutions, data platforms, reporting, and integrations. The role restores service, implements controlled application changes, and supports continuity of global trading operations. The scope excludes platform engineering, infrastructure engineering, and core ETRM basis-analysis responsibilities.

Monitor application health, trade and data flows, batch processing, interfaces, reporting, and downstream dependencies.
Triage incidents, assess business impact, restore service, coordinate escalations, and communicate recovery status, workarounds, and next steps.
Operate within a follow-the-sun model through structured handoffs, regional coordination, and end-to-end issue ownership.
Maintain accurate support procedures and knowledge records.
Meet service-level commitments and comply with ITIL, security, change management, and operational controls.

Technical Responsibilities:

Diagnose production issues across applications, Azure-hosted components, APIs, integrations, databases, configuration, logs, messages, scheduled processes, and file transfers.
Implement minor bug fixes, SQL corrections, configuration updates, and small enhancements using approved development practices.
Validate data integrity and reconcile application, interface, pricing, risk, and reporting output during recovery.
Coordinate deployments, environment readiness, release validation, rollback planning, smoke testing, and post-release monitoring.

Document root-cause evidence and recommend preventive or automated improvements.

DevOps: Intermediate level of knowledge of GitHub, Azure DevOps, source control, pull requests, CI/CD, and production release practices.

Ability to create clear runbooks, troubleshooting guides, known-error records, and handover notes.
Experience supporting energy or commodities trading processes and applications.
Experience improving support operations through automation, reusable playbooks, and continuous improvement.
Experience using GitHub Copilot or similar tools responsibly for code analysis, test creation, and support automation.
ITIL Foundation, Microsoft Azure, GitHub, or related production support, cloud, or DevOps certification.

Works effectively with business users, application teams, platform and infrastructure teams, vendors, and regional support partners.

Bridge the Gap: You are bilingual in "Engineering" and "Business." You work directly with Sales, Product, and Finance to translate "Annual Recurring Revenue" goals into scalable technical architectures .
Drive System Reliability: You understand that billing systems cannot fail. You build for idempotency and resilience, ensuring that our financial data is auditable and flawless, while maintaining a high-velocity frontend experience.

A "Product-First" Mindset: You care deeply about the customer journey. You ask, "How does this feature help us close the next Enterprise deal?" before writing code.
Full-Stack Fluency: You are comfortable traversing the stack. You can design a React component for an Admin Dashboard in the morning and debug a distributed transaction in the backend in the afternoon.
Enterprise Domain Curiosity: You are interested in the hard problems of B2B SaaS—Identity (SAML/SSO), Monetization, and Compliance. You understand that these aren't "boring details"; they are the pillars of trust for enterprise clients .

What We Offer

Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities.
