jobs.title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Role:
Senior Forward Deployed Engineer
Job Location:
London, UK
Experience:
Mid-Senior Level
Work Type:
Hybrid / Open for full-time & Contract

About Company:

At Synechron, we believe in the power of digital to transform businesses for the better. Our global consulting firm combines creativity and innovative technology to deliver industry-leading digital solutions. Synechron’s progressive technologies and optimization strategies span end-to-end Artificial Intelligence, Consulting, Digital, Cloud & DevOps, Data, and Software Engineering, servicing an array of noteworthy financial services and technology firms. Through research and development initiatives in our FinLabs we develop solutions for modernization, from Artificial Intelligence and Blockchain to Data Science models, Digital Underwriting, mobile-first applications and more. Over the last 20+ years, our company has been honored with multiple employer awards, recognizing our commitment to our talented teams. With top clients to boast about, Synechron has a global workforce of 14,700+ and has 55 offices in 20 countries within key global markets. For more information on the company, please visit our website or LinkedIn community .

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

Diversity & Inclusion are fundamental to our culture, and Synechron is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative-action employer. Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) initiative ‘Same Difference’ is committed to fostering an inclusive culture – promoting equality, diversity and an environment that is respectful to all. We strongly believe that a diverse workforce helps build stronger, successful businesses as a global company. We encourage applicants from across diverse backgrounds, race, ethnicities, religion, age, marital status, gender, sexual orientations, or disabilities to apply. We empower our global workforce by offering flexible workplace arrangements, mentoring, internal mobility, learning and development programs, and more.
All employment decisions at Synechron are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to the applicant’s gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Role Overview :

Client is building a small, senior team of Forward Deployed Engineers to design and ship agentic AI applications across our Corporate Functions — Finance, HR, Legal, Procurement, Marketing and Sales operations. You will be embedded directly with the people who own the process, taking a real business problem from idea to a working, production-grade solution in weeks rather than quarters.
This is hands-on engineering. You will typically be the sole technical seat in a small pod alongside a process owner and a business sponsor, building applications that run multi-step workflows, hold state across many users, and act directly on enterprise systems of record. That is materially harder than a chatbot, and it is the point of the role.
You will build on Microsoft Fabric as our enterprise data platform and on Azure AI services, and you will help set the technical patterns the wider team reuses. If you want to build serious AI systems that change how a 50,000-person business actually works, and you want the autonomy to do it properly, this is the role.

What You Will Do:

Design, build and harden agentic AI applications that read from and write to enterprise systems of record, grounded on Microsoft Fabric and Azure AI services.
Embed with a Corporate Function team as the technical lead of a small, multi-functional pod — moving from problem, to prototype, to production at pace.
Run a tight, iterative build cycle: align on the outcome, prototype, gather feedback, refine and finalize, typically within one to two weeks per loop.
Own the quality of what you ship end to end — security, reliability, scalability, observability, and safe, governed write-back to source systems.
Make the right build call for the problem: low-code and agent-builder platforms where they fit, custom code where they do not.
Ensure the data behind each solution is AI-ready — modelled, governed and documented in Fabric, with lineage and access control that will stand up to audit.
Set and document the reusable technical patterns, components and guardrails the team applies across every engagement.
Become credible in a new business domain quickly and challenge requirements constructively to land on the right solution rather than the requested one.

Required Qualifications:

Proven experience building agentic or multi-agent AI systems that run in production and serve real users — working systems, not demonstrations.
Strong command of state management, concurrency, idempotency and authorization for systems that act on a system of record on behalf of many users.
Substantial software development experience in at least one language such as Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, C# or Java — you can architect, write, review and debug production code.
Hands-on integration experience with enterprise APIs and data platforms, including designing safe read and write paths and handling failure gracefully.
Working knowledge of modern AI application patterns — retrieval-augmented generation, prompt and context design, agent orchestration, tool use and protocols such as MCP.
Strong, hands-on command of a major cloud platform, ideally Azure — able to independently provision, configure, deploy, secure and operate cloud resources, owning an application end to end rather than only consuming pre-built services.
Demonstrated ability to prototype rapidly, using AI-assisted development and fast iteration to turn a loosely defined idea into something usable in days.
The judgement and autonomy of a senior individual contributor — able to make sound architecture and feasibility calls alone, under time pressure, and explain them to non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications:

Direct experience with Microsoft Fabric — Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Factory, Real-Time Intelligence, Power BI and OneLake — or a comparable enterprise data platform.
Experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Platform, Azure AI Foundry, or agent-builder platforms such as Lyzr or Moveworks.
Integration experience with major Corporate Function systems of record — for example Oracle HCM, SAP, Workday, Salesforce, Dynamics 365 or ServiceNow.
Familiarity with enterprise governance concerns: identity and access management, data classification and residency, responsible AI policy, and evaluation of model output.
A background that blends software engineering with consulting, business transformation or a Corporate Function discipline.
Experience delivering in short, iterative cycles directly with non-technical business stakeholders.

How We Will Assess You:

A practical build exercise: take an ambiguous business problem to a working agentic prototype and explain your design trade-offs.
A systems design discussion covering state, concurrency, authorization and safe write-back to a system of record.
A stakeholder conversation testing how you scope, challenge and communicate with a non-technical business owner.

Description

Would you like to help drive the growth and technical software delivery expertise of a global company that works with 91% of the Fortune Global 500? Are you an experienced engineer who is fluent with the latest AI and agentic tooling, thrives on AI agent-led delivery, and can think on your feet to propose innovative solutions to challenging problems? This is an exceptional opportunity to play a key role in developing the change capabilities of a global financial services organisation, where our delivery model is pivoting towards AI agent-led development, and the focus is on practical delivery and reacting to the highest value business needs.

You will hit the ground running: building AI-enabled products with large language models and modern agent frameworks and directing AI coding assistants to deliver at pace. You will turn concepts from our architects and product managers into working software quickly, challenge technical design and delivery choices, and bring the analytical rigour needed to take AI solutions safely into production.

The Role

Design, build and productionise AI-enabled features and services using large language models, RAG, prompt engineering and agent frameworks / orchestration (such as LangChain, LangGraph or Semantic Kernel).
Take AI solutions beyond prototype, owning evaluation, testing, guardrails, observability, security and cost management.
Rapidly prototype and validate ideas, turning concepts into working software within days and proving out how to build the solution properly at scale.
Deliver hands-on development of class leading web-based applications and services, integrating AI capabilities with our existing platform (C# / .NET, React and/or Angular, Python) and our Azure cloud and DevOps tooling.
Direct AI coding assistants and agentic workflows (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Claude Code) alongside your own hands-on expertise, and rigorously review both human-written and AI-generated code against our architectural, development and security standards.
Own delivery of a small suite of business-related projects, ensuring architectural and solution alignment with the wider technical vision.
Drive adoption of AI agent-led delivery across the team, coaching others in effective and responsible use of AI tooling so the capability spreads.
Challenge established development processes and procedures, particularly how AI agents are integrated into the SDLC, and work closely with the Engineering Leads on tooling adoption and delivery outcomes.
Track AI and agentic technology trends outside the organisation and apply them pragmatically to our products, whilst developing deep domain knowledge.

Qualifications

What you’ll bring

Essential Experience

Practical experience building with AI and agentic technologies: large language models, RAG, prompt engineering, and agent frameworks / orchestration (such as LangChain, LangGraph or Semantic Kernel).
Hands-on experience using AI coding assistants and agentic development tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor) in a professional delivery setting, and the ability to critically review, validate and secure the code they produce.
Strong hands-on software engineering experience (minimum 10 years commercial), with React and/or Angular, TypeScript, C# / .NET and Python.
Hands-on commercial experience in Azure cloud, using GitHub and Azure DevOps, across all phases of the SDLC and Agile delivery.
Proven ability to rapidly prototype and validate ideas, moving a concept from whiteboard to working demo in days.
Demonstrable experience leading, influencing and mentoring through hands-on contributions.
Experience of working in a financial services organisation, preferably with exposure to the insurance industry / insurance broking. Where this directly relevant experience is not available, we will be looking for an ability to rapidly become effective in a new, unfamiliar environment.
First-rate communication skills, applied to rapid and creative problem solving with technical and business stakeholders in an occasionally pressurised environment.
Comfortable working on your own initiative or as part of a broader project team, remotely or face to face, and confident challenging established approaches.

Desirable Experience

Experience running AI / LLM solutions in production at scale, including evaluation frameworks, guardrails and cost management.
Experience designing or orchestrating multi-agent workflows, and familiarity with agent protocols (e.g. MCP) for integrating AI agents with engineering pipelines and enterprise data.
Experience with microservice based architectures and containerisation.
Experience building and working with mathematical algorithms, or with geospatial, catastrophe or financial-modelling data.
Experience understanding and translating complex business processes across multiple stakeholder groups.
BSc degree qualified in a quantitative discipline (Mathematics, Science or Computer Science).

Start making the most of your career and wellbeing with a range of benefits tailored for you.

Job Description

Derby (Hybrid)

Full-Time, Permanent

We are looking for software and systems engineers to help design, deliver and support the next generation of aerospace test facilities globally with a main focus testing of software developed by the team. The Rolls-Royce Measurement & Test Engineering organisation are responsible for designing and delivering the infrastructure required to test the next generation of gas turbine engines for both Civil and Defence applications. This includes Test Bed 80, the world’s largest indoor aerospace test bed.

Why join Rolls-Royce?

At Rolls-Royce we are proud to be a business that has truly helped to shape the modern world and are committed to always being a force for progress; powering, protecting and connecting people everywhere.

By joining Rolls-Royce, you'll have the opportunity to work on world-class solutions, supported by a culture that believes individuality is our greatest strength, and all perspectives, experiences and backgrounds help us innovate and enable our high-performance culture.

The Experimental Systems team are responsible for delivering a wide range of measurement and control system technologies. The team have just completed the design, installation, and commissioning of all the data systems on Test Bed 80 from concept to first engine run and helped complete the first run on the UltraFan (our most instrumented engine ever).

The software design side of the team are responsible for developing bespoke applications to support the planning, conducting, monitoring, and reporting of engine tests and their data. They are also responsible for managing the IT infrastructure supporting the test facilities. Successful candidates can either specialise in a key skill or obtain a broad range of engineering and IT skills which are required to provide data systems and services that support Rolls-Royce’s core aero-engine products throughout their lifecycle.

What You Will Be Doing

Building of automated test frameworks
Development of applications and data pipelines
Integration of IT systems including networks, data movement and storage
Support the design and integration of new measurement and control system solutions, including high speed data acquisition
Utilising DevOps to perform CI/CD (continuous integration and continuous delivery) and to work within an Agile framework
Requirements capture and analysis, and the preparation of system specifications
Implement and drive cyber security best practices

Who Were Looking For

You will have the confidence and ability to work as part of a team and take the lead on technical projects. The role will be based in Derby, but the global nature of the business requires the flexibility to support the Civil Aerospace global business model, and the requirement for short-term assignments around the globe.

Qualifications

Qualified to degree level or equivalent in computer science or in a relevant engineering discipline.

We are looking for people with the following experience and skills;

Software testing and test automation
Software engineering with experience in scripting and/or low-level languages including but not limited to: Python, C/C++, C#, Java, Terraform
An appreciation of IT infrastructure including operating systems (Windows, Linux), hardware (computers, servers, and network hardware) and associated software
Experience in requirements capture/analysis methods, such as Systems Engineering
Experience in the development of Azure build and release pipeline
Experience of software testing, including automated test of user interfaces

In Addition, The Following Role Specific Skills Are Preferred

Experience of software vulnerability scanning using tools like SonarQube
System and software architecture design
Good knowledge of current products, technologies and methods
Experience in Dev Ops and Agile work practices
Understanding of Data Acquisition, including high speed measurement techniques
Experience of driver development and testing for Windows and Linux
Experience of containerisation for software development and testing

You will have a demonstrable track record of delivering under pressure to both tight and changing project deadlines. Highly self-motivated and enthusiastic, you will be able to produce work of a consistently high standard.

Regional Benefits

Our People are our power, so when join Rolls-Royce you are offered more than a salary. You are given a choice of flexible benefits from life insurance to gym discounts and tax free cycling.

Generous Annual Leave
Retirement Savings through the Rolls-Royce Retirement Savings Trust
Group Life Assurance provides for a lump sum benefit if you die whilst employed by Rolls-Royce
Group Income Protection provides an income in the event that you are unable to work due to illness or injury
Your Shares: Matched is a simple way to own Rolls-Royce shares and invest in our future, together. Buy one share, get one free!
Digital GP provides a convenient way for you to access GP consultations
Employee Assistance (EAP) and Live Well programmes

Our vision is to ensure that the excellence and ingenuity that shaped our history continues into our future. Our multi-year transformation programme aims to turn Rolls-Royce into a high-performing, competitive, resilient and growing company. Join us, and it can be your future vision too.

Rolls-Royce are committed to being a respectful, inclusive, and non-discriminatory workplace where individuality is valued, diverse perspectives fuel innovation, and everyone can thrive.

About GitHub

GitHub is the world’s leading platform for agentic software development — powered by Copilot to build, scale, and deliver secure software. Over 180 million developers, including more than 90% of the Fortune 100 companies, use GitHub to collaborate, and more than 77,000 organisations have adopted GitHub Copilot.

Locations

In this role you can work from Remote, United Kingdom

Overview

GitHub is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join the Git Systems Engineering team, which runs the largest code-hosting platform in the world, part of our Platform and Infrastructure organization. Our group is responsible for the services that store and serve Git repositories, both directly to users and to other layers in the GitHub software stack. We build the various microservices, protocols, proxies, and control systems that power Git operations at GitHub and operate them at scale.

Our group is highly distributed and the right candidate will thrive in an environment of asynchronous communication. We expect you to have excellent written communication skills and be able to create working relationships with coworkers in locations around the globe.

This role is focused on wide-reaching, cross-team work to improve our git code-hosting platform. This role will be involved in the design, rollout and support of highly performant, highly scalable, and highly available services to enable the next generation of AI-driven software development.

Prior experience solving problems with large-scale, distributed systems is preferred.

(i.e. Petabytes of storage, millions of objects, low latency, high throughput with millions of QPS)

Responsibilities

Design, develop, test, and ship high-quality solutions within the team’s service area, with attention to scalability, availability, and maintainability; build deep familiarity with the systems you own and apply best practices to keep code extensible and operable.
Lead technical discussions for features in the team’s area of responsibility; produce design docs/proposals as needed; and validate approaches through targeted experiments and prototypes, incorporating stakeholder and customer feedback.
Lead by example by writing clean, defensive, maintainable code and mentoring engineers within the immediate team on implementation details, debugging techniques, and product/service expertise.
Provide technical leadership in code reviews to ensure changes meet GitHub and team quality standards (correctness, security, reliability, diagnosability, and maintainability), and that code is ready to merge and operate at the expected scale.
Partner with engineering and product stakeholders to define requirements, identify dependencies, break work into deliverable milestones, and provide estimates and risk/impact tradeoffs to support prioritization and successful delivery.
Participate in the on-call rotation for the team’s services; act as a first responder for your area of ownership; troubleshoot complex live-site issues using logs/telemetry; drive mitigations and safe deployments (including rollback plans); and write postmortems that result in measurable follow-up improvements.
Model engineering excellence by improving developer workflows (tooling, automation, and repeatable quality checks), sharing learnings from investigations and incidents, and contributing to a collaborative team culture with strong ownership and inclusive communication.

OR Associate’s Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Math, Physics, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field AND 5+ years experience in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical discipline with proven experience maintaining and delivering production software coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, Go, Ruby, Rust, or Python

OR Doctorate in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Math, Physics, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field
OR equivalent experience.

Other Qualifications:

Ability to meet GitHub, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings: Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft, GitHub’s parent company, Cloud Screen upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience with cloud platforms like Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services.
Understanding of production system monitoring and observability.
Ability to think critically about both system design and software engineering concepts and blend those perspectives pragmatically based on project needs.
Demonstrated experience with large-scale system architecture and design, particularly in cloud-based environments, with a strong understanding of distributed systems and microservices.
Experience working closely with product management, design, and other engineering teams to drive cross-functional projects and deliver high-quality product.

Customer-obsessed
Ship to learn
Growth mindset
Own the outcome
Better together
Diverse and inclusive

GitHub is the world’s leading AI-powered developer platform with 150 million developers and counting. DXC does not make offers of employment via social media networks and DXC never asks for any money or payments from applicants at any point in the recruitment process, nor ask a job seeker to purchase IT or other equipment on our behalf. jobs.description:
At Longshot Systems we build advanced platforms for sports betting analytics and trading.

We're looking for a Software Engineer to join the team that owns and develops our trading platform. Longshot is a small, focused company and so the role suits someone who can architect and implement whatever is needed to meet our next product, performance or stability goal. The team owns the technical standards and coding guidelines, CI/CD, observability and security. This role suits someone who wants to ship features and contribute to the wider technical excellence in the team and platform.

The trading platform at Longshot handles integrations with many bookmakers and exchanges worldwide. It normalises and combines the global odds data for many sports and makes it available internally for strategies to trade on. We handle thousands of odds updates and trades per second and have very strict bounds on latency, correctness and overall quality of the feed and trading. You would be at the heart of this team: integrating more trading venues, optimising key parts of the platform, making trading safer and faster, etc. We also maintain a significant historical data repository and support wider trading and research efforts around the company.

Our key platform systems are all in Golang, with message buses and databases at the core of the architecture. You don't need to be fluent in Golang, but it would help. It's easy to learn and we have a team full of experts able to teach you.

We are a hybrid working company, working Thursdays in our London (Farringdon) office and flexible the rest of the week. Our typical working hours are 10 am to 6 pm UK time, Monday to Friday, but we support flexible working and trust our team to manage their own schedules to meet their goals.

Interview Process

Intro call (30 mins) - your background + interests
1st Technical interview (30 mins) - live code review & pair programming
2nd Technical interview (60 mins) - deep dive technical questions
Full assessment day (10:30-5pm) - a one day systems programming exercise designed to be similar to the real work we do in the team. Meet some of the team, see the office, have a nice lunch (on us)

Bachelors or Masters in a quantitative or technical subject (e.g. Maths, EE, Physics, Comp Sci) from a top university
2+ years experience building mission critical distributed systems (finance, gaming, telco, ad-tech, etc.) where throughput, correctness and availability are a hard requirement
Proven track record delivering and maintaining production systems in at least one systems language (Go, C++, Rust, Java, C#, etc.), with clear, idiomatic designs

Architecture & design: Able to reason about trade offs and produce clean, evolvable service boundaries

Fluent written and spoken English. Communicating with the team is as important as the technical work. You need to be able to effectively collaborate on everything from low level details to long term strategic planning

Trading, market making or exchange experience

About This Role

Vice President, AI-Enabled Product Engineer – Aladdin, Investments & Trading Engineering

Location:
Edinburgh

About The Role

BlackRock is seeking a Vice President, AI-Enabled Product Engineer to join Aladdin, Investments & Trading Engineering within Analytics & Compliance Engineering. This role is for a hands-on engineering leader who can build scalable agentic solutions while helping accelerate the adoption of AI-enabled engineering practices across the product development lifecycle.

The successful candidate will work at the intersection of investment technology, investment compliance workflows, full-stack engineering, and applied AI. They will help design and deliver capabilities across the Aladdin platform that support investment professionals, compliance teams, and business stakeholders operating in complex global markets.

About Aladdin, Investments & Trading Engineering

Aladdin is BlackRock’s technology platform used by investment professionals to manage portfolios, analyse risk, execute workflows, and make decisions at scale. Within Investments & Trading Engineering, Analytics & Compliance Engineering develops technology that helps teams manage investment guidelines, regulatory obligations, analytics-driven workflows, and operational controls across global markets.

The Investment and Trading Compliance Engineering team is responsible for developing and maintaining tools to ensure that organizations using Aladdin® comply at different stages of the asset management process. This includes ensuring that clients follow guidelines established internally, by themselves, and by the market regulators. The system accomplishes this through high-throughput rule-based compliance engines, which sit at the heart of the investment system and process millions of calculations per day.

Our engineering teams build products with real reach, real complexity, and real impact. We are evolving our platform with persona-based, workflow-driven experiences, modular architecture, resilient services, and responsible AI capabilities that improve productivity, decision-making, knowledge discovery, and operational efficiency.

What You’ll Do

Design, build, and deliver high-quality full-stack Agnetic product capabilities across the Aladdin platform, with a focus on Analytics & Compliance Engineering workflows.
Act as a hands-on technical leader across the product development lifecycle, contributing to technical design, implementation, testing, deployment readiness, production support, and continuous improvement.
Partner with product managers, engineers, compliance specialists, and business stakeholders to translate complex business problems into clear specifications, technical designs, delivery plans, and actionable Agile backlogs.
Apply AI-enabled engineering practices to accelerate design exploration, prototyping, software development, testing, code review, documentation, and operational support.
Help embed responsible AI capabilities into product workflows and platform services, including intelligent assistants, workflow automation, semantic search, knowledge retrieval, and reasoning over compliance and investment information.
Build scalable, resilient, and operable systems that balance functional requirements with non-functional concerns such as performance, latency, reliability, security, observability, and maintainability.
Influence architecture and technical direction across initiatives, articulating design trade-offs and aligning stakeholders around pragmatic engineering choices.
Champion engineering excellence through test-driven development, behaviour-driven development, DevOps practices, production readiness, and an SRE mindset.
Mentor engineers, raise the bar for technical quality, and contribute to a culture of continuous learning, innovation, accountability, and collaboration across a global engineering organisation.

Qualifications

Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related STEM discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including experience delivering enterprise-scale systems in production.
Strong full-stack engineering background, with hands-on experience in modern backend and frontend technologies.
Proven ability to lead technical initiatives, shape ambiguous problem spaces, define execution plans, and deliver outcomes through collaboration with cross-functional partners.
Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals, distributed systems, APIs, data flows, event-driven architecture, and resilient platform design.
Experience applying modern Agile, DevOps, and engineering excellence practices to improve delivery quality, team productivity, and operational outcomes.
Excellent communication, influencing, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

Skills And Experience

Hands on experience with AI enabled SDLC / PDLC practices, including:
Using AI to accelerate design exploration, prototyping, and architectural decision making
Applying AI assisted development, testing, code review, and documentation practices
Embedding AI capabilities into product workflows and platform services responsibly and securely
Frameworks such as Devin / Windsurf, Cursor or GitHub Copilot
Hands-on full stack experience with Java or other modern backend languages, and frontend frameworks such as React or Angular.
Experience designing and operating APIs, microservices, distributed systems, and event-driven architectures at enterprise scale.
Exposure to Generative AI, large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, semantic search, embeddings, knowledge retrieval, or agentic workflow patterns.
Strong focus on software quality, including automated testing, TDD, BDD, code review discipline, observability, resiliency, and production support.
Ability to reason about scalability, reliability, security, cost, maintainability, and delivery velocity when making technical decisions.
Experience working in large, global engineering organisations and collaborating across locations, time zones, product areas, and stakeholder groups.
Ability to build domain context quickly and translate investment, analytics, or compliance workflows into robust product and platform capabilities.

Preferred Experience

Experience in financial services, investment technology, compliance technology, regulatory technology, portfolio management, trading, or enterprise SaaS platforms.
Familiarity with compliance workflows, investment guidelines, rule intelligence, regulatory obligations, or controls-oriented technology.
Experience with cloud-native or hybrid architectures, containerisation, Kubernetes, observability platforms, CI/CD, and modern platform engineering practices.
Experience with AI governance, responsible AI principles, evaluation frameworks, model quality metrics, or monitoring of AI-enabled systems.
Exposure to domain-driven design, micro frontend architectures, platform strategies, or modular product architectures that enable multiple teams to deliver independently and consistently.

Our Benefits

To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of employee benefits including: retirement investment and tools designed to help you in building a sound financial future; access to education reimbursement; comprehensive resources to support your physical health and emotional well-being; family support programs; and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.

Our hybrid work model

BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.

Guidance on AI use for candidates

At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided guidance
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.

About BlackRock

At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.

This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.

To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.

jobs.title: Erfaren .NET-utvecklare till anti-penningtvätt
jobs.description:
Att jobba som .NET-utvecklare

Vill du använda din erfarenhet inom .NET för att utveckla lösningar som spelar en viktig roll i arbetet mot penningtvätt?

Hos oss blir du en del av Team Norrsken i Piteå, ett erfaret och välfungerande team med stort ansvar för verksamhetskritiska lösningar. Här får du möjlighet att påverka tekniska vägval, utvecklas tillsammans med kunniga kollegor och arbeta inom ett område som får allt större betydelse.

Några Anledningar Till Att Välja Rollen

Ett uppdrag med tydligt syfte – du arbetar med lösningar inom bland annat antipenningtvätt och bidrar till utvecklingen av system som möter regulatoriska krav.
Erfarna kollegor nära dig – du blir en del av ett kompetent team med seniora systemutvecklare, teamcoach, systemansvarig, mjukvaruarkitekt och produktägare.
Påverka både lösning och arbetssätt – du får vara delaktig från krav och design till utveckling, test och förvaltning.
Möjlighet att fortsätta utvecklas – på sikt finns möjligheter att bredda dig mot exempelvis arkitektur, Teamcoach, systemansvar eller systemspecialist.
Gemenskap på kontoret i Piteå – teamet värdesätter samarbete, kunskapsutbyte och gemensamt ansvar, samtidigt som det finns möjlighet till ett flexibelt hybridarbete.

Vi är 9 personer i teamet som består av systemutvecklare, Scrum Master/Teamcoach, systemansvarig, mjukvaruarkitekt samt systemspecialist. I teamet verkar även från verksamheten en produktägare (PO).

Vi arbetar agilt med dagliga avstämning. Uppgifter och prioriteringar hanteras i Azure DevOps. Din huvudsakliga arbetsplats är vårt kontor centralt i Piteå. Vi ser ett värde i att arbeta tillsammans på plats, samtidigt som rollen erbjuder möjlighet till hybridarbete.

Tillsammans förvaltar och vidareutvecklar vi system inom bland annat antipenningtvätt, där produkten Actimize är en viktig del. I takt med utökade regulatoriska krav väntar fortsatt design och utveckling av tjänster inom området.

Dina Huvudsakliga Arbetsuppgifter Är Att

utveckla och förvalta IT-lösningar i C#, .NET och .NET Framework
delta i kravarbete och omsätta verksamhetens behov till tekniska lösningar
bidra i designarbete med hänsyn till arkitektur, livscykel och roadmap
arbeta med SQL Server, Stored Procedures, Git och enhetstester
genomföra testaktiviteter och bidra till ökad testautomation
felsöka och lösa incidenter och problem samt analysera bakomliggande orsaker
dokumentera lösningar och bidra till förbättringar av teknik, processer och teamets arbetssätt.

För att lyckas i rollen

Vi söker dig som har flera års erfarenhet från en liknande roll och gedigen erfarenhet av backendutveckling i C#och .NET. Du har även erfarenhet av MS SQL, SQL Server, Stored Procedures, Git, enhetstester och agila arbetssätt. Du kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska i tal och skrift.

Som person är du självgående, analytisk och lösningsorienterad med förmåga att snabbt sätta dig in i teknik och verksamhet, förstå krav och omsätta dem till väl genomtänkta lösningar. Eftersom vi arbetar nära varandra behöver du också vara kommunikativ, dela med dig av kunskap och våga be om hjälp. Du bidrar med ett prestigelöst och positivt förhållningssätt där teamets gemensamma resultat står i fokus.

Det är meriterande med eftergymnasial utbildning inom relevant område samt erfarenhet av testautomation, händelsedrivna system, REST/SOAP, CI/CD, Azure DevOps, Octopus Deploy och felsökning i Splunk eller AppDynamics. Även kunskaper inom TypeScript/JavaScript, React.js och AI-utveckling är meriterande.

Vad händer nu?

Vi jobbar med löpande urval så tveka inte att skicka in din ansökan redan idag. I ansökan kommer vi att ställa ett antal urvalsfrågor som ligger till grund för första urvalet. För att göra rekryteringsprocessen så rättvis och objektiv som möjligt kommer det att ingå intervjuer, tester, bakgrundskontroll samt digital referenstagning.

Om du har frågor kopplat till rekryteringsprocessen, vänligen ta kontakt med madelene.skogh@skandia.se eller rekryterande chef på margit.ronn@skandia.se.

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

Mer om Banken

Vi har varit pionjärer inom digital bankverksamhet sedan starten 1994, som Sveriges första helt digitala bank. Med en passion för innovation och kundfokus har vi vuxit till att erbjuda ett brett utbud av produkter och tjänster inom områdena Låna, Spara och Betala – med särskilt fokus på bolån.

Vår verksamhet är fördelad mellan Stockholm och Linköping. I Stockholm finns majoriteten av vår verksamhet, medan vår kundservice har sitt hjärta i Linköping. Tillsammans är vi cirka 270 medarbetare anställda på banken som varje dag skapar smarta lösningar för våra kunder.

Vårt Erbjudande Inkluderar

Låna: Transparenta och attraktivt prissatta bolån
Spara: Sparande i fonder och aktier samt på sparkonto
Betala: Lönekonto samt smidiga kort- och betalningstjänster.

Vi tror på att människor som utvecklas, presterar och mår bra är nyckeln till framgång. Hos oss är kompetensutveckling och lärande självklara delar av vardagen – framåt tillsammans!

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

About Landmark

Landmark, a Halliburton company, builds the software and data platforms that help the global energy industry make better decisions. Our products span subsurface interpretation, well construction planning, reservoir simulation, production optimization, and digital operations. These are tools used daily by engineers and scientists at the world’s largest energy companies and run as cloud-native SaaS platforms and as enterprise on-premises solutions.

About The Role

You are a senior developer with a designer's eye and in-depth knowledge of computer graphics. You shape 3D engineering applications and digital twins, connecting back-end data processing with real-time rendering and 3D user experience (UX) design. Drawing on extensive experience with professional CAD and 3D software, you use established interaction patterns to make navigation, selection, and manipulation efficient, helping engineers stay oriented in complex models. You work across the full stack with Unity, WebGL, Three.js, Babylon.js, and modern web frameworks, taking solutions from prototypes through to production.

What You Will Do

Own the architecture and technical direction of the 3D component, working closely with product management and domain specialists.
Design and build 3D and extended reality (XR) interactions for inspection, measurement, well planning, and collaboration.
Develop processing pipelines, shaders, and reusable tools. Improve memory use, efficiency, and responsiveness with large datasets.
Prepare and integrate CAD models, geospatial and subsurface data, point clouds, and volumetric datasets for accurate real-time visualization.
Lead design and code reviews, strengthen testing and debugging tools, and maintain the code through successive releases.
Evaluate and integrate AI where it improves engineering workflows, with attention to reliability, privacy, and cost.

Qualifications

Masters’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience
20 or more years of wide-ranging experience across software development, computer graphics, and design
Deep proficiency in Unity and C#, with experience owning and improving a substantial real-time 3D codebase
In-depth knowledge of rendering, shading, geometry, and performance optimization, supported by hands-on 3D production experience
Experience designing and implementing 3D and XR interactions, from user research and prototypes to testing with domain users
Strong aesthetic judgment, including composition, lighting, materials, and visual hierarchy, applied to clear, usable engineering tools
Experience converting and optimizing large CAD and geospatial datasets, including coordinate systems, terrain, and point clouds
Communication skills sharp enough to explain a technical trade-off to a product manager and a design choice to a junior engineer with equal clarity
Practical knowledge of AI tools and model integration, including the capabilities and limitations of hosted and local models

Preferred

Experience with WebGL, Three.js or Babylon.js, TypeScript, and full-stack development with automated delivery using Git and Docker
Experience with CI/CD pipelines, containerization, and infrastructure automation
Familiarity with geospatial coordinate systems and transformations, georeferencing, point clouds, and volumetric data such as voxel grids
Experience with industrial digital twins, subsurface visualization, or collaborative VR tools.
Experience contributing to open-source projects, or integrating open-source components at scale.

How You Work

The senior engineer who succeeds in this role thinks at the level of the system, not only the feature. You work end to end, understanding how back-end data, software architecture, real-time graphics, and user interaction affect one another. You stay hands-on from scoping through implementation and delivery. You explain technical choices clearly to developers, designers, domain experts, Product Management, and leadership, with the detail each needs to make a decision.

You bring the experience to know when a technical decision will cost the team later, the credibility to say so clearly, and the follow-through to drive it toward a better outcome. You are comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and pragmatic enough to ship when the solution is sound, even if it is not perfect. You do not wait for someone to identify what needs fixing. You see it, own it, and drive it to resolution.

You stay technically sharp because you are genuinely curious, and you bring what you learn back to the team. You invest in the people around you because you understand that your long-term contribution depends on the quality of the team, not only the quality of your own code.

Why Landmark

We build small, high-ownership teams and invest in the quality of every person on them. You will work in a business where software is the product, the work you do matters, and the standards are high. Here you have the autonomy to make real technical decisions, peers strong enough to challenge you, and problems deep enough to be worth solving well. We offer competitive compensation including bonus and long-term incentive programs, a strong career path, and a role where your technical judgment shapes what gets built.

Minimum Qualifications: Minimum qualifications may be acquired through technical schools or equivalent related experience. jobs.description:
Software Engineer og Azure udvikler

Har du evnen og interessen for at prøve kræfter med udvikling af komplekse Azure cloud-løsninger? cVation søger erfarne software udviklere til at indgå i vores voksende team, hvor høj faglighed, innovation og udviklerglæde er i højsæde.

cVation er et dansk udviklings- og konsulenthus, som bygger avancerede cloud-løsninger på Azure med afsæt i markedets hurtigste og mest agile metoder. cVation blev stiftet i 2014, har modtaget tre Børsen Gazeller og vundet Microsofts Partner Award for App Innovation tre år i træk. Vi arbejder dedikeret med agile arbejdsmetoder, DevOps og Test Driven Development, og er på forkant med mange af de nye teknologier, herunder IoT. Vi sætter desuden en ære i at levere software af den højeste kvalitet.

Hvilken rolle får du?

Du vil blive en del af et team, der designer og udvikler avancerede cloud-løsninger på Azure. Din rolle bliver bl.a. at rådgive om valg af Azure services, implementere og vedligeholde værktøjer, der sikrer continuous integration og continuous delivery og understøtter applikationsudviklingen. Vi har en meget høj release-frekvens i vores projekter, da brugen af vores egenudviklede tool CADD resulterer i ekstremt agile IT-projekter.

Udviklerne i cVation er samlet i teams på 5-8 udviklere. Du vil have fuldt fokus på et projekt/team af gangen. Ud over de hyppige releases til produktion har vi en ekstrem høj grad af automatisering af alt fra unit tests til integrationstests og UI-tests. Det betyder, at de repetitive processer er fjernet, så der er luft til at tænke innovativt, hvilket kommer vores kunder til gode. Kort sagt får de hurtigere udviklede løsninger af højere kvalitet og med en større forretningsmæssig værdi – og du får mulighed for faglig fordybelse og udvikle dig indenfor de nyeste teknologier.

Hvad forventer vi af dig?

Erfaring med cloud udvikling og særligt PaaS og IaaS services fra Azure, vil være en klar fordel.
Du har en kandidat i softwareudvikling
Du er erfaren i C#, og at du går op i kodekvalitet og at skrive testbar kode
Du har arbejdet med automatisering af test, build og release pipelines samt Infrastructure as code
Du er vant til at arbejde med versionskontrol, gerne Git
Du vil gerne arbejde med de nyeste teknologier i Azure med fokus på PaaS og IaaS
Du vil gerne indgå i et agilt setup, hvor krav og retning hurtigt kan ændres, men hvor medbestemmelse og frihed er i højsædet
Du taler/skriver flydende dansk, og taler/skriver engelsk på et medium/højt niveau.

Som person er du ansvarsbevidst, initiativrig, eksekverende og resultatorienteret. Du gør dig umage med dine opgaver og trives med at løfte i flok som del af et team. Hvis du også er engageret, nysgerrig, drevet af at lære nyt og sætter en ære i at dygtiggøre dig passer du perfekt ind hos os. Du må også gerne gå op i at forbedre både kode, værktøjer samt processer.

Hvad tilbyder vi?

Du kommer til at indgå i vores voksende team, hvor høj faglighed, innovation og arbejdsglæde er i højsæde. Det høje faglige niveau blandt dine kollegaer giver en unik mulighed for at arbejde med de bedste, og vi tager din faglige udvikling alvorligt. Vi har en flad organisation med et minimum af administration, hvor ledelsens døre altid er åbne, og der er god plads til både bordfodbold, fredagsbar, frokost på kajen og et aktivt liv udenfor arbejdstid. Flere gange om året afholder vi hackathons, hvor vi i teams dykker ned i præcis de emner, som udviklerne finder interessante. En del af vores kultur er også, at vi gerne ser alle komme med input til hvordan vi kan optimere, forbedre og udvikle cVation.

Hvorfor vælge os som din nye arbejdsplads?

Vores fundament er løsninger bygget på Microsoft Azure Cloud. Alle vores medarbejdere mestrer cloud-native udvikling og DevOps. Vi arbejder i projekter og engagerer os hands-on i fælles teams med vores kunder for at sikre kvalitet og effektiv videndeling.

Vi er passionerede omkring at hjælpe vores kunder med at få det maksimale ud af cloudteknologien. For os er cloud ikke blot infrastruktur eller et nyt datacenter i skyen. Teknologien giver virksomheder mulighed for at skabe væsentligt mere værdi og arbejde med agilitet og innovation på en helt ny måde.

Vi har været med fra starten, da cloud blev udviklet og tilgængeligt. Vi tilbyder således vores årelange erfaring og dybe cloud ekspertise samt en værktøjskasse med alle vores best practices i form af accelerationsplatformen CADD . Den dækker over gennemprøvede værktøjer, rammeværk, effektive udviklingsmetoder og færdige automatiseringskomponenter. Alt dette for at sikre, at projekter kommer hurtigt og sikkert fra start.

Vi har også etableret et CCoE (Cloud Center of Excellence), som løbende vurderer nye cloud services og opdaterer værktøjskassen med relevante opdateringer. CCoE arbejder tæt sammen med de enkelte udviklingsteams, som har fingeren på pulsen ude på kundeprojekterne.

Vi tilbyder derfor gode muligheder for at udvikle dig. Du vil blive en del af en virksomhed, som tror på, at alle har betydning, og at det skal være sjovt at gå på arbejde hver dag.

Develop and maintain trading systems and tools in close collaboration with traders and business stakeholders
Build and improve full-stack internal applications used across the organisation
Translate business requirements into reliable, scalable technical solutions
Contribute to architecture and technology decisions as the team evolves
Write clean, well-tested code and participate actively in code reviews
Identify opportunities to automate, optimize, and simplify existing workflows
Work across the stack from backend logic to front-end interfaces, depending on where the need is greatest
Take pride in understanding the complexity of the domain you operate within

About You

You are genuinely curious about how energy markets work, and motivated by building software that traders rely on every single day. You thrive when given ownership over your own work, comfortable pushing back when a requirement doesn't hold up, and just as comfortable having your own code challenged in review. What matters most is not a background in trading or energy - it's the strength of your technical skills and your drive to understand the domain you're building for.

What you need to succeed

A background in software development - a few years of experience, or a strong foundation from your degree
Hands-on experience with Python, C#/.NET, or similar, and a willingness to work across the stack
Fluent English, spoken and written - our company language is English
Strong communication skills - comfortable engaging directly with traders and stakeholders, not just working from a ticket queue
Strong analytical skills, with the independence to structure your own workload and figure out what needs solving, not just how

Bonus points if you bring

Experience within trading, finance, or an energy environment
Exposure to data pipelines, APIs, or real-time systems in a business-critical context

Working in MFT Energy

At MFT Energy, we combine a startup mindset with the strength of a global organization. We believe in empowering individuals to make data-driven decisions in a fast-paced environment. We are around 200 employees working out of our headquarters in Aarhus C, and from our international offices in Türkiye, Australia, New York, Singapore, Japan, and several remote colleagues working from all over the world.

You can look forward to

An international and dynamic environment where priorities evolve with the business
Close collaboration with skilled and ambitious colleagues across functions
The opportunity to have a real impact on a growing quantitative and trading setup
Competitive benefits and the opportunity to grow with the company
The chance to one day become partner
A flat organization where responsibility and initiative are valued
A culture where we enjoy celebrating both big and small successes - and luckily, we have many reasons to do so

Make the Most of Your Talent! Join us!

Include your CV and answer the questions in the application form instead of writing a traditional cover letter. Share concrete examples of your experience and competencies - it gives us a much better sense of who you are! Feel free to use AI, just don't let it write for you. We want to get to know the real you.

For questions, please contact career@mft-energy.com.

Deadline: As soon as possible

Start date: 2nd of November

We will be screening and interviewing candidates on an ongoing basis.

MFT Energy does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms. Any resume submitted without a valid, written agreement with MFT Energy will not create any obligations on MFT Energy to pay a placement fee if that candidate is subsequently hired.

As a global and independent energy trading hub, we specialize in power, gas, and environmentals trading 24/7 in 41 countries. At MFT Energy, we innovate energy trading through our people and technology, supported by our unique partner model. Vi tror på att bli bättre tillsammans. jobs.title: Copilot Studio Developer
jobs.location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
We are growing fast and looking for someone who wants to build the agents that put AI to work inside large organisations. Not just prototypes, but production agents that are secure, governed, and built to scale.

About KPMG NewTech

KPMG NewTech works with some of Denmark's largest organisations to put AI to work. Our team sits at the centre of this, operating across two areas that go hand in hand: we design and implement AI solutions and transformations, and we help organisations change how they work through AI adoption.

A big part of what makes us different is our NewPractice methodology, our approach to redefining how organisations build AI-native processes from the ground up. It is not about putting AI onto existing ways of working. It is about rethinking work itself.

We are a team that is motivated by learning, works efficiently and follows through. We are growing quickly, and the people joining will have meaningful influence on where we go.

What You Will Be Doing

You will build agents in Microsoft Copilot Studio and stand up the governance that lets them run safely at enterprise scale. That means designing and shipping agents that solve real business problems, and putting in place the policies, guardrails, and controls that keep them secure and compliant across the client's environment.

You will work directly with clients, from the first design conversation through to a live agent that people actually use. You are equally at home in the build and in the governance model, and you understand that at enterprise scale the two cannot be separated.

A central part of the role is working with AI yourself. We use AI across everything we do: running our projects smarter, developing our methods faster, and showing clients first hand what good adoption looks like. You will use AI tools regularly in your own work and help build a team culture where that is the norm, not the exception.

In practice, that means:

Designing and building agents in Microsoft Copilot Studio, from first prototype to a solution that is ready for production.
Connecting agents to enterprise data and systems through Power Platform, Microsoft Graph, and custom connectors and APIs.
Setting up the governance foundation that lets agents scale safely: environment strategy, policies, access and role models, and data loss prevention.
Defining and enforcing the guardrails that keep agents secure, compliant, and under control across the tenant.
Establishing lifecycle and quality practices so agents stay reliable as they move from pilot to enterprise scale.
Working directly with client teams to turn business needs into agents that are built well and governed properly.
Using AI tools actively in your own work and helping clients and colleagues do the same.
Building the reusable patterns, templates, and standards that make our delivery faster and better.

What We Are Looking For

You probably have 3 to 6 years of experience building on the Microsoft platform, from consulting or a similarly demanding environment. You know how to ship something real, and you focus on doing it in a way that holds up at scale.

More specifically, we look for:

Practical experience building with Microsoft Copilot Studio and the wider Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps, Dataverse).
A solid grasp of how to govern AI agents at enterprise scale: environments, policies, access and role models, data loss prevention, and security.
Familiarity with Microsoft 365 and Azure, and how Copilot fits into the broader Microsoft ecosystem.
Comfortable working with connectors, APIs, and integrating agents with enterprise systems and data.
A structured way of working with a focus on quality: you prioritize doing things right, not just fast.
Good at communicating with both technical and business stakeholders: clear, direct, no fluff.
You use AI tools in your work today and are motivated to push that further.
Genuinely curious about agentic AI and where enterprise works.
Relevant Microsoft certifications are a plus, for example within Power Platform or Azure AI.
Fluency in English and Danish.
A relevant master's degree with good results.
Danish security clearance is highly valuable.

Interested?

Upload your CV, a short cover letter, and grade transcripts via the Apply button. Please note that we do not accept applications by e-mail to ensure GDPR compliance.

We review applications and interview on a rolling basis.

Feel free to contact Jeppe Kristiansen ( jekristiansen@kpmg.com ) or Jeppe Østergaard ( jeoestergaard@kpmg.com ) for any questions. We accept applications and interview candidates continuously and will close the position once we have found the right match.

At KPMG, we are committed to developing diverse talents at all levels. We encourage all interested candidates to apply, regardless of age, race, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, religion, or ethnicity.

We look forward to hearing from you.

Illumina is seeking a highly motivated Full Stack Software Engineer to join the Bioinformatics organization. Our teams develop software that helps scientists organize, analyze, and interpret complex biological data from Illumina’s multi-omics technologies.

Our products combine interactive web applications, large scientific datasets, and long-running computational analyses. Engineers work across new product experiences and established codebases, delivering new capabilities while improving existing systems safely and incrementally.

Collaborate with scientists, product partners, designers, and engineers through design reviews, code reviews, and iterative delivery.

Experience developing data-intensive web applications with complex, interactive user interfaces.
Strong TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS skills, using Angular, React, or a comparable framework.

Experience with REST APIs, service integrations, asynchronous processing, SQL, and relational databases such as PostgreSQL.
Experience with cloud and container technologies, automated testing, CI/CD, and responsible use of AI-assisted development tools.
Demonstrated success delivering high-quality software using Scrum, Kanban, or similar collaborative development practices.

Experience with AWS, object storage, messaging systems, Redis, Docker, Kubernetes, or Helm.

Experience developing genomics, bioinformatics, scientific computing, or multi-omics software.
Experience with releases requiring documented requirements, traceable testing, review evidence, and controlled changes.

Bachelor’s degree or higher in computer science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, with five or more years of professional software development experience.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Product (Remote)
jobs.description:
About Finom

Finom is a European tech startup headquartered in Amsterdam, and we’re on a journey towards revolutionizing the financial landscape for entrepreneurs worldwide. Our mission is to develop an all-in-one financial B2B solution that integrates banking functions, accounting, financial management, and invoicing into a seamless, mobile-first platform.

We recently closed a €115 million Series C equity round
(around $133 million), bringing our total funding to approximately $346 million. This significant investment follows a $105 million growth funding round from General Catalyst, a long-term backer since 2021 known for supporting companies like Airbnb, HubSpot, KAYAK, and Stripe.

Finom's platform goes beyond traditional banking, offering invoicing and a growing suite of features, including AI-enabled accounting, aiming to simplify financial management for entrepreneurs. We're actively expanding our reach across key EU markets like Germany, France, the Netherlands, Italy, and Spain.

At Finom, we’re not just redefining the entrepreneurial experience — we’re empowering our employees to make a real difference. Your work matters, and your impact extends far beyond product metrics. We nurture innovation and an inspiring work environment where bold ideas thrive, prioritizing thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and our business as a whole.

Maintaining our start-up spirit, we prioritize thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and, of course, our business.

We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer
who thinks like a product builder, thrives in a collaborative, cross-functional environment, and is passionate about creating robust, scalable financial infrastructure. You'll be part of a domain team where various engineering crafts (Backend, Frontend, Mobile, ML/AI engineers, and QA) work together to own and evolve a shared product area that delivers real value to hundreds of thousands of businesses across Europe.

About You and What You'll Do:

You're pragmatic, learn quickly, and have a proven track record of shipping products that matter. You communicate clearly across disciplines and genuinely enjoy the dynamics of a cross-functional team where everyone contributes to solving the same customer problems. Above all, you're curious – about the product, the users, the business, and how your technical decisions impact all three.

As a product-minded backend engineer, you don't just implement tickets. You understand the "why" behind what you're building, challenge assumptions when needed, and proactively identify opportunities to create better outcomes. You're comfortable discussing trade-offs with product managers, explaining technical constraints to business stakeholders, and collaborating with frontend and mobile engineers to design elegant end-to-end solutions.

You have deep expertise in .NET and C# with a strong appreciation for maintainable, scalable code, and distributed architectures. But more importantly, you know when to apply that expertise and when simpler solutions serve the product better. You've built data-intensive applications before and understand the concepts of working in a regulated environment.

You take ownership not just of your code, but of the outcomes. You move without being prompted, whether that's jumping into a customer issue, improving team processes, or mentoring colleagues. You're curious about adjacent domains – you might peek at the frontend code, ask questions about the ML models, or dive into analytics to understand how features perform.

Quality is non-negotiable for you. Automated testing, thorough code reviews, and security best practices are fundamental to how you work. You balance technical excellence with pragmatism, always keeping the end user and business goals in mind.

Your experience includes:

At least 5 years of professional backend development with a product engineering mindset
Excellent knowledge of .NET platform and C#
Hands-on experience architecting and evolving distributed systems in production
Proven ability to collaborate effectively with product managers, designers, and engineers from other disciplines
Strong business acumen – you understand how your work connects to company objectives
Clear, concise communication in English across technical and non-technical audiences
A builder's mentality: you care deeply about shipping great products, not just writing great code

Our tech stack

Backend: .NET/C#, PostgreSQL, Redis, RabbitMQ, Kafka, Kubernetes, GCP.
You'll work alongside teams using React (Web), Swift (iOS) / Kotlin (Android), Python/ML frameworks, and modern test automation tools (Playwright, Appium).

Recruitment flow:

Recruiter Interview
First Technical Interview
System Design Interview
Team Fit Interview (peer interview)
Offer

What You Will Get In Return

Make a genuine impact on the product

Join our upward trajectory, and grow with us. We provide the resources and opportunities for continuous personal and professional development, empowering you to make a genuine impact on our evolving product.

Work in the EU

Embark on this exciting journey with us and enjoy the flexibility of traveling and working remotely or in a hybrid model across Europe.

Become a stock options holder

Unlock your inner entrepreneur and align your aspirations with ours through our Stock Options Program. This exciting opportunity is available to every team member, from junior team members to our founders.

Receive unwavering support and care

Finom stands by you at every step, embodying our commitment to your well-being and success reflected in our modern, friendly, and eco-conscious corporate culture. We offer constant support and care to ensure your Finom experience is successful and fulfilling.

Work & Swim program

Immerse yourself in our exclusive Work & Swim Program. Spend one month in a comfortable corporate apartment in enchanting Cyprus. It's the ideal opportunity to strike the perfect work-life balance while enjoying breathtaking Mediterranean views.

Equal Opportunity Statement

At Finom, we're an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We embrace diversity and invite applications from all walks of life. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability status, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

What Makes Cloudbeds Unique

At Cloudbeds, we're not just building software, we’re transforming hospitality. Our intelligently designed platform powers properties across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From independent properties to hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've become the World's Best Hotel PMS Solutions Provider and landed on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again in 2024, but we're just getting started.

Location:

Remote (Europe)

How You'll Make an Impact:

As a Staff Software Engineer
in Revenue Intelligence, you will shape the technical direction of systems that help hospitality businesses understand demand, identify revenue opportunities, and make better pricing and commercial decisions. You will work across customer-facing applications, backend services, data pipelines, analytical stores, recommendation workflows, and cloud infrastructure. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will solve complex engineering problems directly while establishing architecture, improving reliability and security, reducing systemic technical debt, and aligning multiple teams around durable technical decisions. Your impact will extend beyond individual features to the quality, scalability, operability, and long-term evolution of the Revenue Intelligence platform.

Our Revenue Intelligence Team:

Machelen.

act as the primary maintenance engineer for baggage handling applications across international airport sites
diagnose and resolve production incidents including display issues, sorting problems, flight data discrepancies and system performance issues

troubleshoot workflow engines, message broker integrations and sortation logic
integrate systems with airline departure control systems and baggage reconciliation platforms
maintain technical documentation including configuration documents, integration specifications, troubleshooting guides and operational runbooks
document connector behaviour, deployment procedures and redundancy configurations
contribute to knowledge sharing and the internal knowledge base

contribute to software stabilisation initiatives across the application portfolio

contribute to software refactoring activities to improve maintainability and code quality

bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, software engineering, industrial automation or a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience
minimum 3 years of experience in software engineering, systems integration or technical support within an industrial, logistics, transport or 24/7 production environment
experience with baggage handling applications, baggage tracking, sortation and reconciliation systems
solid knowledge of OPC UA, IATA 1745 BSM, SITA messaging, MQTT, AMQP and system integration concepts
strong debugging and root cause analysis skills across application, database, network and protocol layers

organised and comfortable managing activities across multiple sites and projects
collaborative approach with the ability to work independently when required

jobs.description:
Join Liebherr, a global leader in engineering and manufacturing, as we advance our digital transformation journey. We are looking for a motivated
Senior Application Developer Microsoft Dynamics 365 & Azure Integrations (m/f/d)
to support the development and evolution of our global CRM and Field Service platform (OneCRM), based in our IT Shared Service Centre (LSS) in Madrid.
In this role, you will design, develop, and maintain solutions within Microsoft Dynamics 365 (Customer Engagement) and its Azure-based integration landscape. You will contribute to building scalable, high-quality applications and interfaces, ensuring seamless integration with SAP S/4HANA and other enterprise systems. You will work closely with Solution Architects, IT Operations, and business stakeholders, playing a key role in delivering robust and future-ready solutions in a global environment.
This is an excellent opportunity to combine hands-on development, and expertise with team leadership with modern cloud technologies in a large-scale, international transformation program.
The working location for this position will be in Madrid city, where we operate a hybrid model, requiring at least 40% of the working time on-site.
Please note that response times to your application may be longer than usual from 30 July to 14 August, as many of our employees will be out of the office during this period.
Thank you for your understanding.

Creating passion: your responsibilities

Design and develop custom solutions in Microsoft Dynamics 365 (Customer Engagement), including plugins, workflows, and client-side customizations.
Build and maintain Azure-based integrations using services such as Azure Functions, Logic Apps, and Service Bus.
Develop and enhance interfaces between Dynamics 365, SAP S/4HANA, and other enterprise systems, ensuring data consistency and performance.
Contribute to the development of Power Platform solutions (Power Apps, Power Automate) to support business processes.
Participate in solution design and technical discussions, ensuring alignment with architecture and development standards.
Build, lead and coordinate a small development team (approx. 2–5 people), managing workload, priorities, and development backlog.
Collaborate with IT Operations to support incident analysis, troubleshooting, and resolution of technical issues.
Ensure high-quality code through testing, code reviews, and adherence to development best practices.
Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices, supporting automated deployments and efficient delivery processes.
Maintain and update technical documentation, ensuring knowledge sharing and transparency across the team.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams in an international and agile environment.

Contributing your strengths: your qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
5+ years of experience in application development, with strong expertise in Microsoft Dynamics 365 (Customer Engagement) and Azure integrations.
Solid experience in custom development (plugins, workflows, scripts) and integration using Azure services (Functions, Logic Apps, APIs).
Strong understanding of Dataverse, Dynamics 365 architecture, and integration patterns.
Experience developing interfaces between enterprise systems (ideally including SAP environments).
Good knowledge of web technologies (JavaScript, TypeScript, C#, REST APIs, JSON).
Experience with Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate) is a strong advantage.
Familiarity with DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines, ideally using Azure DevOps.
Experience in leading or coordinating a small team, with the ability to guide, motivate, and support team members.
Experience with troubleshooting and resolving technical issues in complex environments. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a structured and quality-focused mindset.
Good communication skills and ability to work effectively with technical and business teams.
Experience working in international and agile environments.
Fluent in English (written and spoken); additional languages (e.g., Spanish or German) are an advantage.
Willingness to travel internationally (up to 15%) as required.

Our commitment to you: your benefits

At Liebherr, we believe people are at the heart of our success. As part of our international team, you’ll enjoy a secure role in a family-owned company that values innovation, collaboration, and long-term career growth:
