Schwarz Digits creates the technological foundation for digital sovereignty in Europe. As the IT and digital division of the Schwarz Group, we develop and manage the IT infrastructures for the retail divisions Lidl and Kaufland, as well as Schwarz Production and PreZero. At the same time, we operate as an independent provider in the external market to support companies across Europe in their digital transformation. We bundle our core services in the areas of Cloud, Cyber Security, Data & AI, Communication, and Workspace.

Join us and contribute to digital sovereignty in Europe. With us, you will work at the intersection of agility and security: You will benefit from fast decision-making processes, enjoy genuine creative freedom in your projects, and be able to build upon the stable foundation of the Schwarz Group.

Your Profile

Platform Engineering" Vision:
Investigates pain points across development teams and delivers solutions that provide real value.
Facilitates "Self-service" capabilities by automating processes and providing flawless documentation.
Translates business needs (support, experimentation, configuration) into scalable, reliable frontend and backend architecture decisions, taking into account the overall impact.
"Developer First" Mindset & Sensitivity to Developer Experience (DevEx):
Understands that their code serves not only the end user, but dozens of developers across other squads. Listens, understands, discusses, and prioritizes the needs of other developers within the context and status of the products.
Designs APIs, boilerplates, and technical solutions focused on reducing friction, abstracting technical complexity, and enabling other teams to be as autonomous as possible.
"Hands-On" Profile & Pragmatism:
Highly practical approach focused on delivering value. Enjoys writing frontend, backend, and infrastructure code, resolving real blockages, and avoiding complex abstractions or unnecessary over-engineering.
Excellent Communication & Evangelization Skills:
Ability to communicate architectural decisions, deliver internal workshops, and write flawless integration guides.
Autonomy & Proactivity:
Ability to detect performance bottlenecks in tooling or developer workflows, proposing and implementing quick wins without requiring micromanagement.

Your Skills

Backend & BFF (Backend-for-Frontend):
Backend Ecosystem: Advanced domain in developing robust and scalable services using .NET Core / C# and Node.js (NestJS / Express).
API Design & Resilience: Design and consumption of REST APIs, applying resilience patterns (circuit breakers, retries, rate limiting).
Modern Frontend & Micro-Frontends (MFE) Architecture:
Core Frameworks: Expert domain in React / TypeScript or Next.js for developing complex, modular, high-performance interfaces.
Module Federation: Hands-on experience with Webpack / Vite Module Federation for runtime dynamic loading of MFEs, managing shared scopes, and error isolation (Error Boundaries).
Authentication & State: Management of OIDC / OAuth2 identity and authentication flows, along with global/context state management.
Containers & Orchestration:
Docker: Demonstrable experience in managing, optimizing images (multi-stage builds), and securing Docker containers.
Kubernetes (K8s): Experience in orchestrating, deploying, and administering applications in K8s clusters (deployments, services, ingresses, configmaps).
CI/CD, GitOps & Quality:
CI Pipelines: Creation and management of Continuous Integration pipelines for build automation, executing unit/integration tests, static code analysis, and pushing images to registries (Harbor).
GitOps & CD: Practical experience in GitOps workflows and Continuous Deployment, with a preference for ArgoCD.
Testing: Experience in automated testing and a shift-left quality culture.
Nice-to-Have:
AI-Assisted Development & Agents: Experience or strong interest in AI-powered development workflows (Gemini, Copilot, Cursor, etc.), as well as integrating or developing AI agents and conversational interfaces to automate development or platform tasks.
Cloud Computing (Multicloud & GCP): Experience in Multicloud environments. Practical knowledge and experience in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) (Cloud Run, GKE, IAM, Secret Manager) or involvement in cross-cloud migration projects from Azure to GCP.
Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Terraform: Knowledge or experience in provisioning and automating cloud resources using Terraform, facilitating the creation of scalable, replicable environments integrated into platform deployment workflows.
Observability: Knowledge of telemetry and traceability standards such as OpenTelemetry, as well as experience implementing and querying observability dashboards in the Grafana Stack (Prometheus/Mimir, Loki, Tempo, K6).
Feature Flags: Management of progressive deployment workflows using Feature Flags (Unleash).
Tooling & Internal Developer Portals: Familiarity with the Backstage ecosystem (creation of Software Templates/Boilerplates and TechDocs).

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. Your role Bring your specialist knowledge and experience to a company managing 50% of the world’s MIPS and play a critical role in our modernization mission. In this role, you’ll design, build and maintain the high-volume business logic that runs on the mainframe. Find and fix: Debug, troubleshoot, and analyze complex system interactions to keep mission-critical applications running. Develop for the Future
Bridge the gap: As an instrumental player in modernization, you’ll extract business logic from legacy systems for migration or integration with cloud-based services.

Who You Are

Required skills and experience

Experience working as a software engineer on complex software projects.
Excellent coding skills and solid development experience (Java, Python, .Net etc.) with debugging and problem-solving skills.
Software development methodologies, with demonstrated experience developing scalable and robust software.
Experienced in relational and NoSQL databases, data mapping, XML/JSON, REST-based web services.
Knowledge of architecture design - Microservices architecture, containers (Docker & k8s), messaging queues.
Deep understanding of OOP and design patterns. Preferred skills and experience
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
Certification in one or more of the hyperscalers (Azure, AWS, and Google GCP) - otherwise, you can obtain certifications with Kyndryl.
Experience with DevOps tools and modern engineering practices.

Being You

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

What You Can Expect

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

The team in addition to developing connectors for FARO will also be responsible to develop templates and APIs for Camunda.

Ezen felül vállalati szintű tesztelési módszertanok kialakítását és üzleti folyamatok automatizációját végezzük. A tesztelési és robotizációs kompetenciánk mellett a nagyvállalati projektmenedzsmentben is kiváló referenciákkal rendelkezünk.

A magyar piacon telekommunikációs, pénzintézeti, biztosítói és energiaipari ügyfeleink mellett nemzetközi projekteken is dolgozunk hazai csapatunkkal.

Csapatunk eredményeit saját belső képzési rendszerünkkel biztosítjuk, a jó kedvet pedig rendszeres munkaidőn belüli- és kívüli csapatépítő programokkal garantáljuk. A kölcsönös rugalmasság és bizalom tesz minket közösséggé, ahol a szakmai fejlődés nem elvárás, hanem kiugrási lehetőség.

Tapasztalt Quality Automation Engineert keresünk Innovation Teamünkbe, aki aktívan hozzájárul új tesztelési és quality engineering megoldások fejlesztéséhez.

A pozíció fókuszában olyan újrahasznosítható megoldások tervezése és fejlesztése áll, amelyek javítják a szoftvertesztelés, a termékminőség és a fejlesztési folyamatok hatékonyságát. A megoldások az adott problémától függően hagyományos szoftverfejlesztést, workflow-automatizációt, alkalmazott AI-t vagy ezek kombinációját is magukban foglalhatják.

Szorosan együtt dolgozol majd az Innovation Leaddel belső és ügyféloldali kihívások feltárásán, ötletek validálásán, valamint prototípusok és pilot megoldások fejlesztésén. A sikeres koncepciókat stabil, dokumentált megoldásokká fejlesztjük tovább, amelyek több projektben is alkalmazhatók.

Az adott kezdeményezéstől függően senior test automation engineerekkel, AI engineerekkel és más technikai szakértőkkel is együtt dolgozol majd.

Visszatérő tesztelési és quality engineering kihívások azonosítása és lehetséges technikai megoldások feltárása.
Tesztautomatizációs frameworkök, eszközök és újrahasznosítható komponensek tervezése és fejlesztése.
Prototípusok készítése új ötletek megvalósíthatóságának és várható értékének felmérésére.
Sikeres koncepciók stabil és mérhető pilot megoldásokká fejlesztése.
Automatizációs megoldások létrehozása hagyományos szoftverekkel, workflow-platformokkal, alkalmazott AI-jal vagy ezek kombinációjával.
Tesztelési, fejlesztési és vállalati rendszerek integrációja API-kon és automatizált workflow-kon keresztül.
Új megoldások integrálása CI/CD pipeline-okba.
Megfelelő quality gate-ek meghatározása, valamint a megbízhatóság, a teszteredmények és a hatékonyság javulásának mérhetővé tétele.
A fejlesztett megoldások karbantarthatóságának, biztonságának és tesztelhetőségének biztosítása, valamint megfelelő dokumentálása.
Új technológiák értékelése és gyakorlati alkalmazási lehetőségeik meghatározása.
Ügyfélprezentációk, technikai workshopok és presales tevékenységek támogatása.
Aktív részvétel új innovációs ötletek értékelésében és fejlesztésében.
Többéves gyakorlati tapasztalat tesztautomatizáció vagy quality engineering területén.
Magabiztos programozási tudás legalább egy széles körben használt nyelven, például Python, TypeScript, Java vagy C#.
Tapasztalat tesztautomatizációs framework tervezésében vagy jelentős továbbfejlesztésében.
Gyakorlati tapasztalat webes vagy API-alapú tesztautomatizációban és stabil teszttervezési ismeretek.
A regressziós tesztelés, a tesztek stabilitásának és karbantarthatóságának ismerete, valamint a különböző tesztszintek megfelelő alkalmazásának képessége.
Gyakorlati API-, Git- és CI/CD-ismeretek.
Szoftverfejlesztői szemlélet a kódstruktúra, automatizált ellenőrzések, hibakeresés és dokumentáció területén.
Gyakorlati tapasztalat LLM-alapú alkalmazással, AI-támogatott megoldással, agent-alapú workflow-val vagy modern workflow-automatizációs platformmal.
Képesség részben definiált problémák feltárására és gyakorlati technikai megoldássá alakítására.
Képesség hatékony munkavégzésre meglévő és újonnan kiválasztott technológiai stackekkel egyaránt.
Nyitottság új technológiák felfedezésére és azok objektív, gyakorlati értékének felmérésére.
Magabiztos magyar és angol nyelvtudás szakmai környezetben.
Webes, API-, mobil-, desktop-, contract- vagy performance testing eszközök és módszerek ismerete.
Workflow-automatizációs platformok, például n8n, Power Automate vagy Copilot Studio ismerete.
LLM API-kra vagy AI-agent alapú megoldásokra épülő alkalmazások fejlesztésében szerzett tapasztalat.
Agentic workflow-k, strukturált outputok, tool calling, RAG, MCP, AI evaluation vagy tracing ismerete.
Teszteredmények elemzése, observability és automatizált quality gate-ek.
Docker, cloud platformok vagy egyszerűbb webes felületek fejlesztésének ismerete.
Tanácsadói, ügyféloldali vagy presales tapasztalat.
Belső képzési és mentorprogramunkkal, valamint heti angol- és németórákkal támogatjuk szakmai fejlődésedet.
Lehetőséged lesz alakítani egy fejlődő innovációs terület technikai irányát, és valós tesztelési és quality engineering kihívásokon dolgozni az első ötletektől egészen a működő pilot megoldásokig.
Tapasztalt test automation és AI szakemberekkel dolgozhatsz együtt, különböző ügyfeleken, folyamatokon és technológiai stackeken. Ahogy az innovációs terület növekszik, úgy a szakmai felelősséged és a döntésekre gyakorolt hatásod is egyre nagyobb lesz.
A szakmai fejlődés mellett egy tudásmegosztó közösség része leszel, ahol számíthatsz a kollégák technikai támogatására, valamint a kölcsönös bizalomra, rugalmasságra és jó hangulatra.
Részt vehetsz túrákon, társasjáték-esteken, családi napokon, síeléseken vagy akár faültetéseken is, és bekapcsolódhatsz a TestIT társadalmi felelősségvállalási programjaiba.
A próbaidő után juttatási csomagot is biztosítunk: havi bruttó 60 000 Ft cafeteria, évi bruttó 600 000 Ft bónusz, valamint privát egészségügyi szűrések és járóbeteg-ellátási szolgáltatások várnak.

jobs.title: Data & Reporting Integration Engineer
jobs.description:
Overview

The Data & Reporting Integration Engineer is responsible for managing all data flows and integrations across systems through the data layer into the Oracle Fusion ERP general ledger, as well as reporting integrations to downstream applications and reporting. The role ensures seamless, secure, and accurate data movement to support financial operations. Additionally, the role plays a key part in enabling reliable, scalable, and high-quality financial reporting by ensuring that data pipelines, transformations, and integrations are aligned with reporting requirements, data governance standards, and audit expectations.

Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain data integration pipelines, including extracting, transforming, and loading data from traditional structured and non structured sources as well as SAS solutions such as Oracle Fusion Cloud
Analyze and document business requirements to ensure technical solutions address stakeholder needs
Collaborate with business users to map current vs. future state processes and identify improvement opportunities, with a focus on data consumption, reporting processes, and output usability
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather integration requirements, map data models, and implement security protocols for ERP integrations
Ensuring data quality, accuracy, completeness, traceability, auditability, reconciliation and control frameworks of data integrations till the downstream systems and reporting layer.
Contribute to data pipeline orchestration, including scheduling, dependency management, and monitoring, troubleshooting and optimizing performance
Ensure data structures and transformations support financial, regulatory compliance and management reporting requirements
Partner with business teams thru requirements gathering, implementation, testing and deployment of reports
Support testing cycles by implementation of automated testing, validating functionality, documenting gaps, and coordinating with technical teams

Required Skills & Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field.
5+ years of hands-on data pipeline development experience in Python or .NET
Expertise with modern application frameworks and paradigms (e.g., .NET/C#, Java, OOD/OOP, functional programming, Spring, J2EE, SOA, DI, architectural patterns)
PowerBI or any other market leading reporting tool to design and implement business reports.
Understanding of microservices and API-based integration patterns
Experience in database design, including relational and dimensional modeling, data warehousing approaches (e.g., star schema).
Experience developing data solutions using cloud services (AWS) and associated tooling (e.g., EC2, ECS, S3, Redshift)
Exposure to event-driven or streaming-based data processing is an advantage
Experience with build and deployment tools (e.g., Visual Studio, Git/Bitbucket, Maven, Jenkins, Nexus, SQL Management Studio)
Strong knowledge of data security, APIs, and data structures
Excellent problem-solving and communication skills
Familiarity with integration frameworks or messaging/streaming technologies is an advantage
Experience working with financial reporting datasets (e.g., GL, subledger, or aggregated reporting layers) is a plus

What we offer

Competitive salary
Comprehensive health package
Cafeteria
All You Can Move
Brand new office at an excellent location
Hybrid working
Opportunities for growth and advancement
A highly people-centric, positive, and supportive work environment

jobs.title: Director - Digital Engineering
jobs.description:
The Director - Digital Engineering will provide technical leadership across Qiddiya's core digital product streams, ensuring that all platforms, services, and digital capabilities are designed and delivered to the highest engineering standards. The role is accountable for ensuring that digital products are built with a reusable, scalable, resilient, reliable, observable, and extensible architecture that can be leveraged across multiple Qiddiya assets. This includes setting the technical direction, challenging low-level engineering decisions, governing solution quality, and ensuring that all delivery outcomes meet the standards defined by Qiddiya Investment Company. The Director - Digital Engineering will work in a multi-vendor delivery environment and will play a critical role in ensuring that vendors, engineering teams, and embedded technical leaders are aligned to Qiddiya's technology strategy, architecture principles, and operating model.

Key Responsibilities:

Technical Leadership & Engineering Governance

Lead the technical oversight of Qiddiya's core digital product streams, ensuring that all solutions are designed and delivered in line with Qiddiya's target architecture, engineering standards, and long-term technology vision
Define and enforce engineering principles around reusability, scalability, resiliency, reliability, observability, maintainability, security, and performance across all digital products and platforms
Ensure that all technical decisions are properly reviewed, challenged, and validated by Qiddiya, with clear ownership and governance over architecture and engineering direction
Act as a senior technical authority capable of engaging at low-level design, architecture, code, integration, infrastructure, and operational decision-making levels
Challenge vendor proposals, solution designs, implementation approaches, and technical trade offs to ensure that Qiddiya retains control over critical engineering decisions

Product Architecture & Reusability

Ensure that digital products are built as reusable capabilities that can be extended and adopted across multiple Qiddiya assets, rather than being designed as isolated one-off implementations
Drive the creation of reusable patterns, components, services, APIs, integration approaches, and engineering guidelines that support product scalability across the Qiddiya ecosystem
Partner closely with architecture, product, delivery, DevSecOps, cloud, and security teams to ensure that product delivery aligns with the overall digital target state

Leadership of Staff Engineers

Lead and manage Staff Software Engineers who will be embedded within product streams and work closely with vendor teams
Set clear expectations for Staff Engineers around technical governance, architecture review, engineering excellence, code quality, observability, resiliency, and vendor challenge
Ensure that Staff Engineers are actively influencing product delivery, reviewing technical decisions, and protecting Qiddiya's long-term technology interests
Build a strong internal engineering capability that reduces dependency on vendors for critical technical decisions and strengthens Qiddiya's ownership of its digital platforms

Requirements

Significant experience in senior engineering leadership roles, ideally within large-scale digital platforms, e-commerce, entertainment, travel, hospitality, fintech, or other high-traffic consumer digital environments
Strong hands-on technical background with the ability to challenge detailed engineering, architecture, integration, infrastructure, and implementation decisions
Proven experience leading engineering teams in a complex multi-vendor or system integrator delivery model
Strong experience governing the delivery of reusable digital platforms, shared services, APIs, and scalable product architectures
Strong understanding of modern software engineering practices, DevSecOps, cloud-native architecture, observability, resiliency, reliability engineering, and secure-by-design delivery
Experience working with executive stakeholders and translating technical risks, trade-offs, and recommendations into clear business and delivery decisions

jobs.title: Senior Expert - Software Engineer (Checkout)
jobs.description:
Qiddiya Digital is seeking highly experienced and hands-on Senior Expert of Software Engineer - Digital Platforms to take technical ownership of critical digital product domains across Qiddiya's ecosystem.

This is a senior individual contributor role with strong technical authority. While the position has no direct line-management responsibility, it will provide technical leadership to vendor engineering teams and remain accountable for the quality, resilience, reliability, security, performance, and operational readiness of the assigned platform.

A key objective is to eliminate black-box delivery, retain critical knowledge within Qiddiya, and ensure Qiddiya remains in full control of its digital platforms.

Key Responsibilities

Take end-to-end technical ownership of the assigned digital domain.
Define and maintain the target architecture, engineering standards, and technical roadmap.
Provide hands-on technical leadership across design, implementation, integration, release, and production operations.
Lead and challenge vendor engineering teams, ensuring compliance with Qiddiya Digital standards.
Review and approve architecture, APIs, data models, integrations, code quality, and major technical decisions.
Validate vendor deliverables using clear acceptance criteria and measurable technical evidence.
Ensure solutions are resilient, reliable, scalable, secure, observable, maintainable, and cost efficient.
Define and monitor technical KPIs, service-level objectives, availability, latency, recovery, and performance targets.
Ensure appropriate automated testing, CI/CD controls, monitoring, logging, tracing, and alerting are in place.
Validate release plans, rollout strategies, rollback procedures, capacity testing, disaster recovery, and production readiness.
Lead technical incident management, root-cause analysis, and permanent remediation.
Identify and manage technical debt, architectural risks, recurring incidents, and operational weaknesses.
Maintain architecture documentation, technical decisions, runbooks, and support procedures.
Drive knowledge transfer and ensure Qiddiya can independently operate and evolve the platform.
Promote reusable capabilities and common engineering practices across Qiddiya's digital assets.

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
Extensive software-engineering experience in a Lead, Staff, Principal Engineer, Technical Lead, or senior architecture role.
Strong hands-on engineering capability and the ability to challenge implementation-level decisions.
Experience designing and operating large-scale, distributed, cloud-native, and highly available platforms.
Experience with customer-facing digital products, commerce, payments, loyalty, identity, ticketing, mobile, or similar platforms.
Strong knowledge of APIs, microservices, event-driven architecture, distributed systems, data consistency, and failure recovery.
Strong experience with resilience, observability, performance engineering, security, automated testing, CI/CD, and production operations.
Experience defining technical KPIs, service-level objectives, non-functional requirements, and acceptance criteria.
Proven experience overseeing vendors, system integrators, or outsourced engineering teams.
Strong incident-management, root-cause-analysis, and problem-management experience.
Strong communication, stakeholder-management, and technical decision-making skills

new_jobs.title: Junior NET Developer
new_jobs.description:
Organisatie

Voor een groeiende organisatie in de buurt van Breda zijn wij op zoek naar een enthousiaste Junior .NET Developer die het development team komt versterken. Dit bedrijf, dat inmiddels al twee decennia actief is, heeft een modern kantoor in de regio Breda en een kleinschalige vestiging in Zuid-Afrika.

Je komt terecht in een levendige en dynamische werkomgeving, verdeeld over twee kernteams: consultancy en development. Waar het consultancyteam zich richt op ERP-oplossingen en Power BI, ligt jouw focus als developer op het ontwikkelen en optimaliseren van bedrijfsapplicaties. Denk hierbij aan ERP-modules, integraties met externe systemen, standalone software en nieuwe productontwikkeling. Ook hebben ze een aantal eigen producten waar aan gewerkt wordt.

De klantenportefeuille is internationaal georiënteerd, met ongeveer de helft van de klanten in Nederland en Europa, en de andere helft actief in Afrika. Binnen het team heerst een informele sfeer, waarin collega’s elkaar aanmoedigen en inspireren om continu het beste uit zichzelf en hun werk te halen.

Functie

Als junior .NET Developer maak je deel uit van een team van 18 developers. Binnen het team is er volop senioriteit aanwezig, zodat je kunt rekenen op goede begeleiding en ondersteuning. Je start met het leren kennen van de softwarepakketten en processen, zodat je een stevige basis hebt om mee aan de slag te gaan. Vervolgens ga je actief bijdragen aan het programmeren, onderhouden en testen van de software.

Daarnaast krijg je de ruimte om onderzoek te doen naar nieuwe technische mogelijkheden en kijk je hoe deze te implementeren zijn binnen de bestaande systemen. Het werk vindt plaats op projectbasis en afhankelijk van het project start je de dag al dan niet met een dagelijkse stand-up.

De werkzaamheden zijn evenwichtig verdeeld: 50% bestaat uit maatwerk voor klanten, de andere 50% richt zich op de doorontwikkeling van interne producten.

In jouw rol als fullstack developer werk je met C# .NET/.NET Core aan de backend en met Angular aan de frontend. Ook zijn er veel initiatieven op het gebied van cloudoplossingen, waar je actief bij betrokken zult zijn.

Binnen het team is goede interne communicatie van groot belang. Er heerst een open en informele sfeer, waarin samenwerken centraal staat. Vrijdagmiddagborrels zijn hier de norm en ook buiten werktijd spreken collega’s elkaar regelmatig. Je komt dus terecht in een hecht en gezellig team waar naast hard werken ook ruimte is voor plezier.

Functie-eisen

– Minimaal HBO/WO diploma

– Ervaring/kennis met C#, .NET en bijvoorbeeld Angular

– Een proactieve houding en het vermogen om snel te leren en nieuwe concepten te begrijpen

Aanbod

– Salarisrange €2.800,- tot €3.500,- bruto o.b.v. 40 uur afhankelijk van je ervaring

– 8% vakantiegeld

– 25 vakantiedagen

– Reiskostenvergoeding

– Pensioenregeling

– Trainingsbudget afhankelijk van je behoefte

– Laptop van de zaak

– Elke vrijdag een vrijmibo

Jij bent allround en levert een grote bijdrage aan de ontwikkeling van nieuwe applicaties binnen één van de software development teams in Joure. Je werkt aan producten die ertoe doen!

Comecer Netherlands BV in Joure ontwikkelt, produceert en verkoopt een breed scala innovatieve soft- en hardware producten die wereldwijd worden gebruikt in honderden ziekenhuizen met nucleaire geneeskunde en de (radio)farmaceutische industrie. Comecer Netherlands BV is onderdeel van de Comecer Group en is een bedrijf binnen ATS Corporation.

Als .NET Software Engineer werk je in een SCRUM team aan een nieuw software platform gebaseerd op state-of-the-art technologie. Onze software draait op Windows of Linux en is ontwikkeld in C#, TypeScript en React. Het platform en de applicaties zijn ontworpen om zowel on-premises als in de Cloud te draaien.

Stap voor stap vernieuwen wij onze huidige applicaties naar het nieuwe platform. Bij “applicaties” kun je denken aan software die de complete patiënt/behandel planning regelt in een ziekenhuis voor de nucleaire geneeskunde (planning van PET of SPECT-scan, therapie, van voorbereiding tot injectie). Om de kans op fouten te verminderen en de het de gebruiker makkelijker te maken, heeft de software vele interfaces met ziekenhuis systemen en aangesloten apparatuur van zowel Comecer als derden.

Wat ga je doen?

Je ontwikkelt nieuwe en verbetert bestaande applicaties op basis van technisch en functioneel ontwerp en de product backlog. Je werkt nauw samen met jouw directe collega’s zoals de andere Software Ontwikkelaars, Testers, Software Architect, Functioneel Ontwerper en Product Owners. Je draagt bij aan alle aspecten van software engineering (niet alleen softwareontwikkeling maar ook requirements engineering, functioneel ontwerp, verificatie en validatiestrategie, etc.). Je bouwt snel domeinkennis op over onze producten/ toepassingen en helpt zo nu en dan derdelijns ondersteuning aan onze klanten.

Als senior developer ga je ook een belangrijke bijdrage leveren in het opzetten of optimaliseren van onze development toolchain standaardisatie van ons ontwikkelproces. Je begeleid zowel interne als externe ontwikkelteams in het toepassen van de onze architectuur en gebruik van de juiste tooling.

Dit zoeken wij in jou

Je bent proactief en signaleert tijdig verbeteringen of problemen en draagt bij aan de oplossing hiervan. Je hebt ervaring met technische software documentatie (en eventueel kennis van de IEC 62304 standaard voor het ontwikkelen van medische software).

Je bent een teamspeler en je bent in staat snel en resultaatgericht te werken op basis van Scrum in een zeer dynamische omgeving.

Daarbij Beschik Je Over

Bachelor of Master in software engineering, of ervaring op gelijkwaardig niveau;
goede communicatieve en schriftelijke vaardigheden in het Engels en Nederlands;
ruime ervaring met C#, ASP.NET Core, JavaScript/TypeScript, React (of Angular, Vue, Svelte);
SQL, Docker, Visual Studio en databasesystemen is een pré;
kennis en ervaring van Azure Cloud Services en Azure DevOps is een pré;
ervaring bijvoorbeeld GMP, gezondheidszorg, Medical Devices is een pré.

Dit bieden wij jou

informele werksfeer in een platte structuur, een gedreven team en veel betrokken collega’s;
een marktconform salaris;
pensioenregeling volgens de CAO Metaal & Techniek;
25 vrije dagen, 5 ADV dagen en de mogelijkheid om vrije dagen bij te kopen;
voldoende mogelijkheid om je te blijven ontwikkelen door het volgen van cursussen en trainingen.

Als AI Software Engineer
bij Nmbrs Reporting (voorheen Visionplanner) geef je de toekomst van het Nmbrs Reporting cloud platform vorm voor een grote, enthousiaste groep accountants, administratiekantoren en ondernemers die complexe taken uitvoeren. Met jouw expertise in .NET-development en AI-integratie zorg je voor ijzersterke code en een fantastische gebruikerservaring. Samen met een levendig team van 130 toegewijde collega's bij Nmbrs Reporting (onderdeel van Visma) werk je aan het ontwikkelen van revolutionaire cloudsoftware. Daarbij kijk je verder dan wat er vandaag moet gebeuren en zoek je naar mogelijkheden om het voortouw te nemen in het gebruik van AI binnen ons development-proces en ons team mee te nemen in de razendsnelle AI-revolutie.

Time to grow. Time to thrive.

Wij zijn Nmbrs. We maken slimme business software die onnodige complexiteit wegneemt voor mkb-ondernemers en de professionals die hen ondersteunen. Nmbrs brengt vier gevestigde productorganisaties samen—Payroll, Accounting, Invoicing en Reporting—met teams in Nederland, Zweden en Portugal.
We zijn één merk met een gezamenlijke ambitie, terwijl we blijven werken vanuit de expertise en kracht van onze eigen organisaties. We bundelen onze krachten waar dat logisch is en houden teams, expertise en besluitvorming dicht bij elkaar.
Voor deze functie ga je werken bij Nmbrs Reporting (voorheen Visionplanner) in Veenendaal. Je werkt nauw samen met je directe collega’s op deze locatie en bent tegelijkertijd onderdeel van de bredere Nmbrs-organisatie.

Bij ons werk je aan een geavanceerde Single Page Application (SPA) met React, ondersteund door een back-end in C# en ASP.NET Core, draaiend op Microsoft Azure. We werken Agile met wekelijkse releases en nemen kwaliteit heel serieus. Net zoals we je persoonlijke ontwikkeling serieus nemen.

Je past jouw diepgaande kennis van AI-tools en technieken pragmatisch toe als skill om efficiënter code te schrijven, complexe problemen te analyseren en de kwaliteit van je werk te verhogen.

Bijdragen aan het technische ontwerp wanneer nodig.

Je communiceert helder en hebt een goed gevoel voor humor.
Beheersing van zowel de Nederlandse als Engelse taal.

Gezellige borrels om successen te vieren met ons team, plus een ontspanningsruimte met onder andere games om even te ontspannen met je collega's.
Hybride werken, waarbij je zowel thuis als op kantoor kan werken.

Als Junior Software Developer R&D bij Aangetekend werk je niet alleen aan bestaande software, maar juist ook aan de ontwikkeling en technische vernieuwing van een LegalTech-platform dat dagelijks door organisaties in verschillende sectoren wordt gebruikt. Je krijgt de ruimte om nieuwe technologieën te onderzoeken, oplossingen te ontwikkelen en jezelf onder begeleiding van ervaren developers verder te ontwikkelen.

Bedrijfsprofiel

Aangetekend B.V. is een Nederlandse LegalTech-softwareorganisatie die technologie ontwikkelt voor veilige, aantoonbare en juridisch rechtsgeldige digitale communicatie. De software wordt volledig in Nederland ontwikkeld en draait op infrastructuur en servers in Nederland.
Met oplossingen voor onder andere Aangetekend Mailen, Beveiligd Mailen en Digitaal Ondertekenen helpt Aangetekend organisaties om belangrijke digitale communicatie veilig en aantoonbaar te laten verlopen. De software wordt dagelijks gebruikt door banken, verzekeraars, advocatenkantoren, overheden, zorginstellingen en andere organisaties waar betrouwbaarheid, security en juridische zekerheid essentieel zijn.
Als erkend Trust Service Provider levert Aangetekend Europees gekwalificeerde diensten. Technologie, wetgeving en security komen hierdoor continu samen binnen de softwareontwikkeling. Tegelijkertijd is Aangetekend een groeiende softwareorganisatie met een professionele, nuchtere cultuur, korte lijnen en veel ruimte voor technische ontwikkeling en nieuwe ideeën.

Functieomschrijving

Als Junior Software Developer R&D word je onderdeel van het multidisciplinaire techteam van Aangetekend met backend developers, frontend developers, system engineers, productmanagement en architectuur.
Je werkt binnen Research & Development aan de verdere ontwikkeling en vernieuwing van het platform. Daarbij gaat het niet alleen om het bouwen van functionaliteiten. Je onderzoekt samen met collega's hoe nieuwe technologieën en technische oplossingen kunnen worden toegepast en vertaalt ideeën naar software die uiteindelijk onderdeel kan worden van het platform.
Je hebt al professionele ervaring als developer en kunt daardoor vanaf het begin daadwerkelijk bijdragen. Tegelijkertijd hoef je nog niet alles te kunnen. Ervaren collega's helpen je om complexere technische vraagstukken op te pakken en steeds meer verantwoordelijkheid te nemen.

Werken met Java aan de backend en React aan de frontend
Nieuwe technische mogelijkheden onderzoeken en vertalen naar werkende oplossingen
Prototypes en proof of concepts ontwikkelen en deze waar mogelijk doorontwikkelen naar productiesoftware
Meewerken aan bestaande én nieuwe onderdelen van het LegalTech-platform
Backendservices, API's en moderne frontendcomponenten ontwikkelen
Software testen en valideren om kwaliteit, betrouwbaarheid en veiligheid te bewaken
Leren werken binnen een omgeving waarin bestaande en moderne softwarearchitectuur samenkomen
Kennis opbouwen rondom security, privacy, compliance en Europese regelgeving
Samen met ervaren developers nadenken over architectuur en technische verbeteringen
Code reviews uitvoeren en feedback krijgen op je eigen werk
Stap voor stap meer verantwoordelijkheid krijgen binnen R&D en het ontwikkelproces

Gevraagd wordt

We zoeken een developer die de basis inmiddels in de praktijk heeft geleerd en nu graag de volgende stap wil zetten. Je hoeft nog geen specialist te zijn. Veel belangrijker is dat je nieuwsgierig bent naar technologie, graag onderzoekt hoe iets beter of slimmer kan en vervolgens ook zelf de software wilt bouwen.
Daarnaast beschik je over:
Enige professionele werkervaring als Software Developer

Basiskennis van het ontwikkelen van webapplicaties en API's
Ervaring met frontendontwikkeling, bijvoorbeeld met React, Angular of Vue, is mooi meegenomen
De ambitie om jezelf zowel aan de backend als frontend verder te ontwikkelen

Beschikbaarheid van 32 tot 40 uur per week en de wens om hybride te werken

Je komt terecht in het technische hart van de organisatie, waar je kunt leren van ervaren developers en tegelijkertijd vanaf het begin aan echte software en R&D-vraagstukken werkt. new_jobs.description:
Solution Architect Private Cloud & Managed Services

Ben jij een Solution Architect met ervaring in Private Cloud, managed services en outsourcing? Wil je werken aan veilige, schaalbare infrastructuren voor bedrijf kritische applicaties van enterprise‑organisaties? Dan hebben wij een mooie uitdaging voor jou!

Dit ga je doen

Als Solution Architect ontwerp je veilige en toekomstbestendige IT‑architecturen voor klanten die hun bedrijf kritische applicaties bij Solvinity hosten. Je werkt nauw samen met New Business, Accountmanagement en Solution Consultants en speelt een belangrijke rol in het vertalen van klantbehoeften naar concrete technische oplossingen.
Je ontwerpt, implementeert en optimaliseert oplossingen op het gebied van Private Cloud‑infrastructuur (storage, Compute, networking en virtualisatie), managed services (Linux, Windows, middleware, databases, monitoring en managementtooling), enterprise applicatie‑infrastructuren, CI/CD‑platformen, Kubernetes‑omgevingen, webplatformen en publieke cloud‑diensten zoals Microsoft Azure.

De architectuurcontext waarin je werkt

Security‑by‑design staat centraal in jouw architecturen. Je ontwerpt oplossingen waarbij informatiebeveiliging, risicospreiding en weerbaarheid vanaf het eerste ontwerp leidend zijn. Denk aan zero‑trust‑principes, strikte netwerksegmentatie, logging & monitoring en aantoonbare beheersmaatregelen.
Je werkt binnen omgevingen met complexe besluitvorming, formele kaders en changeprocessen. Adviezen zijn onderbouwd, navolgbaar en gericht op continuïteit van dienstverlening, ook onder politieke of maatschappelijke druk.
Daarnaast is zorgvuldigheid in dataverwerking en data soevereiniteit essentieel. Als architect kun je expliciet verantwoorden waar data staat, wie toegang heeft en hoe de inrichting voldoet aan compliance‑eisen. Cloudkeuzes, tenantconstructies en beheerafspraken worden gemaakt vanuit controle, eigenaarschap en transparantie. Je ontwerpen zijn niet alleen technisch correct, maar ook juridisch en bestuurlijk verdedigbaar.

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het

• Vertalen van klantbehoeften naar een passende, schaalbare en veilige architectuur.
• Ontwerpen van Private Cloud‑ en hybride cloudoplossingen.
• Proactief signaleren van verbeteringen binnen infrastructuur en managed services.
• Adviseren van klanten over managed services, outsourcing en Cloud strategieën.
• Adviseren over security, servicemanagement, transitieaanpakken en bedrijfscontinuïteit.
• Calculeren en beantwoorden van complexe aanbestedingen en offerteaanvragen samen met Customer Relations.
• Deelnemen aan bidteams en schrijven voor strategische deals en aanbestedingen.
• Communiceren van architectuurkeuzes en oplossingen op zowel technisch als managementniveau.

De afdeling

Het Architecten‑team maakt onderdeel uit van de afdeling Projects & Architecture die continu aan het verbeteren van services en is verantwoordelijk voor de implementatie, vernieuwing en het beheer van hosting‑ en high‑performance‑computingoplossingen van Solvinity.
Het team bestaat momenteel uit 17 architecten die werken voor één of meerdere klantenteams.

Dit krijg je

• €6.539 – €8.500 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur (exclusief vakantiegeld), afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring.
• Uitdagend werk in een professionele omgeving waar samenwerking en kennisdeling centraal staan.
• Ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling via opleidingen, certificeringen en trainingen.
• Een cultuur die innovatie, samenwerking en continue verbetering stimuleert.
• Een werkweek van 32 tot 40 uur.
• 80% pensioenbijdrage door de werkgever.
• 26 vakantiedagen met de mogelijkheid tot uitbreiding.
• Een vitaliteitsregeling waarbij we tot €300 per jaar jouw sportactiviteiten financieren.
• Mobiliteitsvergoeding of leaseauto.
• Hybride werken: deels op kantoor, bij de klant en deels vanuit huis.

Dit ben jij

Minimaal 7 jaar ervaring als Solution Architect binnen Private Cloud omgevingen. Recente ervaring binnen enterprise organisaties.
Aanbestedingen en bidtrajecten.
Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal goed, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.
Ervaring met het adviseren van klanten over Private Cloud en containerplatforms zoals Kubernetes.
Kennis van wet- en regelgeving zoals AVG, BIO, NIS2, ARBIT, verwerkersovereenkomsten en auditkaders.
Kennis van VMware (ESXi, vCloud, NSX‑T), compute‑platformen en VDI / VMware Horizon.

Hoe bereik je ons?

Passen we bij elkaar? Wil je ons daarvan overtuigen? Reageer dan via de sollicitatiebutton of mail met Cynthia, onze Recruiter via recruitment@solvinity.com .

Over Solvinity

Solvinity levert Mission Critical dienstverlening aan vitale onderdelen van de Nederlandse Maatschappij. Hiermee ondersteunt het bedrijf de (rijks-)overheid, gemeenten en toonaangevende organisaties in de financiële en zakelijke dienstverlening, zoals het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid en Binnenlandse Zaken, Politie Nederland, Gemeente Amsterdam, Translink (OVPay), ING en Klaverblad. Solvinity ontwerpt, bouwt en beheert de complexe platformen waarop bedrijfskritische applicaties veilig en optimaal functioneren. Daarnaast levert het bedrijf CI/CD, containertechnologie en ‘Stretched’ DevSecOps oplossingen voor softwareontwikkelaars.

Solvinity onderscheidt zich op het gebied van cybersecurity met een uitgebreid portfolio aan securitydiensten en -oplossingen en biedt, met een meerderheidsbelang in Securify ( www.securify.nl ), aanvullende cybersecurity diensten. Daarnaast heeft het bedrijf certificeringen volgens (inter)nationale normen als ISO 27001, ISO 14001, ISO 9001, PCI DSS en heeft het als eerste MSP in Nederland SOC 1 en 2 compliance rapporten voor de gehele beheeromgeving van de private én Azure cloud. Solvinity behaalde in 2025 een jaaromzet van 73 miljoen euro met 300 medewerkers. Kijk voor meer informatie op www.solvinity.nl en linkedIn .

new_jobs.title: Software Engineer - Fintech (L1)
new_jobs.description:
We are hiring an early-career Software Engineer for the Techuity team in our Amsterdam hub.

Full-time · Hybrid · Amsterdam · €45,000-€60,000 per year + Stock Options

About Katanox

Katanox is building the infrastructure layer for hospitality: software that connects hotels and travel buyers and moves money between them. Our platform brings distribution and payments into one workflow (contracting, connectivity, reconciliation, and settlement), so partners can operate with less fragmentation and fewer manual handoffs.

For engineers, this means building reliable systems that handle complex B2B workflows and real financial constraints, with a focus on data integrity, auditability, security, and operational excellence. We're headquartered in Amsterdam with hubs in London and New York.

About the role

You'll join the Techuity team, which owns the finance domain at Katanox: the systems that work out who gets paid what, move the money, and prove afterward that it was done correctly. Every reservation on the platform becomes a set of accounting entries, a fee, a payout to a hotel, and a record an auditor or a regulator can check. Our accounting, billing, payment, and KYC services are what make that happen.

Money code is unforgiving in a way most software is not. A rounding error or an event processed twice is not a cosmetic bug, it is someone's money in the wrong place, and the fix has to be traceable. That constraint is also what makes the domain a good place to learn: you get fast, honest feedback on whether your code is correct.

This is an L1 role. We expect you to arrive with solid fundamentals and real curiosity, not years of production experience. You will pair with senior engineers, own small pieces end-to-end from your first weeks, and grow into owning a service yourself.

What you will work on

Build and extend our Kotlin finance services: accounting entries, fee and invoice calculation, payouts, and the KYC checks that verify the companies we pay, with tests and code review.
Work on event-driven flows where a reservation turns into a payment, an accounting journal, and an invoice as events pass between services, and every step has to be repeatable and correct.
Ship features to the internal back office our finance and compliance colleagues use daily to review KYC cases and check the books.
Own your services in production: when a payout does not land, or a journal does not balance, you trace the event, fix the cause, and add the check that catches it next time.

What you will grow into

Owning one of the finance services end to end, from design to rollout.
The harder correctness problems: idempotency, reconciliation, and audit trails that still hold up years after the fact.
Weighing in on architecture decisions with the senior engineers you pair with.

What we are looking for

Around zero to two years of professional experience, or a strong internship and side-project record. A degree is welcome but not required.
Solid fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, testing, and enough system design to reason about a service boundary.
Working knowledge of Kotlin or Java, or another typed language and a clear interest in Kotlin.
Care for correctness and detail. You would rather write the test that proves the totals balance than assume they do.
Curiosity about how money actually moves. No finance background needed, we will teach you double-entry accounting, payouts, and what KYC is for.
Fluent in English, and based in or around Amsterdam.

How we work

A cornerstone of our culture is in-person collaboration. We follow a "hub" model with unique hubs in Amsterdam, London, and New York, where we regularly collaborate face-to-face, onboard customers and colleagues, hold design sessions, and host events.

We do not hire for strictly remote roles. We expect people to spend meaningful time in our hubs because this is how we maintain our culture, build trust, and move quickly together.
We're also a financially regulated
company. That means high standards for security, auditability, and decision-making. This means your work ships with the rigor and reliability you'd expect from systems that move real money.

Our values

At Katanox, our values are the blueprint for how we work together and build our product.
Team over the individual, no ego
: We prioritize the success of the whole team over individual agendas. We win together, share credit, and leave egos at the door.
Data beats excitement
: We welcome bold ideas, but we commit based on evidence. We use data, experimentation, and clear hypotheses to decide what to build.
Dare to do
: We are proactive, take smart risks, and move from talking to doing. We learn by shipping and improve through iteration.
See it, own it, and close it
: When we spot a problem or opportunity, we take responsibility to drive it to completion instead of assuming someone else will.
We apply radical candor
: We care personally and challenge directly. We give and receive honest feedback so we can grow faster as individuals and as a team.
In person first, call second
: We prioritize in-person collaboration in our hubs to build trust, move quickly, and solve hard problems together.
Build collaboratively
: We actively involve the right people, share context early, and co-create solutions across teams and disciplines.
Iterate fast and pragmatically
: We ship small, learn quickly, and avoid over-engineering. We focus on solutions that work in reality, not just in theory.

Interview process

Introductory call
Live Technical Assessment
System Design
Meeting with the CEO
Offer

new_jobs.title: Software Engineer (m/f/d)
new_jobs.description:
Your mission

NanoTemper makes software that runs scientific measurement instruments — used by researchers and biopharma teams to make faster, more confident decisions. The software matters: it sits between precise hardware and the scientists trying to understand complex biology.

You're Role

You will own product features end-to-end: from understanding the requirement, through implementation and testing, to release and maintenance. The current product landscape includes C#/.NET, TypeScript, React, and Python. C#/.NET is an important part of the existing software, while our technology choices continue to evolve with the needs of our products.

You May Work Across Several Types Of Software, Including

Control and analysis software for scientific instruments.
Instrument backends that support measurement workflows and interact with the devices.
Web application components that help users access and work with instrument data.

You will maintain, develop, and take ownership of software in these areas, depending on the product and your experience. You will also work at the boundary between software and hardware — collaborating with embedded engineers where the application talks directly to measurement instruments.

This is a product engineering role. You will be writing code, reviewing it, fixing things that break in production, and improving the pipelines that ship the product.

Your expertise

Required Qualifications

Proven track record using C# and .NET
Experience with Git
Professional experience shipping and maintaining production software, including ownership of software throughout its lifecycle
Experience with build pipelines and release processes
In-depth experience in automated testing

Preferred Qualifications

Proficiency in TypeScript and React
Familiarity with WPF
Working knowledge of Python
Hands-on involvement in hardware or instrument integration
A track record of developing software that interfaces with hardware or measurement devices
Background in scientific, laboratory, or instrumentation software

Why us?

Who are you joining?

A team of 8 engineers and 1 product owner. The team has strong engineering foundations and doesn't need to relitigate architecture every sprint — you will find colleagues who want to ship good software and value a teammate who does the same. When we tackle something new, the architecture conversation is open to everyone.

You will work closely with scientists, hardware engineers, and product managers, which means translating between technical and non-technical perspectives is a regular part of the job.

We work in the heart of Munich with excellent public transportation access. We work in a flexible hybrid model. We value regular in-person collaboration, while offering the flexibility to work remotely when it makes sense.

About Us

Our vision at NanoTemper is to help create a world where every disease is treatable. What drives us is partnering with scientists to ‘make a difference’ in the world.

With our biophysical instruments we want to push the limits of what is possible for scientific researchers.

The goals are big and audacious. Hence, it requires very innovative ways and a strong team to get there.

Even if we are an expanding global company with more than 200 employees the heart of NanoTemper beats in Munich. This is where our story began and every day we work as one team to make our devices even better.

Our doors are open for talented people excited about the future of scientific research and our vision.

Do you want to make a difference with your daily work and become part of our mission? We are looking forward to get to know you.

But why not let your new colleagues tell you personally what it's like to be part of NanoTemper?

Wir gehören zu den Top-Adressen in der IT-Welt und fokussieren uns auf die Optimierung der Kerngeschäfts­prozesse unserer Kunden. Durch den smarten Einsatz maßgeschneiderter IT-Lösungen unterstützen wir unsere Kunden dabei, das Beste aus ihrem Business und aktuellen Technologien herauszuholen. Unseren Erfolg aber erreichen wir nur durch eins: die Menschen bei adesso! Sie bringen Ideen, fachliches Know how und Technologien zusammen. Gemeinsam programmieren wir (deine) Zukunft bei adesso.

DEINE ROLLE

Architectural Leadership: Du entwirfst zukunftssichere Softwarearchitekturen im .NET-Umfeld und trägst Verantwortung für deren Umsetzung in komplexen Projekten.
Klassische & moderne Welten: Du bewegst dich sicher sowohl in klassischen Enterprise-Architekturen (z. B. Monolithen, Client-Server-Systeme, On-Prem) als auch in modernen cloud-nativen Szenarien (Microservices, Container, Event-Driven).
Tech Strategy & Guidance: Du definierst Architektur- und Technologie-Standards (Cloud-native, API-First, Security by Design, Domain-Driven Design) und unterstützt Teams bei der Umsetzung.
Consulting & Collaboration: Du arbeitest eng mit Kunden, Fachbereichen und Entwicklungsteams zusammen – von der Anforderungsanalyse über die Architektur bis zur produktiven Einführung.
Innovation Driver: Du bringst Trends wie AI-Integration, Serverless, Observability, Zero-Trust-Security und DevSecOps aktiv in die Projekte ein.

DEIN PROFIL

Background: Abgeschlossenes Studium der (Wirtschafts-)Informatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
Architektur-Erfahrung: Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Design und in der Dokumentation komplexer Software-Architekturen, sowohl im klassischen On-Prem-Umfeld als auch in der Cloud.
Engineering Skills: Sehr gute Kenntnisse in moderner Softwareentwicklung mit .NET Core, C#, Cloud-Services (Azure/AWS/GCP), Container-Orchestrierung (Kubernetes) und IaC (Terraform, Bicep) sowie Erfahrung mit der Modernisierung bestehender Systeme zu Microservices, Cloud & SaaS.
Strategie & Delivery: Know-how in Anforderungsanalyse, Betriebskonzepten, Security-Architekturen und in der Transformation von Legacy-Systemen zu skalierbaren Plattformen.
Kommunikation & Leadership: Du bist sicher in der Moderation von Architektur-Workshops, agierst als Schnittstelle zwischen Business und Tech und coachst Entwicklerteams.
KI Kompetenz: Du verfügst über vertiefte KI-Expertise, gestaltest deren verantwortungsvollen Einsatz in deinem Verantwortungsbereich aktiv mit und fungierst als Enabler für Kunden sowie intern bei adesso.
Sprachen: Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Unser Versprechen: Du wirst dich bei uns wohlfühlen! Kollegial, familiär und auf Augenhöhe – wir leben Austausch, Teamgeist und einen respektvollen Umgang miteinander. Diversität und verschiedene Blickwinkel werden bei uns genauso geschätzt wie du als Mensch. Das und viel mehr steht für unser ganz besonderes Wir-Gefühl. Für das es sogar ein Wort gibt: adessi.

Unsere Kultur und das Zusammenarbeiten sind geprägt von gegenseitiger Wertschätzung, Anerkennung und Unterstützung. Das verbindet uns hierarchieübergreifend – auch im Home-Office. So belegen wir zum wiederholten Mal den 1. Platz beim Wettbewerb „Deutschlands Beste Arbeitgeber in der ITK“!. Unser umfangreiches Trainingsangebot und ein transparentes Laufbahnstufenmodell für alle sorgen dafür, dass deine Entwicklung bei uns nicht stillsteht. Denn gemeinsam zu wachsen und Chancengeber zu sein, das ist programmiert in unserer DNA.

new_jobs.description:
Dürkopp Fördertechnik GmbH
Bielefeld
Gronau
Vollzeit

Werde Teil des DFT-Teams!

DFT ist ein Bielefelder Unternehmen mit ca. 550+ Mitarbeitern, gegründet 1954. Der Maschinenbauer gehört seit 2010 zur österreichischen KNAPP AG mit Sitz in Graz, Steiermark. DFT entwickelt, produziert und liefert Sortier- und Sequenzieranlagen zur effizienten Bearbeitung von eCommerce-Aufträgen und zur Filialversorgung. Die Spezialität von DFT ist Hängefördertechnik in verschiedenen Ausprägungen für die Bekleidungsindustrie, den Elektronik(groß)handel, Arzneimittelgroßhandel, die Automobil-Produktionslogistik und allgemein für den eCommerce-Handel. Vor kurzem wurde die AutoPocket™ als Innovation im Bereich der Taschensorter vorgestellt. DFT ist weltweit aktiv, wobei die Hauptmärkte aktuell Nord-, West- und Zentraleuropa sind. Seit 2021 konnten wegweisende Vertriebserfolge in den USA in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Mutterkonzern KNAPP erreicht werden.

Deine Aufgaben

Du möchtest Teil eines innovativen Projektteams sein und die Zukunft der Intralogistik aktiv mitgestalten? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig!

Als Mitglied unseres Project Engineer Software Teams entwickelst du Lösungen für namhafte nationale und internationale Kunden und sorgst dafür, dass komplexe Materialflüsse in automatisierten Lagern reibungslos funktionieren. In deiner Rolle als (Junior) Project Engineer Software C++ / C# (m/w/d) arbeitest du an unserem Standort in Bielefeld oder Gronau
und passt unsere Warehouse-Control-Systeme (WCS) an individuelle Kundenanforderungen an. So trägst du maßgeblich dazu bei, den Warenfluss in hochautomatisierten Logistikzentren effizient und zuverlässig zu steuern. Deine Aufgaben im Projektverlauf

Du erfasst und analysierst individuelle Anforderungen aus internen und externen Quellen
Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Kunden, dem Vertrieb und internen Fachbereichen zusammen, um die fachlichen Anforderungen zu verstehen, zu dokumentieren und umzusetzen
Dabei analysierst du Herausforderungen, entwickelst und programmierst kundenspezifische Anforderungen in unserer WCS-Software und passt das User Interface (GUI) nach Kundenanforderungen an.
Du führst Simulationen und Tests remote oder vor Ort bei unseren Kunden durch und nimmst deine Softwarelösung schließlich in Betrieb
Zum Projektabschluss erstellst du die Bedienerdokumentation und bist für die Durchführung projektspezifischer Schulungen verantwortlich

Was Du Mitbringst

Ein Studium im Bereich (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Elektrotechnik oder einer vergleichbaren Qualifikation - alternativ eine technisch orientierte Ausbildung mit Praxiserfahrung im IT-Umfeld
Du hast (erste) Erfahrungen bzw. Kenntnisse in den Programmiersprachen C++, C#. JavaScript und HTML sowie im Umgang mit Azure DevOps Servern, Oracle-Datenbanken oder PL/SQL
Du bringst deine Kommunikationsstärke in deutscher und englischer Sprache gerne ein und bist bereit national und international zu reisen (je nach Projektphase ca. 30% Reiseanteil)
Du bist ein verlässlicher Teamplayer mit der Fähigkeit, Aufgaben eigenverantwortlich zu bearbeiten und situationsgerecht zu entscheiden

Was Wir Bieten

Einen sicheren Arbeitsplatz mit einer langfristigen Perspektive
Kurze Entscheidungswege durch flache Hierarchien
Ein sympathisches und hilfsbereit Team in einem modernen Umfeld

new_jobs.title: Platform & Data Engineering Director

Visium combines strategy, frontier AI, and deep regulated-industry expertise to build and deploy AI-native systems that reinvent how businesses operate - unlocking the value of AI at scale.

We're not a strategy firm that ships slide decks and walks away. Not a tech consultancy that builds what won't get adopted. Not a product company chasing problems it doesn't understand. We're all three at once: strategy, deep technical and integration expertise, and product, working as one. That combination is our flywheel. Consulting keeps us close to the hardest real-world problems. Products let us solve them at scale. Every engagement sharpens our products; every deployment makes the next engagement faster, deeper, and more certain.

We're obsessed with outcomes. While 95% of enterprise AI pilots never reach production, Visium is built to be the 5% delivering productised AI that compounds in value, not point solutions that deliver marginal gains. We are AI-native, not AI-adjacent. We don't bolt AI onto broken workflows; we redesign them with AI at the core.

Role

As a Platform & Data Engineering Director, you will lead the design, build, and evolution of Visium's client-facing AI and Data platform capabilities. You are the technical authority and delivery lead for our most complex data & platform programs, the person who ensures that what we build is not only technically excellent but also adoptable, scalable, and genuinely transformative.

You will directly manage forward-deployed platform engineering teams, drive data & platform strategy across engagements, and act as a trusted technical advisor to senior client stakeholders. You bring hands-on depth in the modern data and AI platform stack, from infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD to cloud architecture and building data products, combined with the leadership presence and commercial instinct to grow accounts and inspire teams.

As a Platform & Data Engineering Director, you will work on

Architect and lead the delivery of complex AI and Data platform programs, spanning cloud infrastructure design, automation, CI/CD pipelines, data product design and data engineering, from initial scoping through to production deployment. Our focus is on Azure and AWS
Define and drive platform engineering standards and best practices across engagements, ensuring repeatability, reliability, and long-term client value
Build and maintain strong relationships with senior client stakeholders, including C-Level and VP Engineering personas, acting as a hands-on technical advisor who earns trust through delivery
Lead and mentor a team of platform engineers and engagement managers, cultivating a culture of engineering excellence, innovation, and ownership
Identify and develop new business opportunities within existing accounts, partnering with the commercial team to expand Visium's platform footprint
Champion an inspiring, outward-facing engineering culture, one that attracts strong talent and energises clients with a clear and compelling vision for what great platform and data engineering looks like

Requirements

To succeed in this role, you bring a combination of expertise, experience, and skills including:

Proven, hands-on experience leading large-scale platform engineering programs in AI and Data, you have built, shipped and operated production-grade platforms and data products, not just designed them
Mastered the consulting business - you know exactly how the business works and have a proven track record in delivering successful large projects
Deep technical expertise across the modern platform stack: CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, cloud platform design (focus Azure,), data engineering and automation at scale
Demonstrated experience delivering AI and Data use cases end-to-end on enterprise platforms
Proven people leadership: you have hired, grown, and retained high-performing platform engineering teams in fast-paced consulting or product environments
Commercial acumen and a track record of contributing to account growth, whether through identifying upsell opportunities, leading presales technical conversations, or building long-term client partnerships
Outstanding communication and presence: you can translate complex platform concepts into compelling narratives for both technical and executive audiences, and you do so with energy and conviction
An inspiring, outgoing personality: you lead from the front, bring others with you, and make the work feel meaningful
Fluent in English; French and/or German are a plus

Benefits

A competitive compensation package
A yearly education budget to steep your learning curve
A yearly sport budget because a fit body leads to a fit mind
A flexible working culture because your work-life balance matters to us
A position that enables you to have an impact on 1'000s of people, and the whole company's growth
An international, knowledgeable, and passionate team with a strong collaborative mindset

Durch den smarten Einsatz maßgeschneiderter IT-Lösungen unterstützen wir unsere Kunden dabei, das Beste aus ihrem Business und aktuellen Technologien herauszuholen. Unseren Erfolg aber erreichen wir nur durch eins: die Menschen bei adesso! Sie bringen Ideen, fachliches Know how und Technologien zusammen. Gemeinsam programmieren wir (deine) Zukunft bei adesso.

DEINE ROLLE

Architectural Leadership: Du entwirfst zukunftssichere Softwarearchitekturen im .NET-Umfeld und trägst Verantwortung für deren Umsetzung in komplexen Projekten.
Klassische & moderne Welten: Du bewegst dich sicher sowohl in klassischen Enterprise-Architekturen (z. B. Monolithen, Client-Server-Systeme, On-Prem) als auch in modernen cloud-nativen Szenarien (Microservices, Container, Event-Driven).
Tech Strategy & Guidance: Du definierst Architektur- und Technologie-Standards (Cloud-native, API-First, Security by Design, Domain-Driven Design) und unterstützt Teams bei der Umsetzung.
Consulting & Collaboration: Du arbeitest eng mit Kunden, Fachbereichen und Entwicklungsteams zusammen – von der Anforderungsanalyse über die Architektur bis zur produktiven Einführung.
Innovation Driver: Du bringst Trends wie AI-Integration, Serverless, Observability, Zero-Trust-Security und DevSecOps aktiv in die Projekte ein.

DEIN PROFIL

Background: Abgeschlossenes Studium der (Wirtschafts-)Informatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
Architektur-Erfahrung: Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Design und in der Dokumentation komplexer Software-Architekturen, sowohl im klassischen On-Prem-Umfeld als auch in der Cloud.
Engineering Skills: Sehr gute Kenntnisse in moderner Softwareentwicklung mit .NET Core, C#, Cloud-Services (Azure/AWS/GCP), Container-Orchestrierung (Kubernetes) und IaC (Terraform, Bicep) sowie Erfahrung mit der Modernisierung bestehender Systeme zu Microservices, Cloud & SaaS.
Strategie & Delivery: Know-how in Anforderungsanalyse, Betriebskonzepten, Security-Architekturen und in der Transformation von Legacy-Systemen zu skalierbaren Plattformen.
Kommunikation & Leadership: Du bist sicher in der Moderation von Architektur-Workshops, agierst als Schnittstelle zwischen Business und Tech und coachst Entwicklerteams.
KI Kompetenz: Du verfügst über vertiefte KI-Expertise, gestaltest deren verantwortungsvollen Einsatz in deinem Verantwortungsbereich aktiv mit und fungierst als Enabler für Kunden sowie intern bei adesso.
Sprachen: Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Unser Versprechen: Du wirst dich bei uns wohlfühlen! Kollegial, familiär und auf Augenhöhe – wir leben Austausch, Teamgeist und einen respektvollen Umgang miteinander. Diversität und verschiedene Blickwinkel werden bei uns genauso geschätzt wie du als Mensch. Das und viel mehr steht für unser ganz besonderes Wir-Gefühl. Für das es sogar ein Wort gibt: adessi.

Unsere Kultur und das Zusammenarbeiten sind geprägt von gegenseitiger Wertschätzung, Anerkennung und Unterstützung. Das verbindet uns hierarchieübergreifend – auch im Home-Office. So belegen wir zum wiederholten Mal den 1. Platz beim Wettbewerb „Deutschlands Beste Arbeitgeber in der ITK“!. Unser umfangreiches Trainingsangebot und ein transparentes Laufbahnstufenmodell für alle sorgen dafür, dass deine Entwicklung bei uns nicht stillsteht. Denn gemeinsam zu wachsen und Chancengeber zu sein, das ist programmiert in unserer DNA.

new_jobs.title: Software Architect (all genders) in Stuttgart
new_jobs.description:
Du bist interessiert an der Stelle als Software Architect (all genders) in Stuttgart bei PRODYNA SE
?

Auf Instaffo kannst du dich für diesen und weitere Jobs ohne großen Aufwand bewerben. Erstelle dein Profil in unter 2 Minuten und starte den Bewerbungsprozess mit nur wenigen Klicks.

Anforderungen

Bitte beachte, dass für diese Stelle eine Arbeitserlaubnis für Deutschland
erforderlich ist.

Sprache: Deutsch - Verhandlungssicher (C2), Englisch - Fließend (C1)

Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung abgeschlossen und bringst mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Umgang mit Softwareentwicklung sowie technischer Leitung von Projektteams mit
Tiefgehende technologische Kenntnisse in der Entwicklung von Enterprise und Business Applikationen (auch im Cloud-Umfeld) zeichnen dich aus
Du bringst eine stetige Bereitschaft zum Lernen neuer Technologien und Konzepte mit
Du bist eine kommunikationsstarke, selbstbewusste «Hands-On»-Persönlichkeit, Netzwerker und Multiplikator
Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (mind. C1) für die Arbeit in internationalen Teams und für die Kommunikation mit deutschsprachigen Kunden.

Tätigkeiten

Du berätst Kunden bei der technischen Architektur neuer oder bestehender Business Applikationen, auch in Hinblick auf Performanceoptimierungen und Security Themen
Du trägst die technische Leitung und Verantwortung für Softwareentwicklungsprojekte aller Grössenordnungen und bist direkter Ansprechpartner für ausgewählte technologische Spezialbereiche (z.B. GraphDatenbanken)
Unter Verwendung eines abwechslungsreichen Technologie-Stacks (z.B. Java, C# .NET, Angular, React, Spring, Docker, Kubernetes, Kafka) entwickelst du integrierte kundenspezifische Lösungen
Du begleitest Projekte und Kunden ab der Pre-Sales-Phase durch Präsentation von Konzepten und Lösungen bis hin zur Umsetzung und eigenständiger Beratung
Du übernimmst Verantwortung für deinen Aufgabenbereich, Teamkollegen, hast Freude am Mentoring von Kollegen und möchtest die Kultur von PRODYNA maßgeblich mitbestimmen

Über das Unternehmen

PRODYNA ist eine innovative IT-Beratungsgesellschaft, die ein umfassendes Serviceportfolio zum gesamten Application Lifecycle bereitstellt. new_jobs.title: QA Engineer (Settlement & Reporting) (m/f/d)
new_jobs.description:
Unternehmensbeschreibung

Everyone’s story matters. Come shape your story with us at Riverty.

But where does that take you?

To one of our 30 hybrid workspaces – designed for exchanging ideas, learning from others, and shaping the way we work. An international community of over 4,000 people, representing almost 80 nationalities across 11 countries. United by one mission: Combining empathy, advanced technology and data-driven insights to keep people and businesses in flow. With payments made for them. So that they don’t have to worry about it.

And there’s more.
We are part of the family-owned Bertelsmann group. Established. Corporate. In a fast-paced industry. We enable flexible payments in various industries, simplifying the financial management of known brands and helping people repay debt to build financial confidence. In short: shaping FinTech.

Stellenbeschreibung

We are looking for a

QA Engineer (m/f/d)

to join our team at our location in Berlin to build the next generation fintech.

Riverty’s partners and consumers rely on absolute precision when money changes hands. In Settlement and Reporting, financial integrity is not a late-stage audit: it is built directly into APIs, accounting workflows, reconciliation pipelines, and test evidence in Jira/Xray.

We are looking for someone who combines a tester’s rigorous domain judgment with an engineer’s delivery habits: you understand complex financial flows, you make ledger and reporting services testable, and you keep CI honest when tracking every cent.

What Will Be Your Challenge

As a QA Engineer, your role will involve developing software specifically for testing, such as tools, frameworks, and automated tests. You will work on enhancing the quality of existing applications by creating tests, conducting testing, and implementing test automation routines. Your daily tasks will include the following:

Planning testing automation for existing and upcoming projects (Unit Tests / Integration Tests including E2E / Performance Tests )
Support the team with quality tests.
Integrate automated tests into Azure Pipelines.
Brainstorm with the team on upcoming projects and keep test/quality in focus, mentoring team members with new testing technologies.
Proactively collaborate with the development team to ensure the code is testable and achieves comprehensive test coverage, helping the team to keep focus on test and quality.
Work closely with the product owner, giving an overview of the status and the upcoming project quality plan.

You Will Be Using Technologies

Languages: C# / .NET, JavaScript / TypeScript, SQL
API & workflow testing: NUnit, xUnit, Postman / Postman CLI, HTTP clients, Gherkin/Xray
BDD / shared test libraries: Reqnroll, Testing Commons, AI agents
Test infrastructure: Docker, Docker Compose, Testcontainers,
CI/CD & Azure: Azure DevOps Pipelines, Azure (Key Vault, storage, ACR), Git
Reporting & test management: Xray, ReportPortal, Jira, Confluence
Performance k6 and/or JMeter
Nice to have: Cypress, Kafka consumer testing

Qualifikationen

What Will Help You To Succeed In The Role

5+ years as SDET / QA Engineer / Quality Engineer, with automated tests in production CI
Solid knowledge of testing types and methods, and the judgment to choose unit vs integration vs functional vs E2E
Strong experience testing complex APIs and integrations (auth, persistence, downstream HTTP, messaging). Comfort reading YAML/JSON configs and tracing behaviour across services.
Proven delivery of automated suites and, ideally, shared test libraries or pipeline templates - not only one-off scripts.
CI/CD, source control, and dependency management as a normal part of the job. Experience in a DevOps-style team.
BDD/Gherkin experience is useful (Xray/Reqnroll). It is not the only style we use; most new service tests are NUnit/xUnit. Comfort with mixed unit/integration/functional/E2E across repos.
Curiosity about AI-assisted testing is a plus. Willingness to review, correct, and constrain generated tests is required.
As a person you are self-driven, proactive, and able to talk to both business and engineering stakeholders and fluent in English

Zusätzliche Informationen

Our Plus Points

Inclusive and valuing culture: At Riverty, you can be who you are. We strive to create an inclusive environment and an appreciative culture, enhanced by our employee networks.
Health & Wellbeing: Your physical and mental health is important to us. Take advantage of our various preventive care and support services.
Professional and Personal Development: Take advantage of our numerous training and development opportunities. Benefit, for example, from training courses offered by Bertelsmann University, language courses or leadership trainings.
Monetary Benefits & Discounts: Know that you're appreciated with plenty of employee benefits & discounts just for you.
Flexibility: Our diverse working models empower you to customize your work to perfectly align with your preferences. Benefit from mobile office, flexible working hours and part-time models.

More information on riverty.com/careers. Are you already convinced? Then we look forward to receiving your online application – with just a few clicks

Equal Opportunity Employer Statement

We want to be a fair and inclusive employer. We value the diverse perspectives that a diverse workforce brings to the table. Therefore, we are actively looking for people who enrich our company through their identity, background and personal experiences, with or without a disability.
