new_jobs.title: Technical Application Manager - Print.API Serivce (m/w/d)
new_jobs.description:
Herausforderungen meistert man am besten in einem stimmigen Umfeld. Mit einem zukunftsweisenden Arbeitgeber, der seine Mitarbeitenden individuell unterstützt und ihnen auf Augenhöhe begegnet. In 18 Märkten ist die Volkswagen Financial Services Europas führender Anbieter von automobilen Finanz- und Mobilitätsdienstleistungen. Wir sind der Schlüssel zur Mobilität. Entdecke jetzt die vielfältigen Möglichkeiten bei uns.

Kurzbeschreibung der Rolle

Die Abteilung Sales Solutions entwickelt und betreut Applikationen und Services für die Verkäuferarbeitsplatzsysteme (VAP), die bei den Automobil-Händlern der Volkswagen Gruppe in Deutschland im Einsatz sind.

Mit diesen Systemen werden die Verkaufs- und Marktbearbeitungsprozesse im Handel durchgeführt werden. Die Systeme haben Anbindungen an alle relevanten Konzernsysteme sowie Schnittstellen zu vielen im Handel relevanten Fahrzeugsystemen.

Als Unterstützung suchen wir einen Technical Application Manager (TAM), der sich technisch für einen unserer essenziellen Serviceapplikationen verantwortlich zeichnet und die Weiterentwicklung begleitet.

Konkret handelt es sich um einen zentralen Service zur Dokumentengenerierung, der neben den VAP-Systemen auch aktuell 25 weitere Frontendkonsumenten bedient.

Technische Stabilität zur Absicherung des Vertriebskanals hat oberste Priorität. Kontinuierlich besteht der Bedarf technische Maßnahmen zur weiteren Absicherung des Geschäftes zu identifizieren, zu projektieren und zusammen mit dem Entwicklungspartner umzusetzen.

Organisatorisch liegt der Schwerpunkt zusammen mit dem internen Lead Entwickler auf der Steuerung des Entwicklungsdienstleisters und der kontinuierlichen Optimierung in Bezug auf die Zusammenarbeit und Lieferqualität.

Du zeigst gerne Initiative, entwickelts Ideen, kannst Andere dafür begeistern und hast Interesse eine verantwortungsvolle Aufgabe zu übernehmen? Perfekt!

Das sind Deine Aufgaben:

Als TAM stellst du die Stabilität, Sicherheit und Compliance der Anwendung sicher und steuerst Kosten sowie Budget der Anwendung
Du steuerst den externen Dienstleister, der die Anwendungen operativ entwickelt und supported
Du entwickelst auch zusammen mit dem Dienstleister strategisch die Anwendungen hinsichtlich nachhaltiger technischer Stabilität, Sicherheit, Compliance und Architektur weiter
Du löst Störungen der Anwendungen nachhaltig in Zusammenarbeit mit den notwendigen Bereichen und dem externen Dienstleister. Dabei stellst Du sicher, dass dies auch die für die Anwendungen notwendigen, nachgelagerten Services tun.
Du vertrittst die technische Sicht der Anwendungen bei Projekten, gegenüber des Managements und bei steuernden Funktionen
Du treibst und begleitest die Etablierung der agilen Softwareentwicklung in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Business Cluster (ART AVK) und den Prozesspartnern nach Scrum und SAFe.

Das bringst Du mit:

Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Fach- oder Hochschulstudium im Bereich Informatik oder Wirtschaftsinformatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
Du überzeugst mit sicherem Auftreten sowie der Fähigkeit technische Sachverhalte adressatengerecht darzustellen
Du hast Erfahrungen als TAM oder in der Leitung von Softwareentwicklungsprojekten
Agile Vorgehensmodelle wie Scrum oder SAFe sind dir nicht fremd
Du punktest mit analytischen Fähigkeiten sowie deinem technischen und organisatorischen Wissen bei der Entwicklung von webbasierten mehrschichtigen Anwendungen auf Basis von Microsoft Azure und .NET.
Dein tägliches Umfeld findet noch primär auf Deutsch statt, daher bist du hier sicher und wortgewandt. Doch die englische Sprache nimmt immer stärkeren Einzug in den Alltag und daher bist du dem offen gegenüber eingestellt und bringst eine solide Sprachkenntnis in Wort und Schrift mit (B2).

________________________________________________________________________________

Der Einsatz erfolgt bei der Volkswagen Financial Services AG.

Ihre Vorteile

Attraktive Vergütung
35-Stunden-Woche und 30+2* Urlaubstage
Flexible Arbeitszeitgestaltung
Mobiles Arbeiten nach Absprache
Persönliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und Gesundheitsangebote

new_jobs.title: Solution Architect AI Agents Azure (all genders)
new_jobs.description:
Wir gehören zu den Top-Adressen in der IT-Welt und fokussieren uns auf die Optimierung der Kerngeschäfts­prozesse unserer Kunden. Durch den smarten Einsatz maßgeschneiderter IT-Lösungen unterstützen wir unsere Kunden dabei, das Beste aus ihrem Business und aktuellen Technologien herauszuholen. Unseren Erfolg aber erreichen wir nur durch eins: die Menschen bei adesso! Sie bringen Ideen, fachliches Know how und Technologien zusammen. Gemeinsam programmieren wir (deine) Zukunft bei adesso.

DEINE ROLLE

Entwirf intelligente Agentic-AI-Lösungen für Kundenprozesse: Du konzipierst und realisierst Azure-native agentische Lösungen zur Automatisierung, Unterstützung und Optimierung von Geschäftsprozessen auf Basis von Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Agent Service, Semantic Kernel und weiteren Azure-KI-Services – von der ersten Idee bis zum stabilen Betrieb in der Produktion.
Agenten- und Prozessarchitekturen: Du entwirfst agentenbasierte Architekturen inklusive Tool-Integration, Memory-Persistenz, Multi-Agent-Orchestrierung, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, Guardrails und Evaluationsmechanismen. Dabei integrierst du KI-Agenten als digitale Prozessassistenten, Entscheidungsunterstützer oder autonome Teilprozess-Akteure in bestehende Kundenprozesse.
Gestalte Prozessflows & Systemintegrationen: Du gestaltest intelligente Prozessabläufe, Agenten-Workflows und Toolchains, bindest Wissensquellen, RAG-Pipelines, Fachanwendungen und Analytik-Komponenten ein und integrierst externe Systeme über Azure-Services wie Azure Functions, Logic Apps, Event Grid, Service Bus, Azure Storage, Cosmos DB, Azure SQL, Azure AI Search oder API Management.
DevOps & Delivery für KI-Agenten: Du verankerst CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, z. B. Terraform, Bicep oder Azure Developer CLI, automatisiertes Testing sowie Logging und Tracing, z. B. Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics und OpenTelemetry, in deinen Architekturen und sorgst für sichere, reproduzierbare Deployments agentischer Anwendungen in produktionsnahen und produktiven Kundenumgebungen.
Übernimm End-to-End-Projektverantwortung: Du begleitest Kunden über den gesamten Lifecycle – von Prozessanalysen, Potenzialbewertungen, Assessments und Zielbild-Workshops über Architektur- und Designphasen bis zur Implementierung – und übernimmst Verantwortung für Qualität, Skalierbarkeit und Betriebssicherheit der entwickelten agentischen Prozesslösungen.
Begleite Kunden umfassend: Du übersetzt Konzepte wie Tool-Use, RAG-Pipelines, Session-Memory, Multi-Agent-Delegation, Grounding, Guardrails und Evaluation in verständliche Entscheidungsgrundlagen, erstellst Architektur-Roadmaps und unterstützt Teams durch Reviews, Coaching und Wissenstransfer. Dabei berätst du Kunden insbesondere dazu, welche Prozesse sich für agentische Automatisierung eignen, wie Agenten sicher in bestehende Arbeitsabläufe eingebettet werden und wie Fachbereiche, IT und Betrieb gemeinsam tragfähige Lösungen entwickeln.

DEIN PROFIL

Azure-Expertise und Architekturverständnis: Du hast mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung mit Microsoft Azure, kennst die Eigenheiten und Limits zentraler Services, z. B. Azure Functions, Azure Kubernetes Service, Azure Container Apps, Event Grid, Service Bus, Cosmos DB, Azure SQL, Azure Storage, Azure AI Search, Entra ID, Key Vault und Virtual Network, und entwickelst skalierbare, sichere Cloud-Architekturen für produktionsreife KI-, Agenten- und Prozessautomatisierungslösungen.
Azure AI, OpenAI & LLM-Agenten: Du hast mit Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI Service oder Azure AI Agent Service gearbeitet und weißt, was produktionsreifer Betrieb von LLM- und Agentenlösungen bedeutet. Idealerweise bringst du Erfahrung mit Tool-Calling, Function Calling, Agents, Knowledge Sources, Vector Search, Guardrails, Prompt-Evaluation und Content Safety mit. Kenntnisse in Frameworks wie Semantic Kernel, LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen oder CrewAI sind ein Plus. Du verstehst, wie agentische Systeme Tools nutzen, Kontext verwalten, Aufgaben delegieren und sicher in bestehende Prozess- und Systemlandschaften eingebettet werden.
Prozessverständnis und agentische Automatisierung: Du bringst praktische Erfahrung in der Analyse, Modellierung und Optimierung von Geschäftsprozessen mit und verstehst, wie agentische Tools Prozesse unterstützen, automatisieren oder teilweise autonom ausführen können. Du erkennst geeignete Anwendungsfälle für Agentic AI, bewertest Nutzen, Machbarkeit und Risiken und übersetzt fachliche Anforderungen in umsetzbare technische Lösungsansätze.
DevOps-, IaC- und Container-Skills: Du verfügst über Projekterfahrung mit Infrastructure as Code, z. B. Terraform, Bicep oder Azure Developer CLI, CI/CD-Pipelines, z. B. Azure DevOps oder GitHub Actions, und Container-Plattformen wie AKS oder Azure Container Apps. Du verankerst Testing, Observability und Security-Guardrails in deinen Delivery-Prozessen. Kenntnisse zu Compliance, z. B. DSGVO, BSI, ISO 27001, sowie Microsoft-Azure-Zertifizierungen sind wünschenswert. Idealerweise hast du Erfahrung darin, KI- und Agentenlösungen reproduzierbar, überwacht und sicher in produktive Kundenumgebungen zu überführen.
Beratungskompetenz: Du kannst komplexe technische Sachverhalte adressatengerecht erklären und überzeugst in Workshops, Reviews und Management-Präsentationen. Du berätst Kunden souverän bei der Identifikation geeigneter Prozesse, der Bewertung von Automatisierungspotenzialen sowie der Einführung agentischer Lösungen an der Schnittstelle von Fachbereich, IT und Betrieb.
KI Kompetenz: Du verfügst über vertiefte KI-Expertise, gestaltest deren verantwortungsvollen Einsatz in deinem Verantwortungsbereich aktiv mit und fungierst als Enabler für Kunden sowie intern bei adesso. Dabei bringst du ein gutes Verständnis für Responsible AI, Guardrails, Evaluation, Monitoring, Prompt- und Tool-Design, RAG-Architekturen sowie den sicheren Umgang mit Unternehmensdaten mit.
Sprachkenntnisse: Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse

Unser Versprechen: Du wirst dich bei uns wohlfühlen! Kollegial, familiär und auf Augenhöhe – wir leben Austausch, Teamgeist und einen respektvollen Umgang miteinander. Diversität und verschiedene Blickwinkel werden bei uns genauso geschätzt wie du als Mensch. Das und viel mehr steht für unser ganz besonderes Wir-Gefühl. Für das es sogar ein Wort gibt: adessi.

Unsere Kultur und das Zusammenarbeiten sind geprägt von gegenseitiger Wertschätzung, Anerkennung und Unterstützung. Das verbindet uns hierarchieübergreifend – auch im Home-Office. So belegen wir zum wiederholten Mal den 1. Platz beim Wettbewerb „Deutschlands Beste Arbeitgeber in der ITK“!. Unser umfangreiches Trainingsangebot und ein transparentes Laufbahnstufenmodell für alle sorgen dafür, dass deine Entwicklung bei uns nicht stillsteht. Denn gemeinsam zu wachsen und Chancengeber zu sein, das ist programmiert in unserer DNA.

DevOps & Delivery für KI-Agenten: Du verankerst CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, z. B. Terraform, Bicep oder Azure Developer CLI, automatisiertes Testing sowie Logging und Tracing, z. B. Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics und OpenTelemetry, in deinen Architekturen und sorgst für sichere, reproduzierbare Deployments agentischer Anwendungen in produktionsnahen und produktiven Kundenumgebungen.
Übernimm End-to-End-Projektverantwortung: Du begleitest Kunden über den gesamten Lifecycle – von Prozessanalysen, Potenzialbewertungen, Assessments und Zielbild-Workshops über Architektur- und Designphasen bis zur Implementierung – und übernimmst Verantwortung für Qualität, Skalierbarkeit und Betriebssicherheit der entwickelten agentischen Prozesslösungen.
Begleite Kunden umfassend: Du übersetzt Konzepte wie Tool-Use, RAG-Pipelines, Session-Memory, Multi-Agent-Delegation, Grounding, Guardrails und Evaluation in verständliche Entscheidungsgrundlagen, erstellst Architektur-Roadmaps und unterstützt Teams durch Reviews, Coaching und Wissenstransfer. Dabei berätst du Kunden insbesondere dazu, welche Prozesse sich für agentische Automatisierung eignen, wie Agenten sicher in bestehende Arbeitsabläufe eingebettet werden und wie Fachbereiche, IT und Betrieb gemeinsam tragfähige Lösungen entwickeln.

DEIN PROFIL

Azure-Expertise und Architekturverständnis: Du hast mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung mit Microsoft Azure, kennst die Eigenheiten und Limits zentraler Services, z. B. Azure Functions, Azure Kubernetes Service, Azure Container Apps, Event Grid, Service Bus, Cosmos DB, Azure SQL, Azure Storage, Azure AI Search, Entra ID, Key Vault und Virtual Network, und entwickelst skalierbare, sichere Cloud-Architekturen für produktionsreife KI-, Agenten- und Prozessautomatisierungslösungen.
Azure AI, OpenAI & LLM-Agenten: Du hast mit Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI Service oder Azure AI Agent Service gearbeitet und weißt, was produktionsreifer Betrieb von LLM- und Agentenlösungen bedeutet. Idealerweise bringst du Erfahrung mit Tool-Calling, Function Calling, Agents, Knowledge Sources, Vector Search, Guardrails, Prompt-Evaluation und Content Safety mit. Kenntnisse in Frameworks wie Semantic Kernel, LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen oder CrewAI sind ein Plus. Du verstehst, wie agentische Systeme Tools nutzen, Kontext verwalten, Aufgaben delegieren und sicher in bestehende Prozess- und Systemlandschaften eingebettet werden.
Prozessverständnis und agentische Automatisierung: Du bringst praktische Erfahrung in der Analyse, Modellierung und Optimierung von Geschäftsprozessen mit und verstehst, wie agentische Tools Prozesse unterstützen, automatisieren oder teilweise autonom ausführen können. Du erkennst geeignete Anwendungsfälle für Agentic AI, bewertest Nutzen, Machbarkeit und Risiken und übersetzt fachliche Anforderungen in umsetzbare technische Lösungsansätze.
DevOps-, IaC- und Container-Skills: Du verfügst über Projekterfahrung mit Infrastructure as Code, z. B. Terraform, Bicep oder Azure Developer CLI, CI/CD-Pipelines, z. B. Azure DevOps oder GitHub Actions, und Container-Plattformen wie AKS oder Azure Container Apps. Du verankerst Testing, Observability und Security-Guardrails in deinen Delivery-Prozessen. Idealerweise hast du Erfahrung darin, KI- und Agentenlösungen reproduzierbar, überwacht und sicher in produktive Kundenumgebungen zu überführen.
Beratungskompetenz: Du kannst komplexe technische Sachverhalte adressatengerecht erklären und überzeugst in Workshops, Reviews und Management-Präsentationen. Du berätst Kunden souverän bei der Identifikation geeigneter Prozesse, der Bewertung von Automatisierungspotenzialen sowie der Einführung agentischer Lösungen an der Schnittstelle von Fachbereich, IT und Betrieb.
KI Kompetenz: Du verfügst über vertiefte KI-Expertise, gestaltest deren verantwortungsvollen Einsatz in deinem Verantwortungsbereich aktiv mit und fungierst als Enabler für Kunden sowie intern bei adesso. Dabei bringst du ein gutes Verständnis für Responsible AI, Guardrails, Evaluation, Monitoring, Prompt- und Tool-Design, RAG-Architekturen sowie den sicheren Umgang mit Unternehmensdaten mit.
Sprachkenntnisse: Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse

Diversität und verschiedene Blickwinkel werden bei uns genauso geschätzt wie du als Mensch. Das und viel mehr steht für unser ganz besonderes Wir-Gefühl. Für das es sogar ein Wort gibt: adessi.

DevOps & Delivery für KI-Agenten: Du verankerst CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, z. B. Terraform, Bicep oder Azure Developer CLI, automatisiertes Testing sowie Logging und Tracing, z. B. Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics und OpenTelemetry, in deinen Architekturen und sorgst für sichere, reproduzierbare Deployments agentischer Anwendungen in produktionsnahen und produktiven Kundenumgebungen.
Übernimm End-to-End-Projektverantwortung: Du begleitest Kunden über den gesamten Lifecycle – von Prozessanalysen, Potenzialbewertungen, Assessments und Zielbild-Workshops über Architektur- und Designphasen bis zur Implementierung – und übernimmst Verantwortung für Qualität, Skalierbarkeit und Betriebssicherheit der entwickelten agentischen Prozesslösungen.
Begleite Kunden umfassend: Du übersetzt Konzepte wie Tool-Use, RAG-Pipelines, Session-Memory, Multi-Agent-Delegation, Grounding, Guardrails und Evaluation in verständliche Entscheidungsgrundlagen, erstellst Architektur-Roadmaps und unterstützt Teams durch Reviews, Coaching und Wissenstransfer. Dabei berätst du Kunden insbesondere dazu, welche Prozesse sich für agentische Automatisierung eignen, wie Agenten sicher in bestehende Arbeitsabläufe eingebettet werden und wie Fachbereiche, IT und Betrieb gemeinsam tragfähige Lösungen entwickeln.

DEIN PROFIL

Azure-Expertise und Architekturverständnis: Du hast mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung mit Microsoft Azure, kennst die Eigenheiten und Limits zentraler Services, z. B. Azure Functions, Azure Kubernetes Service, Azure Container Apps, Event Grid, Service Bus, Cosmos DB, Azure SQL, Azure Storage, Azure AI Search, Entra ID, Key Vault und Virtual Network, und entwickelst skalierbare, sichere Cloud-Architekturen für produktionsreife KI-, Agenten- und Prozessautomatisierungslösungen.
Azure AI, OpenAI & LLM-Agenten: Du hast mit Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI Service oder Azure AI Agent Service gearbeitet und weißt, was produktionsreifer Betrieb von LLM- und Agentenlösungen bedeutet. Idealerweise bringst du Erfahrung mit Tool-Calling, Function Calling, Agents, Knowledge Sources, Vector Search, Guardrails, Prompt-Evaluation und Content Safety mit. Kenntnisse in Frameworks wie Semantic Kernel, LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen oder CrewAI sind ein Plus. Du verstehst, wie agentische Systeme Tools nutzen, Kontext verwalten, Aufgaben delegieren und sicher in bestehende Prozess- und Systemlandschaften eingebettet werden.
Prozessverständnis und agentische Automatisierung: Du bringst praktische Erfahrung in der Analyse, Modellierung und Optimierung von Geschäftsprozessen mit und verstehst, wie agentische Tools Prozesse unterstützen, automatisieren oder teilweise autonom ausführen können. Du erkennst geeignete Anwendungsfälle für Agentic AI, bewertest Nutzen, Machbarkeit und Risiken und übersetzt fachliche Anforderungen in umsetzbare technische Lösungsansätze.
DevOps-, IaC- und Container-Skills: Du verfügst über Projekterfahrung mit Infrastructure as Code, z. B. Terraform, Bicep oder Azure Developer CLI, CI/CD-Pipelines, z. B. Azure DevOps oder GitHub Actions, und Container-Plattformen wie AKS oder Azure Container Apps. Du verankerst Testing, Observability und Security-Guardrails in deinen Delivery-Prozessen. Idealerweise hast du Erfahrung darin, KI- und Agentenlösungen reproduzierbar, überwacht und sicher in produktive Kundenumgebungen zu überführen.
Beratungskompetenz: Du kannst komplexe technische Sachverhalte adressatengerecht erklären und überzeugst in Workshops, Reviews und Management-Präsentationen. Du berätst Kunden souverän bei der Identifikation geeigneter Prozesse, der Bewertung von Automatisierungspotenzialen sowie der Einführung agentischer Lösungen an der Schnittstelle von Fachbereich, IT und Betrieb.
KI Kompetenz: Du verfügst über vertiefte KI-Expertise, gestaltest deren verantwortungsvollen Einsatz in deinem Verantwortungsbereich aktiv mit und fungierst als Enabler für Kunden sowie intern bei adesso. Dabei bringst du ein gutes Verständnis für Responsible AI, Guardrails, Evaluation, Monitoring, Prompt- und Tool-Design, RAG-Architekturen sowie den sicheren Umgang mit Unternehmensdaten mit.
Sprachkenntnisse: Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse

Diversität und verschiedene Blickwinkel werden bei uns genauso geschätzt wie du als Mensch. Das und viel mehr steht für unser ganz besonderes Wir-Gefühl. Für das es sogar ein Wort gibt: adessi.

new_jobs.description:
Hybrid Working:
We take a flexible approach to hybrid/ remote working, recognising that office attendance may vary depending on your location, role and team needs. Don’t let office attendance put you off applying. The expected working pattern will be discussed during the recruitment process.

Pinewood.AI is looking for experienced hands-on Senior Developers to play a key role in our software development teams. Working closely with Lead Developers, Engineering colleagues, Product, testers, and other colleagues across the wider business, you will support the delivery and ongoing development of our Automotive Intelligence Platform.

As a senior member of the team, you will contribute to the design, development, and delivery of high-quality, scalable solutions for the Pinewood Automotive Intelligence Platform, our enterprise-scale SaaS product used by automotive retailers and OEMs worldwide.

This role is ideal for a strong, hands-on developer who enjoys building new product features, developing integrations with third-party systems, and working across the full software development lifecycle while supporting high engineering standards within a collaborative team environment.

Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and enhance enterprise-level software solutions using C#, .NET / .NET Core, Razor, Web API, SQL Server, HTML, and JavaScript.
Work closely with Product Owners, testers, UI/UX specialists, and Engineering colleagues to deliver new functionality, improvements, and integrations with third-party systems.
Remain hands-on in coding, solution design, and development across the full .NET stack.
Develop and maintain integrations with third-party platforms using APIs and other integration methods.
Support best practices across development, testing, and deployment to ensure scalable, secure, and maintainable solutions.
Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, development tooling, and engineering practices alongside the wider Engineering team.
Participate in technical discussions and contribute ideas that support product improvement and delivery effectiveness.
Diagnose complex technical issues, including integration challenges, data consistency issues, and performance improvements.
Support knowledge sharing and code quality through peer reviews and collaboration.
Contribute to a collaborative engineering culture focused on clean, efficient code and practical delivery.

Requirements

Proven experience as a Senior Developer within a SaaS or enterprise software environment.
Strong hands-on expertise in C#, .NET / .NET Core, and SQL / T-SQL.
Solid understanding of database design, performance optimisation, and query tuning.
Experience delivering front-end functionality using HTML, JavaScript, and Razor.
Experience building and supporting integrations with third-party systems using REST APIs or similar technologies.
Practical experience working with Azure Cloud Services and Azure DevOps, or equivalent CI/CD tooling.
Proficiency with Visual Studio or VS Code.
Strong understanding of software development practices and agile delivery methods.
Experience working across the full software development lifecycle, from concept through to production support.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a passion for clean, efficient, and maintainable code.
Experience in enterprise SaaS industries, or with complex, high-availability platforms, would be beneficial.

Why Join Us?

This is an opportunity to join a well-established engineering team working on a global SaaS platform used by automotive retailers and OEMs around the world.

You will be hands-on in the development of new product features, integrations, improvements, and bespoke customer solutions, with the chance to work within a complex enterprise environment.

Working closely with Product, UI/UX, testing colleagues, and the wider business, you will help deliver practical, high-quality solutions that make a real difference to our customers.

Benefits

Competitive salary based on experience
Bonus scheme
Share scheme
Hybrid working (flexibility depending on your base location).
25 days holiday plus all UK bank holidays
4x life assurance
Enhanced family-friendly leave, supporting employees with 5 months’ full pay for maternity or adoption leave, 2 weeks’ fully paid paternity or adoption leave, plus an additional 2 weeks of paid annual leave to use within 24 months of the birth or adoption.
Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) - free, confidential 24/7 support for you and your immediate family (including counselling, legal & financial advice, and wellbeing resources)
Ongoing training & professional development
Cycle to Work scheme - save up to 40% on bikes and accessories through salary sacrifice
Eyecare vouchers - free eye test and contribution towards prescription glasses
Regular social events
Employee recognition and awards
Exclusive Gym (Virgin Active) membership scheme

About Us

Our story began more than 20 years ago, but right from the start, it has been rooted in the specific needs of the automotive industry. As automotive professionals as well as technologists, we wanted to build practical technology solutions that were designed around how automotive businesses work, recognising what makes them different. Pinewood.AI is an unparalleled Automotive Intelligence Platform that enables automotive retail customers and OEMs to drive growth and profitability throughout every aspect of their business.

Pinewood’s cloud-based secure end-to-end ecosystem unlocks the value of every customer. Our vision is to be the full-service technology partner that helps automotive retailers and OEMs run more efficiently and increase revenue by making better commercial and business decisions more easily.

new_jobs.description:
Olo is a leading SaaS platform accelerating digital transformation in the restaurant industry, by helping customers deliver more personalised and profitable guest experiences. As a result, our digital ordering, payment, loyalty and guest engagement solutions enable brands to do more with less and make every guest feel like a regular.

While our roots are in NYC, we’re intentionally investing in Belfast and Northern Ireland as a key hub, with an established leadership presence, a local team, and community for the long term. This role is fully remote, offering you flexibility to work from anywhere within NI.

Your new role

In this role, you’ll join as a Software Engineer on the ‘ Menu’ team, which is part of the wider ‘ Order’ engineering group.

The Menu team owns and operates all of the systems involved with managing, publishing and accessing billions of menu records. Menus change in real time and their accuracy is essential for the proper operation of our customer’s businesses. Consequently, the Menu team’s scope includes some of the most sophisticated and performance sensitive parts of Olo’s infrastructure. A deep understanding of garbage collection, network latency, and database internals comes with the territory. If you are looking for a challenge, you will find it here.

How you’ll make an impact

Demonstrate a solid understanding of the Menu team's domain and technology stack, contributing to discussions and development decisions with growing independence.
Handle small-to-medium features independently and begin taking ownership of moderately complex tasks with some guidance.
Write clean, maintainable code and actively participate in peer code reviews, providing constructive feedback and adhering to coding standards.
Collaborate closely with Product to refine requirements, helping to shape solutions that meet business needs effectively.
Focus on delivering high-quality software solutions within established timelines, emphasising best practices in software development.
Engage in troubleshooting and debugging efforts, showing an ability to resolve common and moderately complex issues with minimal support.
Assist in the deployment and monitoring of services, learning how to manage and troubleshoot issues in production environments.
Contribute to building and maintaining reliable distributed systems, implementing resilience mechanisms as appropriate.
Participate actively in team ceremonies and demonstrate initiative by taking ownership of tasks and helping to unblock others when possible.
Engage in continuous learning and self-improvement by exploring new technologies and best practices relevant to the team's work.
Use Claude Code and GitHub Copilot extensively as part of your daily workflow, and grow your skills through hands-on AI training designed to help you become highly effective with modern AI coding agents and IDEs.
Demonstrate ownership of the team's delivery pipeline, ensuring that code quality, testing standards, and deployment practices are continuously optimised.
Active participation in on-call duties is required, with specific responsibilities determined by your assigned team and area of expertise.

What will set you up for success

Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
3+ years of experience in software engineering.
Proficient in the .Net/C# ecosystem and capable of independently implementing moderately complex features and algorithms.
Experience using version control tools (e.g., GitHub) and participating in continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, TeamCity).
Proficient in writing and maintaining unit and integration tests, demonstrating an understanding of test-driven development (TDD) principles (e.g., NUnit, Jest).
Deeper understanding of distributed systems, including building scalable and resilient services (e.g., Redis, Kafka, AWS infrastructure).
Show strong problem-solving skills and collaborate effectively with team members, product managers, and stakeholders to deliver solutions that align with business objectives.

About Olo

Olo is a leading restaurant technology provider with ordering, payment, and guest engagement solutions that help brands increase orders, streamline operations, and improve the guest experience. Each day, Olo processes millions of orders on its open SaaS platform, gathering the right data from each touchpoint into a single source—so restaurants can better understand and better serve every guest on every channel, every time. Over 800 restaurant brands trust Olo and its network of more than 400 integration partners to innovate on behalf of the restaurant community, accelerating technology’s positive impact and creating a world where every restaurant guest feels like a regular. Learn more at olo.com.

Job Description

We are seeking a passionate and hardworking Software Developer to join our dedicated Account Management & Onboarding team as we modernise and maintain our Player Account Management platform.

The Onboarding and Account Management Team focus on the key customer journeys related to registration, identity verification and authentication within our platform. The team is responsible for a range of critical systems and processes relating to those journeys, to ensure that we have a scalable, robust and secure system for our customers.

Within the team we are developing, enhancing and supporting our business critical platform; from the delivery of real time identity verification systems utilising innovative AI technology to core operational tooling.

Operating as a full stack team, we are in the process of undertaking a ground up re-architecture into Golang, react and cloud platforms. Core skills within the team are Kafka, SQL, .Net, Golang and Typescript; we are looking for candidates with professional experience in one or more of these technologies though experience in similar technologies are welcome.

Working in a team of talented developers, you will join us in delivering the highest quality solutions for our customers and operational teams.

This role is eligible for inclusion in the Company’s hybrid working from home policy.

Qualifications

Commercial experience within web clients or server-side development.
Experience working with front and backend technology.
Knowledge of Kafka, SQL, .Net, Golang or Typescript, though expertise in similar or alternative technologies is welcome.
Ability to clearly communicate technical matters to people across different areas of the Business.
Experience working in an environment with high volumes of change.
Experience with software development methodologies and best practices.
Understanding of the development of automation and developer tooling such as Continuous Build and CI systems.
Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a relevant discipline, or relevant professional experience.

new_jobs.title: Principal Consultant (Software Development)
new_jobs.description:
Around the world, SYSTRA’s specialists plan, design, integrate, test, commission, project manage and deliver mass transit and mobility solutions that are relied on by more than 50 million people every day.

For more than 60 years, the Group has been committed to helping cities and regions contribute to their development by creating, improving and modernising their transport infrastructure with sustainability, accessibility and innovation at the heart of our designs. With over 10,300 colleagues globally and around 1000 in the UK & Ireland we are growing significantly and seeking out the very best talent to join the SYSTRA signature team and be part of leading the way in infrastructure design.

Context

The Principal Consultant (Software Development) will design, build, and maintain high-performance software systems while acting as a technical reference point for less experienced team members. You will work closely with the Technical Lead and cross-functional teams to deliver features that are reliable, testable, and maintainable — contributing to architecture decisions and championing engineering best practices across the codebase

Missions/Main Duties

Design, develop, and maintain SYSTRA's proprietary microsimulation software Paramics Discovery using C++, C#, and Python across the full software development lifecycle.
Write clean, efficient, well-documented code with a strong emphasis on testability and performance.
Participate in architectural and design discussions, contributing well-reasoned proposals and technical trade-off analysis.
Review code from peers and provide constructive, detailed feedback that raises the quality bar for the whole team.
Collaborate with DevOps colleagues to optimise CI/CD pipelines and ensure smooth, repeatable deployments.
Interact with SQL databases - writing, reviewing, and optimising queries and stored procedures.
Mentor less experienced developers, supporting their technical growth and embedding best practices.
Contribute to test strategies including unit, integration, and performance testing.
Participate in agile ceremonies: sprint planning, stand-ups, retrospectives, and technical refinements.
Demonstrate behaviours aligned with SYSTRA’s behavioural framework by actively fostering a culture of excellence, collaboration, respect, and empowerment, contributing to an environment where all colleagues can thrive, achieve and grow together

Profile/Skills

Essential Skills / Knowledge / Experience

Proficient in C++. Strong command of modern C++ (C++14/17/20), including memory management, templates, STL, and performance optimisation.
Proficient in C#: Solid experience with the .NET ecosystem, including .NET Core / .NET 6+, async programming, and OOP design patterns.
Proficient in Python: scripting, automation, data processing, or back-end service development.
Software Engineering Fundamentals: Deep understanding of algorithms, data structures, design patterns, and SOLID principles.
Debugging & Testing: Experience with unit testing frameworks (e.g. Google Test, NUnit, pytest) and profiling / debugging complex systems.
Version Control: Comfortable with Git-based workflows including branching strategies, pull requests, and code review processes.
Communication: Able to explain technical decisions clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
configuration and deployment of solutions

Desirable Skills / Knowledge / Experience

SQL: Experience writing and optimising SQL queries, stored procedures, and working with large relational datasets.
DevOps Practices: Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (e.g. Jenkins, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps), containerisation (Docker), and infrastructure as code.
Cloud Platforms: Exposure to AWS, Azure, or GCP - particularly compute, storage, and networking services.
Regulated Environments: Experience working in high-integrity, or regulated industries (e.g. defence, finance, transport, aerospace) is advantageous.
Cross-language Systems: Experience integrating components written in multiple languages (e.g. C++ core engine exposed via Python bindings).

new_jobs.description:
Engineering Manager — Own the Backend Behind the Data That Runs Modern Football

Every top-flight football club analyses the game differently now than it did five years ago and that shift runs through data infrastructure most fans will never see.

This is a chance to become the Engineering Manager and lead the team who are building it...

We are looking for a Engineering Manager to run two squads (~8 engineers) building the platform and API layer behind a market-leading football analytics product. This is the kind of tool used inside the walls of Premier League, La Liga, and Serie A clubs to make real tactical and recruitment decisions. Liverpool. Manchester City. Clubs competing at the very top of the European game, working off data your team ships.

The are looking for a former senior/staff engineer with deep hands-on technical depth who transitioned into engineering management, retaining the credibility to challenge system design decisions while now focusing on leading and growing the team.

Why this role is genuinely rare:

Most EM roles ask you to choose between staying technical and going all-in on people leadership. This one refuses that trade-off. You'll be deep enough in architecture and system design to challenge senior engineers and shape how the platform evolves.

At the same time, you're building and growing a high-performing team, not writing code day to day.

It also sits at a genuine intersection point that's hard to find elsewhere: a product with real end users and real commercial stakes (not internal tooling), an API-first data platform doing interesting engineering problems at scale, and a business that is actively investing in AI-augmented engineering as a working practice, not a slide in a strategy deck.

What you need:

Solid background in software engineering with backend depth - (C#/.NET or equivalent), TypeScript, and AWS or Azure)
3+ years managing engineering teams
A track record as a strong individual contributor or tech lead before moving into management
Experience designing APIs and platforms that other teams build on top of
A background shipping customer-facing product, not just internal infrastructure
Genuine, active use of AI tooling in your day-to-day workflow (this is a forward-leaning, AI-first engineering culture)

What makes it different

You won't be managing from a distance. You'll be trusted to get into the technical weeds, influence architecture decisions, and lead a team solving problems for one of the most demanding, highest-scrutiny data products in sport where the people using your platform are analysing matches at the elite end of the game.

About the role:

London-based & hybrid
Paying a competitive base + bonus + stock + excellent benefits package
Working with leading premier league football teams + more

new_jobs.description:
Lead Integrations Engineer | Azure | Up to £100,000 + 20% Bonus | Manchester (Hybrid, 2 days/week)

On behalf of a leading UK retail and e-commerce brand, Venturi is hiring a Lead Integrations Engineer to own the target integration architecture for a well-known, fast-growing consumer name.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You'll spend roughly half your week in code, building and reviewing the most complex integrations on the Azure stack, and the other half on architecture, standards and leading the Integrations team.

The role
Own the integration architecture connecting major SaaS platforms (including Workday, Oracle Symphony and NetSuite) to data, finance and operational systems
Personally design and build the highest-risk, most complex integrations on Azure (APIM, Logic Apps, Function Apps, Service Bus, Event Grid)
Line-manage the Integrations Engineers: performance, development, one-to-ones and engineering culture
Lead the controlled migration off a legacy MuleSoft Anypoint estate onto Azure, keeping legacy flows safely operational until retirement
Define and enforce integration patterns and standards across the team, from API design to observability and security
Review pull requests, pair on the hardest problems, and act as senior technical escalation point for major incidents

What you'll need

Recent, hands-on Azure integration build experience.
You've personally designed and built production integrations on Azure (APIM, Logic Apps, Function Apps, Service Bus) with code committed in the last 12 months. This is a builder-manager role, not a hands-off one.
Real experience leading engineers
, whether as a line manager or technical lead, including performance management and development of a team.

Beyond those two essentials:
6+ years in integration/API engineering
Strong API design skills (REST, JSON, OpenAPI) and event-driven patterns
Experience integrating enterprise SaaS systems (Workday, Oracle Symphony, NetSuite, Salesforce or similar)
Solid grounding in API security on Azure (OAuth 2.0, JWT, mTLS, Managed Identity, Key Vault, APIM policies)
Right to work in the UK without sponsorship

MuleSoft experience is a bonus, not a requirement, if your Azure delivery is current and strong.

What's on offer
Salary up to £100,000 with 20% bonus potential
33+ days annual leave, rising with service

new_jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer
new_jobs.description:
About Bounty

Bounty has supported UK parents since 1959, when it launched with hospital-given packs for new
mothers, and today reaches millions of families each year through the Bounty app, prenatal packs in
clinical settings, and bounty.com. Bounty is part of Joy, an AI-powered parenting platform that pairs
certified experts with AI to give parents round-the-clock support, alongside sister brands and
services across the group.

The Bounty app and bounty.com support hundreds of thousands of parents each month through
pregnancy, birth, and early parenthood. We're now investing in a full modernisation of the platform
behind that experience — a ground-up rebuild designed to give the business a faster, more flexible
foundation for years to come. We're hiring the person who'll lead that rebuild.

The role in brief

Come in, understand what we've built to date, then design and build a modern replacement for the
backend APIs that power the mobile app and website. Preserve the existing users, their data, and
our search ranking through the move. Then rebuild the website on the new backend.

What you'll be doing

Understand the current platform
Get familiar with our current environment: Sitecore, SQL Server and .NET on Azure IaaS, along with a network of scheduled tasks, SFTP feeds and partner integrations built up over time.
Some areas are better documented than others, so part of the role is building a clear, first-hand picture by exploring the code and observing the live systems directly, supported by AI tooling to move quickly.
Document your findings and recommended approach: target stack, migration plan, realistic timeline, risks, and how we keep the app and website running throughout the rebuild.

Rebuild the backend
Design and build the replacement backend API from scratch. We already have the mobile app's API contract documented (OpenAPI 3.1 spec, around 40 endpoints, mapped from the app codebases). The new backend needs to match that contract so we don't have to re-ship the app.
Migrate existing users and their data (accounts, permissions, engagement history, vouchers, editorial content) into the new data model. Nobody should have to re-register.
Switch over from the current backend once you're confident, with a written rollback plan you've tested in advance.

Rebuild the website
SEO is the biggest priority to protect. Rebuild bounty.com off Sitecore onto a modern stack you propose and we agree together. The site ranks well, and that ranking is worth real money, so URLs, redirects and structured data all need to carry over cleanly.

Keep it running
Once the move is complete, the day-to-day is keeping the new stack healthy and making sure integrations (Klaviyo, Purchasely, partner feeds) stay reliable. Our React-based Voucher
Management System sits with you too, both keeping it running and picking up feature work on it.
You'll also keep the analytics pipelines healthy (BigQuery, Looker Studio, Mixpanel) so the business team can rely on them for reporting.

Build what's next
With solid foundations in place, you'll work with the Bounty team on their product roadmap: new
features, improvements to what's there, and whatever the business needs from a platform built to
move quickly. This is where the rebuild starts paying off.

Who you are

Non-negotiables
Lead-level full-stack engineer. You can own a whole system yourself, from database through backend and frontend to deployment and monitoring, and you're comfortable making the architectural calls. You'll own this project end-to-end, with our mobile app engineers available to support you where the app side needs input.
Strong production backend in Node/TypeScript. We're standardising on TypeScript across the stack, so this role can extend into other engineering work at Bounty (and sister brand Joy) over time. React/TypeScript on the frontend is a given.
API design discipline. REST, OpenAPI, versioning, backward compatibility, deprecation. You've kept a client-consumed API stable over time.
Comfort with established systems. You don't need prior experience with our specific stack, but you're comfortable getting to grips with systems that are new to you — reading the actual code and running the actual systems rather than guessing.
Sensible use of AI-assisted development. You use AI tools day-to-day and know when to trust them and when not to, especially around company data, IP, and hallucinations.
Clear writing. You can put together a technical proposal or a handover document without hand-holding. You'll be writing for non-technical stakeholders throughout.
Good judgement about scope. You know when to park a nice-to-have because it's holding up the critical path, and when to flag a scope risk before it becomes a delivery problem.

Nice to have
You've led a live data migration before, at real scale, without losing data or breaking things. You understand why dual-write, reconciliation and a rehearsed cutover matter.
SEO awareness (URL preservation, canonical tags, structured data, redirect chains).
Azure and/or GCP experience. We're on Azure today and moving toward GCP to align with the wider organisation.

Explicitly not required
Please don't rule yourself out because you haven't used our specific stack or third-party tools before.
None of that is a blocker, the parts that matter, you'll pick up quickly.

What we offer

Salary range £90k–£115k, depending on experience.
Remote (UK), with occasional in-person time for team offsites.
25 days holiday.
Pension: 3% employer + 5% personal contribution.
Life assurance at 2x salary.
Option to enrol in private medical cover after a 6-month probation.
Genuinely interesting work: you'll build something modern from scratch with real autonomy, rather than shipping small features on an existing platform.
A well-established brand with a loyal, sizeable audience — hundreds of thousands of parents will be using what you build.

How to apply

Send a CV plus a short note (under 400 words) covering:
The most complex legacy or platform rebuild you've led, and what surprised you about it.
One thing you'd want to understand about our current setup before committing to a target architecture.

Applications via LinkedIn only. Closing date: 30 September 2026.

As our new Engineering Architect, you will own and evolve the technical foundations that underpin product and service delivery, including engineering standards, development frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, testing harnesses, observability, and operational practices.

Your focus will be on enabling a fast-moving, AI-first delivery team to consistently deliver high-quality, scalable, and supportable solutions without needing to rebuild core foundations for every delivery cycle.

What you'll do

In this varied role, you will:
own and version technical foundations across all seven harness dimensions (Security, performance, coding style, UI/UX baselines, logging and observability, testing) so that every deliverable inherits secure, observable and tested defaults
build and maintain the shared ADO CI/CD pipelines and release governance so that standards are enforced automatically, and DORA metrics are produced from the pipeline itself
own the light-touch technical governance model - automated gates over committee review
ensure observability is instrumented from the first commit through to live running so that everything the team ships can be operated and handed over to a receiving product team
contribute hands-on as a full-stack builder inside each delivery's time box so that the harness stays credible and drift is caught in days rather than at cycle end
own the design and hands-on running of the delivery stack end to end - application architecture, containerisation, virtualisation, networking and deployment topology - so that what the team builds can be stood up, scaled and supported in the Azure estate without external dependency
shape deliveries as one of three leads, testing technical feasibility and setting the no-gos, so that committed work stays inside its appetite
represent the team's technical position in assurance, security and enterprise architecture conversations
proactively track industry trends, emerging tools and agentic engineering practice, and self-initiate the learning needed to apply them - trialling promising techniques and approaches in cooldown and sharing what works back into the harness, rules files and skills library.

What you'll need

We are looking for:
deep, current full stack engineering capability with hands-on delivery in an Azure and Azure DevOps (ADO) ecosystem using infrastructure as code approaches
strong practical coding experience in Python and JavaScript/TypeScript, with the fluency to work across back-end services, front-end interfaces and automation scripting
sound stack design judgement, with working knowledge of containerisation, virtualisation and networking sufficient to design, deploy and troubleshoot applications across Azure environments
proven ownership of CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, release governance and DORA-based delivery measurement
strong grounding in security (secret management, dependency and static analysis scanning, least-privilege IAM), observability (structured logging, tracing and metrics) and test and evaluation automation
practical experience of AI-first, agentic delivery - rules files, known-good templates, curated skills libraries and evaluation harnesses for AI-generated output
ability to codify standards as machine-readable scaffolding rather than documentation, and to balance light-touch governance against delivery speed
credibility to represent the team's technical position with enterprise architecture, security and assurance functions
experience designing and delivering production-grade AI software systems across different domains
proven expertise in designing and/or implementing generative AI systems in production, including agentic systems, RAG pipelines, tool-use patterns, and model adaptation strategies
practical experience in retrieval and knowledge systems
breadth of knowledge across modern AI technologies, including generative models, deep learning, and predictive ML.

25 days' holiday rising to 28 with length of service.

Support from trained mental health first aiders.

The project:
New Canary Wharf HQ represents an opportunity to redefine digital delivery standards on one of a leading Financial Institutions most important London developments. The project has been specifically established to avoid lessons learned from previous programmes where inconsistent BIM adoption across the supply chain resulted in significant handover challenges and incomplete information records.

This role offers the chance to shape BIM strategy, drive innovation and establish a leading BIM-to-Digital-Twin delivery model for the flagship global client.

We are seeking an experienced Senior BIM Manager to lead Digital Delivery, Information Management and BIM Governance for a financial institutions new HQ development in Canary Wharf, London where you will be onsite with the client on a hybrid basis.

This is a high-profile project that will establish a benchmark for BIM-enabled project delivery and digital twin readiness across the institutions real estate portfolio. The successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring that BIM requirements are embedded from project inception through design, construction, handover and operational readiness.

Working closely with the clients Design and Construction stakeholders, designers, contractors and specialist trade partners, you will drive compliance with BIM Requirements, ISO 19650 processes and digital twin objectives, ensuring that all project information is delivered in a structured, coordinated and operationally useful manner. The role will also play a key part in preparing project information for integration into Autodesk Tandem and future operational digital twin environments.

You’ll Be Responsible For

Information management leadership

Manage the implementation of BIM and Information Management processes in accordance with ISO 19650.
Act as the primary BIM and Digital Delivery lead for the project.
Establish project BIM governance, assurance and reporting processes.
Review and monitor compliance with Employer's Information Requirements (EIR), Asset Information Requirements (AIR), BIM Execution Plans (BEP), MIDPs and TIDPs.
Provide strategic guidance to designers, contractors and trade contractors on BIM implementation.

BIM assurance and compliance

Undertake formal BIM compliance reviews at key project milestones.
Monitor model quality, metadata completeness, naming compliance and information standards.
Review federated models for coordination and constructability.
Conduct BIM maturity and supply-chain capability assessments.
Produce BIM compliance dashboards in Tableau, risk registers and executive reporting for bank’s stakeholders.

Design and construction coordination

Facilitate BIM coordination workshops and design review sessions.
Oversee clash detection processes and issue management workflows.
Ensure coordination issues are identified, assigned and resolved.
Monitor contractor and subcontractor model delivery throughout construction.
Drive accountability across the supply chain to ensure BIM deliverables are maintained throughout the project lifecycle.

Asset information and digital twin readiness

Define and oversee asset information requirements and data governance processes.
Review COBie deliverables and asset metadata quality.
Ensure information required for operations and facilities management is captured progressively throughout the project.
Support the development and population of the Asset Information Model (AIM).
Prepare project information for handover into Autodesk Tandem and future digital twin environments.

Stakeholder management

Serve as the primary point of contact for all BIM-related matters.

About The Role

Grade Level (for internal use):

12

The Team

The Structured Finance (SF) Methodologies team is responsible for a large portfolio of criteria and models spanning the global SF universe, including CMBS, RMBS, CLO, Covered Bonds, Non-Traditional and ABS asset types. The criteria and models that the group develops and maintains help analysts produce independent credit ratings that increase S&P Global’s analytical relevance in the market. As a Methodology Model SME, the position is embedded within the SF team and works closely with the Model and Criteria SMEs, who are responsible for developing and maintaining a growing portfolio of cutting-edge quantitative tools and analysis that enable analysts to continually produce high-quality and transparent credit analysis.

The Impact

The Associate Director enhances S&P Global Ratings’ ability to produce high-impact, insightful research and models and supports the continued growth of S&P Global Ratings’ relevance in an evolving market by synthesizing, analyzing, and deriving value from datasets, developing innovative analytic solutions and tools, and helping to build data analytics capabilities across the SF team.

What’s in it for you?

The role leverages quantitative abilities to develop analytic solutions and tools that enable credit analysts to perform high-quality analysis and research.
The position explores new areas for research and aids in business development initiatives. It supervises and performs implementation and testing of quantitative models as prototypes and production engines using the Quantitative Toolbox as appropriate, to further the study, application and acceptance of quantitative methodologies as part of the firm’s businesses.
The role offers a challenging, steep learning curve, and the position could lead to continued growth within the organization by demonstrating strong analysis and presentation skills.
Gain analytic knowledge of a wide range of global sectors and market topics.
Gain exposure to stakeholders across S&P Ratings and enjoy a strong collegial, collaborative environment.

Responsibilities

Develop and maintain nimble, user-friendly quantitative solutions and tools that will be used by credit analysts globally in credit rating analyses and research publications.
Synthesize and analyze large datasets to derive analytic value and insights for credit rating analyses and research publications.
Proactively identify and implement creative solutions to drive continuous improvement across models and analytical workflows.
Provide analytical insight and technical guidance to help the team resolve complex, non-routine problems and tasks.
Maintain close interaction with analysts, model developers, and subject matter experts to ensure that data analyses and tools effectively inform analytical decisions.
Work closely with the Model and Criteria Validation group to ensure a high-quality product.
Write clear, concise specifications and development documentation to ensure consistent and thorough documentation in accordance with policy and procedures.
Support criteria projects and be an active member of projects, including testing of new concepts, data gathering, writing and preparation of materials.
Coach and guide junior developers on technical tasks and best practices; support criteria projects by assisting with tool development, testing, and data gathering 

Compensation / Benefits Information

S&P Global states that the anticipated base salary range for this position is $148,491 to $176,000 USD (This section is only applicable to US Candidates). Final base salary for this role will be based on the individual’s geographic location, as well as experience level, skill set, training, licenses, and certifications. In addition to base compensation, this role is eligible for an annual incentive plan. For more information on the benefits we provide to our employees, please visit spgbenefits.com/benefit-summaries.

Basic Qualifications

What We’re Looking For:

An S&P Global employee at this level would typically have 5 to 7 years of experience in quantitative modeling or software development supporting financial analysis.
Knowledge of capital markets and financial instruments, with an emphasis on credit risk modeling preferred.
Basic understanding of database modeling/design and applications, including knowledge of SQL and experience in databases such as Oracle, Sybase, or Access.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel/VBA and programming languages such as R, Python, C++, and MATLAB.
Persistent with a natural curiosity about credit markets and technical details.
Displays well-rounded communication skills that implement good listening techniques, clear and good verbal skills. The ability to communicate across a wide range of groups and personalities internally and externally.
Works well in a team environment, focusing on collaboration and adapting to the needs of a diverse team.

Additional Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Finance, Financial Engineering, Statistics, Quantitative Finance, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics, or a related field 
Self-starter with the ability to work independently and collaborate effectively across diverse teams.
Able to summarize complex quantitative concepts clearly and concisely for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Experience supporting multi-stage projects from planning through execution.
Strong time management, prioritization and deadline-management skills.
Effective communication, interpersonal and facilitation skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
Strong customer service orientation and stakeholder-management skills.
Creative problem-solver who works well in fast-paced environments.
We require all candidates who reach the final stage of our interview process to attend at least one in-person interview, which is ordinarily at your nearest S&P Global Ratings office. This must be completed before we can proceed to an offer.
All employees are required to work from the office a minimum of 2 days per week

About S&P Global Ratings

At S&P Global Ratings, our analyst-driven credit ratings, research, and sustainable finance opinions provide critical insights that are essential to translating complexity into clarity so market participants can uncover opportunities and make decisions with conviction. By bringing transparency to the market through high-quality independent opinions on creditworthiness, we enable growth across a wide variety of organizations, including businesses, governments, and institutions.

S&P Global Ratings is a division of S&P Global (NYSE: SPGI). S&P Global is the world’s foremost provider of credit ratings, benchmarks, analytics and workflow solutions in the global capital, commodity and automotive markets. With every one of our offerings, we help many of the world’s leading organizations navigate the economic landscape so they can plan for tomorrow, today.

For more information, visit www.spglobal.com/ratings

You?

Our Mission

Advancing Essential Intelligence.

We're more than 35,000 strong worldwide—so we're able to understand nuances while having a broad perspective. Our team is driven by curiosity and a shared belief that Essential Intelligence can help build a more prosperous future for us all.From finding new ways to measure sustainability to analyzing energy transition across the supply chain to building workflow solutions that make it easy to tap into insight and apply it. The Role:

As a Senior Solutions Architect specializing in containerized solutions, you will play a crucial, pioneering role in this new initiative. Your primary focus will be leading the deployment of these solutions within our customer environments.

Solutions Architects are vital members of our project teams, often serving as the initial technical point of contact for our customers and key technical stakeholders for a successful deployment of Celonis. To ensure our customers achieve value, you will drive the technical setup required to leverage the full range of Celonis features and functionalities, including process mining, execution management, process automation, Action Flow, and task mining.

Given the unique nature of every customer environment, you will be the key liaison for translating the customer's technical requirements to ensure successful deployment on the clients infrastructure and successful integrations with their source systems. Furthermore, you will lead discussions on user management and authentication, acting as a technical partner to remove any technical barriers to user adoption.

The work you’ll do:

On Celonis side you are the key technical stakeholder for a successful technical delivery and onboarding of Celonis for enterprise clients.
Lead technical discussions to analyze customer architecture, recommend optimal solutions, and facilitate deployment, managing expectations amidst technical constraints.
Remove technical obstacles to maximize Celonis user adoption, clarifying technical risks and necessary tradeoffs.
Promote reusability by choosing between dedicated customer solutions and broader platform enhancements in collaboration with Celonis product development.
Establish real-time data integrations between customer systems and Celonis via APIs and internal tools.
Guide customers on authentication, user/group management, and provisioning best practices. Thus, removing all technical barriers to drive user adoption of Celonis.

Proven experience of 5+ years, with at least 3 years in deploying and managing containerized applications on Kubernetes.
Advanced knowledge with at least one specific Kubernetes distribution (Amazon EKS, Azure AKS, RedHat OpenShift, etc.).
Eligibility for UK Security Check (SC) clearance is required; existing clearance is a strong advantage.

A solution-oriented professional that enjoys deep technical discussions as much as transferring your technical knowledge into understandable terms to a broader audience

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today's challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future. Leveraging Data, AI, and real-time decision-making we turn energy complexity into growth opportunities for our partners.

By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable and affordable.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

What will I be doing?

As a Senior Pre-Sales Engineer
, you are a "developer-plus" technical contributor. You are responsible for building high-quality mock backends, APIs, and demo infrastructure, but with a unique twist: you leverage LLMs and Generative AI
to prototype at high velocity.

This role sits at the critical boundary between Product Engineering and Go-to-Market. While you won't build production systems, you will build "production-shaped" assets: reusable, well-structured, and documented services that enable credible technical storytelling and high-fidelity client validation.

Your core responsibilities will include:

AI-Accelerated Prototyping: Leverage LLMs (e.g., Claude and Gemini) to rapidly scaffold, build, and iterate on proof-of-concept apps and mock services. You move faster than a traditional sprint by using AI to handle the "heavy lifting" of boilerplate and logic generation.
Technical Asset Development: Design, build, and maintain reusable mock services in Node.js / TypeScript. You’ll implement contract-first APIs (REST/GraphQL), manage AWS deployments (API Gateway, Containers), and handle persistence using PostgreSQL or DynamoDB
Infrastructure as Code: Manage demo environments using Terraform, ensuring environments are reproducible and secure using existing OIDC authentication patterns.
Frontend Collaboration: Work closely with frontend engineers to ensure UI components point cleanly to your mock services, debugging integration issues and supporting end-to-end demo flows.
Strategic Pre-Sales Support: Partner with Pre-Sales consultants to translate client "win themes" into working technical artefacts. You will occasionally demo directly to clients, showcasing how Kaluza solves their specific retail challenges.
Product & UX Influence: Collaborate with Design and Product teams for UI direction while developing your own design ideas to make Kaluza’s capabilities shine.
Mentorship & Standards: Set informal engineering standards for the pre-sales team, mentoring others on API design and architecture.
AI Evangelism: Act as the resident expert in GenAI workflows for the Commercial team, mentoring others on how to use AI to bridge the gap between "slide-ware" and "software."

What this role is NOT:

A pure presentation-led role (you will be writing code regularly).
Shipping production code (your value comes from building things that work for a demo, not maintaining production SLOs).

About You

You are a software engineer by trade but a prototyper by heart. You understand the rigour of clean code but know when to lean into AI to accelerate delivery. You are motivated by the immediate impact of winning new clients and validating Kaluza’s value proposition in real-time.

Ideally you’ll have/be:

Software Engineering Foundation: Strong hands-on experience in Node.js / TypeScript and React. You know how to write code from scratch, which is why you’re so good at prompting AI to do it for you.
GenAI Power User: Deep experience leveraging LLMs and Generative AI to build apps, debug complex issues, and accelerate the development lifecycle. You aren't just using an AI assistant; you are "vibe coding" complete PoCs.

new_jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
new_jobs.description:
At MHR, our employees are central to our success and play a key role in helping customers achieve sustainable high performance. With a team of over 900 professionals, we work to make things flow smoothly, whether it's for large organisations or individual employees. As businesses face rapid changes in the world of work, our team is here to help them adapt and thrive.

By focusing on the core needs of efficiency, productivity, growth, and impact, our employees use their expertise to deliver real solutions through our People and Finance platform. This system, which covers finance, HR, payroll, and learning, helps businesses run more smoothly and make better decisions in real time.

With over 40 years of experience behind us, MHR’s track record as a high-performance organisation is built on clear goals, a shared vision, and strong communication - all of which we pass on to our customers.

MHR is more than just a place to work; it’s a platform for empowerment. Joining us means bringing innovation, technology, and teamwork seamlessly removes obstacles, enhances your skills, and allow you to focus on what’s most important to you- work that matters.

With us, you’ll grow, find your flow, and make a lasting difference in your career, your team, and your impact.

Your Career

Join MHR as a Principal Software Engineer, leading complex engineering challenges that shape our products and technical direction.

In this role, you will operate across the organisation—defining strategy, influencing architecture, and guiding delivery within a modern SaaS environment. Drawing on experience with Microsoft technologies such as .NET and Azure, you’ll apply modern programming practices including cloud-native design, distributed systems, and test-driven development.

You will also champion AI-assisted development to improve engineering efficiency, quality, and innovation. This is a high-impact position combining hands-on expertise with technical leadership and mentoring.

Your Team

You’ll work across cross-functional Agile teams, partnering closely with engineers, architects, and stakeholders.
Through influence rather than authority, you’ll help align teams and foster a collaborative, inclusive culture focused on continuous improvement.

Your Impact

This role will see you defining and executing technical strategy, shaping scalable, resilient architecture aligned with business goals.

You’ll drive engineering excellence through best practice—embedding test-driven development and using AI-assisted tooling to enhance delivery. Working across teams, you’ll help align priorities, mitigate risks, and ensure consistent, high-quality outcomes, while mentoring engineers to strengthen capability.

As a trusted technical leader, you’ll balance long-term vision with delivery outcomes.

What you’ll bring to the role and MHR

Strong experience with Microsoft technologies (.NET, Azure) and modern engineering practices
Expertise in scalable architecture and cloud-native systems
Proven ability to deliver technical strategy and complex initiatives
Advocate of TDD, continuous improvement, and AI-assisted engineering
Strong collaboration and stakeholder communication skills
Experience mentoring engineers and raising technical standards

Benefits to support you personally and professionally

Alongside the opportunity to work with an incredible team and express your individuality, we offer a range of personalised benefits including:

Access to over 60 internal training courses, professional qualifications, and cross-departmental mentoring and coaching programs
24/7 access to a GP through Help at Hand for you and your family, confidential mental health support, and paid sick leave
Ability to purchase or sell additional holiday days beyond 25 days and bank holidays
Enhanced Family leave
My MHRewards offering discounts at over 900 retailers
Monthly employee recognition program and departmental awards
Referral bonus scheme of up to £2,000
Employee-led social events such as running clubs, football teams, book clubs, and bake-offs
On-site subsidised restaurants offering a variety of fresh meals daily
Opt-in benefits schemes such as private medical insurance and dental coverage

We value the well-being, financial stability, and inclusivity of our employees, and strive to provide a supportive working environment.

At MHR, we’re completely committed to creating a supportive and inclusive workplace where all voices are heard, and everyone feels valued and supported.

Whatever your background, abilities and experiences, if you’re excited by this role we want to hear from you. If you require assistance for an interview, please let us know and we’ll make sure your needs are met when you arrive.

If we receive an exceptionally high volume of applications, we reserve the right to close this vacancy earlier than originally advertised.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be a technical leader within your team, responsible for delivering complex full-stack web applications, serving millions of users, driving technical excellence, and mentoring other engineers. Design and deliver complex, scalable systems

Own large features or entire components
across their complete lifecycle from conception to production support
Make commercially aware technical decisions

Lead technical discussions

Drive technical excellence

for owned systems to enable team continuity

Lead story refinement sessions
with Product Owners, providing technical expertise for estimation and risk assessment
Partner with cross-functional teams
(product, design, QA) to deliver comprehensive solutions that meet business objectives
Influence technology choices
based on deep technical understanding and business context

to drive continuous process improvements, and establish team practices that enhance delivery predictability
Proactively identify and inspire resolution
of technical debt and system improvements

Champion comprehensive quality practices
including TDD/BDD standards, automated testing strategies, and shift-left testing
Lead security implementation across complex features
establish security practices and conduct comprehensive security reviews
Establish development tooling and practices
used consistently within the team

actively to raise team capability and technical standards

Around the world, SYSTRA’s specialists plan, design, integrate, test, commission, project manage and deliver mass transit and mobility solutions that are relied on by more than 50 million people every day.

For more than 60 years, the Group has been committed to helping cities and regions contribute to their development by creating, improving and modernising their transport infrastructure with sustainability, accessibility and innovation at the heart of our designs. With over 10,300 colleagues globally and around 1000 in the UK & Ireland we are growing significantly and seeking out the very best talent to join the SYSTRA signature team and be part of leading the way in infrastructure design.

Context

The Principal Consultant (Software Development) will design, build, and maintain high-performance software systems while acting as a technical reference point for less experienced team members. You will work closely with the Technical Lead and cross-functional teams to deliver features that are reliable, testable, and maintainable — contributing to architecture decisions and championing engineering best practices across the codebase

Missions/Main Duties

Design, develop, and maintain SYSTRA's proprietary microsimulation software Paramics Discovery using C++, C#, and Python across the full software development lifecycle.
Write clean, efficient, well-documented code with a strong emphasis on testability and performance.
Participate in architectural and design discussions, contributing well-reasoned proposals and technical trade-off analysis.
Review code from peers and provide constructive, detailed feedback that raises the quality bar for the whole team.
Collaborate with DevOps colleagues to optimise CI/CD pipelines and ensure smooth, repeatable deployments.
Interact with SQL databases - writing, reviewing, and optimising queries and stored procedures.
Mentor less experienced developers, supporting their technical growth and embedding best practices.
Contribute to test strategies including unit, integration, and performance testing.
Participate in agile ceremonies: sprint planning, stand-ups, retrospectives, and technical refinements.
Demonstrate behaviours aligned with SYSTRA’s behavioural framework by actively fostering a culture of excellence, collaboration, respect, and empowerment, contributing to an environment where all colleagues can thrive, achieve and grow together

Profile/Skills

Essential Skills / Knowledge / Experience

Proficient in C++. Strong command of modern C++ (C++14/17/20), including memory management, templates, STL, and performance optimisation.
Proficient in C#: Solid experience with the .NET ecosystem, including .NET Core / .NET 6+, async programming, and OOP design patterns.
Proficient in Python: scripting, automation, data processing, or back-end service development.
Software Engineering Fundamentals: Deep understanding of algorithms, data structures, design patterns, and SOLID principles.
Debugging & Testing: Experience with unit testing frameworks (e.g. Google Test, NUnit, pytest) and profiling / debugging complex systems.
Version Control: Comfortable with Git-based workflows including branching strategies, pull requests, and code review processes.
Communication: Able to explain technical decisions clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
configuration and deployment of solutions

Cloud Platforms: Exposure to AWS, Azure, or GCP - particularly compute, storage, and networking services.
Regulated Environments: Experience working in high-integrity, or regulated industries (e.g. defence, finance, transport, aerospace) is advantageous.
