new_jobs.title: Software Engineering Manager
new_jobs.description:
At MHR, our employees are central to our success and play a key role in helping customers achieve sustainable high performance. With a team of over 900 professionals, we work to make things flow smoothly, whether it's for large organisations or individual employees. As businesses face rapid changes in the world of work, our team is here to help them adapt and thrive.

By focusing on the core needs of efficiency, productivity, growth, and impact, our employees use their expertise to deliver real solutions through our People and Finance platform. This system, which covers finance, HR, payroll, and learning, helps businesses run more smoothly and make better decisions in real time.

With over 40 years of experience behind us, MHR’s track record as a high-performance organisation is built on clear goals, a shared vision, and strong communication - all of which we pass on to our customers.

MHR is more than just a place to work; it’s a platform for empowerment. Joining us means bringing innovation, technology, and teamwork seamlessly removes obstacles, enhances your skills, and allow you to focus on what’s most important to you- work that matters.

With us, you’ll grow, find your flow, and make a lasting difference in your career, your team, and your impact.

Your Career

As a Software Engineering Manager at MHR, you'll lead a cross-functional team of Software Engineers and Test Engineers, helping build the next generation of our cloud-based HR and Payroll platform. You'll combine people leadership with technical influence, fostering a culture of engineering excellence, test-driven development and continuous improvement.

Working with modern technologies including .NET, Angular, Azure and AI-assisted development tools, you'll help shape how software is built while supporting the growth and success of your team.

Your Team

You'll lead a collaborative Agile team of engineers and testers, working closely with Product and Scrum teams to deliver high-quality software. new_jobs.title: Manager, Software Engineering (BI & Analytics)
new_jobs.description:
Get to Know Us

Since being founded in 2001, BlackLine has become a leading provider of cloud software that automates and controls the entire financial close process. Our vision is to modernize the finance and accounting function to enable greater operational effectiveness and agility, and we are committed to delivering innovative solutions and services to empower accounting and finance leaders around the world to achieve Modern Finance.
Being a best-in-class SaaS company, we understand that bringing in new ideas and innovative technology is mission critical. At BlackLine we are always working with new, cutting-edge technology that encourages our teams to learn something new and expand their creativity and technical skillset that will accelerate their careers.
This role is specifically for our AI-powered Invoice-to-Cash (I2C) solution, a market-leading platform that uses intelligent automation to help companies collect cash faster, unlock working capital, and supercharge efficiency in their accounts receivable processes.
Work, Play and Grow at BlackLine!

Make Your Mark

As the founding Manager, Software Engineering for our new Business Intelligence & Analytics Engineering team
in Krakow, you have one of the most consequential roles in this new chapter of BlackLine's growth. This is a genuinely multi-disciplinary team - spanning data engineering, cloud data platforms, BI and analytics, and applied AI - and you will be the architect of the team itself: hiring and developing a world-class group of engineers across those disciplines, and shaping the culture, practices, and career trajectories of everyone in it.
You will lead the team through an ambitious delivery arc. You will start by standing up modern data pipelines - using Fabric database mirroring to move data from our Azure-hosted tenant databases into a canonical data model in Snowflake
- then build the modelling layer and surface insight to customers through Power BI
dashboards. From there, the team will develop true agentic AI experiences for risk analysis, credit management, cash allocation, and Disputes & Deductions (D&D), blending Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) and Human-on-the-Loop (HOTL) patterns on BlackLine's BL 3.0 Agentic framework.
You will partner closely with your senior engineers and cross-functional product leadership to ensure the team operates with clarity, urgency, and a high engineering bar. You will champion a culture of AI-accelerated development, where tools like Claude and Cursor are woven into the everyday fabric of how we build. This is not just a management role - it is a founding leadership role with an enduring impact on our mission to deliver autonomous finance and expand BlackLine's office-of-the-CFO footprint.

You'll Get To

Build and Scale the Krakow BI & Analytics Engineering Team:
Lead the hiring, onboarding, and ongoing development of a high-performing, multi-disciplinary team spanning data engineering, BI/analytics, and AI. Be an ambassador for BlackLine's engineering culture in the Krakow hub from day one.
Deliver the Snowflake Analytics Platform:
Own delivery of our modern data platform - Fabric database mirroring from Azure-hosted tenant databases into a canonical Snowflake data model, the Snowflake modelling and semantic layers, and customer-facing Power BI dashboards that turn that data into insight.
Lead the Agentic Experience Roadmap:
Guide the team from analytics into applied AI - building true agentic agents for risk analysis, credit management, cash allocation, and Disputes & Deductions management, delivering a mix of Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) and Human-on-the-Loop (HOTL) experiences on BlackLine's BL 3.0 Agentic framework, integrated with our existing web applications.
Lead, Coach, and Grow Your Team:
Own the career development, performance, and wellbeing of your direct reports across a varied set of specialisms. Conduct regular 1:1s, provide meaningful feedback, and create growth paths that retain and attract top talent in a competitive Krakow market.
Drive Delivery and Execution:
Partner with Product Management to align on priorities, manage engineering capacity, and ensure the team consistently delivers high-quality software and data products on time. Remove blockers, manage risk, and keep commitments.
Champion AI-Accelerated Development:
Cultivate a team mindset and workflow that embraces modern agentic development tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude) as force multipliers for velocity and quality - and hold the bar high for what great engineering looks like in this era.
Shape Engineering Culture and Standards:
Establish and uphold best practices across the full stack of the team's work - data pipeline reliability and observability, data quality and lineage, dimensional and semantic modelling standards, code quality, CI/CD, testing, and security. Set the tone for a culture of ownership, craft, and continuous improvement.
Collaborate Cross-Functionally:
Serve as the primary engineering leadership voice in conversations with Product, Design, and senior stakeholders, and with the analytics and office-of-the-CFO consumers of the team's output. While our headquarters are based in Denver, Colorado, our team spans the globe, with teammates across Brazil, Poland, the Philippines, Mexico, and beyond. We care deeply about our customers and foster a culture where our company, people and Pros grow and succeed together—no matter where they’re based. 100% remote work

A culture built on innovation that values big ideas, no matter where they come from

Equity in a rapidly growing startup backed by top-tier VCs

About The Role

As a Software Engineer II, you bring growing technical depth, strong problem-solving skills, and the ability to take ownership of features and components across the product. You focus on building scalable, reliable systems, writing well-structured code, and contributing to solutions that deliver real customer value.

We are currently hiring Software Engineers II to join one of two teams within our Platform organization: Identity & Access Management (IAM) or API. The IAM team
focuses on authentication, authorization, and access management, ensuring users can access only the resources and functionality they are permitted to use. One of the team’s key projects involves Keycloak, an open-source Identity and Access Management solution. The API team
owns and improves the backend API layer that powers the Housecall Pro application, with a strong current focus on application performance and creating a fast, reliable user experience.

In this role, you will elevate team effectiveness by sharing knowledge, contributing to design and code reviews. Our team is passionate, empathetic, and committed to improving the lives of our service professionals, our Pros. Your impact will help strengthen our product, enhance user experiences, and support the long-term success of the people we serve.

Compensation: 5,300 - 6,600 USD per month

Design, build, and maintain reliable, performant, and maintainable software systems that deliver real value to users

Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and fellow engineers to translate product goals into technical solutions

Product-oriented thinking, motivated by building solutions that serve real customer needs
Curiosity about emerging technologies and enthusiasm for learning and applying them
Demonstrated ability to leverage AI tools to improve workflows, streamline execution, or enhance outputs

The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.

Tripadvisor Experiences Engineering
is the team that builds and supports the world's leading marketplace for travel experiences
. We believe that making memories is what travel is all about. And with 400,000+ travel experiences to explore—everything from simple tours to extreme adventures (and everything in between) —making memories that will last a lifetime has never been easier.

About The Role

We’re looking for a product-focused Software Engineer II
to join our fast-growing Experiences Engineering team. This is a full-stack role, leveraging Java, SQL, React, AWS and AI tools
. It’s ideal for mid-level engineers who enjoy solving complex problems, shipping frequently, and working in a modern cloud environment. You’ll play a key role in building high-impact features that power millions of traveler experiences globally.

We embrace flexibility in where and how work gets done and also value meaningful in-person moments to connect and collaborate. You can expect a remote-first working model
with periodic in-person gatherings at your closest office for team connection, planning, or other key moments. This position is open to candidates based within a commutable distance (generally up to 1.5 hours) of one of our office hubs in London, Oxford, Krakow or Lisbon.

What You’ll Do

Drive Impact: Connect your engineering work directly to traveler value by owning features from design to deployment.
Shape the Product: Partner with product, design, and data teams to influence what we build, helping to define specifications and find the most efficient path to success.
Collaborate & Mentor: Review code, provide thoughtful feedback, and coach less experienced engineers to maintain a high bar for quality.
Innovate with AI: Use agentic AI as a daily partner to plan approaches, automate routine tasks, and focus your energy on solving more complex technical challenges.
Champion Operational Health: Take hands-on ownership of system reliability by building monitoring dashboards, managing alerts and support cases, and fixing underlying bugs to continuously improve service resilience and eliminate operational toil.
Build for Quality: Design and implement clean, maintainable solutions with a focus on performance, security, and automated testing.

Skills & Experience

We typically look for a minimum of 2-3 years’ experience, following a Bachelor’s degree or above in Comp Science or a related field.

Full-Stack Mindset: Experience developing web apps, including proficiency in a modern backend language (e.g., Java, C#, Go, Python) and familiarity with relational databases.
Problem Solving: A strong grasp of computer science fundamentals (data structures, algorithms) and the ability to apply them to real-world distributed systems.
Data-Driven: A habit of using operational data and experiment results to validate that your changes had the intended effect.
AI Coding: you are fluent coding with either Cursor or Codex/Claude/Open Code.
Global Mindset: Ability to operate effectively within a global team, communicating clearly about progress and blockers.

We don’t expect you to know everything on day one. However, we’re especially interested if you’ve had exposure to AWS, React, or NoSQL databases. More than any specific tool, we value curiosity and the ability to solve problems creatively.

We value engineers from different technical backgrounds. You can complete our coding interview exercises
in any language of your choice, but need to be open to working within the Java ecosystem when you join!

What We Offer

Competitive compensation packages, including base salary, annual bonus, and more.
“Work your way” with flexibility to suit your lifestyle. We take a remote-friendly approach to collaboration, with the option to join on-site as often as you’d like in select locations.
Flexible schedule. Work-life balance is ingrained in our culture by design. Trust and accountability make it work.
Donation matching. Give back? Give more! We match qualifying charitable donations annually.
Tuition assistance. Want to level up your career? We love to hear it! Receive annual support for qualified programs.
Lifestyle benefit. An annual benefit to spend on yourself. Use it on travel, wellness, or whatever suits you.
Travel perks. We believe that travel is employee development, so we provide discounts and more.
Employee assistance program. We’re here for you with resources and programs to help you through life’s challenges.
Health benefits. We offer great coverage and competitive premiums.
Generous referral scheme. Help us grow and be rewarded with generous awards for referring successful candidates.

Our Cultural Pillars

Traveller first: We exist to create value for our customer, the traveler. We enable our suppliers and partners to unlock this value. Their collective behaviors and insights are what drives us.
Execution is our edge: We act fast, experiment, learn from failure, iterate, and improve the solutions of tomorrow across every aspect of our business. Our execution is agile, data-driven, prioritised, and built to scale. We assume no problem is someone else’s problem and finish what can be done today, knowing tomorrow will bring fresh challenges.
We succeed together: The best outcomes are driven by empathic, humble, and diverse subject matter experts working toward shared goals. We collaborate relentlessly, challenge assumptions, give actionable feedback, and set each other up for success through empowered teams with a clear charter. We transparently take ownership of our growth, individually and as a team. We celebrate the quality of our effort, our learnings, and our collective achievements.

Discover more in our Tech Blog, for an inside look into some of our exciting and ground-breaking technical projects here at Tripadvisor Group.

Tripadvisor Group champions the unique identities, abilities, and experiences of all our people – employees, customers, and partners. This stems from our belief in the transformative power of travel, dining, and experiences to connect us and open doors to worlds very different from our own. Our ED&I strategy shapes how we approach our people, culture, business, and reputation. Tripadvisor Group strives to embed inclusion and belonging across all our brands.

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please make sure to reach out to your individual recruiter or our team at AccessibleRecruiting@tripadvisor.com
.

. We have all the answers!

We reduce engineering toil, eliminate technical debt, and enable teams to move forward with confidence as Netflix's technology continues to evolve at pace.

We are not a feature delivery team. We are a revenue protector and accelerator — through our work we enable faster feature delivery, innovation, and security protection across the entire engineering organization.

Netflix operates one of the most sophisticated and high-scale engineering platforms in the world. Keeping that platform on the leading edge requires continuous, intentional modernization. The Paved Path — our curated set of recommended, well-supported infrastructure standards — is constantly advancing as Netflix pushes into new technical territory. Our team exists to bring the fleet along with it: setting clear baselines, accelerating adoption across thousands of services, and protecting that progress from erosion over time. We affect both engineering culture and engineering quality at scale.

We operate in pods (3–6 month cycles), partnering closely with the most strategically critical initiatives across Infrastructure Engineering. We build the automation and tooling that lets us execute these at a scale and speed no manual effort could match, including AI-assisted code modification pipelines and fleet-wide orchestration systems.

About The Role

We are looking for an experienced L5 Software Engineer who thrives at the intersection of large-scale systems, automation, and cross-functional influence. You will design and build the tooling and automation that powers fleet-wide migration campaigns, partner directly with platform and product teams to de-risk complex infrastructure changes, and help define what excellent Paved Path adoption looks like in practice at Netflix.

This is a high-autonomy, high-impact role. You will own migration projects end-to-end — from scoping and technical design through automated execution, quality validation, and completion. You'll also build durable tooling that outlasts any single campaign.

Key Responsibilities

Migration Engineering

Design and execute large-scale code and infrastructure migration campaigns across Netflix's fleet of thousands of repositories and services. Own the full lifecycle: scoping, campaign design, automated execution, validation, and completion.

Automation & Tooling

Build and extend PME's internal automation platforms — leveraging AI-assisted code modification, rule-based transformations, and batch orchestration — to scale the team's impact across the fleet with speed and reliability.

Technical Design

Write clear, well-researched design documents. Identify and communicate tradeoffs between migration approaches and drive decisions with data and stakeholder input.

Cross-Functional Partnership

Embed with partner teams driving the most crucial infrastructure-level strategic initiatives to deeply understand migration needs, de-risk project execution, and ensure campaigns land successfully with minimal customer toil.

Paved Path Advocacy

Proactively identify opportunities to improve Paved Path adoption and adherence. Surface patterns and systemic opportunities — then act on them. Influence product strategy and roadmaps of platform teams through direct engagement and data.

Operational Excellence

Instrument migrations with telemetry and dashboards. Monitor fleet health, track adoption rates, and build the feedback loops that continuously improve campaign design and execution.

Who You Are

A strong generalist engineer energized by scope and ambiguity — comfortable working across the full stack (backend services, automation pipelines, data models, dashboards) while building depth in the areas that matter most.

A systems thinker who understands that successful migrations are as much about people and process as they are about code — and designs solutions accordingly.

A self-directed owner who can take a high-priority, ambiguous challenge and drive it to completion across teams, time zones, and organizational boundaries.

Someone who builds customer trust through repeated, low-drama delivery. You communicate proactively, course-correct quickly, and leave things better than you found them.

A pragmatic builder who defaults to automation and reuse, builds tools that generalize beyond a single use case, and knows when to ship fast vs. when to invest in durability.

Required Experience

Strong backend engineering skills, with demonstrated ability to build and operate production services at scale (experience in Java or Python is a plus)
Proven experience navigating and operating within large, complex infrastructure ecosystems — understanding service interdependencies, fleet-wide patterns, and the ripple effects of change at scale
Deep, hands-on experience with AI-driven solutions — not as a user, but as a builder. You follow where the technology is going, form opinions, and bring that edge into the work
Proven ability to drive complex, cross-functional technical projects from design through completion
Strong technical writing: design docs, tradeoff analyses, postmortems
Experience working with cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred: EC2, S3, EKS/Kubernetes)
Ability to navigate ambiguity, influence without authority, and partner effectively with senior stakeholders

Experience We'd Be Excited About

Experience with large-scale code migration or modernization campaigns
Demonstrated ability to build with or integrate LLMs and AI agents into engineering workflows — you have shipped AI-powered solutions, not just experimented with them
Experience building or operating fleet-management, dependency graph, or service catalog systems
Background in platform or infrastructure engineering organizations
Familiarity with Java or Python in a backend services context
Experience designing campaigns with measurable adoption and adherence metricsa

The Opportunity

For our research center in Kraków, Poland, we are looking for a Research Scientist with strong expertise in software architecture for industrial systems.

In this role, you will shape and develop next‑generation software solutions supporting the digital transformation of power systems. You will work at the intersection of research and real-world applications—translating advanced concepts into scalable, production‑ready architectures used in mission‑critical energy systems.

As part of Hitachi Energy’s global research organization, you will join a multidisciplinary team of experts in software engineering, power systems, and AI. You will collaborate closely with business units and external partners to rapidly ideate, prototype, and validate solutions that have direct impact on products and customers worldwide.

Based on-site in Kraków, you will benefit from a strong local research ecosystem while engaging in global collaboration across regions and business domains. This unique setup enables you to drive innovation end‑to‑end—from early research and proof‑of‑concepts to architecture design and technology transfer into real systems operating in the energy sector.

How You Will Make An Impact

Collaborate with a global team of researchers and engineers in Hitachi Energy business units to identify and solve software-related real-world challenges in power systems.
Propose, contribute to, and lead research projects related to the development of next-generation products and systems for power grid management, automation and control, IoT solutions, and mission-critical systems.
Contribute at different levels, from ideas and proof-of-concept software development to architect-level discussions.
Create software solutions based on various technology stacks, in cooperation with multidisciplinary teams across the entire Hitachi Energy organization.
Propose, validate, discuss, and document technical solution concepts.
Build networks across the company and actively share your knowledge and expertise.
Collaborate with local and global external partners, including universities, open-source communities, startups, and vendors.
Disseminate results through scientific publications, patent applications, and technical reports.

Your Background

Master’s or PhD degree, or equivalent industrial experience, in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
Experience in the architecting,designing and development of software-intensive industrial products and systems.
Expertise in at least a few of the following domains: IoT edge solutions, Real-time systems, Embedded products, OS/kernel/driver development and tuning, Industrial networks

Programming experience (e.g., Python, C++, C#, Java, Rust, shell)
Deep knowledge of SW architecture theory, methods and tools, ideally with publication track record
Willingness to combine conceptual activities with hands-on work
Willingness to take an interdisciplinary approach, working with experts from domains beyond your own area of expertise
Experience that demonstrates a team-oriented, innovative, and strategic working style
Fluency in English, both written and spoken

In addition, the following skills would be beneficial for the role:

Collaborative development and code quality practices in Azure DevOps or GitHub
Agile delivery and iterative development practices
Familiarity with data engineering solutions, on-premises and cloud-based
Knowledge of, and experience with, products and systems for power grids, green energy, and related fields
Basics of hardware development or electronics
Proven track record of publishing research in reputable scientific journals and conferences
Strong communication skills to effectively present research findings to both technical and non-technical audiences

new_jobs.description:
Posting Type

Remote

Job Overview

WHO WE ARE

Relativity is a leading legal data intelligence company building technology that helps users organize data, discover the truth, and act on it with confidence. Our AI-powered, cloud platform, RelativityOne, transforms massive volumes of complex information into actionable insights for litigation, investigations, regulatory inquiries, data breach responses, and other high-stakes legal work where accuracy and trust are crucial.

The world’s largest law firms, corporations, and government agencies rely on Relativity’s legal AI software to securely surface and manage the most relevant and impactful information in their matters. Beyond our commercial impact, we are committed to expanding access to technology and supporting pro bono legal work.

What We Do

At Relativity, engineers do more than write code - they build systems that enable users to uncover insights from complex data at scale using cloud-native architecture, AI, and modern tools.

About The Role

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Engineering Platform team, where you will help build the cloud-native backbone that powers Relativity’s development ecosystem. You will work on high-impact initiatives that shape how our engineers build, test, deploy, and scale software—driving technical excellence across the company.

As part of a growing and financially stable organization, you will contribute in a dynamic, fast-moving environment that values autonomy, ownership, and practical action over excessive process. Platform engineers are trusted to solve complex problems at scale and empowered to make decisions that improve the day-to-day experience of developers.

Job Description And Requirements

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Design, build, and operate scalable, secure, and reliable platform services and developer tooling using .NET and Microsoft Azure
Lead the development of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) components to automate and standardize cloud infrastructure
Drive adoption of DevOps practices and CI/CD automation across engineering teams
Collaborate with internal stakeholders to build reusable capabilities that improve development speed and consistency
Integrate observability, performance monitoring, and self-service tooling into the platform ecosystem
Mentor and support engineers through code reviews, technical discussions, and knowledge sharing
Proactively identify improvement areas, experiment with solutions, and deliver results with a bias toward action
Contribute to initiatives that embed AI/ML into platform services and developer workflows

Required

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

5+ years of software development experience with strong expertise in C# and the .NET ecosystem
Deep hands-on experience with Azure services and cloud-native application patterns
Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates
Experience building or supporting CI/CD systems and modern DevOps pipelines
Familiarity with containers and orchestration tools such as Docker, Kubernetes, or AKS
Demonstrated success working in Agile teams and collaborating cross-functionally
Strong problem-solving, communication, and mentorship skills

Preferred

Exposure to AI/ML tools or interest in applying AI to platform and engineering challenges

WHY WE COULD BE A GREAT FIT

Impactful Mission

Build systems that help customers organize data, discover the truth, and act on it in high-stakes legal matters.

Engineering at Scale

Work on distributed, cloud-native systems that process large volumes of data.

Cutting-Edge Technology

Build with AI, cloud platforms, and scalable architectures shaping legal tech.

Growth and Ownership

Gain experience owning systems end-to-end across cloud and distributed environments.

Collaborative Culture

Work in a team focused on knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.

Inclusive Environment

Diverse perspectives create stronger teams and better outcomes.

Compensation And Benefits

Competitive salary, benefits, DTO, parental leave, and equity program.

Relativity is committed to competitive, fair, and equitable compensation practices.

This position is eligible for total compensation which includes a competitive base salary, an annual performance bonus, and long-term incentives.

The expected salary range for this role is between following values:

208 000 and 312 000PLN

The final offered salary will be based on several factors, including but not limited to the candidate's depth of experience, skill set, qualifications, and internal pay equity. Hiring at the top end of the range would not be typical, to allow for future meaningful salary growth in this position.

Required Skills

Automation, Data Analysis, Database Management, Network Architecture, Performance Optimizations, Problem Solving, Project Management, Software Development, System Designs, Technical Leadership

Project Description:

The project is part of the Credit, Asset-backed & Securitized Products (CASP) division of an investment bank, focusing on platforms that support securitization and structured finance products. The current primary objective is migrating existing on-premise systems to a modern Microsoft Azure cloud environment, transforming legacy architecture into scalable, cloud-native solutions. It involves rebuilding and adapting systems used for structuring, processing, and distributing securities such as ABS, MBS, and CLOs. The platform integrates with trading, risk, and regulatory systems to support both real-time and batch data processing. The target architecture follows a microservices-based approach with containerized services deployed on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS). Infrastructure provisioning and configuration are managed using Terraform as Infrastructure as Code. The system leverages REST APIs and event-driven communication to ensure scalability and flexibility during and after migration. Special focus is placed on maintaining data consistency, performance, and regulatory compliance throughout the transition. The project emphasizes high availability, resilience, and observability in a complex financial ecosystem. AI-assisted development tools like GitHub Copilot are integrated to enhance engineering productivity. The environment promotes modern engineering practices, automation, and continuous improvement.

Use Terraform to define and manage infrastructure as code.

Experience building and running containerized applications

new_jobs.description:
Vi tror att framsteg och möjligheter skapas bäst tillsammans. Välkommen till en plats där samarbete gör skillnad.

Din roll

Ta chansen att bli en del av vårt engagerade team inom delprojektet Digital Map Generating System (DMGS) / Geodata inom JAS Gripen i rollen som mjukvaruutvecklare.

Vi är en central resurs som har expertis inom GIS, geodata och aeronautisk information. Geodata är en viktig del av de flesta av Saabs produkter och tjänster inom flyg, försvar och säkerhet. DMGS är ett egenutvecklat verktyg baserat på ESRI ArcMap för att behandla, kvalitetssäkra och producera Geodata till Gripen samt dess stöd- och träningssystem.

I rollen som mjukvaruutvecklare ingår t.ex. uppgifter som att arbeta fram kreativa lösningar kring överenskommen kravbild tillsammans med angränsande system. Planering, testning och möjligheten att kommunicera utvecklad funktion till intressenter kan också vara en del av arbetet.

Under funktionsutvecklingen kommer du samtidigt att få lära dig om hur vårt data och system kravställs, utvecklas, testas och distribueras; både i form av geografiska data till flygplan, till 3D-omvärldar för Gripens simulatorer samt till andra intressanta system.

Teamet består idag av roller som uppdragsledare, systemingenjörer och mjukvaruutvecklare och kännetecknas av en trevlig stämning och en god kultur av att hjälpa och lära av varandra.

Det finns en stor möjlighet till att anpassa dagarna med varierade arbetsuppgifter och även möjligheter att få delta på konferenser som sker utomlands.

Din närmsta chef är utbildad coach och om du brinner för personlig utveckling finns det stora möjligheter. Du erbjuds möjligheten att genomföra både interna och externa utbildningar.

Din profil

Kunskap inom C#.NET; gärna även inom WPF, Async Await och TPL.
Du har erfarenhet kring AI i kombination med programmering
Kunskap att se helheten och förstå hur olika delar av ett system interagerar. Detta är kritiskt för att designa skalbara och underhållbara system.
Förmågan att identifiera, analysera och lösa komplexa problem.
Förmågan att kommunicera tekniska koncept på ett sätt som är förståeligt för både tekniska och icke-tekniska teammedlemmar. Detta inkluderar dokumentation och presentationer.
Förmågan att säkerställa att mjukvaran uppfyller högsta kvalitetsstandarder. Inkluderar även testning, säkerhet och prestandaoptimering.
Förmågan att arbeta effektivt i ett team och har en bra kommunikativ approach
Applikationer: MS Visual Studio, ESRI ArcMap, ESRI ArcGIS Pro

Befattningen kräver att du genomgår och godkänns enligt vid var tid gällande bestämmelser för säkerhetsskydd. För befattningar där Saab har krav på säkerhetsklassinplacering kan, i förekommande fall, medföra krav på visst medborgarskap.

Vad blir du en del av

Upptäck oändliga möjligheter. Anta utmaningar, skapa smarta innovationer och uppgradera dina förmågor. Det här är en plats för kluriga tänkare, modiga pionjärer och alla däremellan. Tillsammans uppnår vi det extraordinära, var och en tar med sitt unika perspektiv. Varje bidrag räknas.

Saab är ett ledande försvars- och säkerhetsföretag med syfte att hjälpa nationer att skydda sin befolkning och bidra till trygghet för människor och samhällen. Med 28 000 talangfulla medarbetare utvecklar Saab teknik och lösningar för en säkrare och mer hållbar värld.

Saab utvecklar, tillverkar och underhåller avancerade system inom flygteknik, vapen, ledningssystem, sensorer och undervattenssystem. Saab har sitt huvudkontor i Sverige men en global verksamhet där Saab är en del av många nationers försvarsförmåga. Läs mer om oss här

The Role

We are looking for a mid-level full-stack developer with a strong sense of ownership and genuine curiosity. You will work across a suite of applications built primarily with .NET, running in Docker-based environments. That means taking features from start to finish, contributing to architectural decisions, and helping improve how the team works.

Day to day, that means building and maintaining backend services in C#, developing front-end components in TypeScript, designing REST APIs, and operating services with Docker and Docker Compose. You will also contribute to infrastructure automation and internal tooling as the need arises.

We are AI-first in practice, not just in name. We actively use AI-assisted development workflows and expect that to deepen over time. The landscape shifts fast, and we are not waiting to see where it lands. We are building with it now. That means we want someone who is genuinely curious about these tools, experiments with them, and develops their own judgment about when and how to use them well.

Why Maranics

Most people spend years executing other people's decisions. At Maranics, you own the outcome. We are a small team building a tool that changes how businesses run in practice. Not prototypes, not internal tools that get quietly abandoned. When something ships here, you feel it.

Because we are small, your work is visible and the people who depend on it are not three teams away. We are genuinely AI-first, and we are building the kind of team that develops real judgment on real problems. Growth here is not rationed. When you are ready for more, you take it.

What We Are Looking For

You have 2–4 years of professional software development experience, solid .NET backend skills, and practical front-end experience. You are comfortable with Docker, Git-based workflows, and taking full ownership of a feature. A good grasp of software architecture fundamentals is important, as is strong written and spoken English.

Experience with CI/CD, infrastructure automation, or AI-assisted development tools is a plus. So is having worked in a small, distributed team before. You will know what that feels like.

Who This Is For

This role suits someone who wants more than ticket execution, who notices things, communicates openly, and cares about the outcome. If you want to build real things in a small remote team where your work has visible impact and your name is attached to it, this role will fit.

Practical Information

Location: Maranics is based in Gothenburg and the role works well hybrid, with flexibility on how often you are in the office.

About Maranics

Maranics builds a platform that digitalises operational workflows in complex, regulated industries. Full stack or backend software development.
Java and Spring Boot.

Microservices and RESTful APIs.
Relational databases and distributed data stores.

AWS and Azure cloud platforms.
Automated testing, CI/CD, observability, and production readiness.
Data intensive and analytics driven applications.
Databricks, Spark, experience.

new_jobs.title: Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)
new_jobs.description:
About Ministry Brands

Ministry Brands is a leading provider of SaaS operational management systems, payments platforms, digital engagement tools and background screening solutions for purpose-driven organisations. We serve more than 95,000 customers as a trusted partner in digital transformation and enablement – advancing missions, driving efficiencies, and building engaged communities for more than four decades.

Our Galway R&D centre is Ministry Brands' global AI R&D hub and is in the middle of a major expansion as we deliver a multi-year AI-native transformation of our product portfolio.

About The Role

Are you passionate about software quality and innovation? We’re looking for a talented Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to join our growing engineering team. In this role, you’ll play a critical part in ensuring the quality and reliability of our products—leveraging cutting-edge AI tools to automate and enhance testing processes, and supporting the delivery of next-generation agentic products to market.

You’ll work with cross-functional teams to design and implement scalable, high-quality automated tests, while championing best practices and promoting a culture of excellence.

What You’ll Do

Leverage AI tools (e.g., Copilot) to assist in the creation of test cases, unit tests, UI tests, and performance tests—accelerating automation and increasing coverage.
Develop comprehensive testing strategies for AI-based products, including testing agent responses, evaluating model reliability, validating data inputs and outputs, and ensuring overall system performance.
Design, build, and maintain automated test frameworks using C#, Python, and/or TypeScript.
Implement and maintain automated testing frameworks and tools.
Develop and execute contract testing (e.g., PACT testing) to ensure seamless integration with external APIs and services.
Conduct manual testing where required, including functional, exploratory, regression, integration, and end-to-end testing, to identify issues that may not be captured through automated testing.
Collaborate closely with developers to understand requirements and identify potential issues early in the development lifecycle.
Conduct thorough code reviews and provide constructive feedback to peers.
Participate in all phases of the software development lifecycle—from planning and design to release and maintenance.
Promote a culture of quality by advocating for best practices and continuous improvement throughout the development process.

What You Bring

Proven experience using AI tools for test creation and execution, improving efficiency and accuracy in test automation.
Experience developing QA strategies for AI-based products, including evaluating agent responses and ensuring model fairness and scalability.
Strong hands-on experience with both manual and automated software testing, with the ability to determine the appropriate testing approach based on the feature, risk, and requirements.
Strong programming skills in C#, Python, and TypeScript.
Hands-on experience with automated testing frameworks and tools.
Experience with contract testing and tools like PACT.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams.

Bonus Points

Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP).
Experience with performance and security testing.
Familiarity with Agile development methodologies.

Who You Are

Experienced: Proven track record in software development and testing.
Independent: Self-motivated and capable of working with minimal supervision.
Adaptable: Thrives in fast-paced environments with changing priorities.
Leadership Potential: Demonstrates a willingness to mentor and guide others, and to contribute to technical discussions.

What's In It For You

At Ministry Brands, we invest in our people and provide the support, flexibility, and opportunities you need to do your best work and grow your career.

Hybrid working model based from our Galway office.
25 days annual leave plus public holidays.
100% employer-paid private health insurance, including cover for dependents.
Dental coverage.
Employer-matched pension scheme.
Income protection and life assurance.
Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) and wellbeing initiatives.
Career development through mentorship, professional training, and certification opportunities.
Galway gym membership.
Annual volunteer day.
Amazing company culture.

new_jobs.title: Engineering Manager (Hybrid)
new_jobs.description:
About Us:

A global SaaS leader for seamless digital document workflows, Nitro offers a suite of solutions for PDF, eSigning, identity verification and analytics supported by a best-in-class customer success and change management team. With more than 3 million licensed users and 13,000+ business customers across 157 countries, we serve 67% of the Fortune 500.

How We Work:

We aim to create an environment where talented individuals are empowered to excel. How we collaborate, innovate, and engage with one another is important to us. Our work is driven by 5 key principles:

One team, One mission Our collective dedication to Nitro's mission defines us. Together, we are building an environment where everyone feels like a valued part of something bigger than themselves.
Own it We take full ownership of our actions and decisions. We empower one another to lead with confidence, creativity, and a solutions-focused mindset.
Accountable to our customers We are dedicated to our customers and take our commitments seriously. We do what we say we are going to do.
Excellence in execution Driven by passion and precision, we exemplify excellence in our delivery with innovative, top-quality results.
Be bold, fail fast, learn faster We learn as we grow, dare to try, and bravely question. We are not chasing perfection but forever iterating towards it.

These guiding values shape our approach to work, fostering a culture where everyone is inspired to contribute their best.

The Role:

We are seeking an experienced, driven, and customer-focused Engineering Manager to lead our team of skilled engineers in the development and delivery of Nitro's Sign product, API and integrations.

The ideal candidate will have a relentless focus on delivering an exceptional user experience, have a strong technical background, proven leadership abilities, and experience in managing teams operating under Agile and Scrum frameworks. You will play a pivotal role in driving team performance, ensuring high-quality software delivery, and fostering a collaborative and innovative engineering culture.

Key Responsibilities

Lead, mentor, and inspire a team of front-end, back-end and QA engineers, taking accountability for delivery across your team.
Actively foster a high bar for engineering excellence with a culture of continuous improvement, collaboration, and accountability.
Encourage and enable a customer-centric mindset within the team, working closely with our product and partner teams to develop solutions that exceed our customer expectations.
Support professional growth through regular feedback, coaching, and performance reviews.
Partner with senior engineers in your area to drive technical initiatives that raise the bar for our engineering practices.
Lead communication with stakeholders from other teams, creating focused space for engineers to do their best work.
Collaborate with the wider engineering organisation to contribute to and improve company-wide best managerial and technical practices and standards.
Champion and implement modern development practices and workflows to maximize team efficiency and transparency, using metrics to identify process improvements and make data driven decisions.
Align engineering efforts with business goals, product vision, and technical strategy.
Proactively identify risks, dependencies, and mitigation plans.

Required Skills And Qualifications

3-5+ years as an Engineering Manager in a software development environment with direct experience leading cross functional teams.
Strong understanding of application development and release management.
Experience working on APIs and enterprise integrations is a plus.
Track record of shipping user focused applications and products.
Hands-on experience with modern development practices such as CI/CD, unit testing, and version control (Git).
Proven experience leading teams using Agile and/or Scrum methodologies.
Ability to quickly build trust, motivate, mentor, and develop high-performing teams.
Strong communication, organizational, and decision-making skills.
Ability to work with a diverse set of teams and individuals with various working styles to drive clarity, make decisions and simply get things done.
Experience working cross-functionally with Product, Design, QA and marketing teams.

Why Nitro?

Along With Our Regular Benefits And Programs (including Health, Dental, Vision, And Retirement As Standard), We Are Also Very Proud To Offer a Few Additional Initiatives To Future Nitronauts:

Flex Time Off

Work-life balance is important at Nitro, and we understand that there are events that we cannot plan for. We are proud to offer Flex Time Off to be used for holidays, spending days with your family, or appointments.

Hybrid Work

Our team embraces the hybrid work model, appreciating its blend of flexibility and structure. We combine three days of in-person collaboration at our global offices in Toronto, Dublin, Antwerp, Porto, and Melbourne with the convenience of two days of remote work each week.

Benefits:

Nitro provides all employees with a comprehensive benefits package that includes health insurance, dental and vision coverage, and wellness perks. We also offer pension/401k matching, along with many other country-specific benefits.

Nitro strongly encourages applications from everyone regardless of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. We provide an accessible candidate experience and invite you to request any accommodations or adjustments throughout the interview process and beyond.

new_jobs.title: Senior Developer – C# .Net
new_jobs.description:
Are you an experienced C# .Net developer looking for the next big challenge?

We are on the lookout for someone like you to be part of a team of developers managing applications that are critical to both our business and our customers.

About The Role

We are looking for a Senior Developer to take a leading role in driving the evolution of our Norwegian applications that support the core systems. These systems are very important to our business operations, and we’re seeking someone who can lead their continued development with technical excellence.

In this role, you’ll collaborate closely with key stakeholders including the Product Owner, Tribe Architect, IT Delivery Manager, and the Mainframe Centre of Excellence. Together, you’ll ensure that our solutions are aligned with If’s architectural principles. You will also have the opportunity to guide and mentor a team of skilled developers.

This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of the applications that support the core systems, contribute to modernizing legacy platforms, and make a lasting impact on how we deliver value to our customers.

Key Responsibilities

Lead the technical delivery within the Yggdrasil squad, ensuring design, development, and maintenance of stable and secure solutions.
Translate business requirements into efficient technical solutions.
Act as a bridge between business experts, technical developers in Norway and India, and architectural teams.
Ensure consistent coding standards, version control, security and documentation practices.
Drive adoption of modern engineering practices, including CI/CD, automated testing and monitoring.
Drive modernization activities such as API enablement for integration between cloud-based and mainframe systems and data replication using Change Data Capture (CDC).
Ensure optimal usage and cost management of Azure resources.

We offer

Benefits

In the same way that we place high demands on you as an employee, we also expect you to place high demands on us as an employer. Here are some of the benefits of working at If:

An including work environment where everyone is welcome
Career and development opportunities in the biggest insurance company in the Nordics
Social activities, as well as highly skilled professional environment
Possibility of hybrid workplace
Health promoting workplace with e.g., wellness allowance and various sports activities
Great insurance benefits
Weekly workout hour
High pension savings

About The Team

The Core Tribe is responsible for maintaining and evolving our business-critical insurance and claims systems. The Tribe operates cross-functionally across Finland and Norway, organized into smaller squads combining business domain experts with IT professionals.

Our IT development teams include colleagues from If’s internal IT units as well as strategic partners such as Tata Consultancy Services, ensuring seamless collaboration across Norway and India.

Yggdrasil squad is one of the squads in the Core Tribe. The mission of this squad is to ensure the ecosystems of applications supporting the Policy and Claims systems within the Norwegian scope is viable, healthy and stable. As the Senior Developer for this squad, you’ll be responsible for maintaining and developing this ecosystem and strengthening our squad technical capabilities.

Who are you?

You are a technically strong and forward-thinking developer with a passion for quality and long-term solutions. You bring deep technical expertise and strong communication skills that enable you to develop effective, maintainable solutions and you collaborate well across roles.

You also take ownership of your work and continuously look for ways to improve. You understand the bigger picture, think with a long-term and solution-oriented mindset, and bring an architectural perspective when designing and evaluating solutions. In addition, you work in a collaborative, transparent, and pragmatic way when solving problems.

In Terms Of Technical Experience, You Have

Solid experience with C#, .NET, and Azure application development and maintenance.
Familiarity with enterprise solutions, REST APIs, and message-based architecture.
Good knowledge and practical use of Infrastructure as Code (for example Terraform or Bicep).
Hands-on experience with tools such as Azure DevOps and CI/CD pipelines.
Experience with static code and security analysis tools such as SonarQube and Snyk.
Experience applying OWASP Top 10 in design, development, and risk assessment of applications.
Experience with authentication and authorization solutions including OAuth2, Curity and Identity Providers.

It´s a Plus If You Have

Experience working in an Agile setup, collaborating closely with product owners and business stakeholders.
Python and Databricks competence.
Familiarity with integration patterns between distributed systems and IBM z Mainframe.
Experience with monitoring and observability using Dynatrace, Application Insights, Splunk or similar tools.
Understanding of basic networking concepts including firewall rules and ability to use Wireshark for troubleshooting when needed.

Additional Facts And The Recruitment Process

Application deadline:
Screening and interviewing will start immediately. However, application deadline is September 30th 2026.

To apply for the position:
Please attach your CV and answer the questions in the recruitment system

Work location:
Oslo, Norway

Travelling:
Some travelling might be involved

Start:
As soon as possible, or by agreement.

For more information, please contact Santhosh Kumar, IT Deliver Manager, santhosh.kumar@if.no

We use Semac for background checks for the final candidates. It is a requirement for the position that If’s extended fit & proper requirements, including background checks, can be met.

We look forward to your application!

new_jobs.description:

We’ve officially launched Vivicta, your trusted Nordic transformation partner, making everyday easier through technology. You can explore more about our brand and what we stand for at https://www.vivicta.com

Ready to join us? Click ‘Apply’ and complete our short application form to get started. Prefer another option? Apply via LinkedIn to automatically populate your details using your profile.

Brenner du for skyinfrastruktur og moderne plattformutvikling i Azure? Har du erfaring med å bygge og automatisere skyløsninger ved hjelp av Infrastructure as Code og CI/CD? Eller har du bakgrunn fra IT-infrastruktur og et ønske om å spisse deg innen sky og automatisering?

Vi styrker nå vårt fagmiljø innen cloud og plattform og ser etter en strukturert og selvgående teknisk konsulent som kan bidra i kundeprosjekter, rådgivning og utvikling av tjenester og plattformer.

Være en nøkkelressurs i design, implementering og videreutvikling av skyinfrastruktur i Azure
Være teknisk rådgiver og sparringspartner for kunder og kollegaer
Bidra til utvikling av gjenbrukbare moduler og beste praksis innen Infrastructure as Code
Drive automatisering gjennom CI/CD og moderne utviklingsprosesser
Samarbeide på tvers av utvikling, drift og plattformteam for å sikre skalerbare og sikre løsninger

Relevant Kompetanse Og Erfaring

Azure og skyinfrastruktur

Erfaring med Microsoft Azure og tjenester som Resource Groups, Storage Accounts, Key Vault, Virtual Networks, Private Endpoints og Azure Firewall.
Erfaring med Azure SQL, Function Apps, Event Grid, Managed Identities og RBAC

Erfaring med strukturering av miljøer (dev/test/prod)

Erfaring med GitHub og GitHub Actions
Kjennskap til workflows, reusable workflows og branch protection
Erfaring med pull request-prosesser, secrets/variables og deployment environments
Erfaring med automatisering av build, test og deploy

Automatisering og utvikling

Erfaring med scripting og automatisering (PowerShell, Bash eller Azure CLI)
Erfaring med Go er en fordel (for utvikling av interne verktøy eller plattformkomponenter)

Personlige Egenskaper

Kommuniserer godt på norsk og engelsk, både muntlig og skriftlig
Har interesse for å bygge fagmiljø og dele kunnskap
Trives med å jobbe både selvstendig og i team
Evner å forstå kundens behov og omsette dette til tekniske løsninger
Motiveres av å forenkle, automatisere og forbedre arbeidsmåter

Vi Tilbyr

Profesjonell vekst, meningsfulle prosjekter, åpen kultur og en god balanse mellom arbeid og fritid. Du får muligheten til å jobbe med moderne skyplattformer i en voksende og viktig sektor. Vi tilbyr en fleksibel hybrid arbeidsmodell og et miljø med fokus på kontinuerlig læring.

Vi ser frem til din søknad! Vennligst legg ved CV‑en din, så tar vi kontakt med deg. Intervjuer vil bli gjennomført kontinuerlig, så vi oppfordrer deg til å søke i dag. Hvis du har spørsmål angående denne rollen, vennligst kontakt ansettelsesleder Kristine.strom@vivicta.com

new_jobs.title: Solution Architect
new_jobs.description:
Are you a subject-matter-oriented Solution Architect ready to shape digital transformation in complex environments? Do you enjoy tackling business challenges in an international setting and collaborating closely with customers and fellow experts? Then this role might be just right for you.

Nortal is currently looking for a Solution Architect to join impactful projects with our enterprise customers. In this role, you will collaborate closely with both our customers and internal development teams, focusing on understanding business needs through active stakeholder discussions and shaping them into high-value solution opportunities. You play a key role in engaging with stakeholders, gathering and refining requirements, demonstrating solutions, and proactively identifying how we can best support business goals.

What you will do

Support customers in their digital transformation across areas such as data modelling and architecture, system integrations, platform modernization, and AI-driven solutions.
Engage in regular discussions with stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into actionable requirements.
Translate high-level architectural directions into concrete guidance for development teams.
Own and prioritize the backlog, ensuring alignment between business value and technical feasibility.
Produce documentation, technical diagrams, architectural notes, and decision records.
Work closely with developers to clarify technical implications, even if you don’t write code yourself.
Collaborate closely with Nortal colleagues, including development, project management, and data/architecture experts.

Our tech environment

In this role you don’t need to program hands-on, but a background in software engineering is essential. Technologies in use include Azure (Azure SQL, Functions, Data Lake, Container Apps etc.), MS Fabric, C#, React, and API management.

What will help you to succeed

Ability to understand business needs and ways of working, enabling smooth collaboration.
Solid technical understanding and ability to discuss architectural-level topics such as software and data architectures, integrations, and AI.
A background in software development (hands-on coding experience at some stage).
Ownership mindset and ability to drive initiatives forward.
Consultant-like approach: proactive, solution-oriented, comfortable in the client interface, willingness to ask questions.
Excellent communication skills in Finnish and English.

If you’re not yet familiar with Nortal, we are a global leader in strategic change and technology. Our 2,500+ employees worldwide share the vision of creating a better future through seamless digital transformation, and we're constantly on the lookout for new talents to join us on this journey. We maintain offices in Helsinki, Oulu, Turku, Jyväskylä, and Uusikaupunki. We highly value flexibility, giving you the option to work from home, your local office, or find a balance that suits your needs.

Why join us?

You’ll play a central role in driving digital transformation for our customers. You’ll gain broad visibility into complex ecosystems—and real ownership of key areas. You’ll work closely with a friendly and experienced team.
We value individuals not just for their skills, but also for their cultural alignment. Our core values include a commitment to delivering value and results, taking ownership, empowering oneself and others, and owning your future and growth. In addition to our professionalism, we appreciate a touch of good humor!
We prioritize your growth and development. At Nortal, we actively support constant improvement and knowledge sharing, both internal and external training opportunities, self-learning, a mentorship program, and strong 1:1 culture.
We prioritize your health and well-being by offering a flexible range of benefits, including adaptable working hours, access to high-quality occupational healthcare, massage services, and bicycle benefit. We are also a remote friendly company.

Salary range: 5200-7800€ / month (full-time). Final compensation will depend on factors such as relevant experience, role seniority, and skill set.

Please note that we will begin reviewing applications in week 31.

Nortal values equality and diversity in our work community. We welcome applicants with different backgrounds, such as in regard to age, gender, culture or minority group.

Haemme systeemi-insinööriä Tornion tehtaiden Tehdaspalveluiden Automaatio L2 -tiimiin.

Tehtävässä pääset työskentelemään monipuolisten ja liiketoiminnalle kriittisten tuotantoa ohjaavien tietojärjestelmien parissa osana kokeneiden asiantuntijoiden tiimiä. Työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä tuotannon, kehityksen, IT:n, ulkoisten toimittajien ja muiden sidosryhmien kanssa varmistaen järjestelmien korkean käytettävyyden, luotettavuuden ja jatkuvan kehittämisen teollisuuden toimintakriittisessä ympäristössä.

Job Description

Tule mukaan Tieto Tech Consulting -tiimiin ja kasva rooliasi laajemmaksi! Tarjoamme mahdollisuuden työskennellä monipuolisissa ja yhteiskunnallisesti merkityksellisissä projekteissa. Kehitämme palveluita, joita todennäköisesti käytät itsekin.

Etsimme AI kehittäjää tiimiimme. Kehitä uraasi ympäristössä, jossa yhdistyvät huipputeknologia, kannustavat kollegat sekä mahdollisuus liikkua joustavasti eri roolien, tiimien ja toimialojen välillä.

Mikä on Tech Consulting?

Tech Consulting on digitaalisen suunnittelun ja ohjelmistokehityksen yksikkö, jossa autamme asiakkaitamme kasvamaan yhdistämällä liiketoimintamuotoilun, teknologisen asiantuntemuksen ja modernin ohjelmistokehityksen.

Etsimme AI kehittäjää, jolla on vahva tekninen osaaminen ja konsultoiva työote. AI-agenttien ja avustajien hyödyntäminen omassa työssä sekä niiden käyttöönoton tukeminen

Ohjelmistokehityskokemusta (esim. Python), backend- / API-kehitystä sekä pilvinatiivien arkkitehtuurien tuntemusta (Docker, Kubernetes)

Sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa

Merkityksellistä työtä yhteiskunnallisesti tärkeiden digitaalisten ratkaisujen parissa
Pohjoismaisen, vastuullisen ja luottamukseen perustuvan työyhteisön
Mahdollisuuksia kehittää osaamistasi eri toimialoilla, teknologioissa ja rooleissa
Joustavat työskentelymallit, hyvinvointiedut ja aidosti ihmislähtöisen kulttuurin

Tieto rakentaa teknologiaa, joka toimii ihmisten hyväksi. Tieto Tech Consultingilla työskentelet teknologian, innovaation ja yhteiskunnallisen vaikuttavuuden rajapinnassa. Saat käyttöösi laajan IT-osaajaverkoston sekä kulttuurin, joka kannustaa yhteistyöhön, uteliaisuuteen ja jatkuvaan oppimiseen. Meillä kasvu ei pysähdy.

new_jobs.description:
SYBO
is part of the Miniclip family and known for the widely popular game, Subway Surfers - the most downloaded mobile game in the world, with over four and a half billion downloads. Located in the heart of Copenhagen, we aim to create playful moments that inspire our fans to care.

Hundreds of millions of players play Subway Surfers
each month, and enjoy smooth gameplay, new features and a concept that’s now worked for over fourteen (Yes, 14!) years - and we’re looking for a talented Game Engineer
to keep the fun going for years to come.

As a Game Engineer on Subway Surfers, you’ll work closely with engineers, designers, artists, and other disciplines to take ideas from concept through implementation and into the hands of the above-mentioned hundreds of millions of players. You’ll have the opportunity to take ownership, contribute to technical decisions, and help us continuously improve both the game and the way we build it.

Working with LiveOps lets you get instant feedback on your work - working with one of the largest LiveOps games makes it unique. Read below and get in touch!

Responsibilities

Develop and maintain gameplay features, systems, and content for Subway Surfers using Unity and C#
Collaborate with Designers, Artists, and other Engineers to take features from concept through implementation and release
Write clean, maintainable code and contribute to the long-term health of the Subway Surfers codebase
Review code and collaborate with other Engineers to share knowledge and maintain engineering quality
Debug and resolve technical issues across gameplay systems and live features
Contribute to improving the tools, workflows, and development practices used by the team

Life at SYBO

In your first month, you’ll get to know SYBO, Subway Surfers, our technology, and how the team works. You’ll work closely with the Technical Owner, Engineers, Designers, and Artists on the game team, familiarize yourself with the codebase and development pipeline, and start contributing to your first features.
In your first three months, you’ll be contributing independently to features and content and taking an active role in the team’s development process. You’ll participate in technical discussions around implementation, system design, and architecture and become increasingly comfortable working across the Subway Surfers codebase.
In your first twelve months, you’ll be a trusted and impactful member of the Subway Surfers team, contributing to the development of features and content from planning through release and helping shape technical solutions for the game - and you’ve received plenty of player feedback on things you’ve worked on!

Requirements

Strong knowledge of OOP languages, primarily C#
Professional experience developing games, ideally on mobile
Solid hands-on experience with Unity
Good understanding of software engineering principles, data structures, algorithms, and common design patterns
Experience collaborating with multiple disciplines to develop and deliver game features
Experience working with version control systems such as Git
Experience working in Agile methodologies

Bonus points

Experience working on a live game and regularly shipping new features and content
Experience developing or integrating client/server features and backend services

About SYBO

We're SYBO, the mobile games studio behind the legendary Subway Surfers, with over 4.5 billion downloads worldwide! Join our team in the heart of Copenhagen, where creativity flourishes in our new, state-of-the-art studio.

If you join us, you'll have the opportunity to dive into exciting and creative projects alongside a diverse group of like-minded colleagues from over 40 countries across the globe.

We truly believe you perform your best, when you have the equipment you need - and our IT team is always on hand to ensure you have access to the latest tools and gear, enabling you to be at your best - even remotely with a home-office budget!

We also pride ourselves in taking care of your well-being, offering a delicious lunch buffet, a variety of healthy snacks, and regular social events to keep the energy flowing.

SYBO is committed to providing equal opportunities to all applicants, regardless of race, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Microsoft, AWS, or other relevant cloud certifications.
Experience from the Financial Services industry.

What you can expect:

Entrepreneurial spirit and people-centric growth – We embrace an entrepreneurial mindset where dedication and teamwork are keys to our success. Commitment and quality – We value those who actively contribute to shaping an environment where everyone is seen, heard, and engaged. With a long-term commitment and a dedication to quality in everything we do, we are creating something lasting—for our clients, our team, and our workplace.  
Professional & personal growth – We invest in our people. Through regular discussions with your development manager, formal trainings and hands-on project work, we’ll support your personal and professional development every step of the way.  
Competitive salary, benefits & flexible work options – We offer a competitive salary and benefits, along with hybrid working options to promote a healthy work-life balance. Our centrally located office offers a dynamic space for focus, collaboration, and connection.

Its remit spans the full engineering lifecycle, from technical design and delivery through to production ownership and continuous improvement.

Secure Software Development: Define Tech org-wide application security and engineering risk strategy.

Act as a senior technology leader and trusted partner to business and technology stakeholders, influencing strategic decisions and positioning engineering as a driver of resilience, innovation, and competitive advantage.

Experience: Extensive experience in senior software engineering, platform engineering or technology leadership roles, with accountability for multiple engineering teams, senior leaders or enterprise platforms in complex, high-availability environments.

You will work on technology that underpins critical market infrastructure, where engineering decisions have direct consequences for the business, its customers and the markets it serves. Not many engineering roles carry that weight.
The mandate is real. You will shape how platforms are engineered, owned and evolved, and what software engineering becomes at SGX Group. Could that be you?

Your mission

As a Principal Software Engineer, you will help define and evolve the technical strategy for cloud services that power critical automation capabilities across the UiPath platform. You will lead architecture and design across complex backend and distributed systems, often working through ambiguity, dependencies, and cross-team impact. You will help teams make the right technical tradeoffs across scalability, reliability, security, customer experience, operational excellence, and cloud cost, while setting engineering standards that support UiPath’s current and future growth.

What You'll Do At UiPath

Lead the architecture and technical direction of complex backend and cloud-native services across the UiPath platform.
Design scalable, secure, reliable, and high-performing distributed systems across cloud, on-premises, and hybrid environments.
Partner with engineering leaders, architects, product managers, and cross-functional teams to shape technical solutions for high-impact product and platform areas.
Drive technical planning and roadmap input for complex services, platform capabilities, or cross-team initiatives.
Identify long-term scalability, reliability, security, performance, and cost challenges, and lead the design of sustainable solutions.
Set high standards for system design, code quality, testing, observability, automation, incident management, and engineering excellence.
Mentor and guide engineers through design reviews, technical discussions, architecture decisions, and hands-on technical feedback.

What You'll Bring To The Team

7+ years of software engineering experience, with strong backend and cloud development experience.
Hands-on experience with one or more modern programming languages such as C#, Java, Python, or Go.
Strong experience designing and building distributed systems, microservices, APIs, and cloud-native architectures.
Proven ability to influence technical direction and drive architecture decisions across teams.
Experience building and operating production-grade services in cloud environments such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.
Good knowledge of containers, Kubernetes, CI/CD, monitoring, logging, observability, and production operations.
Strong understanding of system design, data structures, algorithms, multithreading, asynchronous programming, and performance optimization.
Experience with relational and/or NoSQL databases, messaging systems, event-driven architectures, or high-scale data processing.
